questions.section: शुक्र और आर्तव का स्वरूप व विकार

questions.q: By unit 15, with what does the vātodara subside?
optionExplain: Pitta-increasing measures belong to unit 14.
The gulma treatment is the advice of unit 14.
No Kapha remedy is named here.
Right: वातौपशमनैः उपशाम्यति: it subsides with Vāta-pacifying (ones).
questions.explain: That (vātodara) subsides with Vāta-pacifying (ones).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these words of unit 15 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Sometimes … vātodara occurs; that subsides with Vāta-pacifying (ones).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 15 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four words carry the two clauses: what occurs, and how it subsides.
questions.teaches: वातोदर = वात + उदर: a belly (swelling) from Vāta, a probable identification.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of वातौपशमनैः is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + औ gives औ: वात + औपशमनैः → वातौपशमनैः.
पशमनैः is not a word of the card.
अ + उ would give ओ: वातोपशमनैः.
आ + उ would give ओ, not औ.
questions.explain: वात (Vāta) + औपशमनैः (by pacifying ones).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which does unit 15 state?
options: It needs the treatment of gulma
optionExplain: Right: कदाचित् … वातोदरं भवति.
Right: वातौपशमनैः उपशाम्यति.
That is unit 14's advice for the lifeless thing.
The unit names Vāta, not Pitta.
questions.explain: The unit says vātodara sometimes occurs and subsides with Vāta-pacifying (ones).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of वातौपशमन, how is वन + औषधि written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + औ does not give ओ.
Right: अ + औ → औ, as in वात + औपशमन.
No व् is inserted after अ.
अ + औ does not split into आ + उ.
questions.explain: वात + औपशमन → वातौपशमन; so वन + औषधि → वनौषधि.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before औ merges into औ (वृद्धि vowel stays).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 16, how does the belly look when the held-back ārtava increases it?
options: As if struck by a blow
As if occupied by an embryo
optionExplain: No blow is named in the unit.
Pus is not named in this unit.
Right: गर्भाधिष्ठितम् इव: as if an embryo were in it.
No poison is named in this unit.
questions.explain: It increases the belly, free of complications, as if occupied by an embryo.
questions.rule: इव = as if; गर्भाधिष्ठित = occupied by an embryo.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 16 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Subject, then the cause of holding back, then held back, then the belly, then 'as if occupied by an embryo'.
questions.rule: आर्तव → आहारविहार → स्तम्भित → उदर → गर्भाधिष्ठित इव.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 16 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words describe the cause (gentle, bulk-promoting diets and regimens); two describe the result.
questions.teaches: बृंहण means bulk-promoting, nourishing: such diets and regimens hold the ārtava back.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 16, what holds the ārtava back?
optionExplain: In unit 14 these make it flow, not stop.
Vāta-pacifying (ones) belong to unit 15.
Those make the blood flow in unit 18.
Right: सौम्यैः बृंहणात्मभिः आहारविहारैः स्तम्भितम्.
questions.explain: The ārtava is held back by gentle diets and regimens of a bulk-promoting nature.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: What does the word इव tell us about the belly in unit 16?
options: It only looks occupied by an embryo
It truly holds a living embryo
It holds two embryos at once
It shrinks after a few days
optionExplain: Right: इव = as if: the likeness is in looks only.
इव marks a likeness, not a fact.
Nothing of the kind is said.
The verb says it grows (वर्धयति).
questions.explain: गर्भाधिष्ठितम् इव: as if occupied by an embryo, so not truly.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: An invented line reads बालः सिंह इव गर्जति. What does it say?
options: The lion roars like a boy
The boy roars like a lion
The boy is a lion who roars
The boy roars at a lion
optionExplain: इव follows सिंह, so the lion is the likeness.
Right: इव after सिंह = like a lion.
इव makes it a likeness, not an identity.
No 'at' (object) is expressed.
questions.explain: As गर्भाधिष्ठितम् इव = as if occupied by an embryo, सिंह इव = like a lion.
questions.rule: X इव = like X, as if X.
questions.teaches: इव follows the word it compares with: X इव = like X.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 17, who call the woman pregnant?
optionExplain: No physician is named in this line.
No midwife is named in this line.
Right: मूढाः आहुः: the deluded say so.
No parent is named in this line.
questions.explain: The deluded call her pregnant though she is not.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 17 in their order.
questions.explain: Because of which, her (not pregnant), pregnant they call, the deluded.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 17 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The four words make the line: because of which the deluded call her pregnant.
questions.teaches: आहुः is a plural verb: they say, they call; its subject here is मूढाः.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of आहुर्मूढाः is right?
optionExplain: आहुर is not the verb form; it is आहुः.
र्मूढाः is not a word.
म् + म would stay म्म, not र्म.
Right: Visarga after उ becomes र् before the voiced म.
questions.explain: आहुः (they call) + मूढाः (the deluded).
questions.rule: Visarga after उ → र् before a voiced sound.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 17, what does येन (because of which) point back to?
options: The belly grown as if pregnant
optionExplain: Right: Unit 16's swollen belly is what misleads them.
That is advice in unit 14, not a cause of the mistake.
Those calm the vātodara in unit 15.
The blood flows later, in unit 18.
questions.explain: The card takes येन as the appearance of unit 16: the belly grows as if occupied by an embryo.
questions.rule: येन = by which / because of which (unit 16).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of आहुर्मूढाः, how is गुरुः + वदति written when joined?
optionExplain: That is not a possible spelling.
Right: Visarga after उ → र् before the voiced व.
Visarga becomes स् only before त/थ.
The visarga does not drop after उ.
questions.explain: आहुः + मूढाः → आहुर्मूढाः; so गुरुः + वदति → गुरुर्वदति.
questions.teaches: A visarga after उ (or इ, ए ...) becomes र् before a voiced consonant.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 18, what do the ignorant say when they do not see the embryo's body?
options: It was never there at all
It was carried off by beings
optionExplain: The ignorant say nothing of Vāta here.
The ignorant do not say this; they blame beings (भूत).
Right: भूतहृतम् इति अज्ञाः ब्रुवते.
No such claim is made.
questions.explain: The ignorant say: carried off by beings (bhūta).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 18 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Cause of the flow, the flow, not seeing the body, the claim, the speakers.
questions.rule: विपरीतैः/यदृच्छया → प्रवृत्ते रक्ते → अपश्यन्तः → भूतहृतम् इति → अज्ञाः ब्रुवते.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 18 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words make up the claim and who makes it.
questions.teaches: अपश्यन्तः = not seeing (present participle, plural), describing the ignorant.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of भूतहृतमित्यज्ञाः is right?
optionExplain: इत्य and ज्ञाः are not the card's words.
भूतहृतमि is not a word.
यज्ञाः would mean sacrifices; the word is अज्ञाः.
Right: म् joins the vowel; इ + अ → य: इत्यज्ञाः.
questions.explain: भूतहृतम् (carried off by beings) + इति (thus) + अज्ञाः (the ignorant).
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 18, how may the blood come to flow?
optionExplain: Right: विपरीतैः.
Right: यदृच्छया.
Those calm the vātodara in unit 15.
Those held the ārtava back in unit 16.
questions.explain: The blood flows through contrary (ones) or by chance (वा = or).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Built like प्रवृत्ते रक्ते, what does उदिते सूर्ये mean?
options: The sun is going to rise
By means of the rising sun
optionExplain: Right: Two locatives together give the time: when X has happened.
The pair gives a time, not a place in the light.
The participle उदित is past, not future.
That would need an instrumental, not a locative.
questions.explain: प्रवृत्ते रक्ते = when the blood flows; उदिते सूर्ये = when the sun has risen.
questions.rule: Noun + participle both in the locative = when (that happens).
questions.teaches: A noun and a participle together in the locative tell when something happens.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 19, what can rakṣas (demons) take away?
options: The whole body of the embryo
optionExplain: The unit says: not of the body.
Right: ओजसः अपहरणं रक्षोभिः सम्भवति.
Breast milk is not named here.
Semen is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The taking away of ojas by rakṣas occurs, but not of the body.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 19 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Since … occurs … the taking away of ojas … by rakṣas … but not of the body.
questions.rule: यस्मात् → सम्भवति → ओजसः अपहरणम् → रक्षोभिः → न तु कायस्य.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 19 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words carry the claim: ojas may be taken by demons, the body not.
questions.teaches: यस्मात् = since: the unit gives the reason against the claim of unit 18.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of ओजसोऽपहरणम् is right?
optionExplain: पहरणम् is not a word of the card.
That would give ओज उपहरणम्, and उपहरणम् is not the card's word.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the second अ is shown by ऽ.
आ + अ would give ओजसापहरणम्.
questions.explain: ओजसः (of ojas) + अपहरणम् (taking away) → ओजसोऽपहरणम्.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 19, what role does the word यस्मात् play?
options: It names the demons who act
It states the remedy for the loss
It gives the reason against unit 18
optionExplain: The demons are रक्षोभिः.
The argument goes on in the next units.
No remedy is given here.
Right: Since …: it begins the argument against 'carried off by beings'.
questions.explain: यस्मात् (since) opens the reason why the body is not carried off.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of ओजसोऽपहरणम्, how is रामः + अपि written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the lost अ is marked ऽ.
अः + अ does not give आ.
र् comes after a vowel other than अ/आ.
The visarga does not stay before अ here.
questions.explain: ओजसः + अपहरणम् → ओजसोऽपहरणम्; so रामः + अपि → रामोऽपि.
questions.teaches: Final अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ is dropped, written ऽ.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 20, what is not seen?
options: The flow of blood from the woman
The removal of anyone's body by humans
The swelling of the woman's belly
The taking of ojas by rakṣas
optionExplain: The flow is seen; unit 18 speaks of it.
Right: न च दृश्यते कस्यचिन्मानुषैर्देहापहारः.
The swelling is seen; unit 16 speaks of it.
Unit 19 says that can occur.
questions.explain: The removal of anyone's body by humans is not seen.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these words of the clear clause of unit 20 in their printed order.
questions.explain: And not is seen, of anyone, by humans, removal of the body.
questions.rule: न च → दृश्यते → कस्यचित् → मानुषैः → देहापहारः.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 20 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words make the clear part of the unit and link it to unit 19.
questions.teaches: दृश्यते is passive: is seen; the thing seen (देहापहारः) is in the nominative.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of कस्यचिन्मानुषैः is right?
optionExplain: आनुषैः is not a word of the card.
चिन्मानुषैः is not a word.
Right: त् before a nasal (म) may become न् (optional; द् is also correct).
म् + म would give म्म, not न्म.
questions.explain: कस्यचित् (of anyone) + मानुषैः (by humans).
questions.rule: Final त् + nasal → न् + nasal (optional; द् is also correct).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which are in unit 20 as the card reads it?
options: The removal of a body by humans is not seen
The word हि (for) links it to the reason in unit 19
Demons are often seen carrying bodies away
Ojas is taken away by humans
optionExplain: Right: न च दृश्यते … देहापहारः.
Right: हि = for; the card reads this unit as continuing unit 19.
The unit says no removal of a body is seen.
Unit 19 speaks of rakṣas, not humans, taking ojas.
questions.explain: No removal of anyone's body by humans is seen; हि ties this to unit 19.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of कस्यचिन्मानुषैः, how is तत् + मात्रम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Before म the त् may become न् (optional; द् is also correct), never the retroflex ण्.
त् does not become म्.
In sandhi the त् does not stay before म.
Right: त् before म may become न् (optional; तद्मात्रम् is also correct).
questions.explain: कस्यचित् + मानुषैः → कस्यचिन्मानुषैः; so तत् + मात्रम् → तन्मात्रम्.
questions.rule: त् + म → न्म (optional; द् is also correct).
questions.teaches: A final त् before a nasal consonant may become न् (optional; द् is also correct).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In the supposition of unit 21, what do some powerful ones proceed to do?
options: Make the blood flow by chance
optionExplain: Right: गर्भस्य शरीराक्षेपे प्रवर्तन्ते.
Ojas belongs to unit 19.
The chance flow belongs to unit 18.
The swelling belongs to unit 16.
questions.explain: If some proceed to cast off the body of the embryo …
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 21 in their printed order.
questions.explain: If … some powerful ones … proceed to cast off the embryo's body, then how … would neglect its mothers?
questions.rule: यदि → केचित् → शरीराक्षेपे प्रवर्तन्ते → तदा कथम् इव → उपेक्षेरन्.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 21 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: यदि … तदा frames the argument; the other words fill it.
questions.teaches: यदि … तदा = if … then: a supposition followed by its consequence.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of तज्जननीः is right?
optionExplain: तज् is not a word; the pronoun is तत्.
Right: त् before ज becomes ज्: तज्जननीः.
ज्जननीः is not a word.
A visarga before ज would not give ज्ज.
questions.explain: तत् (its) + जननीः (mothers).
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: In the clear part of unit 21, whom would they neglect?
optionExplain: No father is named in the unit.
No physician is named in the unit.
Right: तज्जननीः उपेक्षेरन्: would neglect its mothers.
The ignorant are in unit 18, as speakers.
questions.explain: The question asks how they would neglect its mothers.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of तज्जननीः, how is तत् + जलम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Before ज the त् goes on to ज्.
च् appears before च/छ, not before ज.
In sandhi the त् does not stay before ज.
Right: त् before ज becomes ज्.
questions.explain: तत् + जननीः → तज्जननीः; so तत् + जलम् → तज्जलम्.
questions.teaches: A final त् before ज (or झ) becomes ज्.
questions.section: वातोदर और मिथ्या गर्भ: भूतहरण का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 22, pure ārtava resembles what?
options: Ghee, oil or honey in colour
optionExplain: Right: शशरुधिर-लाक्षारस-उपमम्.
Those colours describe śukra in unit 10.
Milk and cane juice belong to unit 10's simile (ghee in milk, jaggery in cane juice).
Neither is named in this unit.
questions.explain: Pure ārtava resembles hare's blood and lac juice.
questions.rule: शश = hare; रुधिर = blood; लाक्षा = lac.
questions.section: शुद्ध आर्तव, प्रजनन-आयु और दंपती का शोधन

questions.q: Put these words of unit 22 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Ārtava, resembling hare's blood and lac juice, washed, losing colour, they call pure.

questions.q: Why is सघृतः printed as सघृतो before विरेकः?
options: अः before any consonant becomes ओ
अः before a voiced sound becomes ओ
The visarga is dropped by mistake
optionExplain: Before a voiceless sound like त it becomes स्, not ओ.
Right: व is voiced, so सघृतः + विरेकः → सघृतो विरेकः.
The change is regular sandhi, not a misprint.
सघृतः is singular; ओ here comes from sandhi.
questions.explain: Final अः before a voiced consonant (here व) becomes ओ.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ शुक्रदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the rule of त्रिवृच्चूर्णः, how is तत् + च written when joined?
optionExplain: त् before च does not become द्.
त् does not stay before च; it becomes च्.
Right: त् before च becomes च्, as in त्रिवृत् + चूर्णः.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: त्रिवृत् + चूर्णः → त्रिवृच्चूर्णः; so तत् + च → तच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् before च becomes च्.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ शुक्रदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 47 in their printed order.

questions.q: Which split of वातजेऽप्यार्तवदोषे is right?

Right: ए + अ → ए with ऽ; इ + आ → या.
यार्तवदोषे is not a word; the य comes from इ.
questions.explain: वातजे (in the Vāta-type) + अपि (also) + आर्तवदोषे (in the fault of ārtava).
questions.rule: ए + अ → एऽ; इ + आ → या.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the rule of वातजेऽपि, how is वने + अपि written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ → ए, and the lost अ is marked by ऽ.
ए + अ here gives एऽ, not अय.
ए + अ does not give आ.
ए does not turn into अ; ए stays and the following अ is dropped.
questions.explain: वातजे + अपि → वातजेऽपि; so वने + अपि → वनेऽपि.
questions.teaches: A final ए before अ stays, and the अ is dropped and marked with ऽ.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: In योनौ (from योनि), what does the ending -औ mark here?
optionExplain: -औ is dual in अ-stems, but योनि is an इ-stem; here it is loc. sg.
The instrumental of योनि is योन्या.
Right: The gram label is f. loc. sg.: योनौ = in the yoni.
The genitive plural is योनीनाम्.
questions.explain: For इ-stem nouns like योनि, -औ is the locative singular: योनौ = in the yoni.
questions.rule: -औ is not always dual: इ-stem loc. sg. ends in -औ.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which statement about the second line of unit 54 is right?

It names the yoni as what is washed
It gives the amount of the decoction

questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the ending of योनौ, what does an invented अग्नौ (from अग्नि, fire) mean?
optionExplain: Right: अग्नि is an इ-stem like योनि; -औ is the locative singular.
-औ is dual in अ-stems like देव (देवौ); the dual of अग्नि is अग्नी.
By the fire is अग्निना.
Of the fires is अग्नीनाम्.
questions.explain: योनि → योनौ (in the yoni); so अग्नि → अग्नौ (in the fire).
questions.teaches: Masculine and feminine इ-stems (अग्नि, योनि) form the locative singular in -औ (feminine ones also in -याम्: योन्याम्).
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split of क्वाथमुत्पलपद्मक is right?

questions.q: By the rule of क्वाथमुत्पल, how is the invented जलम् + उष्णम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: Final म् before the vowel उ joins it: जलमु-.
Anusvāra stands for म् only before a consonant.
That would be जल + उष्णम् (अ + उ → ओ), not जलम्.
र् comes from a visarga, not from म्.
questions.explain: क्वाथम् + उत्पल → क्वाथमुत्पल; so जलम् + उष्णम् → जलमुष्णम्.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel is written joined to it; before a consonant it may be written as anusvāra.
questions.section: वात, पित्त, कफ आर्तवदोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.teaches: The ghee is cooked (सिद्धम्) with the plants of the list: dāḍima is pomegranate, arjuna Terminalia arjuna.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the probable sense on the card, what is kuṇapa-retas?
optionExplain: Right: कुणप = corpse; the usual understanding is a corpse-like smell (probable).
That is granthi-retas, in unit 68.
That is pūya-retas, in unit 68.
That is mūtra-purīṣa-retas, in unit 69.
questions.explain: Literally corpse-semen; the card takes it, as probable, as semen smelling like a corpse.
questions.rule: कुणप = corpse; कुणपरेतस् = corpse-like (smelling) semen, probable.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does the causative form पाययेत् tell us here?
options: It should be poured on him
One should make him drink it
He should drink it after a month
It should be held in the mouth
optionExplain: √पा means to drink; nothing is poured.
Right: पाययेत् is the causative optative of √पा: should make (him) drink.
No time is given in the unit.
Holding (धारण) belongs to unit 71.
questions.explain: पाययेत् = should cause to drink; the plain form would be पिबेत् (should drink), as in unit 71.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: An invented line reads बालं क्षीरं पाययेत्. What does it say?
options: The child should drink milk on his own
One should give milk to the cow
The child should not drink milk
optionExplain: That would be बालः क्षीरं पिबेत्, the plain verb.
बालम् is the child, not a cow.
Right: पाययेत् is causative: make (the child) drink.
There is no न (not) in the line.
questions.explain: As सर्पिः पाययेत् = make him drink ghee, बालं क्षीरं पाययेत् = make the child drink milk.
questions.teaches: The causative पाययति takes both the drinker and the drink in the accusative: make X drink Y.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By unit 68, what is named for granthi-retas?
optionExplain: Candana is named for an ārtava fault in unit 71.
Triphalā belongs to unit 71.
Hiṅgu and citraka are named in unit 69.
Right: पाषाणभिदा पलाशभस्मना वा: with pāṣāṇabhid or with palāśa ash.
questions.explain: For semen with knots or lumps: pāṣāṇabhid, or the ash of palāśa.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 68 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: ग्रन्थि and पूय name the two faults; भस्म and न्यग्रोध belong to the remedies.
questions.rule: ग्रन्थि = knot; पूय = pus; भस्म = ash; न्यग्रोध = banyan.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of unit 68 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Fault, then its two remedies; second fault, then its two groups.
questions.teaches: Each line names a fault in the locative (-रेतसि, in ... semen) and then the remedy in the instrumental.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: What does the card take the dual ending of परूषकादिन्यग्रोधादिभ्याम् to mean?
options: Two persons, the woman and the man
Two single plants, with no others at all
optionExplain: Right: आदि = beginning with; the dual counts the two named groups.
No dose or time is given.
That dual is स्त्रीपुंसौ of unit 72.
आदि (beginning with) marks groups, not single plants.
questions.explain: परूषकादि and न्यग्रोधादि are two groups; the dual ending is read once, on the second.
questions.rule: X-आदि = X and the like; the dual -भ्याम् = by the two.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which does unit 68 state?
options: Palāśa ash is the alternative for granthi-retas
The members of the nyagrodha group are listed
The remedies are to be drunk
optionExplain: Right: पाषाणभिदा.
Right: पलाशभस्मना वा, or with palāśa ash.
No member is listed; only the group's name.
No verb is stated in this unit.
questions.explain: The unit names the drugs only; how they are used and the group members are not given.
questions.rule: वा = or: pāṣāṇabhid, or palāśa ash.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the join of परूषक + आदि, how is चन्दन + आदि written?
optionExplain: अ + आ does not give ए.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as in परूषक + आदि → परूषकादि.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not अ + आ.
Two vowels meeting in a compound must join.
questions.explain: परूषक + आदि → परूषकादि; so चन्दन + आदि → चन्दनादि (candana and the like).
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial आ merge into one long आ.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: In unit 69, by what has the semen been greatly altered?
optionExplain: Pitta is not named in this unit.
Kapha is not named in this unit.
Right: वायुनाऽतिविकृते: greatly altered by Vāyu, the wind.
Blood is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The fault is mūtra-purīṣa-retas that Vāyu has greatly altered.
questions.rule: वायुना = by Vāyu; अतिविकृत = greatly altered.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put the six drugs of the second (cooked) list in their printed order.
questions.explain: After अथवा the compound runs citraka, vitunnaka, priyaṅgu, hiṅgu, samaṅgā, mṛṇāla, then सिद्धम् (cooked).
questions.rule: चित्रक → वितुन्नक → प्रियङ्गु → हिङ्गु → समङ्गा → मृणाल.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 69 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words build the second preparation: or else, cooked, with powder as the addition.
questions.teaches: प्रतीवाप is an addition put into a cooked preparation; here it is the powder of elā and moca.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which two drugs stand in both lists of unit 69, as printed?
optionExplain: These two are only the added powder.
These two are only in the cooked list.
These two are only in the cooked list.
Right: Both are in the first list and again in the cooked list.
questions.explain: First list: hiṅgu, (uśīra), citraka; second: citraka, vitunnaka, priyaṅgu, hiṅgu, samaṅgā, mṛṇāla.
questions.rule: Citraka and hiṅgu recur in both lists.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: In the second preparation of unit 69, what part do elā and moca play?
options: They are cooked with the six drugs
They make up the whole first list
optionExplain: Right: एलामोचचूर्णप्रतीवापम्: with elā-moca powder as the addition.
The six drugs are the cooked list; elā and moca come as powder.
The first list is hiṅgu, (uśīra), citraka.
They are named only as the addition.
questions.explain: The six drugs make the cooked preparation; elā and moca powder is added to it.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the join in चित्रकैरथवा, how is फलैः + अथवा written?
optionExplain: The अ of अथवा cannot vanish here.
Right: Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel, as in चित्रकैः + अथवा.
Visarga becomes श् only before a palatal consonant (च, छ, श), never before a vowel.
Visarga after ऐ does not drop before a vowel; it becomes र्.
questions.explain: चित्रकैः + अथवा → चित्रकैरथवा; so फलैः + अथवा → फलैरथवा.
questions.teaches: A visarga after ऐ (any vowel but अ/आ) becomes र् before a vowel.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By unit 70, in what form are pāṭhā, trikaṇṭaka and vṛkṣaka given?
optionExplain: Paste (कल्क) is named in units 71 and 73.
Ash is named for palāśa in unit 68.
Right: …वृक्षकक्वाथम्: the decoction of these three.
Powder is named in unit 69.
questions.explain: The compound ends in क्वाथम्: a decoction of pāṭhā, trikaṇṭaka and vṛkṣaka.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put the members of the compound of unit 70 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The three drugs come first, then क्वाथ (decoction) closes the compound.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 70 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The three plant identifications are probable in the data; तथा links this to the faults before.
questions.rule: पाठा, त्रिकण्टक, वृक्षक (all probable); तथा = likewise.
questions.teaches: The three drugs are identified as probable only: pāṭhā Cissampelos pareira, trikaṇṭaka Tribulus terrestris, vṛkṣaka kuṭaja.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split of ग्रन्थ्यार्तवे is right?
optionExplain: यार्तवे is not a word of the card.
ई + short अ would give ग्रन्थ्यर्तवे, with a short a.
म् before आ would give ग्रन्थिमार्तवे.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: ग्रन्थि + आर्तवे → ग्रन्थ्यार्तवे.
questions.explain: ग्रन्थि (knot) + आर्तवे (in ārtava).
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: The ārtava fault of unit 70 shares its first member with which semen fault of unit 68?
optionExplain: Right: Both are named with ग्रन्थि, knot or lump.
Pūya (pus) appears with ārtava in unit 71, not here.
Kuṇapa is the fault of unit 67.
That is the fault of unit 69.
questions.explain: Unit 68 treats ग्रन्थिरेतस्; unit 70 turns to ग्रन्थ्यार्तव: the same knot, now in ārtava.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the join of ग्रन्थि + आर्तवे, how is प्रति + आगच्छति written?
optionExplain: The इ cannot vanish; it turns into य्.
Right: इ + आ → य् + आ, as in ग्रन्थ्यार्तवे.
इ + आ does not give ए.
य् replaces the इ; the इ does not remain.
questions.explain: ग्रन्थि + आर्तवे → ग्रन्थ्यार्तवे; so प्रति + आगच्छति → प्रत्यागच्छति (comes back).
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: In unit 71, what should one drink in kuṇapa-pūya-ārtava?
optionExplain: Ghee with dāḍima belongs to unit 67.
Palāśa ash belongs to unit 68.
Right: चन्दनक्वाथं पिबेत्: one should drink a candana decoction.
Pāṭhā decoction belongs to unit 70.
questions.explain: The first clause: in this ārtava fault, drink a decoction of candana.
questions.rule: चन्दनक्वाथ = candana decoction; पिबेत् = should drink.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 71 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two forms of triphalā (paste, decoction) and two acts (holding, sipping) are named.
questions.rule: कल्क = paste; क्वाथ = decoction; धारण = holding; आचमन = sipping.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of unit 71 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Fault, decoction, verb; then the triphalā pair and the pair of acts.
questions.teaches: The unit has one full sentence (with पिबेत्) and then a verbless clause of two duals.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Does unit 71 say which of paste and decoction goes with holding, and which with sipping?
options: Yes; the paste is for sipping
Yes; the decoction is for holding
Yes; both go only with holding
optionExplain: No pairing is stated in the text.
No pairing is stated in the text.
आचमन is named too, and no pairing is given.
Right: Two duals with no verb; the pairing is not stated.
questions.explain: त्रिफलाकल्कक्वाथौ and धारणाचमने stand together; the card does not claim who goes with whom.
questions.rule: Two duals listed, no verb, no stated pairing.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which is not one of the three myrobalans of triphalā as the card names them?
optionExplain: Right: Candana is the separate decoction to drink, not part of triphalā.
Harītakī is one of the three.
Bibhītaka is one of the three.
Āmalaka is one of the three.
questions.explain: Triphalā = harītakī, bibhītaka and āmalaka (standard).
questions.rule: त्रिफला = the three fruits: harītakī, bibhītaka, āmalaka.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the join of च + अत्र, how is न + अस्ति written?
optionExplain: अ + अ does not give ए.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as in च + अत्र → चात्र.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not अ + अ.
The two vowels must join.
questions.explain: च + अत्र → चात्र; so न + अस्ति → नास्ति (is not).
questions.teaches: Two short अ sounds meeting merge into one long आ.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By unit 72, who is to be treated in all faults of semen and ārtava?
options: Both the woman and the man
The child who is to be born
optionExplain: The dual स्त्रीपुंसौ names both.
The dual स्त्रीपुंसौ names both.
Right: स्त्रीपुंसौ is a dual: the woman and the man, both.
No child is named in this unit.
questions.explain: स्त्रीपुंसौ … उपाचरेत्: one should treat the woman and the man.
questions.rule: स्त्रीपुंसौ = the woman and the man (dual).
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put these words of unit 72 in their printed order.
questions.explain: In all faults of semen and ārtava → the couple → with sneha and the rest → uttarabasti → should treat.
questions.rule: सर्वेषु → दोषेषु → स्त्रीपुंसौ → स्नेहादिकर्मभिः → उत्तरबस्तिभिः → उपाचरेत्.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 72 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words give the means, the stress, the repetition and the verb.
questions.teaches: स्नेह = oleation with oil or fat; स्नेहादि = the series of actions that begins with it.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split of विशेषेणोत्तरबस्तिभिः is right?
optionExplain: विशेषेणो is no word; the ओ comes from अ + उ.
म् before उ would give विशेषेणमुत्तर…
ओत्तरबस्ति is no word; the word is उत्तरबस्ति.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: विशेषेण + उत्तर → विशेषेणोत्तर.
questions.explain: विशेषेण (especially) + उत्तरबस्तिभिः (with uttarabastis).
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which treatment does unit 72 single out with विशेषेण (especially)?
optionExplain: Right: विशेषेणोत्तरबस्तिभिः: especially with uttarabastis.
Picu is named in unit 73.
Triphalā belongs to unit 71.
Candana belongs to unit 71.
questions.explain: Among the actions beginning with sneha, uttarabasti is named as especially to be used.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: An invented line reads गुरुशिष्यौ वदतः. What does it say?
options: The teacher speaks to the pupil
The teacher and the pupil speak
The teachers of the pupil speak
optionExplain: Both are subjects; no 'to' is expressed.
Right: A dual dvandva names both, like स्त्रीपुंसौ; वदतः is dual too.
-औ is a dual dvandva, not a genitive.
The dvandva names two different persons, teacher and pupil.
questions.explain: As स्त्रीपुंसौ = the woman and the man, गुरुशिष्यौ = the teacher and the pupil.
questions.rule: A dvandva of two nouns in the dual = both of them.
questions.teaches: A dvandva compound of two nouns takes the dual and names both together.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By unit 73, where are the pastes and the picu used?
optionExplain: Sipping (ācamana) was in unit 71; here it is the yoni.
The head is not named.
Right: योनौ: in the yoni (vagina).
The navel is not named.
questions.explain: योनौ कल्कैः पिचुभिश्च: in the yoni, with pastes and picu.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Put the words of unit 73 in their printed order.
questions.explain: As suited to each → in the yoni → with pastes → with picu.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 73 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four words: the manner, the place, and the two means.
questions.teaches: पिचु is a wad or swab of cotton (standard).
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Which split of पिचुभिश्च is right?
optionExplain: श्च is no word.
म् before च would be written पिचुभिं च.
पिचुभिश is no word; the ending is -भिः.
Right: Visarga becomes श् before च: पिचुभिः + च → पिचुभिश्च.
questions.explain: पिचुभिः (with picu) + च (and).
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: Unit 73 has no verb. Which verb does the card take as carried over?
options: आसेवेताम् (the two should follow) of unit 74
optionExplain: Right: The unit appears to continue unit 72, whose verb is उपाचरेत्.
Pastes and wads in the yoni are not drunk.
Unit 67 is a separate prescription.
That verb comes after this unit.
questions.explain: The card's grouping note: the unit appears to continue unit 72; its verb उपाचरेत् is understood.
questions.rule: Verbless unit → verb carried from the unit it continues.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By the join in पिचुभिश्च, how is रामः + च written?
optionExplain: र् replaces visarga only after other vowels before voiced sounds.
Right: Visarga becomes श् before च.
अः → ओ only before voiced sounds; च is unvoiced.
स् comes before त/थ; before च it is श्.
questions.explain: पिचुभिः + च → पिचुभिश्च; so रामः + च → रामश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्.
questions.section: कुणप, ग्रंथि, पूय आदि दोषों की चिकित्सा

questions.q: By unit 74, how long does the ṛtu last?
optionExplain: Sixteen is the view of others in unit 75.
A month is the view of some in unit 76.
Right: द्वादशरात्रं भवति: it lasts twelve nights.
Seven is not named.
questions.explain: ऋतुस्तु दृष्टार्तवो द्वादशरात्रं भवति: twelve nights.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 74 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Line 1: thus, the purified two, the earlier procedure, should follow. Line 2: the ṛtu, seen ārtava, twelve nights.
questions.rule: इत्येवम् → विशुद्ध… → पूर्वोक्तं विधिम् → आसेवेताम् → ऋतुः → द्वादशरात्रम्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 74 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words belong to line 1, two to line 2.
questions.teaches: आसेवेताम् is a dual verb: the two (man and woman) should follow (practise) the procedure.

questions.q: Which split of पूर्वोक्तम् is right?
optionExplain: क्तम् is no word; the second word is उक्तम्.
म् before उ would give पूर्वमुक्तम्.
ओक्तम् is no word; the ओ comes from अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: पूर्व + उक्तम् → पूर्वोक्तम्.
questions.explain: पूर्व (earlier) + उक्तम् (stated).

questions.q: Who are the two that should follow the earlier procedure (आसेवेताम्)?
options: Two women who are in their ṛtu
optionExplain: Right: The bahuvrīhi describes two persons, the couple treated in unit 72.
The compound describes persons whose semen and ārtava are purified.
Semen belongs to the man; the two are a couple.
The compound is a bahuvrīhi: persons having them, not the fluids.
questions.explain: विशुद्धशुक्रार्तवौ = the two whose semen and ārtava are purified: the man and the woman.
questions.rule: Bahuvrīhi in the dual = the two persons who have X.

questions.q: By the join in ऋतुस्तु, how is गुरुः + तु written?
optionExplain: र् replaces visarga before voiced sounds; त is unvoiced.
Right: Visarga becomes स् before त, as in ऋतुः + तु → ऋतुस्तु.
No ओ arises here; the visarga turns into स्.
श् replaces visarga before च or छ, not before त.
questions.explain: ऋतुः + तु → ऋतुस्तु; so गुरुः + तु → गुरुस्तु.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त or थ becomes स्.

questions.q: According to others in unit 75, how long is the ṛtu?
optionExplain: Twelve nights is the statement of unit 74.
A month is the view of some, in unit 76.
Right: षोडशरात्रम् इति अन्ये: sixteen nights, say others.
Ten is not named.
questions.explain: Others give sixteen nights.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 75 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The whole unit: sixteen nights, thus (say) others.

questions.q: In unit 75 the word for others is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अन्ये = others (nominative plural); इति अन्ये = so say others.
questions.teaches: अन्ये (others) marks a view held by other authorities.

questions.q: Which split of इत्यन्ये is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give इत्यान्ये, with a long आ.
यन्ये is no word.
इति is indeclinable; it has no visarga.
Right: इ before अ becomes य्: इति + अन्ये → इत्यन्ये.
questions.explain: इति (thus) + अन्ये (others).

questions.q: How does unit 75 stand to the twelve nights of unit 74?
options: It corrects twelve as a misprint
It adds sixteen to the twelve
It is the text's own final ruling
optionExplain: Right: इति अन्ये marks the view of others beside the text's own.
Nothing says twelve is wrong; others simply differ.
Sixteen is an alternative length, not a sum.
इति अन्ये reports others; it is not the text's own statement.
questions.explain: Unit 74: twelve nights; unit 75: sixteen nights, according to others.
questions.rule: X इति अन्ये = X, say others.

questions.q: An invented line reads दशरात्रमित्यपरे. What does it say?
optionExplain: अपरे is masculine nominative: other (authorities), not women.
Right: X इति अपरे = so say others, like X इति अन्ये.
There is no न (not) in the line.
इति marks a quoted view, not a sequence.
questions.explain: Like षोडशरात्रमित्यन्ये, दशरात्रमित्यपरे = ten nights, say others.
questions.rule: X इति अन्ये / अपरे = X, according to others.
questions.teaches: X इति अन्ये (or अपरे) reports a view held by others.

questions.q: According to some in unit 76, how long may the ṛtu be?
optionExplain: Twelve nights is unit 74's statement.
Sixteen is the others' view of unit 75.
Right: मासमपि तु केचित्: but some (say) even a month.
Two months are not named.
questions.explain: Some extend it to even a month for a woman whose yoni, womb and ārtava are pure.
questions.rule: मासम् अपि = even a month; केचित् = some.

questions.q: Put the members of the compound of unit 76 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Pure → yoni → womb → ārtava: the compound names what must be pure.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 76 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: गर्भाशय names the organ; the rest give the length and whose view it is.
questions.teaches: गर्भाशय = गर्भ (embryo) + आशय (seat): the womb.

questions.q: For which woman do some allow even a month in unit 76?
options: One who has not yet borne a child
One whose ārtava is not seen
One whose semen fault was treated
One with pure yoni, womb, ārtava
optionExplain: Childbirth is not named.
Unseen ārtava belongs to unit 77.
Semen belongs to the man; the compound names her organs.
Right: शुद्धयोनिगर्भाशयार्तवायाः: of her whose yoni, womb, ārtava are pure.
questions.explain: The condition is purity of yoni, womb and ārtava.

questions.q: A teacher says the ṛtu may last a month for a woman with pure yoni, womb and ārtava. Whose view does he repeat?
options: The text's own view in unit 74
optionExplain: Right: मासमपि तु केचित्: the month is the view of some.
Unit 74 gives twelve nights.
Unit 75's others give sixteen nights.
Unit 77's others speak of unseen ārtava.
questions.explain: Twelve nights (74), sixteen say others (75), even a month say some (76).
questions.rule: केचित् = some: the month view of unit 76.

questions.q: An invented line reads वर्षमपि तु केचित्. What does it say?
options: But some (say) not even a year
But some (say) a year at most
optionExplain: There is no न (not) in the line.
Right: X अपि तु केचित् = but some (say) even X.
No verb of coming is present.
अपि = even, not 'at most'.
questions.explain: As मासमपि तु केचित् = but some (say) even a month, वर्षमपि तु केचित् = even a year.
questions.teaches: अपि after a word stresses it: even X; केचित् marks the view of some.

questions.q: According to others in unit 77, what also exists?
options: A month for a pure woman
Ārtava that has knots or lumps
optionExplain: That is the view of others in unit 75.
That is the view of some in unit 76.
Right: अदृष्टार्तवोऽप्यस्ति: there is also one with ārtava not seen.
Knotted ārtava is the fault of unit 70.
questions.explain: Others say: in the same way there is also one with unseen ārtava.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 77 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Likewise → not-seen-ārtava → also → is → thus → others.
questions.rule: तद्वत् → अदृष्टार्तवः → अपि → अस्ति → इति → अपरे.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 77 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four words carry the claim and whose claim it is.
questions.teaches: अपरे, like अन्ये, means others: it marks a view reported, not the text's own.

questions.q: Which split starts तद्वददृष्टार्तवः correctly?
optionExplain: That would be written तद्वद्दृष्ट… with two द्.
तद्व is no word; the word is तद्वत्.
अ + अ would give तद्वदादृष्ट… with a long आ.
Right: त् becomes द् before a vowel: तद्वत् + अ… → तद्वद…
questions.explain: तद्वत् (likewise) + अदृष्टार्तवः (one with ārtava not seen).

questions.q: What does the अ- of अदृष्टार्तव add, against दृष्टार्तव of unit 74?
optionExplain: Right: अ- before a word denies it: अ-दृष्ट = not seen.
अ- does not strengthen; it negates.
अ- adds no time.
अ- adds no plural.
questions.explain: Unit 74's ṛtu is दृष्टार्तव (ārtava seen); unit 77's others add अदृष्टार्तव (not seen).

questions.q: By the join in अदृष्टार्तवोऽपि, how is रामः + अपि written?
optionExplain: अः + अ does not give आ.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the अ that drops is marked ऽ.
र् replaces visarga only after vowels other than अ/आ.
Visarga does not become स् before a vowel.
questions.explain: अदृष्टार्तवः + अपि → अदृष्टार्तवोऽपि; so रामः + अपि → रामोऽपि.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ, before अ, gives ओ; the following अ drops and is marked with ऽ.

questions.q: By verse 78, as what should one know such a woman?
options: As one with an ārtava fault
optionExplain: Pregnancy is not named in the verse.
No fault is named; these are signs of the ṛtu.
Right: विद्याद् ऋतुमतीं स्त्रियम्: know her as a woman in her ṛtu.
The signs mark a woman in her ṛtu (ऋतुमती), not one past it.
questions.explain: The signs mark a ṛtumatī, a woman in her season.
questions.rule: ऋतुमती = a woman in her ṛtu.

questions.q: Put these phrases of verse 78 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Face, then hips and breasts (line 1); drooping belly, desire, then the verb and object (line 2).

questions.q: Match each word of verse 78 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five words of the signs; पयोधर literally means water-bearer.
questions.teaches: पयोधर (literally water-bearer) is a standard word for breast.

questions.q: Which split of स्फुरच्छ्रोणि is right?
optionExplain: छ्रोणि is no word; the word is श्रोणि.
च्छ्रोणि is no word.
न् + श would not give च्छ.
Right: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ): स्फुरत् + श्रोणि → स्फुरच्छ्रोणि.
questions.explain: स्फुरत् (throbbing) + श्रोणि (hip).
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ).

questions.q: Which signs does verse 78 list for a woman in her ṛtu?
optionExplain: Right: क्षामप्रसन्नवदनाम्.
Right: स्फुरच्छ्रोणिपयोधराम्.
Right: पुंस्कामा(म्).
Neither is named.
The face is lean (क्षाम) and clear.
questions.explain: The verse lists face, hips and breasts, drooping eyes (reading probable) and belly, and desire for a man.
questions.rule: Signs: क्षाम-प्रसन्न वदन, स्फुरत् श्रोणि-पयोधर, स्रस्त कुक्षि, पुंस्काम.

questions.q: By the join in स्फुरच्छ्रोणि, how is महत् + शास्त्रम् written?
optionExplain: Right: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (च्श also correct), as in स्फुरत् + श्रोणि.
त् → द् happens before voiced sounds; श is unvoiced.
त् → न् (optional) happens only before nasals.
That change is for visarga, not for त्.
questions.explain: स्फुरत् + श्रोणि → स्फुरच्छ्रोणि; so महत् + शास्त्रम् → महच्छास्त्रम्.
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel.
questions.teaches: A final त् before श becomes च्, and the श may then become छ (before a vowel or semivowel): च्छ; च्श is also correct.

questions.q: By verse 79, what happens to the lotus when the day has passed?
optionExplain: संकोच is contraction, the opposite.
Right: पद्मं संकोचमायाति: the lotus comes to contraction.
No shedding is named.
No moon is named.
questions.explain: As the day passes, the lotus closes up (संकोचम् आयाति).

questions.q: Put these phrases of verse 79 in their printed order (the doubtful word left out).
questions.explain: Line 1 gives the lotus; line 2 gives the yoni that does not receive semen.
questions.rule: पद्म … यथा → तथा → योनिः → न प्रतीच्छति.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 79 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two words for the lotus half, two for the yoni half.
questions.teaches: प्रतीच्छति (from प्रति + √इष्) = receives; with न it means does not receive.

questions.q: Which split of दिनेऽतीते is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give दिनातीते.
अः + अ would give दिनोऽतीते.
Right: ए + अ: the अ drops and is marked ऽ: दिनेऽतीते.
तीते is no word; ऽ marks a dropped अ.
questions.explain: दिने (the day, locative) + अतीते (having passed).

questions.q: In the simile of verse 79, what stands for the lotus?
options: The face of the woman in her ṛtu
optionExplain: The semen is what is not received.
The day is the time that passes in the lotus half; it is not the lotus.
No face is named in this verse.
Right: यथा पद्मम् … तथा योनिः: the yoni matches the lotus.
questions.explain: Lotus ↔ yoni; contracting ↔ not receiving semen inside.
questions.rule: यथा X … तथा Y: X is the likeness of Y.

questions.q: By the join in दिनेऽतीते, how is वने + अस्मिन् written?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ: the अ drops, marked ऽ.
ए + अ does not give आ.
ए + अ does not give ऐ.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not from ए.
questions.explain: दिने + अतीते → दिनेऽतीते; so वने + अस्मिन् → वनेऽस्मिन् (in this forest).
questions.teaches: A final ए before अ stays; the अ drops and is marked with avagraha ऽ.

questions.q: By verse 80, over how long is the blood accumulated?
optionExplain: Twelve nights is the ṛtu of unit 74.
Right: मासेनोपचितं रक्तम्: blood accumulated over a month.
Sixteen nights is the others' ṛtu of unit 75.
A year is not named.
questions.explain: The blood is collected over a month and comes again in the ṛtu.
questions.rule: मासेन = over a month; उपचित = accumulated.

questions.q: Put these phrases of verse 80 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Line 1: the blood, the two vessels, in the ṛtu again; line 2: its colour and smell, Vāyu, from the yoni's mouth.
questions.rule: रक्तम् → धमनीभ्याम् → ऋतौ पुनः → ईषत्कृष्णम् → वायुः → योनिमुखात्.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 80 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five words describe the blood and its way out.
questions.teaches: धमनी is a vessel or channel (probable); the verse speaks of two, by which the blood comes.

questions.q: Which split of मासेनोपचितम् is right?
optionExplain: मासेनः is no form; अः before उ would drop the visarga.
म् before उ would give मासमुपचितम्.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: मासेन + उपचितम् → मासेनोपचितम्.
ओपचित is no word; the word is उपचित.
questions.explain: मासेन (over a month) + उपचितम् (accumulated).

questions.q: Which does verse 80 say of the blood in the ṛtu?
options: It was collected over a week
optionExplain: Right: ईषत्कृष्णम्.
Right: विगन्धम्.
It is slightly dark (ईषत्कृष्ण), not bright red.
मासेन: over a month.
questions.explain: Slightly dark, ill-smelling, accumulated over a month, coming by two vessels.

questions.q: An invented phrase reads ईषत्पीतं वस्त्रम्. What does it mean?
optionExplain: ईषत् lessens; it does not intensify.
ईषत् is not a negation.
No smell is named in the phrase.
Right: ईषत् = slightly, as in ईषत्कृष्णम् = slightly dark.
questions.explain: ईषत्कृष्णम् = slightly dark; so ईषत्पीतम् = slightly yellow.
questions.teaches: ईषत् before an adjective softens it: slightly X.

questions.q: By unit 81, for how long does she keep these rules?
optionExplain: Right: त्रिरात्रम् आसीत: she should remain so for three nights.
Seven nights (सप्तरात्रम्) are named in unit 86, not here.
The unit counts three nights from the first day.
No month is named in this unit.
questions.explain: From the first day the flower is seen, she remains so for three nights (त्रिरात्रम्).

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 81 in their printed order.
questions.explain: When the flower is seen, from the first day on, chaste, without bath and ornament, sleeping on darbha, she should remain so for three nights.
questions.rule: When → from when → three marks of her conduct → how long.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 81 to its meaning on the card.
pairs: the sight of the flower (onset of menses)
questions.explain: These five words carry the time, the conduct and the verb of the unit.
questions.teaches: In this chapter पुष्प (flower) is the usual word for the menstrual flow; पुष्पदर्शन is its first sight.

questions.q: Which split of स्नानालंकाररहिता is right?
optionExplain: स्नानाल and कार are not words of the card.
Right: अ + अ → आ: स्नान + अलंकार gives स्नानालंकार.
म् before a vowel would give स्नानमलंकार.
ए + अ would give स्नानेऽलंकार, not स्नानालंकार.
questions.explain: स्नान (bathing) + अलंकार (ornament) + रहिता (without).

questions.q: Which belong to the three-night rule of unit 81?
options: Sleeping on a spread of darbha grass
optionExplain: The cold-water bath comes on the fourth day, in unit 84.
Right: दर्भसंस्तरशायिनी.
White garlands belong to the fourth day, in unit 84.
Right: स्नानालंकाररहिता.
questions.explain: For three nights she is chaste, without bath and ornaments, and sleeps on darbha.

questions.q: Built like त्रिरात्रम् आसीत (remains for three nights), what does an invented मासम् अधीते say?
options: He studies from the month on
He studies in the month's end
optionExplain: 'From' would need the ablative, like दिवसात्.
No end is named; मासम् gives a span of time.
Right: The accusative मासम् gives the length of time, like त्रिरात्रम्.
No lesson is named; मासम् gives a span of time.
questions.explain: त्रिरात्रम् = for three nights; मासम् = for a month.
questions.rule: Time word in the accusative = for how long.
questions.teaches: A time word in the accusative (त्रिरात्रम्, मासम्) tells for how long something goes on.

questions.q: By unit 82, what is she to eat?
options: A little yāvaka cooked with milk
optionExplain: Neither rice nor ghee is named; the amount is a little.
Neither is named in this unit.
Neither is named in this unit.
Right: यावकं पयसा सिद्धम् अल्पम्.
questions.explain: She eats a little yāvaka (probably a barley preparation) cooked with milk.
questions.rule: पयसा सिद्धम् = cooked with milk; अल्पम् = a little.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 82 in their printed order.
questions.explain: In a leaf-bowl or palm, yāvaka, cooked with milk, a little, for thinning, she should eat.
questions.rule: Vessel → food → cooked with milk → amount → purpose → verb.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 82 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two words give the vessel, one the liquid, one the amount and one the aim.
questions.teaches: कर्शन (making lean, thinning) names the aim of this food.

questions.q: Which split of करतलान्यतमे is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: करतल + अन्यतमे gives करतलान्यतमे.
न्यतमे is not a word of the card.
म् before a vowel would give करतलमन्यतमे.
ए + अ would give करतलेऽन्यतमे.
questions.explain: करतल (palm of the hand) + अन्यतमे (in one of them).

questions.q: By unit 82, in what may she eat it?
optionExplain: No metal vessel is named in this unit.
Right: पर्णशराव.
No pot is named; the two are a leaf-bowl and the palm.
Right: करतल.
questions.explain: अन्यतमे: in either one of the two, a leaf-bowl or the palm of the hand.

questions.q: Built like कर्शनार्थम् (for thinning), what does an invented धनार्थं गच्छति say?
options: He goes along with his wealth
He goes for the sake of wealth
He goes away from his wealth
He goes and gives his wealth
optionExplain: 'With' would need an instrumental, धनेन.
Right: -अर्थम् at the end = for the sake of, as in कर्शनार्थम्.
'From' would need the ablative, धनात्.
No giving is named; -अर्थम् means for the sake of.
questions.explain: कर्शनार्थम् = for the purpose of thinning; धनार्थम् = for the sake of wealth.
questions.rule: X + अर्थम् = for the sake of X.
questions.teaches: X + अर्थम् at the end of a compound means for the sake of X, for the purpose of X.

questions.q: By unit 83, what should she avoid?
options: Sweet, cold, bitter and oily things
Milk, ghee, honey and barley food
Sharp, hot, sour and salty things
optionExplain: None of these four is named in this unit.
None is named here; yāvaka with milk is to be eaten (unit 82).
Right: तीक्ष्ण-उष्ण-अम्ल-लवणानि वर्जयेत्.
Those belong to the three-night rule of unit 81.
questions.explain: She should avoid sharp, hot, sour and salty (things).

questions.q: Put the four qualities of unit 83 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The compound runs: sharp, hot, sour, salty.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 83 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four qualities and one verb make the whole unit.
questions.teaches: The four are joined in one dvandva compound, तीक्ष्णोष्णाम्ललवणानि: sharp, hot, sour and salty (ones).

questions.q: Which split of तीक्ष्णोष्णाम्ल is right?
optionExplain: ष्ण is not a word.
म् before a vowel would give तीक्ष्णमुष्ण.
ओष्ण is not a word of the card; the word is उष्ण.
Right: अ + उ → ओ (तीक्ष्णोष्ण); अ + अ → आ (उष्णाम्ल).
questions.explain: तीक्ष्ण (sharp) + उष्ण (hot) + अम्ल (sour).
questions.rule: अ + उ → ओ; अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which of these does unit 83 tell her to avoid?
optionExplain: Right: अम्ल is the third of the four.
मधुर is not in the list.
तिक्त is not in the list.
शीत is not in the list; hot (उष्ण) is.
questions.explain: Only sharp, hot, sour and salty are named.
questions.rule: The list: तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण, अम्ल, लवण.

questions.q: By the rule of तीक्ष्णोष्ण, how is शीत + उष्ण written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + उ gives ओ, not औ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in तीक्ष्ण + उष्ण.
The अ cannot simply vanish.
No व् is put in after अ.
questions.explain: तीक्ष्ण + उष्ण → तीक्ष्णोष्ण; so शीत + उष्ण → शीतोष्ण (cold and hot).
questions.teaches: अ or आ before उ or ऊ merges into ओ.

questions.q: By unit 84, on which day is she bathed and adorned?
optionExplain: From the first day she goes without bath (unit 81).
No seventh day is named in this unit.
Right: चतुर्थे अहनि: on the fourth day.
No twelfth day is named in this unit.
questions.explain: On the fourth day she is rubbed, bathed, anointed and adorned.

questions.q: Put these marks of her preparation in unit 84 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Rubbed with powder, bathed in cold water, anointed, adorned, in white garlands and garments.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 84 to its meaning on the card.
pairs: with the mind on no other
questions.explain: Four words describe her preparation; the last describes her mind.
questions.teaches: अनन्यमनाः = अन् + अन्य + मनस्: one whose mind is on no other.

questions.q: Which split of चतुर्थेऽहन्युद्वर्तिता is right?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give चतुर्थोऽहनि, with ओ.
हनि is not a word; ऽ marks a dropped अ.
द्वर्तिता is not a word of the card.
Right: ए + अ → एऽ (the अ drops); इ + उ → यु.
questions.explain: चतुर्थे (fourth) + अहनि (on the day) + उद्वर्तिता (rubbed with powder).
questions.rule: ए + अ → एऽ; इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: Which are part of her fourth-day preparation in unit 84?
options: Sleeping on a spread of darbha grass
Eating a little yāvaka with milk
optionExplain: That is the three-night rule of unit 81.
Right: शुक्लमाल्याम्बरा.
That is the food rule of unit 82.
Right: कृतमंगलस्वस्त्ययना.
questions.explain: On the fourth day she wears white garlands and garments and has the auspicious rites done.

questions.q: By the rule of पश्येदनन्यमनाः, how is भवेत् + अत्र written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्.
The vowel अ of अत्र cannot vanish.
Before a vowel the त् becomes द्, not त.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: पश्येत् + अनन्यमनाः → पश्येदनन्यमनाः; so भवेत् + अत्र → भवेदत्र.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a vowel (or a voiced sound) becomes द्.

questions.q: By line 1 of unit 85, what kind does she bear?
options: The kind her mother once was
The kind she sees or thinks of
The kind that the stars decide
optionExplain: No mother is named in the line.
Right: यादृशम् … पश्यति चिन्तयति वा, तादृशं प्रसूते.
No physician is named in the line.
No stars are named in the line.
questions.explain: Whatever kind she then sees or thinks of, of that kind she bears.
questions.rule: यादृश … तादृश = of which kind … of that kind.

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 of unit 85 in their printed order.
questions.explain: For then, whatever kind, she sees, or thinks of, of that kind, she bears.
questions.rule: तदा हि → यादृशम् एव → पश्यति → चिन्तयति वा → तादृशम् → प्रसूते इति.

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 of unit 85 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The pair यादृश … तादृश frames the line; three verbs say what she does.
questions.teaches: यादृश … तादृश is a pair: of which kind … of that kind (as the one, so the other).

questions.q: The card reads the printed प्रसूत इति as a verb plus इति. Which joining gives it?
optionExplain: अ + इ would merge into ए: प्रसूतेति.
म् before a vowel would give प्रसूतमिति.
Right: ए before a vowel becomes अय्; the य् drops, leaving प्रसूत इति.
आ + इ would merge into ए: प्रसूतेति.
questions.explain: प्रसूते (she bears) + इति (closing word) → प्रसूत इति.
questions.rule: ए + a vowel → अ(य्) + vowel; the य् is usually dropped.

questions.q: By line 1 of unit 85, she then keeps thinking of a strong person. What kind does she bear?
options: One of the opposite, weak kind
One of no fixed kind at all
optionExplain: The rule is likeness (तादृश), not the opposite.
The line ties the kind to what she sees or thinks of.
No father is named in the line.
Right: Whatever kind she thinks of, of that kind (तादृशम्) she bears.
questions.explain: The line ties the kind of child to the kind she sees or thinks of then.
questions.rule: यादृशम् पश्यति चिन्तयति वा, तादृशं प्रसूते.

questions.q: An invented line reads यादृशं बीजं तादृशं फलम्. What does it say?
options: As the seed is, so is the fruit
The seed is better than the fruit
The fruit grows without a seed
Seed and fruit differ in kind
optionExplain: Right: यादृश … तादृश: of which kind … of that kind.
No better or worse is said.
The line pairs seed and fruit; it denies neither.
तादृश says of that same kind.
questions.explain: As यादृशं … तादृशं प्रसूते in unit 85, यादृशं बीजं तादृशं फलम् = as the seed, so the fruit.
questions.rule: यादृश X तादृश Y = Y is of the same kind as X.
questions.teaches: यादृश … तादृश pairs two things of the same kind: as the one, so the other.

questions.q: What span of time does unit 86 name?
optionExplain: Three nights (त्रिरात्रम्) are named in unit 81.
Right: सप्तरात्रम् = seven nights.
Twelve is not named in this unit.
No fortnight is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The fragment names seven nights (सप्तरात्रम्), counted from a day (दिनात्).

questions.q: Match each part of unit 86 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The fragment is made of these four members.

questions.q: What does unit 86 lack, as the card reads it?
options: A number: no count is given
A time word: none is named
A verb: none is printed or supplied
A noun: it has only verbs
optionExplain: सप्त, seven, is a number.
दिन and रात्र are time words.
Right: The note calls it a fragment without a verb.
It has no verb; दिन and रात्र are nouns.
questions.explain: Unit 86 is a fragment with no verb; the card supplies none.
questions.rule: No verb: read the fragment with the units around it.
questions.teaches: A fragment without a verb is read with the units around it; the card adds no verb of its own.

questions.q: Which split of दिनात्सप्तरात्रं is right?
optionExplain: त्सप्तरात्रम् is not a word.
म् before स would show as an anusvara: दिनं सप्त.
Neither part is a word of the card.
Right: त् stays त् before the unvoiced स.
questions.explain: दिनात् (from the day) + सप्तरात्रम् (seven nights).
questions.rule: Final त् stays before an unvoiced consonant such as स.

questions.q: Which are true of unit 86 as the card reads it?
options: It names the eighth night for a son
It tells her to bathe on that day
optionExplain: That is unit 87.
Right: सप्तरात्रम्.
Right: दिनात् is ablative, from the day.
No bath is named in this fragment.
questions.explain: The fragment counts seven nights from the day (of the flower).
questions.rule: दिनात् = from the day; सप्तरात्रम् = seven nights.

questions.q: Built like दिनात् (from the day), what does an invented ग्रामात् आगच्छति mean?
optionExplain: Right: The ablative -आत् means from, as in दिनात्.
'To' would be an accusative, ग्रामम्.
'In' would be a locative, ग्रामे.
'With' would be an instrumental, ग्रामेण.
questions.explain: दिनात् = from the day; ग्रामात् = from the village.
questions.teaches: The ablative ending -आत् (दिनात्, ग्रामात्) means from.

questions.q: By unit 87, on which nights should one desiring a son lie together?
optionExplain: Those are for one desiring a daughter, unit 88.
Right: अष्टम्यां दशम्यां द्वादश्यां वा रात्रौ.
Those are not named in this unit.
Those fall in the three nights of unit 81.
questions.explain: On the eighth, tenth or twelfth night, one desiring a son should lie together.
questions.rule: अष्टमी, दशमी, द्वादशी = eighth, tenth, twelfth.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 87 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Then, on the eighth, tenth or twelfth night, one desiring a son should lie together.
questions.rule: अथ → अष्टम्याम् → दशम्याम् → द्वादश्याम् वा → रात्रौ → पुत्रकामः संविशेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 87 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three ordinals give the nights; two words give the person and the act.
questions.teaches: The ordinals are feminine (अष्टम्याम्, दशम्याम्) because they go with रात्रि, night, a feminine noun.

questions.q: Which split of अथाष्टम्यां is right?
optionExplain: ष्टम्याम् is not a word.
अः + अ would give अथोऽष्टम्याम्.
Right: अ + अ → आ: अथ + अष्टम्याम् gives अथाष्टम्याम्.
म् before a vowel would give अथमष्टम्याम्.
questions.explain: अथ (then) + अष्टम्याम् (on the eighth).

questions.q: One desiring a son is called ____ in unit 87 (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पुत्रकामः संविशेत्: one desiring a son should lie together.
questions.teaches: पुत्र (son) + काम (desire): one whose desire is a son.

questions.q: In an invented phrase धनकामो वणिक् (a merchant), what does धनकामः say of him?
optionExplain: काम is desire, not loss.
काम is desire, not giving.
The compound names what he desires, not who desires him.
Right: X-काम = one whose desire is X, like पुत्रकाम.
questions.explain: पुत्रकामः = one desiring a son; धनकामः = one desiring wealth.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi in -काम (पुत्रकाम, धनकाम) describes a person: one whose desire is X.

questions.q: By unit 88, which nights are for one desiring a daughter?
optionExplain: Right: पंचम्यां सप्तम्यां नवम्यां वा.
Those are for one desiring a son, unit 87.
These are not named in this unit.
These are not named in this unit.
questions.explain: On the fifth, seventh or ninth (night), one desiring a daughter.
questions.rule: पञ्चमी, सप्तमी, नवमी = fifth, seventh, ninth.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 88 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Fifth, seventh, or ninth, one desiring a daughter.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 88 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three ordinals give the nights; दुहितृकाम names the person.
questions.teaches: दुहितृकाम = one whose desire is a daughter (दुहितृ).

questions.q: Unit 88 prints no verb. Where does its verb come from?
optionExplain: भवति belongs to the next statement, not to this one.
Right: The verb and रात्रौ are carried from unit 87.
That is the avoidance rule, much earlier.
नवम्याम् is an ordinal, not a verb.
questions.explain: The unit is elliptic: संविशेत् and रात्रौ come from unit 87.
questions.rule: An elliptic line borrows its verb from the line before.

questions.q: By unit 88, which of these nights is named for one desiring a daughter?
optionExplain: The eighth is a night for a son, unit 87.
The tenth is a night for a son, unit 87.
Right: सप्तम्याम्: the seventh is one of the three.
The sixth is not named.
questions.explain: Only the fifth, seventh and ninth are named for a daughter.

questions.q: Built like सप्तम्यां (on the seventh), what does an invented तृतीयायां रात्रौ mean?
optionExplain: 'Of' would need a genitive.
That would be त्रिरात्रम्, an accusative of time.
'By' would need an instrumental.
Right: Locative ordinal + रात्रौ = on the Nth night.
questions.explain: सप्तम्यां (रात्रौ) = on the seventh night; तृतीयायां रात्रौ = on the third night.
questions.rule: Feminine ordinal in the locative + रात्रौ = on the Nth night.
questions.teaches: A feminine ordinal in the locative with रात्रौ (सप्तम्यां रात्रौ, तृतीयायां रात्रौ) means on the Nth night.

questions.q: By unit 89, how does the offspring's endowment go across these nights?
optionExplain: Right: उत्तरोत्तरम्: each later one more.
Decrease (ह्रास) comes after these, in unit 90.
उत्तरोत्तरम् says each later one is more.
The order runs upward: each later one more.
questions.explain: In these nights, progressively, the offspring has more of the endowment.

questions.q: Put these items of the endowment in unit 89 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Life-span, health, lordship, good fortune, strength, complexion (then the senses).
questions.rule: आयु → आरोग्य → ऐश्वर्य → सौभाग्य → बल → वर्ण → इन्द्रिय.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 89 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four items of the list and the one who receives them.
questions.teaches: अपत्यस्य भवति: (the endowment) is the offspring's; the genitive shows who has it.

questions.q: Which split of आयुरारोग्य is right?
optionExplain: रारोग्य is not a word.
Right: Visarga after उ becomes र् before a vowel.
म् before a vowel would give आयुमारोग्य.
ऊ + आ would give आय्वारोग्य, with व्.
questions.explain: आयुः (life-span) + आरोग्य (health).
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ → र् before a vowel.

questions.q: Which are named in the endowment of unit 89?
optionExplain: बुद्धि is not named in the list.
Right: बल is in the list.
विद्या is not named in the list.
Right: इन्द्रिय closes the list.
questions.explain: The list: life-span, health, lordship, good fortune, strength, complexion, senses.
questions.rule: आयुस्, आरोग्य, ऐश्वर्य, सौभाग्य, बल, वर्ण, इन्द्रिय.

questions.q: By the rule of आयुरारोग्य, how is धनुः + आदाय written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga after उ does not simply drop before a vowel.
Before a vowel the visarga after उ becomes र्, not स्.
Right: Visarga after उ → र् before the vowel आ.
The उ does not change to ओ.
questions.explain: आयुः + आरोग्य → आयुरारोग्य; so धनुः + आदाय → धनुरादाय (taking the bow).
questions.teaches: A visarga after उ (or any vowel but अ/आ) becomes र् before a vowel.

questions.q: By unit 90, what happens to life-span and the rest after this?
options: A sudden end on one night
optionExplain: Increase is the rule of unit 89, before this.
ह्रास, decrease, is stated.
The decrease is progressive, not sudden.
Right: उत्तरोत्तरम् एव … ह्रासः.
questions.explain: After this, life-span and the rest decrease, each later one more.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 90 in their printed order.
questions.explain: After this, but progressively indeed, of life-span and the rest, decrease.
questions.rule: अतः परम् → तु उत्तरोत्तरम् एव → आयुरादीनाम् → ह्रासः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 90 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words turn unit 89's growth into a decrease.
questions.teaches: आयुरादि = life-span and the rest: आदि stands for the remaining items of unit 89's list.

questions.q: Which split of तूत्तरोत्तरम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: उ + उ → ऊ.
त्तरोत्तरम् is not a word.
ए + उ would not give ऊ.
त् before a vowel would give तदुत्तरोत्तरम्.
questions.explain: तु (but) + उत्तरोत्तरम् (progressively).

questions.q: In unit 90, which word shows that the change comes step by step?
optionExplain: It names the change, a decrease, not its steps.
Right: Progressively: each later one more.
It means after.
It means of the rest.
questions.explain: उत्तरोत्तरम् makes the decrease progressive.

questions.q: By the rule of तूत्तरोत्तरम्, how is साधु + उक्तम् written when joined?
optionExplain: उ becomes व् only before a different vowel.
उ + उ does not give ओ.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ.
Two like vowels merge; they are not left side by side.
questions.explain: तु + उत्तरोत्तरम् → तूत्तरोत्तरम्; so साधु + उक्तम् → साधूक्तम् (well said).
questions.teaches: Two like vowels merge into the long one: उ + उ → ऊ.

questions.q: By unit 91, what happens to the ārtava in the even nights?
optionExplain: It increases in the odd nights (आप्यायते).
Not said; it becomes small.
No colour is named here.
Right: युग्मासु रात्रिषु अल्पीभवति.
questions.explain: In the even nights the ārtava becomes small; in the odd ones it increases.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 91 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Among these, in the even nights, becomes small, the ārtava; in the odd, it increases.
questions.rule: तत्र → युग्मासु → रात्रिषु → अल्पीभवति → आर्तवम् → अयुग्मासु आप्यायते.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 91 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two kinds of night, and what the ārtava does in each.
questions.teaches: युग्म = even; with the negative अ- it becomes अयुग्म, odd.

questions.q: Which split of रात्रिष्वल्पीभवति is right?
optionExplain: Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्.
रात्रिष्व is not a word, and अ + अ would give आ.
A visarga after इ would give र्: रात्रिरल्पीभवति.
ओ + अ would give रात्रिषोऽल्पीभवति.
questions.explain: रात्रिषु (in the nights) + अल्पीभवति (becomes small).
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + that vowel.

questions.q: By unit 91, what does the ārtava do on the ninth night?
optionExplain: That is in the even nights.
Right: Nine is odd (अयुग्म): there it increases.
Nothing like this is said.
The unit gives a change for both kinds of night.
questions.explain: The ninth night is odd, and in the odd nights the ārtava increases.

questions.q: By the rule of रात्रिष्वल्पीभवति, how is मधु + अरिः written when joined?
optionExplain: उ + अ does not give ओ.
उ + अ does not give ऊ.
Right: उ + अ → व् + अ.
The उ itself turns into व्; it does not stay.
questions.explain: रात्रिषु + अल्पीभवति → रात्रिष्वल्पीभवति; so मधु + अरिः → मध्वरिः.
questions.teaches: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व्.

questions.q: By unit 92, what follows in these nights, in order?
options: The growth and fall of life-span
The bath and the adorning of the wife
Chastity and sleep on darbha grass
The birth of a son and of a daughter
optionExplain: That is units 89 and 90.
That is unit 84.
Both belong to the three nights of unit 81.
Right: क्रमात् पुत्रस्य दुहितुश्च जन्म.
questions.explain: Therefore in these (nights), in order, there is the birth of a son and of a daughter.
questions.rule: पुत्रस्य दुहितुः च जन्म = birth of a son and of a daughter.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 92 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Therefore, in these, in order, of a son, and of a daughter, birth.
questions.rule: तस्मात् → तासु → क्रमात् → पुत्रस्य → दुहितुः च → जन्म.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 92 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words make the whole conclusion.
questions.teaches: क्रमात् is an ablative used as an adverb: in order, in turn.

questions.q: Which split of दुहितुश्च is right?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before च becomes श्.
श्च is not a word.
ए before च stays: दुहिते च; no श् comes in.
म् before च would show as an anusvara: दुहितुं च.
questions.explain: दुहितुः (of a daughter) + च (and).

questions.q: What does the card say about the pairing of nights in unit 92?
options: It names the even nights for a daughter
This unit itself does not spell it out
It names the odd nights for a son
It says the order is left to chance
optionExplain: No nights are named in this unit.
Right: The pairing is not spelled out here; units 87-88 give the nights.
No nights are named in this unit.
क्रमात् means in order, not by chance.
questions.explain: Unit 92 says only 'in order'; the nights are listed in units 87 and 88.
questions.rule: क्रमात् = in order; the nights: units 87-88.

questions.q: By the rule of दुहितुश्च, how is रामः + च written when joined?
optionExplain: अः becomes ओ only before a voiced sound; च is unvoiced.
Before च the visarga becomes श्, not स्.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्.
अः does not become र्.
questions.explain: दुहितुः + च → दुहितुश्च; so रामः + च → रामश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्.

questions.q: By unit 93, whom should one desiring a son not approach?
options: A woman who is already pregnant
A woman who is past fifty years
A woman whose ārtava has not ceased
optionExplain: No bath is named in this unit.
Pregnancy is not named in this unit.
Age is not named in this unit.
Right: अनुपरतार्तवदर्शनाम्: one in whom the sight of ārtava has not ceased.
questions.explain: He should not approach a woman whose ārtava is still seen.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 93 in their printed order.
questions.explain: For this very reason, and the woman whose ārtava has not ceased, one desiring a son, even on odd days, should not approach.
questions.rule: अतएव → अनुपरतार्तवदर्शनाम् → पुत्रार्थी → विषमेषु अपि अहस्सु → न उपेयात्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 93 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five words carry the person, the woman, the days and the act.
questions.teaches: अनुपरत = अन् + उपरत: not ceased; अन् is the negative before a vowel.

questions.q: Which split of नोपेयात् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ.
पेयात् is not the card's word.
A visarga after अ drops before उ, giving न उपेयात्.
Neither part is the card's word.
questions.explain: न (not) + उपेयात् (should approach).

questions.q: By unit 93, which days does it name with अपि (also, even)?
optionExplain: युग्म is unit 91's word; this unit says विषम.
Right: विषमेषु अपि अहस्सु: even on odd days.
The fourth day belongs to unit 84.
No bath is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The rule holds even on the odd days.

questions.q: By the rule of अनुपरत, which word means without beginning?
optionExplain: Before a vowel the negative is अन्, not अ.
The negative never takes व्.
Right: अन् + आदि: the negative is अन् before a vowel.
आदि keeps its long आ.
