Right: चिरायुषः means long-lived, not short-lived.
questions.explain: Line 1 calls those born thus long-lived (चिरायुषः).
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of ऋणान्मोचयितारः, how is सत् + मार्गः (good path) usually written?
optionExplain: Right: त् before the nasal म may become न् (optional; सद्मार्गः is also correct).
त् does not stay unvoiced before a nasal.
त् becomes च् only before च/छ.
The consonant is not lost.
questions.explain: सत् + मार्गः = सन्मार्गः, like ऋणात् + मोचयितारः.
questions.rule: Final त् + nasal → optionally न् (द् is also correct).
questions.teaches: A final त् before a nasal may become न् (optional; द् is also correct): ऋणात् + मोचयितारः → ऋणान्मोचयितारः.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By line 1 of unit 144, the woman devoted to what bears one of great qualities?
options: Wealth, ornaments, fine clothes and the like
Gods, conduct, purity and the like
optionExplain: Wealth is not named.
Right: दैवताचारशौचादिरता.
Sleep is not named.
Those are causes of colour in unit 135.
questions.explain: Devotion to gods, conduct, purity and the like is named.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Put the words of line 1 of unit 144 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: Gods, conduct, purity, and the like, devoted; bears; one of great qualities.
questions.rule: दैवत → आचार → शौच → आदिरता → सूते → महागुणम्.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 of unit 144 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the whole first line.
questions.teaches: -रत at the end of a compound = devoted to: X-रता = (a woman) devoted to X.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the card, how is it known that a woman is meant in line 1?
options: The word स्त्री appears in the line
From the feminine ending of रता
The word योषित् appears in the line
optionExplain: No noun for woman is stated.
Verbs carry no gender.
Right: The note: 'woman' is understood from the feminine ratā.
योषितः comes in unit 145.
questions.explain: The feminine रता alone shows that a woman is meant.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which statements about unit 144 match the card?
options: No noun for woman is stated in line 1
The sense of line 2 is not made firm
Line 2 says former-birth practice fixes the child's colour
Line 1 says the child will be a son
optionExplain: Right: understood from रता.
Right: the note says the sentence is hard.
Colour is not named; line 2 is unsettled.
महागुणम् has no noun; no son is named.
questions.explain: Line 1 implies the woman by gender; line 2 stays unsettled.
questions.rule: रता → woman understood; line 2 not firm.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of रता, which word means a woman devoted to dharma, as subject?
optionExplain: That is masculine: a man devoted to dharma.
That is neuter or accusative, not a feminine subject.
That is plural, not one woman.
Right: Feminine nominative singular, like दैवताचारशौचादिरता.
questions.explain: धर्म + रता = धर्मरता, like ...आदि + रता.
questions.teaches: रत (devoted) takes the feminine -आ for a woman: X-रता = she who is devoted to X.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By unit 145, who too discharge śukra at union?
optionExplain: Right: योषितोऽपि स्रवन्त्येव शुक्रम्.
अपि (too) adds women to men.
Pregnancy is not named in line 1.
Children are not named.
questions.explain: Women too discharge śukra at union with a man.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 of unit 145 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: Women, too, discharge, śukra, of a man, at union.
questions.rule: योषितः → अपि → स्रवन्ति → शुक्रम् → पुंसः → समागमे.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 145 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry both lines.
questions.teaches: चिन्त्यते is passive: is thought; न चिन्त्यते = is not thought.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: What does line 2 of unit 145 say of women's śukra?
options: It is thought to do nothing for the foetus
It is not thought to do nothing for the foetus
It alone forms the whole foetus
It does harm to the foetus
optionExplain: This drops the second न of न चिन्त्यते.
Right: Both negatives are printed: न ... करोति इति न चिन्त्यते.
The verse makes no such claim.
Harm is not named.
questions.explain: The line denies the view that it does nothing.
questions.rule: न किंचित् करोति इति न चिन्त्यते.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: A translation reads: 'Women too discharge śukra at union with a child.' Which word is wrong?
optionExplain: योषितः = women: right.
अपि = too: right.
Right: पुंसः means of a man, not of a child.
समागमे = at union: right.
questions.explain: The line says union with a man (पुंसः).
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of स्रवन्त्येव, how is अस्ति + एव (is indeed) written when joined?
optionExplain: इ + ए does not give a plain ए.
इ + ए does not give ऐ.
That is अस्ति + इव, not अस्ति + एव.
Right: इ before ए becomes य्, as स्रवन्ति + एव → स्रवन्त्येव.
questions.explain: अस्ति + एव = अस्त्येव, like स्रवन्ति + एव.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: स्रवन्ति + एव → स्रवन्त्येव.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: What name does the colophon of unit 146 give the chapter?
optionExplain: Right: पुत्रकामीयो नाम: named Putrakāmīya.
The colophon names no such chapter.
The colophon names no such chapter.
The colophon names no such chapter.
questions.explain: The chapter is named Putrakāmīya.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Put the words of the colophon in its order.
questions.explain: Thus, Putrakāmīya, named, first, chapter.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Match each word of the colophon to its meaning.
pairs: relating to the desire for a son
questions.explain: Five words make the whole colophon.
questions.teaches: X नाम = named X: नाम after a name marks it as a title.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which split of प्रथमोऽध्यायः is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would give प्रथमाध्यायः.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and ऽ marks the lost अ.
ध्यायः is not a word; the noun is अध्यायः.
A final म् would give प्रथममध्यायः.
questions.explain: प्रथमः (first) + अध्यायः (chapter).
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which split of पुत्रकामीयोनाम is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give पुत्रकामीयं नाम.
योनाम is not a word.
Right: अः before the voiced न becomes ओ.
उनाम is not a word.
questions.explain: पुत्रकामीयः + नाम: अः → ओ before a voiced consonant.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of प्रथमोऽध्यायः, how is द्वितीयः + अध्यायः (second chapter) written?
optionExplain: That joins a plain अ, not अः.
Visarga drops this way only before vowels other than अ.
अः does not become र् here.
Right: अः + अ → ओ with ऽ, as in प्रथमः + अध्यायः.
questions.explain: द्वितीयः + अध्यायः = द्वितीयोऽध्यायः.
questions.teaches: A final अः before अ becomes ओ, and the अ is shown by ऽ: प्रथमः + अध्यायः → प्रथमोऽध्यायः.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: What does the opening line of chapter 2 say the speakers will explain?
options: The Garbhāvakrānti Śārīra, the descent of the embryo
The Putrakāmīya Śārīra, on desiring a son
The signs of approaching death and decay
The daily care of the newborn child here
optionExplain: Right: गर्भावक्रान्तिशारीरं व्याख्यास्यामः.
That was chapter 1; this line names Garbhāvakrānti.
The line names no such subject.
The line names no such subject.
questions.explain: The line announces the Garbhāvakrānti Śārīra: the descent (entry) of the embryo.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 1 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Now, therefore, the Garbhāvakrānti Śārīra, we shall explain.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words make the whole opening formula.
questions.teaches: गर्भावक्रान्ति = गर्भ (embryo) + अवक्रान्ति (descent, entry), joined by अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which split of अथातो is right?
optionExplain: तः alone is not a word of the card.
Right: अ + अ → आ gives अथातः; before the voiced ग, अतः is written अतो.
There is no word अथः; the particle is अथ.
आतः is not a word of the card; the word is अतः, therefore.
questions.explain: अथ (now) + अतः (therefore): अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Why is अतः written अतो in अथातो गर्भावक्रान्ति…?
options: The ओ shows that अतः is a dual form here
-अः becomes -ओ before a voiced consonant such as ग
The ओ is a misprint that the data corrects
optionExplain: Before a voiceless consonant -अः does not become -ओ.
अतः is an indeclinable; it has no dual.
Right: ग is voiced, so -अः → -ओ.
The data marks no misprint here; it is regular sandhi.
questions.explain: अतः + गर्भ… → अतो गर्भ…: -अः → -ओ before a voiced consonant.

questions.q: By the rule of अथ + अतः, how is तत्र + अपि (even there) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + अ does not give ए.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
One अ is not simply dropped; the two make long आ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as in अथ + अतः → अथातः.
questions.explain: तत्र + अपि = तत्रापि, like अथ + अतः = अथातः.
questions.rule: Short अ + short अ → long आ.
questions.teaches: Two short अ sounds meeting at a word joint become one long आ: अथ + अतः → अथातः.

questions.q: By unit 2, where does the śukra finally go?
optionExplain: Right: गर्भाशयम् उपयाति = goes to the womb.
The verb उपयाति says it goes to, reaches.
The heart is not named in this unit.
No channels are named in this unit.
questions.explain: The sentence ends गर्भाशयमुपयाति: it goes to the womb.

questions.q: Put these phrases about the śukra in unit 2 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Seed-form unaltered śukra, impelled by wind, followed by the elements, mingled with ārtava, joined with the jīva, goes to the womb.
questions.rule: शुक्र → वायु → महाभूत → आर्तव → जीव → गर्भाशय.

questions.q: Match each participle of unit 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four past participles describe the śukra; उपयाति is the main verb.
questions.teaches: Each participle takes its agent or partner in the instrumental: वायुना प्रेरितम् = impelled by wind (agent), आर्तवेन अभिमूर्च्छितम् = mingled with ārtava (partner).

questions.q: Which phrase of unit 2 describes the jīva, not the śukra?
options: बीजात्मना: in the form of seed
अन्यैः महाभूतैः अनुगतम्: followed by the elements
optionExplain: This describes the śukra (बीजात्मना शुक्रम्).
Right: मनोजवेन is instrumental, like जीवेन; the data calls it a qualifier of the jīva.
अभिमूर्च्छितम् is neuter nominative, agreeing with शुक्रम्.
अनुगतम् is neuter nominative, agreeing with शुक्रम्.
questions.explain: The jīva's qualifiers are instrumentals: रागादिक्लेशवशानुवर्तिना, स्वकर्मचोदितेन, मनोजवेन.
questions.rule: jīva: swift as mind, impelled by own karma, under the sway of passion and the other afflictions.

questions.q: Which conditions does unit 2 state before the śukra goes to the womb?
optionExplain: Right: गते पुराणे (रजसि).
No fasting is named in this unit.
The text says the passage is clean (शुद्धे … मार्गे).
Right: नवे अवस्थिते.
questions.explain: Old rajas gone, new rajas established, womb and passage clean: these are the conditions.
questions.rule: गते पुराणे रजसि नवेऽवस्थिते शुद्धे गर्भस्याशये मार्गे च.

questions.q: By the rule of महाभूतैरनुगतम्, how is देवैः + अर्चितम् (worshipped by the gods) written?
optionExplain: श् stands for visarga only before च, छ, श.
The अ of अर्चितम् cannot be lost.
Right: Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel, as महाभूतैः + अनुगतम्.
ओऽ comes only from -अः, not from -ऐः.
questions.explain: देवैः + अर्चितम् = देवैरर्चितम्, like महाभूतैः + अनुगतम् = महाभूतैरनुगतम्.
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ → र् before a vowel.
questions.teaches: Visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ becomes र् before a vowel: महाभूतैः + अनुगतम् → महाभूतैरनुगतम्.

questions.q: By unit 3, whose nature does the embryo attain?
options: The nature of the mother alone
A nature opposite to its cause
optionExplain: The line names no mother.
The line names no season.
Effects follow their causes; nothing opposite is said.
Right: तत्स्वभावताम्: the nature of that (cause).
questions.explain: Because effects follow causes, it attains the nature of that cause.
questions.rule: कार्य कारण का अनुसरण करते हैं.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 3 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Effects follow causes, so it attains that nature.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 3 in the line's order, as corrected.
questions.explain: Of effects, and, because of following the cause, the nature of that, attains.
questions.teaches: -त्वात् is the ablative of a -त्व abstract noun and gives the reason: because of following the cause.

questions.q: What does the ending -त्वात् in कारणानुविधायित्वात् express?
options: A reason: because of following the cause
A place: in the following of the cause
An owner: of the following of the cause
A goal: for the following of the cause
optionExplain: Right: The card labels it an ablative; here it gives the reason.
That would need a locative, -त्वे.
That would need a genitive, -त्वस्य.
That would need a dative, -त्वाय.
questions.explain: -त्वात् = ablative: because of.
questions.rule: Ablative -आत् of an abstract can give the reason.

questions.q: Which split of कारणानुविधायित्वात् is right?
optionExplain: नुविधायित्व is not a word.
Right: अ + अ → आ: कारण + अनु… = कारणानु….
Then the म् would show: कारणमनु….
ए + अ would give कारणेऽनु…, not कारणानु….
questions.explain: कारण (cause) + अनुविधायित्वात् (because of following).

questions.q: In the invented sentence शिला गुरुत्वाज्जले मज्जति (गुरुत्वात् + जले) (the stone sinks in water), what does गुरुत्वात् mean?
optionExplain: A locative would be गुरुत्वे.
A genitive would be गुरुत्वस्य.
Right: -त्वात् gives the reason, as कारणानुविधायित्वात्.
A dative would be गुरुत्वाय.
questions.explain: गुरु (heavy) + -त्व (-ness), ablative -त्वात्: because of heaviness.
questions.teaches: -त्व makes an abstract noun (being X); its ablative -त्वात् gives the reason: because of being X.

questions.q: By unit 4, what follows from the abundance of ārtava?
optionExplain: A male comes from the abundance of śukra.
A napuṃsaka comes from the equality of the two.
No miscarriage is named in this unit.
Right: आर्तवस्य बाहुल्यात् स्त्री.
questions.explain: Abundance of ārtava gives a female.

questions.q: Match each cause in unit 4 to its result.
questions.explain: Three causes, three results, in this order.
questions.rule: शुक्र → पुमान्, आर्तव → स्त्री, साम्य → नपुंसकम्.

questions.q: Put the phrases of unit 4 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For that very reason: male, then female, then napuṃsaka.
questions.teaches: बाहुल्यात् (ablative, from abundance) and साम्येन (instrumental, by equality) both give the cause.

questions.q: In unit 4, what does तयोः (of the two) refer to?
options: The old and the new rajas
optionExplain: Right: The two just named: शुक्रस्य … आर्तवस्य.
They are the results, not the two whose equality is meant.
Neither is named in this unit.
Rajas is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: तयोः साम्येन = by the equality of the two, śukra and ārtava.

questions.q: The print has ततएव. Which split is right?
optionExplain: That would give तदेव.
Right: After -अ, visarga drops before a vowel other than अ: तत एव.
अ + ए would join into ऐ: ततैव.
That would give ततमेव.
questions.explain: ततः (from that) + एव (indeed) → तत एव.
questions.rule: -अः + vowel other than अ → -अ, with a gap.

questions.q: By the rule of ततः + एव, how is रामः + इति written?
optionExplain: -अः → -ओ only before a voiced consonant, or before अ as ओऽ.
Once the visarga drops, the vowels do not join again.
Right: -अः drops its visarga before इ and the gap stays, as तत एव.
र् replaces visarga only after vowels other than अ/आ.
questions.explain: रामः + इति = राम इति, like ततः + एव = तत एव.
questions.teaches: After अ, a visarga is dropped before any vowel except अ, and the vowels then stay apart: ततः + एव → तत एव.

questions.q: By unit 5, what splits śukra and ārtava into pieces?
optionExplain: The jīva is named in unit 2, not here.
No food is named in this unit.
The elements are named in unit 2, not here.
Right: अनिलेन = by wind.
questions.explain: शुक्रार्तवेऽनिलेन खण्डशो भिन्ने: split into pieces by the wind.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 5 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Śukra-ārtava, by wind, in pieces, split: according to division, the origin of offspring.
questions.rule: शुक्रार्तवे → अनिलेन → खण्डशः → भिन्ने → यथाविभागम् → अपत्यानाम् उत्पत्तिः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 5 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Split by wind into pieces, offspring arise according to the divisions.
questions.teaches: The card glosses both अनिल (unit 5) and वायु (unit 2) as wind.

questions.q: Which split of शुक्रार्तवेऽनिलेन is right?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ → एऽ: the ऽ marks the lost अ of अनिलेन.
निलेन is not a word; the ऽ shows an अ was lost.
-अः + अ would give शुक्रार्तवोऽनिलेन.
Then the म् would show: शुक्रार्तवमनिलेन.
questions.explain: शुक्रार्तवे (locative) + अनिलेन (by wind): ए + अ → एऽ.

questions.q: Which does unit 5 state?
options: Śukra and ārtava are split into pieces
The splitting is done by the jīva
The splitting is done by wind
optionExplain: No number is given; अपत्यानाम् is only plural.
Right: खण्डशो भिन्ने.
The agent is अनिल, wind.
Right: अनिलेन.
questions.explain: Split into pieces by wind; offspring arise according to the divisions, no number stated.

questions.q: By the pattern of यथाविभागम्, what does यथाशक्ति mean?
optionExplain: That would need a negative, not यथा.
Right: यथा + noun = according to X, like यथाविभागम्.
यथा does not mean beyond.
यथा does not give a reason.
questions.explain: यथा + शक्ति = according to (one's) strength, as यथा + विभाग = according to the division.
questions.teaches: यथा + a noun makes an indeclinable compound meaning according to X: यथाविभागम्, according to the division.

questions.q: Unit 6 opens with विकृते. What does it mean?
optionExplain: विकृत is the opposite of unaltered (अविकृत).
That is भिन्ने in unit 5.
Right: The card glosses विकृते as when vitiated.
That is अवस्थिते in unit 2.
questions.explain: विकृते = when vitiated (locative of the participle विकृत).

questions.q: Match each part of unit 6 to its meaning.
questions.explain: When vitiated: of the forms of other wombs.

questions.q: Which split of वियोन्याकृतीनाम् is right?
optionExplain: इ + अ would give वियोन्यकृतीनाम्, with short य.
Visarga after इ would become र्: वियोनिराकृतीनाम्.
Neither part is a word.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: इ + आ → या.
questions.explain: वियोनि (other womb) + आकृतीनाम् (of forms).
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: वियोनि + आकृतीनाम् → वियोन्याकृतीनाम्.

questions.q: In unit 6, what case is वियोन्याकृतीनाम्?
optionExplain: Right: -ईनाम् is the genitive plural; the card glosses it of forms.
That would be -आकृतयः.
That would be -आकृतौ.
That would be -आकृतिभिः.
questions.explain: वियोन्याकृतीनाम् = of the forms of other wombs: genitive plural.

questions.q: Which are true of unit 6, by the card?
options: विकृते is a locative: when vitiated
वियोन्याकृतीनाम् is genitive plural: of the forms
It says the forms are animal forms
optionExplain: Right: locative of the participle विकृत.
What is vitiated is not stated.
Right: -ईनाम्, genitive plural.
That is not stated and is not added.
questions.explain: विकृते = when vitiated; वियोन्याकृतीनाम् = of the forms of other wombs. What is vitiated, and what the forms are, is not said.

questions.q: By the rule of वियोन्याकृतीनाम्, how is इति + आह (he said thus) written?
optionExplain: The इ is not dropped; it becomes य्.
Right: इ + आ → या, as वियोनि + आकृतीनाम्.
इ + आ does not give ये.
इ + आ does not give ए.
questions.explain: इति + आह = इत्याह, like वियोनि + आकृतीनाम् = वियोन्याकृतीनाम्.
questions.teaches: इ before an unlike vowel becomes य्: इति + आह → इत्याह.

questions.q: Whose signs does unit 7 list?
options: A woman whose pregnancy is manifest
A woman in her monthly flow
A woman who has newly conceived
optionExplain: That is unit 9 (व्यक्तगर्भायाः).
No flow is named in this unit.
Right: सद्योगृहीतगर्भायाः = of her who has just now conceived.
No delivery is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The signs are of the woman who has just conceived.
questions.rule: सद्योगृहीतगर्भा = she who has just conceived.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put the signs of unit 7 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Seed taken in, satisfaction, heaviness, throbbing, continued connection.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each sign of unit 7 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five signs of a woman who has just conceived.
questions.teaches: सद्योगृहीतगर्भा = सद्यः (just now) + गृहीत (taken) + गर्भ: a bahuvrīhi, she who has just conceived.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What does सद्यः in सद्योगृहीतगर्भा mean?
optionExplain: Gradually is क्रमेण, in unit 9.
सद्यः is the opposite: just now.
No such word is in the compound.
Right: The card glosses सद्यः as just now.
questions.explain: सद्यः = just now; with गृहीतगर्भा, she who has just conceived.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which are signs named in unit 7?
optionExplain: That is named in unit 9, not here.
That is named in unit 9, not here.
Right: गुरिमा is in the list.
Right: स्फुरणम् is in the list.
questions.explain: Unit 7: seed taken in, satisfaction, heaviness, throbbing, connection.
questions.rule: Unit 7 = just conceived; unit 9 = manifest pregnancy.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of तृप्तिर्गुरिमा, how is मतिः + गता (the mind has gone) written?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after इ becomes र् before a voiced sound, as तृप्तिः + गुरिमा.
स् stands for visarga only before त, थ.
श् stands for visarga only before च, छ, श.
After इ the visarga is not simply dropped.
questions.explain: मतिः + गता = मतिर्गता, like तृप्तिः + गुरिमा = तृप्तिर्गुरिमा.
questions.teaches: Visarga after इ (or another vowel than अ/आ) becomes र् before a voiced sound: तृप्तिः + गुरिमा → तृप्तिर्गुरिमा.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which word in unit 8 means thirst?
optionExplain: ग्लानिः is exhaustion.
Right: The card glosses पिपासा as thirst.
तन्द्रा is drowsiness.
प्रसेकः is flow, trickling.
questions.explain: पिपासा = thirst, near the end of the list.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 8 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These five words are sure; the doubtful ones are left out.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these sure words of unit 8 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Drowsiness, limb-weariness, flow, exhaustion, thirst (doubtful words left out).
questions.teaches: अङ्गसाद = अङ्ग (limb) + साद (weariness, slackness): weariness of the limbs.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What does तथा, the first word of unit 8, mean?
optionExplain: That is तस्मात्, in unit 11.
That is क्रमेण, in unit 9.
Right: The card glosses तथा as likewise: the list of signs goes on.
That is न.
questions.explain: तथा = likewise.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Why is प्रसेकः printed प्रसेको before हृदय…?
options: The ओ marks a vocative form
optionExplain: अङ्गसादः keeps its visarga before प्रसेकः.
प्रसेकः is labelled nominative.
The stem is प्रसेक; ओ is sandhi.
Right: ह is voiced, so -अः → -ओ.
questions.explain: प्रसेकः + ह… → प्रसेको ह…: -अः → -ओ before a voiced consonant.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of प्रसेको हृदय…, how is बालः + हसति (the child laughs) written?
optionExplain: Right: -अः → -ओ before the voiced ह.
र् replaces visarga only after vowels other than अ/आ.
स् stands for visarga only before त, थ.
-अः does not become -आ.
questions.explain: बालः + हसति = बालो हसति, like प्रसेकः + हृदय… = प्रसेको हृदय….
questions.teaches: -अः becomes -ओ before a voiced consonant (ग, द, ब, ह …): प्रसेकः + हृदय… → प्रसेको हृदय….
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 9, what does the woman crave once her pregnancy is manifest?
optionExplain: Sweet is not named in this unit.
Right: अम्लेऽभिलाषः = craving for the sour.
Salty is not named in this unit.
Water is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: अम्ले अभिलाषः: craving for the sour.
questions.rule: अम्ले अभिलाषः = craving for the sour.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these signs of unit 9 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Sleep, yawning, fainting, vomiting, distaste for food, swelling of the feet.
questions.rule: निद्रा → जृम्भण → मूर्च्छा → छर्दि → अरुचि → पादशोफ.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each sign of unit 9 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Sure signs of manifest pregnancy in unit 9.
questions.teaches: पादशोफ = पाद (foot) + शोफ (swelling, oedema; standard): swelling of the feet.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What does क्रमेण, the first word of unit 9, mean?
optionExplain: That is not क्रमेण; unit 7 has सद्यः, just now.
क्रमेण is not a negative.
Right: The card glosses क्रमेण as gradually, in order.
No time of day is named.
questions.explain: क्रमेण तु व्यक्तगर्भायाः: gradually, in her whose pregnancy is manifest.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of पादशोफोऽम्ले is right?
optionExplain: म्ले is not a word; the ऽ marks a lost अ.
ए + अ would give पादशोफेऽम्ले.
Then the म् would show: पादशोफमम्ले.
Right: -अः + अ → -ओऽ: पादशोफोऽम्ले.
questions.explain: पादशोफः (swelling of the feet) + अम्ले (for the sour).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of पादशोफोऽम्ले, how is वेदः + अयम् (this is the Veda) written?
optionExplain: Right: -अः + अ → -ओऽ, as पादशोफः + अम्ले.
Before अ the visarga does not just drop; -अः + अ → -ओऽ.
र् replaces visarga only after vowels other than अ/आ.
-अः + अ does not give आ.
questions.explain: वेदः + अयम् = वेदोऽयम्, like पादशोफः + अम्ले = पादशोफोऽम्ले.
questions.teaches: -अः before अ becomes -ओ and the अ is dropped, marked by ऽ: पादशोफः + अम्ले → पादशोफोऽम्ले.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 10, what blocks the paths of the rajas-carrying channels?
optionExplain: Wind is not named in this unit.
Right: गर्भेण = by the embryo.
Old rajas is named in unit 2, not here.
Ārtava is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: वर्त्मानि उपरुध्यन्ते गर्भेण: the paths are blocked by the embryo.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 10 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The paths of her rajas-carrying channels are blocked by the embryo.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 10 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of her, of the channels, the paths, are blocked, by the embryo.
questions.teaches: In a passive sentence the doer stands in the instrumental: गर्भेण उपरुध्यन्ते = are blocked by the embryo.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What does उपरुध्यन्ते say about the paths?
options: They were opened by the embryo
optionExplain: That would be active; the form is passive.
The form is present, not future.
Right: The card labels it 3 pl. present passive.
उप-√रुध् means block, not open.
questions.explain: उपरुध्यन्ते = are blocked; वर्त्मानि is its plural subject.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of वर्त्मान्युपरुध्यन्ते is right?
optionExplain: युपरुध्यन्ते is not a word.
Then the म् would show: वर्त्मानमुप….
-अः + उ would drop the visarga: वर्त्मान उप….
Right: इ before उ becomes य्: नि + उ → न्यु.
questions.explain: वर्त्मानि (paths) + उपरुध्यन्ते (are blocked).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: In the invented sentence जलेन मार्गा उपरुध्यन्ते, what blocks the paths?
options: Nothing; the paths block the water
optionExplain: Right: जलेन is instrumental: the doer of the passive.
मार्गाः is the subject that is blocked.
The verb is passive: the paths are blocked.
No traveller is named.
questions.explain: जलेन मार्गा(ः) उपरुध्यन्ते = the paths are blocked by water, like वर्त्मानि गर्भेण उपरुध्यन्ते.
questions.teaches: With a passive verb, the thing acted on is nominative and the doer instrumental: वर्त्मानि … गर्भेण उपरुध्यन्ते.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 11, what is no longer seen after conception?
optionExplain: Śukra is not named in this unit.
Right: आर्तवं न दृश्यते.
No throbbing is named in this unit.
That is a sign in unit 9, not named here.
questions.explain: आर्तवं न दृश्यते: the ārtava is not seen.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 11 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Therefore, from then on, the ārtava is not seen.
questions.rule: तस्मात् → ततः → परम् → आर्तवम् → न → दृश्यते.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 11 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Therefore, from then on, ārtava is not seen.
questions.rule: तस्मात्, ततः परम्, आर्तवम्, न, दृश्यते.
questions.teaches: ततः परम् is an idiom: after that, from then on.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the card, what does तस्मात् (therefore) point back to?
options: The splitting by wind in unit 5
The blocking of the channels in unit 10
optionExplain: That explains offspring, not the stopping of ārtava.
Unit 7 lists signs; it gives no cause.
Right: The data links unit 11 to unit 10.
That is a condition for conception, not this cause.
questions.explain: The paths are blocked by the embryo (unit 10); therefore ārtava is not seen (unit 11).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What form is दृश्यते in unit 11?
optionExplain: The form is passive, not active.
The plural would be दृश्यन्ते.
The form is present, not future.
Right: The card labels it 3 sg. pres. pass. of √दृश्.
questions.explain: दृश्यते = is seen; with न, is not seen.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: In the invented line चन्द्रो न दृश्यते, what is said?
options: The moon will not be seen
optionExplain: Right: दृश्यते is passive singular: is seen; न = not.
That would need an active verb, पश्यति.
दृश्यते is present, not future.
चन्द्रः and दृश्यते are singular.
questions.explain: चन्द्रो न दृश्यते = the moon is not seen, like आर्तवं न दृश्यते.
questions.teaches: दृश्यते is the present passive of √दृश्: is seen; न दृश्यते = is not seen.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 12, what name is given to what is checked below and increases of itself?
optionExplain: जरायु is the name others give, in unit 13.
Right: अपरेत्याहुः = they call it aparā.
Ārtava is not the name given here.
The womb is not the name given here.
questions.explain: They call it aparā, probably the afterbirth (placenta).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 12 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Checked below, increasing of itself, they call it aparā.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 12 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, that, checked below, increasing of itself, they call aparā (the doubled अपरम् is left out).
questions.rule: ततः → तत् → अधः प्रतिहतम् → स्वोपचीयमानम् → अपरा इति आहुः.
questions.teaches: स्वोपचीयमान = स्व (of itself) + उपचीयमान (being built up, present passive participle of उप-√चि).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of स्वोपचीयमानम् is right?
optionExplain: -अः before उ drops the visarga and leaves a gap: स्व उप….
Then the म् would show: स्वमुप….
Right: अ + उ → ओ: स्व + उप… = स्वोप….
ए before उ would not give ओ.
questions.explain: स्व (by itself) + उपचीयमानम् (being built up): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of अपरेत्याहुः is right?
optionExplain: ए + इ would give अपर इति, not अपरेति.
Then the म् would show: अपरमित्याहुः.
इत्या and हुः are not words of the card.
Right: आ + इ → ए, then इ + आ → या.
questions.explain: अपरा (the name) + इति (thus) + आहुः (they say).
questions.rule: आ + इ → ए; इ + आ → या.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of अपरा + इति → अपरेति, how is महा + इन्द्रः written?
optionExplain: Right: आ + इ → ए, as अपरा + इति.
आ + इ gives ए, not ऐ.
आ + इ does not give ई.
No य् is put between आ and इ.
questions.explain: महा + इन्द्रः = महेन्द्रः, like अपरा + इति = अपरेति.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before इ or ई joins into ए: अपरा + इति → अपरेति.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 13, what name do others give?
optionExplain: Aparā is the name of unit 12.
Right: जरायुरित्यन्ये = jarāyu, say others.
Ārtava is not the name given.
Srotas are the channels of unit 10.
questions.explain: Others call it jarāyu, probably the foetal membrane.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 13 to its meaning.
questions.explain: jarāyu, thus, say others.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Others say: ____ इति अन्ये. Type the name in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is जरायुरित्यन्ये: jarāyu, say others.
questions.teaches: इति after a word marks it as quoted; the verb say is carried from unit 12.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of जरायुरित्यन्ये is right?
optionExplain: रिति is not a word; the र् comes from the visarga.
Then the म् would show: जरायुमित्यन्ये.
Right: -उः → -उर् before a vowel; इ + अ → य.
न्ये is not a word; the अ of अन्ये joins with इ.
questions.explain: जरायुः (the name) + इति (thus) + अन्ये (others).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: What does अन्ये mean in unit 13?
optionExplain: That would be इमे.
That would be सर्वे.
That would be केचित्.
Right: The card glosses अन्ये as others (nom. pl.).
questions.explain: जरायुरित्यन्ये: jarāyu, say others.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of जरायुरिति, how is गुरुः + आगतः (the teacher has come) written?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after उ becomes र् before a vowel, as जरायुः + इति.
After उ the visarga is not dropped before a vowel.
The उ of गुरुः does not change to ओ.
स् stands for visarga only before त, थ.
questions.explain: गुरुः + आगतः = गुरुरागतः, like जरायुः + इति = जरायुरिति.
questions.teaches: Visarga after उ (any vowel but अ/आ) becomes र् before a vowel: जरायुः + इति → जरायुरिति.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 14, what appears when the blood has settled?
optionExplain: Unit 11 says the ārtava is no longer seen.
Right: रोमराजी प्रादुर्भवति: a line of hair appears.
No swelling of the feet is named in this unit.
The kalala is named for the first month in unit 17.
questions.explain: When the blood has settled, a line of hair (romarājī) appears.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 14 in their printed order.
questions.explain: First the time (the blood settled), then the line of hair appears, then the blood goes up to the jarāyu's remainder.
questions.rule: स्थिते रक्ते → रोमराजी प्रादुर्भवति → जरायुशेषम् → ऊर्ध्वम् असृक् प्रतिपद्यते.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 14 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words carry the two events: the hair-line appears, the blood goes upward.
questions.teaches: असृक् (stem असृज्) is another word for blood, like रक्त.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of चोर्ध्वम् is right?
optionExplain: औ + ऊ would give चावूर्ध्वम्, not चोर्ध्वम्.
ए before a vowel does not give ओ.
Right: अ + ऊ → ओ: च + ऊर्ध्वम् → चोर्ध्वम्.
चोर् and ध्वम् are not the card's words.
questions.explain: च (and) + ऊर्ध्वम् (upward): अ + ऊ merges into ओ.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: In unit 14, which word is another name for रक्त (blood)?
optionExplain: जरायु is probably the foetal membrane, not blood.
रोमराजी is a line of hair.
ऊर्ध्वम् means upward.
Right: असृक् (असृज्) is a synonym of रक्त, both 'blood'.
questions.explain: The line begins with रक्ते and later calls the blood असृक्.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of चोर्ध्वम्, how is जल + ऊर्मिः written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ऊ → ओ, as in च + ऊर्ध्वम् → चोर्ध्वम्.
अ + ऊ gives ओ, not the vṛddhi vowel औ.
The अ does not simply drop before ऊ.
No व् is inserted after अ.
questions.explain: च + ऊर्ध्वम् → चोर्ध्वम्; so जल + ऊर्मिः → जलोर्मिः.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before उ or ऊ merges into ओ.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 15, which parts become plump (पीन)?
optionExplain: Those become black (कृष्ण), not plump.
Right: पीनकपोलपयोधरता: plumpness of cheeks and breasts.
Hands and feet are not named in this unit.
Belly and thighs are not named in this unit.
questions.explain: Plump: cheeks and breasts; black: lips and nipples.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put the body parts of unit 15 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The plump pair (cheeks, breasts) comes first, then the black pair (lips, nipples).
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 15 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two qualities (plump, black) and the parts they qualify.
questions.teaches: पयोधर literally means 'milk-bearer', a word for the breast.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which pairing of change and part does unit 15 state?
optionExplain: The qualities are swapped: cheeks are plump, lips black.
Swapped: breasts are plump, nipples black.
Right: कृष्णौष्ठ: black lips; पीनकपोल: plump cheeks.
Breasts are plump and lips black, not the reverse.
questions.explain: पीन goes with कपोल and पयोधर; कृष्ण goes with ओष्ठ and चूचुक.
questions.rule: पीन: कपोल, पयोधर · कृष्ण: ओष्ठ, चूचुक.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of कृष्णौष्ठ is right?
optionExplain: उष्ठ is not a word; the lip is ओष्ठ.
औ + ओ would give कृष्णावोष्ठ.
म् before ओ would give कृष्णमोष्ठ.
Right: अ + ओ → औ (vṛddhi): कृष्ण + ओष्ठ → कृष्णौष्ठ.
questions.explain: कृष्ण (black) + ओष्ठ (lip): अ + ओ merges into औ.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Like पीनता (plumpness) in unit 15, what does मधुरता mean?
options: Sweetness, the state of being sweet
optionExplain: Right: -ता makes a noun of state: मधुर → मधुरता.
-ता names the state, not a thing.
-ता is no word of degree.
-ता names a state, not an action.
questions.explain: पीन (plump) → पीनता (plumpness); मधुर (sweet) → मधुरता (sweetness).
questions.rule: -ता / -त्व after a word = the state of being that.
questions.teaches: -ता (f.) and -त्व (n.) make nouns of state: पीनता, कृष्णत्व.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 16, by what is it nourished again?
options: By the blood of the embryo
optionExplain: No ghee is named in this unit.
Right: पुनराहाररसेनाप्यायते: nourished again by food-rasa.
The embryo's blood is not named here.
No water or time of day is named.
questions.explain: It is nourished again by the rasa of food (आहाररसेन).
questions.rule: आहाररस = the nutrient juice of food.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 16 in their printed order (the damaged word left out).
questions.explain: Resting in the breasts, reaching the state of milk, in her who has given birth, nourished again by food-rasa.
questions.rule: स्तनाश्रय → स्तन्यता उपगत → प्रसूतायाः → आहाररसेन आप्यायते.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 16 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five sure words of the line; the damaged word is left out.
questions.teaches: स्तन्य is breast milk (standard identification); स्तन्यता is the state of being milk.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of पुनराहार is right?
optionExplain: पुन and राहार are not the card's words.
पुना is not a word; the word is पुनर्.
Right: पुनर् ends in र्, which joins the following vowel.
पुनरा is not a word; the food is आहार.
questions.explain: पुनर् (again) + आहार (food): the र् is kept before the vowel.
questions.rule: पुनर् + vowel → पुनर् joined to it.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: In unit 16, what does प्रसूतायाः tell us?
options: Of the embryo in the womb
Of the nurse who feeds the child
Of her who has given birth
optionExplain: The embryo is not named in this unit.
प्रसूता means one who has already given birth.
No nurse is named in this unit.
Right: प्रसूतायाः: f. gen. sg., 'of her who has given birth'.
questions.explain: The milk-state is reached in her who has given birth (प्रसूता).
questions.rule: प्रसूता = she who has given birth.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: Like प्रसूतायाः (of her who has given birth), what does बालायाः mean?
optionExplain: Right: -आयाः is the genitive (and also ablative) singular of an आ-stem feminine; 'of' is the genitive sense, as in प्रसूतायाः.
That would be बालाः.
That would be बालया.
That would be बालायाम्.
questions.explain: प्रसूता → प्रसूतायाः (of her); बाला → बालायाः (of the girl).
questions.rule: आ-stem feminine: -आयाः = of (genitive sg.; the ablative sg. has the same form).
questions.teaches: Feminine आ-stems take -आयाः in the genitive (and ablative) singular: प्रसूता → प्रसूतायाः.
questions.section: सद्योगृहीत व व्यक्त गर्भ के लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 17, what arises in the first month?
options: A kalala, the first embryonic mass
optionExplain: The ghana is named for the second month (unit 18).
Right: प्रथमे मासे कललं जायते.
Sprouting in five ways is the third month (unit 19).
The line of hair appears in unit 14.
questions.explain: In the first month a kalala arises.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put the words of unit 17 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Of these, in the first month, a kalala arises.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 17 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five words: the frame, the time, the thing, the verb.
questions.teaches: कलल is the first stage of the embryo; 'early embryo' is a probable modern equivalent.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of the printed कललंजायते is right?
optionExplain: अंजायते is not a word.
कलला is not the card's word; it is कललम्.
Right: Final म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra: कललं जायते.
Neither कललः nor अजायते is the card's form.
questions.explain: कललम् (kalala, nom.) + जायते (arises); the print runs them together.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: In unit 17, what does the locative प्रथमे मासे tell?
options: From where: out of the month
Whose: belonging to the first month
When it arises: in the first month
optionExplain: What arises is the kalala, not the month.
A source would need the ablative.
Possession would need the genitive.
Right: The locative gives the time: in the first month.
questions.explain: प्रथमे मासे (locative) = in the first month: the time of arising.
questions.rule: Locative of time = in, at, during.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Built like प्रथमे मासे कललं जायते, what does वसन्ते पुष्पं जायते mean?
options: A flower gives rise to spring
The flower of spring is born
optionExplain: Right: वसन्ते is a locative of time, like प्रथमे मासे.
पुष्पम् is the subject; वसन्ते is not an object.
जायते means arises, not gives rise to.
वसन्ते is locative, not genitive (वसन्तस्य).
questions.explain: प्रथमे मासे = in the first month; वसन्ते = in spring.
questions.rule: Locative = the time when; nominative = what arises.
questions.teaches: A locative noun gives the time: in the first month, in spring.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: With which month does unit 18 name the ghana, peśī or arbuda?
optionExplain: The first month has the kalala (unit 17).
Right: द्वितीये: in the second (month).
The third month has the five sprouts (unit 19).
No fourth month is named in this unit.
questions.explain: द्वितीये (in the second) opens the unit.
questions.rule: द्वितीय मास → घन, पेशी या अर्बुद.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put these words of unit 18 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The month, the three forms, then 'from these, in order', then the three sexes.
questions.rule: द्वितीये → घनः → पेशी/अर्बुदम् वा → तेभ्यः → क्रमात् → पुम्-स्त्री-नपुंसक.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 18 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three forms joined by 'or', and the order word that links them to the sexes.
questions.teaches: क्रमात् = in order, respectively: it links two lists item by item without spelling the pairs out.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of पेश्यर्बुदम् is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give पेश्यार्बुदम्.
ए + अ would give पेशेऽर्बुदम्.
Right: ई + अ → य्: पेशी + अर्बुदम् → पेश्यर्बुदम्.
यर्बुदम् is not a word.
questions.explain: पेशी (muscle-like lump) + अर्बुदम् (lump): ई before अ becomes य्.
questions.rule: इ/ई + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which are true of unit 18?
options: It joins the three forms with वा (or)
It spells out which form becomes male
It has a printed verb such as 'arises'
optionExplain: Right: द्वितीये.
Right: घनः पेशी अर्बुदं वा.
The pairing is left to क्रमात्; it is not spelled out.
No verb is printed in this unit.
questions.explain: The unit names the month and three forms joined by वा; it has no verb and spells out no pairing.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of पेश्यर्बुदम्, how is नदी + अस्ति written when joined?
optionExplain: The ई does not drop before अ.
The अ stays short; ई + अ gives य, not या.
ई + अ does not give ए.
Right: ई + अ → य्, as in पेशी + अर्बुदम् → पेश्यर्बुदम्.
questions.explain: पेशी + अर्बुदम् → पेश्यर्बुदम्; so नदी + अस्ति → नद्यस्ति.
questions.teaches: इ or ई before a different vowel becomes य्.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By unit 19, in which month does it sprout in five ways?
optionExplain: Right: तृतीये: in the third (month).
The first month has the kalala (unit 17).
The second month has ghana, peśī or arbuda (unit 18).
No fifth month is named here.
questions.explain: तृतीये पञ्चधा प्ररोहति: in the third, it sprouts in five ways.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put the words of unit 19 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The month, the manner, the verb.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: In unit 19, it sprouts ____ (in five ways). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पञ्चधा (printed पंचधा) = in five ways.
questions.teaches: पञ्च (five) + -धा (in … ways) = in five ways.
questions.rule: -धा after a number = in so many ways.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What does प्ररोहति mean in unit 19?
optionExplain: That is जायते (unit 17).
Right: प्र + √रुह्: it sprouts, grows out.
That is स्पष्टीभवन्ति (unit 22).
That is आप्यायते (unit 16).
questions.explain: प्ररोहति = it sprouts, like a plant putting out shoots.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Unit 19 prints no subject for प्ररोहति. Whom does the card take it to be?
optionExplain: The card does not take the blood as subject here.
The line of hair belongs to unit 14.
Right: The note: subject 'it' (the embryo) is understood.
Breast milk belongs to unit 16.
questions.explain: प्ररोहति (it sprouts) has the embryo as its understood subject.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: तृतीये = in the third (month). How is in the fourth month said?
optionExplain: That is the nominative: the fourth month (as subject).
चतुर्धा means in four ways, not fourth.
That is the genitive: of the fourth month.
Right: Ordinal and noun both in the locative, like तृतीये (मासे).
questions.explain: प्रथमे, द्वितीये, तृतीये (मासे); so चतुर्थे मासे = in the fourth month.
questions.rule: Ordinal + मासे in the locative = in the Nth month.
questions.teaches: Ordinals agree with मास in the locative to give the month: तृतीये मासे.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What does तद्यथा (unit 20) mean?
optionExplain: Right: तत् + यथा: 'that, as', i.e. namely.
Therefore would be तस्मात् (unit 15).
Otherwise is अन्यथा (unit 24).
Simultaneously is युगपत् (unit 22).
questions.explain: तद्यथा = namely: it opens a list.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put the steps that form तद्यथा in order.
items: त् stands before the voiced य
questions.explain: The two words meet; the voiced य turns त् into द्; the joined form results.
questions.rule: तत् + यथा → त् before voiced य → द् → तद्यथा.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: The formula meaning 'namely' in unit 20 is ____ (one joined word). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तद्यथा = तत् + यथा, namely.
questions.teaches: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा: a stock formula that opens a list.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of तद्यथा is right?
optionExplain: That would join as तदयथा.
Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्.
तदा + यथा would stay तदा यथा.
तद्य and था are not the card's words.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as, namely).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: In this chapter, what does तद्यथा (unit 20) introduce?
options: The list of the first three months
The list of the plump body parts
The list of the five sprouts
The list of things born after birth
optionExplain: The months come before, in units 17 to 19.
Those were named before, in unit 15.
Right: Unit 21 lists the two thighs, two arms and head.
Teeth and the rest are named in unit 22.
questions.explain: तद्यथा opens the list of the five sprouts of unit 19, given in unit 21.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is तत् + वनम् written when joined?
optionExplain: त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
त् becomes च् only before च/छ.
Before the voiced व the त् must become द्.
Right: त् before the voiced व becomes द्.
questions.explain: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा; so तत् + वनम् → तद्वनम्.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel or a soft consonant such as य, व, ग, द, ब (before ल it becomes ल्; before a nasal it may become न्).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Unit 21 names the five sprouts. Which list is it?
options: Two thighs, two arms and the head
Two eyes, two ears and the nose
Two hands, two feet and the heart
Two thighs, two arms and the belly
optionExplain: Right: सक्थिनी बाहू शिरश्च.
Eyes, ears and nose are not named here.
The heart is not named; the list is thighs, arms, head.
The fifth is the head (शिरः), not the belly.
questions.explain: Two thighs (legs), two arms and the head make the five.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put the three words of unit 21 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Thighs first, then arms, then the head.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 21 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three body words and the joining 'and'.
questions.teaches: सक्थिनी is the neuter dual of सक्थि (thigh); बाहू is the dual of बाहु (arm).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of शिरश्च is right?
optionExplain: श्च is not a word.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्: शिरश्च.
श्च is not a word; the word is च.
शिरा would mean a vein; the word is शिरः, head.
questions.explain: शिरः (head) + च (and).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which two words of unit 21 are dual (a pair)?
optionExplain: शिरः is singular: one head.
शिरः is singular.
Right: Both are nom. dual: the two thighs, the two arms.
च is an indeclinable, 'and'.
questions.explain: सक्थिनी (n. du.) and बाहू (m. du.) are duals; शिरः is singular.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of शिरश्च, how is रामः + च written when joined?
optionExplain: Visarga becomes ओ only before a voiced sound.
Before च the sibilant is श्, not स्.
Visarga does not become च्.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्.
questions.explain: शिरः + च → शिरश्च; so रामः + च → रामश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By unit 22, which are excepted from arising simultaneously?
options: Teeth and the rest, born after birth
optionExplain: Right: अन्यत्र जन्मोत्तरकालजेभ्यो दन्तादिभ्यः.
They are the sprouts at whose time all arise.
The indriyas are among those that arise together.
Neither is named as an exception.
questions.explain: All arise together except those born after birth, the teeth and the rest.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 22 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The time, the things that arise, 'together', the exception, the teeth, then 'in order they become distinct'.
questions.rule: एककालम् → सर्वाङ्ग… → युगपत् → अन्यत्र … दन्तादिभ्यः → क्रमेण स्पष्टीभवन्ति.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 22 to its meaning on the card.
pairs: born in the time after birth
questions.explain: Five words carry the teaching: together, except the later-born, then distinct in order.
questions.teaches: अन्यत्र with an ablative (…भ्यः) means 'except': अन्यत्र दन्तादिभ्यः = except the teeth and the rest.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What contrast does unit 22 draw?
options: They arise in order, but become distinct together
They arise together, but become distinct in order
They arise before the sprouts, then vanish
Teeth arise first, the limbs come last
optionExplain: This reverses युगपत् and क्रमेण.
Right: युगपत् सम्भवन्ति … क्रमेण तु स्पष्टीभवन्ति.
They arise at the same time as the sprouts.
Teeth are the exception, born after birth.
questions.explain: Arising is simultaneous (युगपत्); becoming distinct is in order (क्रमेण).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of संभवन्त्यन्यत्र is right?
optionExplain: उ + अ would give संभवन्त्वन्यत्र.
ए + अ would give संभवन्तेऽन्यत्र.
Right: इ + अ → य्: संभवन्त्यन्यत्र.
संभवन्त्यन् is not a word.
questions.explain: संभवन्ति (they come to be) + अन्यत्र (except).
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Built like अन्यत्र दन्तादिभ्यः, what does सर्वे गताः अन्यत्र रामात् mean?
optionExplain: With would need सह and an instrumental.
To would need an accusative (रामम्).
Cause is not the sense of अन्यत्र; with an ablative it means except.
Right: अन्यत्र with the ablative रामात् = except Rāma.
questions.explain: अन्यत्र + ablative = except: अन्यत्र दन्तादिभ्यः, अन्यत्र रामात्.
questions.teaches: अन्यत्र with an ablative noun means 'except that'.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What does unit 23 call 'this' (एषा)?
optionExplain: Right: एषा प्रकृतिः: this is the prakṛti.
vikṛti is named in unit 24, as otherwise than this.
kalala is the first month (unit 17).
jarāyu is not named here.
questions.explain: This is the prakṛti, the natural, normal state.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which are true of unit 23?
options: एषा is feminine, agreeing with प्रकृतिः
No verb is printed; 'is' is understood
optionExplain: It is nominative singular.
Right: both are f. nom. sg.
It has only two words and no list.
Right: the copula is understood.
questions.explain: Two words, both feminine nominative, with 'is' understood.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Unit 23: एषा ____ (this is the normal state). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. prakriti).
questions.explain: एषा प्रकृतिः = this is the prakṛti, the normal state.
questions.teaches: प्रकृति here = the natural, normal course.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What does प्रकृति mean in unit 23?
optionExplain: The note rules this sense out here.
Right: The note: here prakṛti is the normal course.
The note rules this sense out here.
A deviation would be vikṛti, not prakṛti.
questions.explain: प्रकृति in unit 23 is the normal course, as against विकृति in unit 24.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Unit 23 prints no verb. How is एषा प्रकृतिः read?
options: As a question: is this prakṛti
As an order: make this prakṛti
With 'is' understood: this is the prakṛti
optionExplain: Nothing marks a question.
No command form is present.
Right: A nominal sentence: the copula is understood.
That would need a genitive, प्रकृतेः.
questions.explain: Two nominatives with 'is' understood: this is the prakṛti.
questions.rule: Nominal sentence: X Y = X is Y.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Like एषा प्रकृतिः, which pronoun goes with नदी (a river, f.) to say: this is the river?
optionExplain: एषः is masculine; नदी is feminine.
एतत् is neuter; नदी is feminine.
एताम् is accusative; the subject needs the nominative.
Right: एषा is f. nom. sg., agreeing with the feminine नदी.
questions.explain: एषा agrees with प्रकृतिः (f.); so एषा नदी.
questions.rule: Pronoun agrees with its noun in gender, case and number.
questions.teaches: The pronoun एतद् takes the gender of its noun: एषः (m.), एषा (f.), एतत् (n.).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: What does unit 24 call 'otherwise than this'?
optionExplain: Right: विकृतिः अतः अन्यथा.
prakṛti is the normal course of unit 23.
kalala is the first month's mass (unit 17).
stanya belongs to unit 16.
questions.explain: Otherwise than this is vikṛti, deviation.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Put the three words of unit 24 in their printed order.
questions.explain: vikṛti, than this, otherwise.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 24 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words: the name, the reference point and the difference.
questions.teaches: अतः (than this) points back to the prakṛti of unit 23.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: Which split of विकृतिरतोऽन्यथा is right?
optionExplain: रतः is not the card's word; the र् is the visarga.
Right: इः + vowel → इर्; अः + अ → ओऽ.
न्यथा is not a word; the word is अन्यथा.
विकृतिर and तो are not words.
questions.explain: विकृतिः (deviation) + अतः (than this) + अन्यथा (otherwise).
questions.rule: इः + vowel → इर्; अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: In अतोऽन्यथा, what does the sign ऽ mark?
options: A visarga that must be restored
A long vowel to be held
The अ of अन्यथा, dropped after ओ
A damaged letter in the print
optionExplain: The visarga became ओ; ऽ marks the lost अ.
ऽ marks a dropped अ, not length.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the lost अ is shown by ऽ.
ऽ is a regular sign (avagraha), not damage.
questions.explain: अतः + अन्यथा → अतोऽन्यथा: ऽ (avagraha) stands for the dropped अ.
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of अतोऽन्यथा, how is रामः + अत्र written when joined?
optionExplain: Visarga → र् only after a vowel other than अ/आ.
अः + अ does not give आ.
Visarga → स् only before त/थ.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ, as in अतः + अन्यथा.
questions.explain: अतः + अन्यथा → अतोऽन्यथा; so रामः + अत्र → रामोऽत्र.
questions.teaches: अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ drops, marked by ऽ (avagraha).
questions.section: गर्भ: पहले से तीसरे मास तक

questions.q: By unit 25, where do the states (bhāva) become established?
options: In the mind and in the body
In the blood and the milk
optionExplain: Right: मनसि शरीरे च संतिष्ठन्ते.
Blood and milk are not named here.
The unit names the mind and the body.
They are the embryo's states (गर्भस्य).
questions.explain: The states become established in the mind and in the body.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 25 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Each by its own, of the embryo, conforming to one sex's sign, the states, in mind and body, are established.
questions.rule: यथास्वम् → गर्भस्य → …लिङ्गानुरूपाः एव → भावाः → मनसि शरीरे च → संतिष्ठन्ते.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 25 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five sure words of the sentence; the uncertain अन्यतर्म is left out.
questions.teaches: भाव here is a state or disposition; the unit does not say which ones.

questions.q: By unit 25, to what do the embryo's states conform?
options: The season in which it was conceived
The sign of male, female or neuter
optionExplain: No season is named in this unit.
Right: …लिङ्गानुरूपाः: conforming to the sign (liṅga).
Food is not named in this unit.
No month is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The states conform to the liṅga (sign) of one of male, female or neuter.

questions.q: In the printed अनुरूपा एव, what happened to अनुरूपाः?
options: It is a feminine singular word
It lost its last vowel to एव
Its visarga dropped before the vowel ए
A word has dropped out of the print
optionExplain: It is m. nom. pl., agreeing with भावाः.
The आ stays; only the visarga goes.
Right: आः + vowel → आ, with the gap kept: अनुरूपा एव.
Nothing is missing; this is regular sandhi.
questions.explain: अनुरूपाः + एव → अनुरूपा एव: visarga after आ drops before a vowel.

questions.q: By the rule of अनुरूपा एव, how is बालाः + इह written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga drops first; आ and इ are then not merged.
Visarga → र् only after a vowel other than अ/आ.
ओ comes from अः, not from आः.
Right: आः + vowel → आ, and the two words stay apart.
questions.explain: अनुरूपाः + एव → अनुरूपा एव; so बालाः + इह → बाला इह.
questions.rule: आः + vowel → आ + vowel (no further joining).
questions.teaches: After आ, a visarga drops before a vowel and the vowels are not joined.

questions.q: In unit 26, what does लिंगसंकरे mean?
optionExplain: Right: लिंग-संकरे: sign; in a mixture (locative).
संकर is mixture, not absence.
No order is named; संकर means mixture.
A mixture is the opposite of a single sign.
questions.explain: लिंगसंकर = mixture of signs; -ए gives the locative, in.

questions.q: Put these printed pieces of unit 26 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Distinguishing, in a mixture of signs but, greater abundance, from that one or the other states.
questions.rule: वैशेषिकं → लिंगसंकरे तु → (यवो) भूयस्त्वं → ततोऽन्यतरा भावाः.

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 26 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words are sure; यवो, the ending of अन्यतरा and the role of वैशेषिकं stay doubtful.
questions.teaches: -त्व makes an abstract noun: भूयस् (more) + त्व = भूयस्त्व, greater abundance.

questions.q: Which split of the start of ततोऽन्यतरा is right?
optionExplain: त् + अ would give तदन्यतरा.
Right: अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ is dropped (ऽ): ततः + अन्यतरा → ततोऽन्यतरा.
A final म् would give ततमन्यतरा.
न्यतरा is not a word; the word is अन्यतर.
questions.explain: ततः (from that) + अन्यतरा(ः) (one or the other); the avagraha marks the dropped अ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 26 match the card?
options: The unit names the signs that are mixed
The data takes यवो as barley in this line
The reading of the unit is of low confidence
optionExplain: No signs are named in unit 26.
The flag says barley makes no sense here.
Right: confidence is low; यवो → यतः is only possible.
Right: the card glosses it so.
questions.explain: Two statements follow from the card; the signs are not named and यवो is not read as barley.
questions.rule: Low confidence; sure words: लिंगसंकर, भूयस्त्व, भाव.

questions.q: By the rule of ततोऽन्यतरा, how is रामः + अपि (Rāma too) written?
optionExplain: The visarga does not vanish into a long आ.
र् comes only after vowels other than अ or आ.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, with the अ dropped (ऽ), as ततः + अन्यतरा.
The visarga does not become स् before a vowel.
questions.explain: रामः + अपि = रामोऽपि, like ततः + अन्यतरा = ततोऽन्यतरा.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ before अ: अः becomes ओ and the next अ is dropped (ऽ): ततः + अन्यतरा → ततोऽन्यतरा.

questions.q: By the card, what does तद्यथा in unit 27 introduce?
optionExplain: The chapter does not end here.
No verse follows; unit 28 is prose.
No speaker is named.
Right: The note: the formula introduces the list in line 28 (card 28).
questions.explain: तद्यथा opens the list of unit 28.

questions.q: What does तद्यथा mean?
optionExplain: Right: तत् (that) + यथा (as): that is, namely.
Therefore is तस्मात्, in unit 34.
And then is तदा च, in unit 31.
Others however is अन्ये तु, in unit 36.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = namely, as follows.

questions.q: तद्यथा = ____ + यथा (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as); त् before य is written द्.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a voiced sound such as य becomes द्: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.

questions.q: Which split of तद्यथा is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give तं यथा.
Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्.
अथा is not a word; the word is यथा.
Neither तद्य nor था is a word here.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as, namely).

questions.q: Which statements about unit 27 match the card?
options: तद्यथा itself names a woman-making state
तत् in तद्यथा is neuter nominative singular
तत् here is ablative, from that
The formula introduces the list of unit 28
optionExplain: It names nothing; the states come in unit 28.
Right: the card labels tat n. nom. sg.
From that would be तस्मात्; तत् is nominative.
Right: the note says so.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = तत् (n. nom. sg.) + यथा, introducing unit 28's list.
questions.rule: तत् = n. nom. sg.; तद्यथा introduces a list.

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is एतत् + वनम् (this forest) written?
optionExplain: त् does not stay unvoiced before व.
त् becomes च् only before a palatal (च, छ, श), not before व.
Right: त् before the voiced व becomes द्, as तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: एतत् + वनम् = एतद्वनम्, like तत् + यथा = तद्यथा.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a voiced consonant (here य) becomes द्: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.

questions.q: By unit 28, what are timidity, laxity and softness called?
optionExplain: Man-making are the opposite ones, in unit 29.
Neuter-making are the mixed ones, in unit 30.
Stability of the embryo comes in unit 38.
Right: The list closes with स्त्रीकराभावाः = स्त्रीकराः भावाः.
questions.explain: The whole list is labelled woman-making states.

questions.q: Put these states of unit 28 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Klaibya, timidity, (lack of confidence), bewilderment, (unsteadiness), heaviness below, (lack of compactness), laxity, softness.
questions.rule: क्लैब्य → भीरुत्व → मोह → अधोगुरुत्व → शैथिल्य → मार्दव.

questions.q: Match each state of unit 28 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five of the listed woman-making states.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अ- before a consonant (अ + संहनन = असंहनन) and अन्- before a vowel (अन् + अवस्थान = अनवस्थान).

questions.q: Which is NOT among the woman-making states of unit 28?
optionExplain: Right: The list has असंहनन, lack of compactness, its opposite.
Named in the list.
Named in the list.
Named in the list.
questions.explain: Lack of compactness is listed; compactness itself is not.

questions.q: Which states of unit 28 carry the negative prefix अ- or अन्-?
optionExplain: मार्दव (softness) has no negative prefix.
Right: अ + वैशारद्य, lack of confidence.
Right: अन् + अवस्थान, unsteadiness.
मोह (bewilderment) has no negative prefix.
Right: अ + संहनन, lack of compactness.
questions.explain: Three listed states are negatives of a quality; softness and bewilderment are not.

questions.q: By the pattern of अनवस्थान and असंहनन, what is the negative of आरोग्य (health)?
optionExplain: अ- stands only before a consonant.
Right: Before a vowel the negative prefix is अन्-: अन् + आरोग्य.
The negative prefix is never अम्-.
The prefix has a short अ, not आ.
questions.explain: अन् + आरोग्य = अनारोग्य, ill-health, like अन् + अवस्थान = अनवस्थान.
questions.rule: अ- before a consonant, अन्- before a vowel.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अ- before a consonant (असंहनन) and अन्- before a vowel (अनवस्थान).

questions.q: By unit 29, which states are man-making?
options: Those mixed with the woman-making ones
The woman-making ones in greater amount
Those opposite to the woman-making ones
The states of womb and seed
optionExplain: The mixed ones are neuter-making, unit 30.
Unit 29 speaks of opposites, not amounts.
Right: ततो विपरीताः पुंकराः: opposite to these.
Those are among the woman-making states of unit 28.
questions.explain: Opposites of the unit 28 list are man-making.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 29 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Than these, opposite, man-making.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 29 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words make the sentence; भावाः is understood.
questions.teaches: -कर at the end of a compound means making: पुं- (man) + कर = man-making, as स्त्री + कर = woman-making.

questions.q: Which word is understood in unit 29 though not printed, by the card?
optionExplain: The note supplies states, not embryo.
No doṣa is named or supplied.
Woman is not the understood subject.
Right: The note: bhāvāḥ is understood from 28.
questions.explain: The man-making ones are states, as in unit 28.

questions.q: Applying unit 29, which state would be man-making?
optionExplain: Right: Unit 28 lists lack of confidence; its opposite is man-making.
Timidity is listed as woman-making in unit 28.
Softness is listed as woman-making in unit 28.
Laxity is listed as woman-making in unit 28.
questions.explain: The opposite of a listed woman-making state is man-making.
questions.rule: Opposite of a स्त्रीकर भाव → पुंकर.

questions.q: By the rule of ततो विपरीताः, how is नरः + गच्छति (the man goes) written?
optionExplain: The visarga is not replaced by a long आ.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ, as ततः + विपरीताः.
र् comes only after vowels other than अ or आ.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: नरः + गच्छति = नरो गच्छति, like ततः + विपरीताः = ततो विपरीताः.
questions.teaches: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ: ततः + विपरीताः → ततो विपरीताः.

questions.q: By unit 30, which states are neuter-making?
options: The listed ones of unit 28 alone
optionExplain: The opposite ones are man-making, unit 29.
Those are woman-making.
Right: संकीर्णा नपुंसककराः: the mixed ones are neuter-making.
Abundance is the topic of unit 26, not of unit 30.
questions.explain: Mixed states make a neuter.

questions.q: Match each class of states (units 28 to 30) to what it makes.
questions.explain: Units 28, 29 and 30 give the three classes in this order.
questions.rule: list → स्त्रीकर, opposite → पुंकर, mixed → नपुंसककर.

questions.q: The mixed ones are neuter-making: ____ नपुंसककराः (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: संकीर्णाः (mixed), printed संकीर्णा before नपुंसककराः.
questions.teaches: संकीर्ण = mixed; printed संकीर्णा because आः loses its visarga before न.

questions.q: Which split of संकीर्णा नपुंसककराः is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give संकीर्णं नपुंसक-.
अः before न would give संकीर्णो नपुंसक-.
A final त् before न would give संकीर्णान्नपुंसक-.
Right: आः before the voiced न drops its visarga: संकीर्णा नपुंसक-.
questions.explain: संकीर्णाः (mixed, nom. pl.) + नपुंसककराः.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 30 match the card?
options: The unit says which states are mixed
The sentence has no printed verb
optionExplain: Right: the card glosses saṅkīrṇāḥ as mixed.
It does not say which states, or in what proportion.
It means neuter-making; woman-making is स्त्रीकर.
Right: the copula is understood.
questions.explain: Mixed ones are neuter-making; nothing more is stated.

questions.q: By the rule of संकीर्णा नपुंसककराः, how is देवाः + गच्छन्ति (the gods go) written?
optionExplain: Right: आः before a voiced consonant drops the visarga.
ओ comes from अः, not from आः.
र् comes only after vowels other than अ or आ.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: देवाः + गच्छन्ति = देवा गच्छन्ति, like संकीर्णाः + नपुंसककराः.
questions.teaches: आः before a voiced consonant loses its visarga: संकीर्णाः + नपुंसककराः → संकीर्णा नपुंसककराः.

questions.q: By unit 31, what of the embryo becomes fully manifest then?
optionExplain: The heart is the topic of unit 33.
Right: चेतना प्रव्यक्ता भवति.
Sex is not named in unit 31.
Colour is not named in unit 31.
questions.explain: Consciousness becomes fully manifest.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 31 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, and, its, consciousness, fully manifest, becomes.
questions.rule: तदा → च → अस्य → चेतना → प्रव्यक्ता → भवति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 31 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words carry the sentence.
questions.teaches: प्रव्यक्ता agrees with चेतना (feminine nominative singular): consciousness, fully manifest.

questions.q: Which split of चास्य is right?
optionExplain: अ + इ would give चेस्य.
A final त् would give चदस्य.
Right: अ + अ → आ: च + अस्य → चास्य.
A final म् would give चमस्य.
questions.explain: च (and) + अस्य (its).

questions.q: In unit 31, whose consciousness does अस्य refer to, by the card?
optionExplain: For the mother a feminine form अस्याः would be needed.
The father is not the subject here.
No physician is named.
Right: The note: asya refers to the embryo.
questions.explain: अस्य (m. gen. sg.) = its, the embryo's.

questions.q: By the rule of चास्य, how is न + अस्ति (is not) written?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as च + अस्य → चास्य.
The two vowels join into long आ, not short अ.
No य् is put in between.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: न + अस्ति = नास्ति, like च + अस्य = चास्य.
questions.teaches: अ before अ joins into long आ: च + अस्य → चास्य.

questions.q: By unit 32, from then on what does the embryo do besides having desire?
optionExplain: Sleep is not named in unit 32.
Right: स्पन्दते: moves, throbs.
No crying is named.
No food is named.
questions.explain: Movement and desire are the two things named.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 32 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And then, from then on, moves, desire, (for the sense objects) makes.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 32 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words carry the sure part of the line.
questions.teaches: अभिलाषं करोति = literally makes desire, i.e. has desire; करोति with a noun of feeling means to have it.

questions.q: Which split of ततश्च is right?
optionExplain: A final त् would give तच्च.
A final म् would give ततं च.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्.
श्च is not a word; the particle is च.
questions.explain: ततः (then) + च (and).

questions.q: Which split of स्पंदतेऽभिलाषं is right?
optionExplain: A visarga would give स्पन्दतोऽभिलाषम्.
इ + अ would give स्पन्दत्यभिलाषम्.
भिलाष is not a word; the word is अभिलाष.
Right: ए before अ stays; the अ is dropped and shown by ऽ.
questions.explain: स्पन्दते (moves) + अभिलाषम् (desire).

questions.q: By the rule of स्पन्दतेऽभिलाषम्, how is वने + अस्मिन् (in this forest) written?
optionExplain: Right: A final ए before अ stays and the अ is dropped (ऽ).
ए does not turn into आ.
ओऽ comes from अः, not from ए.
ए + अ does not give ऐ.
questions.explain: वने + अस्मिन् = वनेऽस्मिन्, like स्पन्दते + अभिलाषम्.
questions.teaches: A final ए before अ stays, and the अ is dropped (ऽ): स्पन्दते + अभिलाषम् → स्पन्दतेऽभिलाषम्.

questions.q: By unit 33, the embryo's heart is born of whom?
optionExplain: The line says मातृज, born of the mother.
Right: मातृजं ह्यस्य हृदयम्: its heart is born of the mother.
No elements are named in unit 33.
Karma is not named in unit 33.
questions.explain: The heart is मातृज.

questions.q: Put these pieces of unit 33 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Born of the mother its heart, rasa-carrying, by dhamanīs, to the mother's heart, joined is.
questions.rule: मातृज हृदय → रसहारिणी → धमनी → मातृहृदय → अभिसंबद्ध.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 33 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the line's two claims.
questions.teaches: -ज at the end of a compound means born of: मातृ + ज = मातृज, born of the mother.

questions.q: By unit 33, through what is the embryo's heart joined to the mother's heart?
optionExplain: No sinews are named.
No bones are named.
Right: रसहारिणीभिर्धमनीभिः: by dhamanīs carrying rasa.
No breath is named.
questions.explain: The joining is by dhamanīs, in the instrumental plural.

questions.q: Which split of ह्यस्य is right?
optionExplain: ए + अ would give हेऽस्य.
ह्य is not a word; अ + अ would give ह्यास्य.
हम् is not a word; a final म् would give हमस्य.
Right: इ before अ becomes य्: हि + अस्य → ह्यस्य.
questions.explain: हि (for) + अस्य (its).
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: By the rule of ह्यस्य, how is इति + आह (thus he says) written?
optionExplain: Right: इ before आ becomes य्, as हि + अस्य → ह्यस्य.
अय् comes from ए before a vowel, not from इ.
The इ is not dropped.
इ + आ does not give ए.
questions.explain: इति + आह = इत्याह, like हि + अस्य = ह्यस्य.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: हि + अस्य → ह्यस्य.

questions.q: By unit 34, what arises (संपद्यते)?
optionExplain: No pain is named.
Right: श्रद्धा संपद्यते: a longing arises.
No fever is named.
No sleep is named.
questions.explain: A longing arises in the two, through the vessels.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 34 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Therefore, in the two, through them, longing, arises.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 34 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four of the five words; who the two (तयोः) are is left open.
questions.teaches: ताभिः is feminine instrumental plural, so the card can take it up as the धमनीभिः (feminine) of unit 33.

questions.q: What does श्रद्धा mean in unit 34, by the card?
optionExplain: The note says not faith here.
The card gives no such sense.
Right: The note: longing, desire, not faith.
The card gives no such sense.
questions.explain: श्रद्धा here = longing, leading to the daurhṛda of units 35 to 37.

questions.q: Which split of तयोस्ताभिः is right?
optionExplain: That would give तयस्ताभिः.
A final म् would give तयोंताभिः.
स्ताभिः is not a word; the word is ताभिः.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्.
