questions.explain: तयोः (in the two) + ताभिः (through them).

questions.q: By the rule of तयोस्ताभिः, how is रामः + तत्र (Rāma, there) written?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before त becomes स्.
ओ comes only before a voiced sound; त is unvoiced.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
A visarga does not become त्.
questions.explain: रामः + तत्र = रामस्तत्र, like तयोः + ताभिः = तयोस्ताभिः.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त becomes स्: तयोः + ताभिः → तयोस्ताभिः.

questions.q: By unit 35, which woman is called दौर्हदिनी (read daurhṛdinī), a woman with longings?
options: A woman in her monthly period
A woman who has recently given birth
optionExplain: No monthly period is named.
Right: द्विहृदयां नारीं दौर्हृदिनीत्याचक्षते.
Childbirth is not named.
No age is named.
questions.explain: The two-hearted woman is called daurhṛdinī.

questions.q: Put these printed pieces of unit 35 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And so, two-hearted, woman, daurhṛdinī thus they call.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 35 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The name is marked by इति and governed by आचक्षते.
questions.teaches: द्वि-हृदया is a bahuvrīhi: it names the one who has two hearts, not the hearts.

questions.q: By the card, does unit 35 say whose the two hearts are?
options: Yes: the mother's and the embryo's
Yes: the mother's and the father's
No, the line does not say
Yes: the heart and the mind
optionExplain: The note says this is not stated here.
The father is not named.
Right: The note: whether the hearts are the mother's and the embryo's is not stated here.
The mind is not named.
questions.explain: The line calls the woman two-hearted and says no more.

questions.q: Which split of इत्याचक्षते is right?
optionExplain: इ + short अ would give इत्यचक्षते.
इत्या is not a word here.
Neither इत् nor याचक्षते is the word here.
Right: इ before आ becomes य्: इति + आचक्षते → इत्याचक्षते.
questions.explain: इति (thus) + आचक्षते (they call).

questions.q: By the pattern of द्विहृदया, what does the name दीर्घबाहुः (of a man) mean?
options: A long road for the arms
optionExplain: Right: A bahuvrīhi names the owner, as द्विहृदया = she who has two hearts.
That would be बाहुदैर्घ्य, a noun of length.
दीर्घ means long, not two.
No road is in the compound.
questions.explain: दीर्घ (long) + बाहु (arm) as a bahuvrīhi: one whose arms are long.
questions.rule: Bahuvrīhi = the one who has X.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi compound names its owner: द्वि + हृदया = (the woman) who has two hearts.

questions.q: By the others in unit 36, from when does the time of daurhṛda run?
optionExplain: No first day is named.
Right: पक्षत्रयात् प्रभृति: from three fortnights, one and a half months.
Three fortnights, not three months.
The time ends at the fifth month.
questions.explain: The time runs from three fortnights up to the fifth month.

questions.q: Put these pieces of unit 36 in the lines' order.
questions.explain: Others, from three fortnights, up to the fifth month, call the daurhṛda time; when the wish is intense, (the unwholesome) joined with the wholesome one should give.
questions.rule: अन्ये → पक्षत्रय → पञ्चम मास → दौर्हृदकाल → तीव्र प्रार्थना → हितोपसंहित दद्यात्.

questions.q: Match each phrase of unit 36 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These phrases carry the time and the advice.
questions.rule: पक्षत्रय, आ पञ्चमात्, दौर्हृदकाल, अहित, हित.
questions.teaches: आ with the ablative means up to: आ पञ्चमात् मासात् = up to the fifth month.

questions.q: By unit 36, when her wish is intense, what should be given to her?
options: Only the wholesome, never the unwholesome
Nothing until after the fifth month
Even the unwholesome, joined with the wholesome
A medicine to stop the longing
optionExplain: The line allows even the unwholesome.
No such delay is stated.
Right: काममहितमप्यस्यै हितोपसंहितं दद्यात्.
No medicine is named.
questions.explain: The intense wish is met, the unwholesome being joined with the wholesome.

questions.q: A woman is two months pregnant. By the others of unit 36, is she within the daurhṛda time?
options: No: it begins only at the fifth month
No: it ends at three fortnights
The unit gives no time at all
Yes: two months is past three fortnights
optionExplain: The fifth month is where it ends.
Three fortnights is where it begins.
It gives three fortnights to the fifth month.
Right: Two months = four fortnights, within three fortnights to the fifth month.
questions.explain: Three fortnights is one and a half months; two months is inside the span.
questions.rule: दौर्हृदकाल (अन्य मत) = तीन पक्ष से पाँचवें मास तक.

questions.q: By the rule of काममहितम्, how is अहम् + अपि (I too) written?
optionExplain: Right: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins it, as कामम् + अहितम्.
Anusvāra stands for म् only before a consonant.
ओऽ comes from अः, not from अम्.
The म् is not dropped.
questions.explain: अहम् + अपि = अहमपि, like कामम् + अहितम् = काममहितम्.
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joined to the vowel.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and is written joined to it: कामम् + अहितम् → काममहितम्.

questions.q: By unit 37, what may follow disregard of the daurhṛda?
options: Pitta may cause fever in the mother
Agitated vāyu may destroy or deform the embryo
Kapha may make the child sleepy
No harm; the longing fades by itself
optionExplain: No pitta or fever is named.
Right: वायुः प्रकुपितः ... गर्भस्य विनाशं वैरूप्यं वा कुर्यात्.
No kapha is named.
The line names harm to the embryo.
questions.explain: Disregard → agitated vāyu → destruction or deformity.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 37 in the line's order.
questions.explain: From disregard, vāyu agitated, moving inside the body, destruction or deformity of the embryo, may cause.
questions.rule: विमान → कुपित वायु → अनुचरन् → विनाश/वैरूप्य → कुर्यात्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 37 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the chain of harm.
questions.teaches: -आत् on an a-stem is the ablative, from: दौर्हृदविमानात् = from disregard of the longing.

questions.q: Which of these does unit 37 NOT name?
optionExplain: Named: वायुः प्रकुपितः.
Named: गर्भस्य विनाशम्.
Right: No fever is named in unit 37.
Named: वैरूप्यम्.
questions.explain: The line names agitated vāyu, destruction and deformity only.

questions.q: Which split of विमानाद्धि is right?
optionExplain: A visarga would give विमानो हि.
A final म् would give विमानं हि.
द्धि is not a word; the particle is हि.
Right: Final त् before ह: त् → द् and ह → ध, written द्ध.
questions.explain: विमानात् (from disregard) + हि (for).

questions.q: By the rule of विमानाद्धि, how is तत् + हितम् (that wholesome thing) written?
optionExplain: Right: त् before ह becomes द् and ह becomes ध, as in विमानाद्धि.
त् does not stay unvoiced before ह.
छ comes from श after त्, not from ह.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: तत् + हितम् = तद्धितम्, like विमानात् + हि = विमानाद्धि.
questions.rule: त् + ह → द्ध (द्ह is also allowed).
questions.teaches: A final त् before ह becomes द्, and the ह is usually written ध: विमानात् + हि → विमानाद्धि.

questions.q: By unit 38, what son does a woman whose longing was fulfilled bear?
optionExplain: Fairness and learning are not named.
Right: वीर्यवन्तं चिरायुषं च पुत्रं प्रसूते.
Deformity is the risk of disregard, unit 37.
The son is long-lived.
questions.explain: Fulfilled longing → a vigorous and long-lived son.

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 of unit 38 in the line's order.
questions.explain: She whose longing is fulfilled, vigorous, and long-lived, son, bears.

questions.q: Match each word of line 1 of unit 38 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the sure first line.
questions.teaches: लब्ध-दौर्हृदा is a bahuvrīhi: she whose longing has been obtained.

questions.q: Which word of unit 38 means long-lived?
optionExplain: That means vigorous.
That means she whose longing is fulfilled.
Right: चिर (long) + आयुषम् (life): long-lived.
That means bears, gives birth to.
questions.explain: चिरायुषम् = long-lived, said of the son.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 38 match the card?
options: The noun month is printed after चतुर्थे
A woman whose longing is fulfilled bears a vigorous, long-lived son
The reading limbs and minor limbs in line 2 is conjectural
Line 1 names the woman with the noun नारी
optionExplain: Month is understood, not printed.
Right: line 1.
Right: अङ्गमत्त्यंग is corrected only as a possibility.
No noun woman is printed; only the bahuvrīhi.
questions.explain: Line 1 is sure; line 2 is conjectural, and month and woman are not printed.

questions.q: By the rule of चिरायुषम्, how is दीर्घ + आयुः (long life) written as one compound?
optionExplain: Inside a compound the two vowels must join.
The vowels join into long आ, not short अ.
अ + आ does not give ओ.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as चिर + आयुषम् → चिरायुषम्.
questions.explain: दीर्घ + आयुः = दीर्घायुः, like चिर + आयुषम् = चिरायुषम्.
questions.teaches: अ before आ joins into long आ: चिर + आयुषम् → चिरायुषम्.

questions.q: By unit 39, what becomes more awakened in the fifth (month)?
optionExplain: Right: मनः प्रबुद्धतरं भवति: the mind becomes more awakened.
Increase of strength is named in unit 40, not here.
Hair becomes manifest in unit 40, the sixth.
Completeness of the limbs is unit 41, the seventh.
questions.explain: In the fifth, the mind becomes more awakened.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the words of unit 39 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the fifth, the mind, more awakened, becomes; and increase of flesh and blood.
questions.rule: पञ्चमे → मनः → प्रबुद्धतरम् → भवति → मांसशोणितोपचयः → च.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 39 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words carry the two statements of the fifth (month).
questions.teaches: -तर is the comparative: प्रबुद्ध (awakened) → प्रबुद्धतर (more awakened).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of शोणितोपचय is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga, and अः before उ would not give ओ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: शोणित + उपचय = शोणितोपचय.
पचय is not the word of the card; the word is उपचय (increase).
अ + ओ would give औ, not ओ; and ओपचय is not a word.
questions.explain: शोणित (blood) + उपचय (increase): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: What does the ending -तर add in प्रबुद्धतरम्?
optionExplain: The superlative ending is -तम, not -तर.
Negation would be a prefix अ-, not the ending -तर.
Right: -तर makes the comparative degree.
-तर does not mean again; that would be पुनः.
questions.explain: प्रबुद्ध + तर = more awakened.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of शोणितोपचय, how is सूर्य + उदयः (sunrise) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + उ does not give औ.
The अ is not simply dropped before उ.
अ + उ does not give ए; ए comes from अ + इ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in शोणित + उपचय.
questions.explain: सूर्य + उदयः = सूर्योदयः, like शोणित + उपचय = शोणितोपचय.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by उ joins as ओ: शोणित + उपचय → शोणितोपचय.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 40, what becomes manifest in the sixth (month)?
options: Hair, body-hair, nails, bones, sinews and so on
The mind, becoming more awakened than before
The completeness of all the limbs, every one of them
An exchange of ojas between mother and embryo
optionExplain: Right: केशरोमनखास्थिस्नायवादीन्यभिव्यक्तानि.
That is unit 39, the fifth.
That is unit 41, the seventh.
That is unit 42, the eighth.
questions.explain: In the sixth, hair, body-hair, nails, bones, sinews and so on become manifest.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the parts listed in unit 40 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Hair, body-hair, nails, bones, sinews, then आदि (and so on).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each part named in unit 40 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five parts are named, then -आदि (and so on).
questions.teaches: -आदि = and so on: the list of manifest parts is left open.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of आदीन्यभिव्यक्तानि is right?
optionExplain: A final न् would give आदीनभिव्यक्तानि, with no य.
Right: इ + अ → य: आदीनि + अभिव्यक्तानि.
न्यभिव्यक्तानि is not a word.
भिव्यक्तानि is not a word; the word is अभिव्यक्तानि (manifest).
questions.explain: आदीनि (and so on) + अभिव्यक्तानि (manifest): इ + अ → य.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: In unit 40, what increases (उपचय) in the sixth (month)?
optionExplain: Flesh and blood increase in unit 39, the fifth.
No mind or senses are named in unit 40.
Right: बलवर्णोपचयश्च: increase of strength and complexion.
Ojas and rasa are named in unit 42, not here.
questions.explain: बल (strength) and वर्ण (complexion) increase.
questions.rule: बलवर्णोपचयः = increase of strength and complexion.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of आदीन्यभिव्यक्तानि, how is इति + अर्थः (this is the meaning) written when joined?
optionExplain: इ + अ does not give ए.
The इ is not dropped before अ.
इ + अ does not give ई.
Right: इ + अ → य, as आदीनि + अभिव्यक्तानि.
questions.explain: इति + अर्थः = इत्यर्थः, like आदीनि + अभिव्यक्तानि.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: आदीनि + अभिव्यक्तानि → आदीन्यभिव्यक्तानि.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 41, what comes in the seventh (month)?
optionExplain: Right: सप्तमे सर्वाङ्गसंपूर्णता.
That is unit 40, the sixth.
That is unit 39, the fifth.
That is unit 42, the eighth.
questions.explain: The seventh brings completeness of all the limbs.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 41 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four members make the whole line.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: In unit 41, the word for limb is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: सर्वाङ्ग = सर्व (all) + अङ्ग (limb); printed सर्वांग.
questions.teaches: अङ्ग = limb; अंग and अङ्ग are two spellings of one word.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of सर्वांग (सर्वाङ्ग) is right?
optionExplain: A visarga before अ would give सर्वोऽङ्ग.
Right: अ + अ → आ: सर्व + अङ्ग = सर्वाङ्ग.
A final म् would give सर्वमङ्ग.
ए before अ would give सर्वेऽङ्ग.
questions.explain: सर्व (all) + अङ्ग (limb): अ + अ → आ.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: What does the ending -ता add in संपूर्णता?
options: It makes a comparative: complete → more complete
It marks a place: complete → in the complete one
It makes an abstract noun: complete → completeness
It makes a past form: complete → was completed
optionExplain: The comparative ending is -तर.
-ता is not a locative ending.
Right: -ता forms abstract nouns.
-ता here is not a verb ending.
questions.explain: संपूर्ण + ता = completeness.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the -ता of संपूर्णता, what does मधुरता mean, from मधुर (sweet)?
optionExplain: That would need the comparative -तर: मधुरतर.
That would need the superlative -तम: मधुरतम.
-ता does not make a participle.
Right: -ता makes the abstract noun: मधुर → मधुरता.
questions.explain: मधुर + ता = sweetness, like संपूर्ण + ता = completeness.
questions.teaches: -ता added to an adjective makes an abstract noun: संपूर्ण → संपूर्णता, मधुर → मधुरता.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 42, what do the embryo and the mother take from each other in the eighth (month)?
optionExplain: Right: ओजः परस्परमाददाते.
Flesh and blood increase in unit 39; they are not exchanged here.
These increase in unit 40.
Breathing is named in unit 47, not here.
questions.explain: The two take ojas from each other.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put these words of unit 42 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the eighth, the embryo ... the mother, by the channels, ojas, the two take.
questions.rule: अष्टमे → गर्भः → माता → वाहिनीभिः → ओजः → आददाते.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 42 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words say by what, how often, what and between whom.
questions.teaches: परस्परम् = from each other: the exchange of ojas runs both ways.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Why does the verb आददाते have a dual ending in unit 42?
options: It agrees with the many channels (वाहिनीभिः)
Its two subjects are the embryo and the mother
It agrees with ojas, the thing taken (ओजः)
It agrees with मुहुः, which is said twice
optionExplain: वाहिनीभिः is instrumental plural: by the channels, not the subject.
Right: The note: the verb is dual, with subjects garbha and mātā.
ओजः is the object (accusative), not the subject.
मुहुः is an indeclinable, repeated for repeatedly.
questions.explain: Two subjects, गर्भः and माता, take a dual verb.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which statements does unit 42 make?
options: Only the mother gives; the embryo only receives
The exchange runs through channels that carry rasa
The exchange begins in the fifth month
optionExplain: Right: मुहुर्मुहुः, repeatedly.
परस्परम्: each takes from the other.
Right: रसहारिणीभिर्वाहिनीभिः.
The unit speaks of the eighth (अष्टमे).
questions.explain: Repeated, two-way, through the rasa-carrying channels, in the eighth.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of रसहारिणीभिर्वाहिनीभिः, how is अग्निः + दहति (fire burns) written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga is not simply dropped after इ.
स् stays only before त/थ, not before द.
Right: A visarga after इ before a voiced consonant becomes र्.
The इ is not lengthened; the visarga becomes र्.
questions.explain: अग्निः + दहति = अग्निर्दहति, like रसहारिणीभिः + वाहिनीभिः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound: रसहारिणीभिः + वाहिनीभिः → रसहारिणीभिर्वाहिनीभिः.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 43, how is the pregnant woman at that time?
options: At times glad, at times languid
optionExplain: The line says glad only at times (मुहुः).
The line says languid only at times (मुहुः).
No time of day is named.
Right: मुहुर्मुदिता भवति मुहुर्म्लाना.
questions.explain: She swings between glad and languid.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 43 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Therefore then the pregnant woman, at times glad, is, at times languid; likewise the embryo.
questions.rule: तस्मात् तदा → गर्भिणी → मुहुः मुदिता → भवति → मुहुः म्लाना → तथा गर्भः.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 43 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two states, the two subjects and the linking words.
questions.teaches: मुहुः ... मुहुः = at one moment ... at another.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of मुहुर्मुदिता is right?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after उ before the voiced म becomes र्.
A final म् would give मुहुं मुदिता, with no र्.
र्मुदिता is not a word.
Before a vowel this would give मुहुरुदिता, with no म.
questions.explain: मुहुः (at times) + मुदिता (glad).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 43, what is said of the embryo?
options: It stays calm whatever the mother feels
Likewise it is at times glad, at times languid
It grows stronger while the mother fades
It is not mentioned in unit 43 at all
optionExplain: तथा (likewise) ties it to the mother's states.
Right: तथा गर्भः: likewise the embryo, the verb carried over.
No growth of the embryo is named here.
The line ends तथा गर्भः.
questions.explain: तथा गर्भः: the embryo too has the same changing states.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of मुहुर्मुदिता, how is धेनुः + गच्छति (the cow goes) written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga is not simply dropped after उ.
स् stays only before त/थ.
Right: Visarga after उ before the voiced ग becomes र्.
The vowel उ does not change to ओ.
questions.explain: धेनुः + गच्छति = धेनुर्गच्छति, like मुहुः + मुदिता.
questions.teaches: A visarga after उ becomes र् before a voiced sound: मुहुः + मुदिता → मुहुर्मुदिता.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 44, what is the birth of the embryo then accompanied by?
optionExplain: Strength and complexion increase in unit 40; not here.
No long life is named in unit 44.
Gladness is in unit 43, not tied to the birth.
Right: जन्म व्यापत्तिमत् तदा भवति.
questions.explain: The birth then is accompanied by calamity.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the words of unit 44 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus, of the embryo, the birth, accompanied by calamity, then, is.
questions.rule: एवम् → गर्भस्य → जन्म → व्यापत्तिमत् → तदा → भवति.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Thus the birth of the embryo: एवं गर्भस्य ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line opens एवं गर्भस्य जन्म.
questions.teaches: जन्म = birth, a neuter noun; व्यापत्तिमत् agrees with it.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: What does the suffix -मत् add in व्यापत्तिमत्?
options: Having: having calamity, accompanied by it
More: a greater calamity than before
optionExplain: Right: -मत् is a possessive suffix (matup).
Being free of something is not the sense of -मत्.
-मत् means having, not causing.
The comparative would be -तर.
questions.explain: व्यापत्ति + मत् = having calamity.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: In unit 44, which word does व्यापत्तिमत् agree with?
optionExplain: गर्भस्य is genitive masculine; व्यापत्तिमत् is neuter nominative.
Right: The note: a neuter agreeing with janma.
एवम् is an indeclinable; nothing agrees with it.
तदा is an indeclinable of time.
questions.explain: व्यापत्तिमत् describes जन्म: the birth is accompanied by calamity.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the -मत् of व्यापत्तिमत्, what does बुद्धिमत्, from बुद्धि (intelligence), mean?
optionExplain: Lacking would need a negative, not -मत्.
-मत् means having, not giving.
Right: -मत् = having, as व्यापत्तिमत् = having calamity.
Made of would be -मय.
questions.explain: बुद्धि + मत् = having intelligence.
questions.teaches: The suffix -मत् means having: व्यापत्ति → व्यापत्तिमत्, बुद्धि → बुद्धिमत्.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 45, the unsteadiness of what is named?
optionExplain: The mind is in unit 39, not here.
The limbs are in unit 41.
The channels are in unit 42.
Right: ओजसः अनवस्थितत्वात्.
questions.explain: The unsteadiness of ojas.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each piece of अनवस्थितत्वात् to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four pieces build because of unsteadiness.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the pieces of unit 45 in the order of the printed word.
questions.explain: Of ojas, not, steady, -ness, because of.
questions.teaches: Before a vowel the negative is अन्-: अन् + अवस्थित → अनवस्थित (not steady).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of ओजसोऽनवस्थितत्वात् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अः + अ → ओ, and ऽ marks the lost अ.
ऽ shows a lost अ; नवस्थित is not the word.
A final म् would give ओजसमनवस्थितत्वात्.
आ + अ → आ would give ओजसानवस्थितत्वात्.
questions.explain: ओजसः (of ojas) + अनवस्थितत्वात् (because of unsteadiness).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: What sense does the ending -त्वात् give in unit 45?
options: Because of being: because of unsteadiness
Inside: in the state of unsteadiness
optionExplain: Motion toward is not the sense of the ablative here.
Right: -त्व (-ness) + ablative -आत् = because of.
That would be an instrumental sense.
That would be a locative, -त्वे.
questions.explain: The ablative of an abstract noun gives the cause.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of ओजसोऽनवस्थितत्वात्, how is मनसः + अपि (even of the mind) written when joined?
optionExplain: That would come from मनसा + अपि.
र् comes from a visarga after other vowels; after अ, अः + अ gives ओऽ.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, with ऽ for the lost अ.
अः + अ does not give ए.
questions.explain: मनसः + अपि = मनसोऽपि, like ओजसः + अनवस्थितत्वात्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ before a short अ: अः + अ → ओ + ऽ (ओजसोऽनवस्थितत्वात्).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 46, separation (वियोग) from what is spoken of?
optionExplain: Rasa is not named in unit 46.
The channels are not named in unit 46.
The mind is not named in unit 46.
Right: ओजसा वियोगः: separation from ojas.
questions.explain: The unit speaks of separation from ojas.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put these words of unit 46 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For thus of this one, on the point of coming out, turning round and the like, experiencing, this by ojas, separation.
questions.rule: तथा ह्यस्य → निष्क्रमणोन्मुखस्य → परिवर्तनादीनि → अनुभवन् → एषौजसा → वियोगः.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 46 to its meaning.
pairs: directed toward, on the point of
questions.explain: These are the sure words of the unit.
questions.teaches: निष्क्रमण-उन्मुख = turned toward coming out: on the point of coming out.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of ह्यस्य is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: हि + अस्य = ह्यस्य.
अ + अ would give हास्य, with no य.
No vowel meets here; हि यस्य would stay apart, with no joined य्.
हिः is not a word; the particle is हि.
questions.explain: हि (for, indeed) + अस्य (of this one).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which statements does unit 46 make?
options: It names turning round and the like
It allows breathing for some time
It speaks of one on the point of coming out
optionExplain: The mother's weariness is unit 48.
Right: परिवर्तनादीनि अनुभवन्.
Breathing for some time is unit 47.
Right: निष्क्रमणोन्मुखस्य.
questions.explain: One on the point of coming out, experiencing turning round and the like; separation from ojas.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of ह्यस्य, how is अति + अन्तम् (exceedingly) written when joined?
optionExplain: इ + अ does not give ए.
Right: इ + अ → य, as हि + अस्य → ह्यस्य.
इ + अ does not give ई.
The इ is not dropped before अ.
questions.explain: अति + अन्तम् = अत्यन्तम्, like हि + अस्य.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: हि + अस्य → ह्यस्य.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 47, if there is breathing for some time, what is it made by?
options: The rasa-carrying channels of the mother
The growing strength of the limbs
The continuing lingering impression of ojas
The turning round of the one coming out
optionExplain: The channels are unit 42, not the cause here.
No strength of limbs is named in unit 47.
Right: ओजःसंस्कारानुवृत्तिकृतम्.
Turning round is unit 46, not the cause here.
questions.explain: The breathing is made by the continuation of the saṃskāra of ojas.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 47 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Even if, for some time, breathing there may be, like a severed limb's, made by the continuation of the ojas impression.
questions.rule: यद्यपि च → किंचित्कालम् → उच्छ्वसनम् → स्यात् → छिन्नस्य इव अङ्गस्य → ओजःसंस्कारानुवृत्तिकृतम्.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 47 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words say how long, what, the image and the cause.
questions.teaches: -कृत at the end of a compound = made by: ओजःसंस्कारानुवृत्तिकृत = made by the continuation of the ojas impression.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of तच्छिन्नस्य is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give तं छिन्नस्य.
Neither piece is a word.
त् + च gives च्च; चिन्नस्य is not a word.
Right: त् before छ becomes च्, written च्छ.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + छिन्नस्य (of one severed).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: What image does unit 47 use for this breathing?
options: A lamp after its oil is gone
A wheel that keeps on turning
A tree cut down at the root
optionExplain: Right: छिन्नस्येवाङ्गस्य: like a severed limb.
No lamp is named in unit 47.
No wheel is named in unit 47.
No tree is named in unit 47.
questions.explain: The image is a severed limb.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of अङ्गस्यौजः, how is जल + ओघः (a flood of water) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + ओ gives औ, not ओ.
Right: अ + ओ → औ, as अङ्गस्य + ओजः → अङ्गस्यौजः.
अ + ओ does not give ए.
No व् comes between अ and ओ.
questions.explain: जल + ओघः = जलौघः, like अङ्गस्य + ओजः.
questions.teaches: A short अ before ओ joins as औ: अङ्गस्य + ओजः → अङ्गस्यौजः.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 48, what does the mother have when rasa has passed over in one part?
optionExplain: Death is named for the embryo in unit 50, not for the mother here.
Gladness is in unit 43; here it is weariness.
Right: ग्लानिरेव: only weariness.
Her ojas is called stable (स्थिर).
questions.explain: For the mother, only weariness.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 48 in the line's order.
questions.explain: But of the mother, because of stable ojas, in one part, when rasa has passed over, only weariness; thus.
questions.rule: जनन्याः तु → स्थिरौजस्कतया → एकदेशेन → रसे संक्रान्ते → ग्लानिः एव → इति.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 48 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Who, why, how much, what happened, and the result.
questions.teaches: रसे संक्रान्ते is a locative absolute: when rasa has passed over.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Which split of जनन्यास्तु is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give जनन्यां तु.
स्तु is not a word; the particle is तु.
A final त् would give जनन्यात्तु.
Right: Visarga before त becomes स्.
questions.explain: जनन्याः (of the mother) + तु (but).
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By unit 48, why is it only weariness for the mother?
options: Because she has no ojas at all
Because the embryo returns the rasa
optionExplain: Right: स्थिरौजस्कतया: because of the stability of ojas.
Her ojas is called stable, not absent.
No closing of channels is named here.
No return of rasa is named here.
questions.explain: Stable ojas in the mother: only weariness.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: By the rule of ग्लानिरेव, how is हरिः + अपि (even Hari) written when joined?
optionExplain: अः + अ → ओऽ needs अ before the visarga, not इ.
Right: Visarga after इ before a vowel becomes र्.
That is the rule for a final इ without visarga.
The visarga is not simply dropped.
questions.explain: हरिः + अपि = हरिरपि, like ग्लानिः + एव = ग्लानिरेव.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ becomes र् before a vowel: ग्लानिः + एव → ग्लानिरेव.
questions.section: पाँचवें से आठवें मास: ओज की अस्थिरता

questions.q: Who speaks, by unit 49?
optionExplain: No name is given in unit 49.
The mother is not the speaker here.
Right: अन्ये पुनराहुः: others, however, say.
No physician is named in unit 49.
questions.explain: Unnamed others give another view.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 49 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words make the whole formula.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Others, however, say: अन्ये पुनर् ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is अन्ये पुनराहुः.
questions.teaches: आहुः = they say, the third person plural perfect of √अह्, used for a stated view.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which split of पुनराहुः is right?
optionExplain: अ + आ → आ would give पुनाहुः, with no र्.
Neither piece is a word.
A final म् would give पुनमाहुः.
Right: र् stays before a vowel and joins it: पुनर् + आहुः.
questions.explain: पुनर् (however) + आहुः (they say).
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the card, what form is आहुः?
optionExplain: Right: Labelled 3 pl. pf. of √अह्.
The singular is आह.
आहुः is not first person.
आहुः is not a command form.
questions.explain: आहुः = they say: plural, because others speak.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the rule of पुनराहुः, how is पुनर् + अपि (again too) written when joined?
optionExplain: ओऽ comes from अः, not from पुनर्.
Right: र् stays and joins the vowel, as पुनर् + आहुः.
The र् is not dropped before a vowel.
श् comes before च/छ, not before a vowel.
questions.explain: पुनर् + अपि = पुनरपि, like पुनर् + आहुः = पुनराहुः.
questions.teaches: The र् of पुनर् stays before a vowel and joins it: पुनर् + आहुः → पुनराहुः.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the sure words of unit 50, what is spoken of for the embryo?
optionExplain: Birth is the word of unit 44, not of unit 50.
Turning round is unit 46.
Right: गर्भस्य मरणम्: death of the embryo.
Taking ojas is unit 42.
questions.explain: The sure part is death of the embryo.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 50 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The reason (doubtful reading), there, of the embryo, death.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 50 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These three words are the sure part of the line.
questions.teaches: गर्भस्य is the genitive: -स्य = of; गर्भस्य मरणम् = death of the embryo.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which printed word of unit 50 does the card mark as a doubtful, conjectural reading?
optionExplain: तत्र is a sure word: there.
गर्भस्य is a sure word: of the embryo.
मरणम् is a sure word: death.
Right: The flag: भागतवात् is not a form; भागत्वात् is a conjecture.
questions.explain: Only the first word is doubtful.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which statements about the sure words of unit 50 are right?
options: It names the birth (जन्म) of the embryo
It names the death (मरणम्) of the embryo
optionExplain: Right: a nominal line.
The mother's weariness is unit 48.
Birth is unit 44; here the word is मरणम्.
Right: गर्भस्य मरणम्.
questions.explain: A nominal line whose sure part is death of the embryo.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the गर्भस्य of unit 50, how is the birth of the child (बाल) said in an invented phrase?
optionExplain: Right: -स्य = of, as गर्भस्य = of the embryo.
बालः is nominative: the child, not of the child.
बालेन is instrumental: by the child.
बालाय is dative: to the child.
questions.explain: बालस्य जन्म = the birth of the child, like गर्भस्य मरणम्.
questions.teaches: The genitive singular of an a-stem ends in -स्य: गर्भ → गर्भस्य (of the embryo), बाल → बालस्य.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By unit 51, for what purpose should the woman be bathed, pure and the rest?
options: To cure a fever she has
optionExplain: प्रतिषेध means prevention, not hastening.
Right: प्रसवप्रतिषेधार्थम्: for preventing delivery.
No child's sex is named in this unit.
No fever is named in this unit.
questions.explain: प्रसव (delivery) + प्रतिषेध (prevention) + अर्थम् (for the sake of): to prevent delivery.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Put these words of unit 51 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The purpose comes first, then the woman, then her four qualities, and the verb स्यात् closes the line.
questions.rule: Purpose → स्त्री → स्नाता → शुचिः ब्रह्मचारिणी → दैवताराधनपरमा → स्यात्.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 51 to its meaning on the card.
pairs: intent on the worship of the deities
questions.explain: Four qualities of the woman, and the verb that makes them an instruction.
questions.teaches: The woman's four qualities are bathed, pure, chaste and devoted to worship of the deities.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which split of शुचिर्ब्रह्मचारिणी is right?
optionExplain: म् would stay म् or become ं before ब, never र्.
A final ई does not change before ब; no र् would appear.
Right: Visarga after इ becomes र् before a voiced sound such as ब.
र्ब्रह्मचारिणी is not a word of the card.
questions.explain: शुचिः (pure) + ब्रह्मचारिणी (chaste): two separate adjectives, not a compound.
questions.rule: इः / उः + voiced sound → इर् / उर्.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: In unit 51, which word do स्नाता, शुचिः and ब्रह्मचारिणी describe, by their feminine endings?
optionExplain: गर्भ is masculine and is not named here.
दैवत is only inside a compound, as what is worshipped.
प्रसव is masculine and only part of the purpose compound.
Right: All are f. nom. sg., agreeing with स्त्री.
questions.explain: स्त्री is the subject; the four qualities agree with it in feminine nominative singular.
questions.rule: An adjective agrees with its noun in gender, case and number.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the rule of शुचिर्ब्रह्मचारिणी, how is हरिः + गच्छति written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after इ becomes र् before the voiced ग.
The visarga does not drop with a long ई before ग.
स् comes before त/थ, not before ग.
श् comes before च/छ/श, not before ग.
questions.explain: शुचिः + ब्रह्मचारिणी → शुचिर्ब्रह्मचारिणी; so हरिः + गच्छति → हरिर्गच्छति.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ or उ becomes र् before a voiced sound: हरिः + गच्छति → हरिर्गच्छति.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By unit 52, of what is the bali (offering) made?
optionExplain: Neither milk nor honey is named here.
Right: मांसौदनबलिम्: a bali of meat (मांस) and boiled rice (ओदन).
Neither flowers nor water is named here.
Neither ghee nor barley is named here.
questions.explain: मांस + ओदन + बलि: a bali of meat and boiled rice.
questions.rule: मांसौदनबलि = an offering of meat and boiled rice.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Put these words of unit 52 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The object comes first, then च अत्र (joined as चात्र), and the verb ends the line.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 52 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: बलि is what is offered; निर्वपेत् is the verb; च अत्र = and here.
questions.teaches: बलि means an offering; निर्वपेत् (nir-√vap) means 'should offer'.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which split of मांसौदन is right?
optionExplain: अ + उ would give ओ: मांसोदन.
आ + उ would give ओ, not औ.
Right: अ + ओ gives औ: मांस + ओदन → मांसौदन.
दन is not a word of the card.
questions.explain: मांस (meat) + ओदन (boiled rice), a dvandva inside the compound.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: What kind of statement does the optative निर्वपेत् make in unit 52?
optionExplain: A past form would be needed; निर्वपेत् is optative.
A future form would be needed; निर्वपेत् is optative.
No question word or sign stands in the line.
Right: The optative (3 sg. opt.) here means 'should offer'.
questions.explain: Like स्यात् in unit 51, निर्वपेत् is an optative that gives an instruction.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the rule of मांसौदन, how is गङ्गा + ओघः written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: आ + ओ gives औ, as अ + ओ does in मांसौदन.
आ + ओ does not give ओ.
The two vowels must merge into one.
No व् is inserted after आ.
questions.explain: मांस + ओदन → मांसौदन; so गङ्गा + ओघः → गङ्गौघः.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before ओ merges into औ: गङ्गा + ओघः → गङ्गौघः.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which word of unit 53 means 'up to a year'?
optionExplain: अतिक्रान्ते = when (one day) has passed.
Right: आ with the ablative संवत्सरात्: up to a year.
प्रसवकालम् = the time of delivery.
तस्मिन् = in that.
questions.explain: आ + संवत्सरात् = up to a year; it closes the line.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Put these words of unit 53 in their printed order.
questions.explain: In that, one day having passed, even; the time of delivery, they say, up to a year.
questions.rule: तस्मिन् → एकदिवसातिक्रान्ते → अपि → प्रसवकालम् → आहुः → आसंवत्सरात्.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 53 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These four words carry the literal sense; the meaning of the whole is not firm.
questions.teaches: आहुः (3 pl. of √ah) means 'they say': it reports what others hold.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which split of तस्मिन्नेक is right?
optionExplain: तस्मिन्न is not a word; the form is तस्मिन्.
न्नेक is not a word of the card.
Right: A final न् after a short vowel doubles before a vowel: तस्मिन् + एक → तस्मिन्नेक.
नेक is not a word of the card; the word is एक.
questions.explain: तस्मिन् (in that) + एक (one): the न् doubles before the vowel ए.
questions.rule: Short vowel + न् + vowel → न्न् + vowel.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Whose statement does आहुः present in unit 53?
optionExplain: That would be 3rd person singular, आह.
आहुः is not a 1st person form.
आहुः is not a 2nd person form.
Right: आहुः is 3rd person plural: they say.
questions.explain: आहुः (3 pl. pf. of √ah) = they say: the line reports others' view.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By the join in अतिक्रान्तेऽपि, how is वने + अपि written?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ at a word end: the अ is dropped and marked with ऽ.
ए + अ does not give ऐ.
The ए cannot turn into आ here.
ए + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: अतिक्रान्ते + अपि → अतिक्रान्तेऽपि; so वने + अपि → वनेऽपि.
questions.teaches: After a final ए or ओ, an initial अ is dropped and marked with ऽ: वने + अपि → वनेऽपि.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By unit 54, what does (he) become after this?
optionExplain: The word is विकारी, disordered.
Right: विकारी भवति: becomes subject to disorder.
Birth is not named in this unit.
That is the opposite of विकारी.
questions.explain: अतःपरम् विकारी भवति: after this he becomes disordered.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Put the words of unit 54 in their printed order.
questions.explain: After this → disordered → becomes.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Match each word of unit 54 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words make the whole line.
questions.rule: अतःपरम् = after this; विकारी = disordered; भवति = becomes.
questions.teaches: अतःपरम् means 'after this'; भवति (√भू) means 'becomes'.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: What form is विकारी in unit 54, by the card?
optionExplain: The feminine would be विकारिणी.
The neuter would be विकारि.
Right: The data labels विकारी m. nom. sg.
The plural would be विकारिणः.
questions.explain: विकारी (stem विकारिन्) is masculine nominative singular, so the unstated subject is masculine.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: Which two are true of unit 54?
options: It names the child as subject
It does not say what the disorder is
It names Vāta as the cause
optionExplain: Right: the line has no subject word.
The child is only a probable guess of the data, not printed.
Right: the kind of disorder is not specified.
No doṣa is named in this unit.
questions.explain: The line says only that (he) becomes disordered after this; subject and kind of disorder are not stated.
questions.rule: Read only what is printed: अतःपरं विकारी भवति.
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: विकारी is the m. nom. sg. of विकारिन्. By the same pattern, what is the m. nom. sg. of ब्रह्मचारिन्?
optionExplain: -इन् stems take no visarga in the m. nom. sg.
That is the bare stem, not the nominative.
-आ is no ending of an -इन् stem.
Right: -इन् stem, m. nom. sg. → -ई, as विकारिन् → विकारी.
questions.explain: विकारिन् → विकारी; so ब्रह्मचारिन् → ब्रह्मचारी (feminine ब्रह्मचारिणी).
questions.teaches: An -इन् stem has m. nom. sg. in -ई (विकारी, ब्रह्मचारी) and a feminine in -इणी (ब्रह्मचारिणी).
questions.section: नैर्ऋत भाग और प्रसव का काल

questions.q: By unit 55, which way does the embryo face in the garbha-koṣṭha?
optionExplain: Right: मातुः पृष्ठाभिमुखः: facing the mother's back.
पृष्ठ means the back, not the front.
The forehead (ललाट) is where its palms are joined.
The right side is where the male rests.
questions.explain: मातुः (of the mother) पृष्ठ (back) अभिमुखः (facing).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 55 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Face, hands, limbs, the place, and then the three sides: right, left, middle.
questions.rule: Facing the back → palms at forehead → limbs contracted → garbha-koṣṭha → right: male → left: female, middle: neuter.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each side in unit 55 to who rests on it.
questions.explain: Right side: male; left: female; middle: neuter.
questions.rule: दक्षिण → पुमान्, वाम → स्त्री, मध्य → नपुंसक.
questions.teaches: Unit 55 places the male on the right side, the female on the left and the neuter in the middle.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of आश्रित्यावतिष्ठते is right?
optionExplain: वतिष्ठते is not a word of the card.
Right: अ + अ gives आ: आश्रित्य + अवतिष्ठते → आश्रित्यावतिष्ठते.
ई + अ would give य: आश्रित्यवतिष्ठते, with a short अ.
Then no आ could appear; वतिष्ठते is no word.
questions.explain: आश्रित्य (resting on, absolutive) + अवतिष्ठते (stays).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: In वामं स्त्री, which printed words must be understood again?
optionExplain: That is the embryo's posture, said once of the garbha.
That too is the posture, not the verb of the sides.
Right: These are printed once with पुमान् and carried over.
That is the next clause, which itself needs the verb.
questions.explain: The clauses वामं स्त्री and मध्यं नपुंसकम् borrow आश्रित्य अवतिष्ठते from the male clause.
questions.rule: Elliptical clauses borrow the verb printed once.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in पृष्ठाभिमुखो ललाटे, how is रामः + गच्छति written?
optionExplain: र् comes only after vowels other than अ/आ.
अः does not become आ before a consonant.
स् comes before त/थ, not before ग.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ.
questions.explain: पृष्ठाभिमुखः + ललाटे → पृष्ठाभिमुखो ललाटे; so रामः + गच्छति → रामो गच्छति.
questions.teaches: A final अः becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: पृष्ठाभिमुखः + ललाटे → पृष्ठाभिमुखो ललाटे.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 56, when does the embryo wake?
optionExplain: Right: प्रबुद्धायाम् (मातरि) प्रबुध्यते: it wakes when she is awake.
No time of day is named in this unit.
Eating is not named in this unit.
Touch is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: The embryo follows the mother: it wakes when she is awake.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 56 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Staying there, the embryo, when the mother is sleeping (sleeps); when awake, wakes.
questions.rule: तत्र स्थितश्च → गर्भो मातरि → स्वपन्त्याम् → प्रबुद्धायाम् → प्रबुध्यते.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each phrase of unit 56 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Place, the embryo's staying, the two states of the mother, and the waking.
questions.rule: तत्र, स्थितः, मातरि स्वपन्त्याम्, प्रबुद्धायाम्, प्रबुध्यते.
questions.teaches: मातरि स्वपन्त्याम् is a locative absolute: 'when the mother is sleeping'.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What is मातरि स्वपन्त्याम् in unit 56?
options: A main clause: the mother is sleeping now
A locative absolute: when the mother is sleeping
An instrumental: by the mother who is sleeping
A genitive: of the mother who is sleeping
optionExplain: There is no finite verb in these two words.
Right: Both words are f. loc. sg.: a time-clause.
The instrumental would be मात्रा स्वपन्त्या.
The genitive would be मातुः स्वपन्त्याः.
questions.explain: Noun and participle together in the locative mark the time: when the mother is sleeping.
questions.rule: Locative absolute = noun + participle in the locative: 'when …'.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: In प्रबुद्धायां प्रबुध्यते, who is awake (प्रबुद्धा), by the feminine ending?
optionExplain: गर्भ is masculine and does the waking, प्रबुध्यते.
No father is named in this unit.
Right: प्रबुद्धायाम् is feminine, so it goes with मातरि.
No midwife is named in this unit.
questions.explain: प्रबुद्धायाम् (f. loc. sg.) carries over मातरि: when the mother is awake, the embryo wakes.
questions.rule: A feminine participle goes with a feminine noun.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: An invented line reads पितरि सुप्ते पुत्रः पठति. What does it say?
options: The father reads while the son sleeps
The son reads to the sleeping father
The son reads about his father's sleep
When the father is asleep, the son reads
optionExplain: पुत्रः goes with पठति; the father is the one asleep.
No 'to' (dative) is expressed.
No 'about' is expressed; पितरि is a time-clause.
Right: पितरि सुप्ते is a locative absolute.
questions.explain: As मातरि स्वपन्त्याम् = when the mother is sleeping, पितरि सुप्ते = when the father is asleep.
questions.teaches: A noun and a participle in the locative make a time-clause: पितरि सुप्ते = when the father is asleep.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 57, what kind of functioning does the embryo have?
optionExplain: Right: परतन्त्र = under another's control.
That would be स्वतन्त्र, the opposite.
The unit names its functioning, वृत्ति.
No disorder is named in this unit.
questions.explain: परतन्त्रवृत्ति = functioning that depends on another.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 57 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Because of dependent functioning, and, of the embryo.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 57 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: परतन्त्र + वृत्ति = dependent functioning; गर्भस्य names whose it is.
questions.teaches: परतन्त्र means 'under another's control'; वृत्ति means functioning.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of वृत्तेश्च is right?
optionExplain: श्च is not a word of the card.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्: वृत्तेः + च → वृत्तेश्च.
वृत्तेम् is no form of वृत्ति.
ए + अ would leave ऽ, and अश्च is no word here.
questions.explain: वृत्तेः (because of / of the functioning) + च (and).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which two are true of unit 57, by the card?
options: It has no verb of its own
The form वृत्तेः can be ablative or genitive
It says the embryo acts on its own
optionExplain: The mother's heart is in unit 58, not here.
Right: it is a nominal fragment.
Right: both cases have this form; the card takes ablative.
परतन्त्र says the opposite: under another's control.
questions.explain: Unit 57 is a fragment; its वृत्तेः is read as a reason, though the form is also genitive.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in वृत्तेश्च, how is रामः + च written?
optionExplain: ओ comes before voiced sounds; च is voiceless.
र् is not used after अ, and not before च.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्.
स् comes before त/थ, not before च.
questions.explain: वृत्तेः + च → वृत्तेश्च; so रामः + च → रामश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्: रामः + च → रामश्च.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 58, from when onward are the womb's upasneha and upasveda the means of sustenance?
options: From the birth of the child
optionExplain: Birth is not the starting point named here.
No month is named in this unit.
No cry is named in this unit.
Right: निषेकात् प्रभृति: from impregnation onward.
questions.explain: निषेकात् (from impregnation) प्रभृति (onward).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 58 in their printed order.
questions.explain: From impregnation, moistening and warming of the womb are sustenance; then the duct at the navel; the mother's heart closes the line.
questions.rule: निषेकात् → उपस्नेह-उपस्वेद → वर्तन → नाभि में नाडी → मातृहृदय.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 58 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words carry the sure first sentence and the navel link.
questions.teaches: वर्तन means the means of sustenance: at first, the womb's moistening and warming.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 58, what is fastened (प्रतिबद्धा) at the navel?
optionExplain: Right: नाभ्यां प्रतिबद्धा नाडी: a duct is fastened at the navel.
Moistening is the early sustenance, not a thing fastened.
Hair-pores are not named in this unit.
The rasa of food is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: नाभ्याम् (at the navel) प्रतिबद्धा (fastened) नाडी (duct; probably the umbilical cord).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which join makes गर्भाशयोपस्नेह out of गर्भाशय + उपस्नेह?
optionExplain: आ + उ gives ओ, never औ.
Right: गर्भाशय ends in अ; with उ it gives ओ.
अ + ओ would give औ, and उपस्नेह begins with उ.
गर्भाशय does not end in इ.
questions.explain: गर्भाशय + उपस्नेह → गर्भाशयोपस्नेह; likewise उपस्नेह + उपस्वेदौ → उपस्नेहोपस्वेदौ.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the same join, how is सूर्य + उदयः written?
optionExplain: अ + उ does not give औ.
The अ cannot simply drop.
Right: अ + उ → ओ.
No व् is inserted after अ.
questions.explain: गर्भाशय + उपस्नेह → गर्भाशयोपस्नेह; so सूर्य + उदयः → सूर्योदयः.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before उ merges into ओ: सूर्य + उदयः → सूर्योदयः.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 59, from where does the rasa of food set out?
optionExplain: The navel comes later, in unit 60.
The stomach is not named in this unit.
Hair-pores belong to unit 62.
Right: मातृहृदयात्: from the mother's heart.
questions.explain: ततः मातृहृदयात्: then from the mother's heart.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 59 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Then, from the mother's heart, through the vessels, pulsating, to the aparā, it reaches.
questions.rule: ततः → मातृहृदयात् → धमनीभिः → स्पन्दमानः → अपराम् → उपैति.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 59 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words carry the time, the manner, the goal and the verb.
questions.teaches: उपैति (upa-√i) means 'reaches'; अपराम् is its goal, the aparā (placenta).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of स्पन्दमानोऽपराम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the dropped अ is marked ऽ.
अ + अ would give आ: स्पन्दमानापराम्.
म् + अ would give स्पन्दमानमपराम्.
The ऽ marks a dropped अ, so the word is अपराम्.
questions.explain: स्पन्दमानः (pulsating) + अपराम् (to the aparā).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 59, through what does the rasa of food move?
options: Through the hair-pores of the mother's skin
Through the mouth and throat of the embryo
optionExplain: Hair-pores are named in unit 62, not here.
Right: धमनीभिः: through the vessels, instrumental plural.
No mouth or throat is named in this unit.
The pakvāśaya comes in unit 61, not here.
questions.explain: धमनीभिः स्पन्दमानः: pulsating through the dhamanīs.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in स्पन्दमानोऽपराम्, how is बालः + अपि written?
optionExplain: अः + अ does not give आ.
र् is not used after अ.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, with ऽ for the dropped अ.
अः + अ does not give औ.
questions.explain: स्पन्दमानः + अपराम् → स्पन्दमानोऽपराम्; so बालः + अपि → बालोऽपि.
questions.teaches: A final अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ is dropped (ऽ): बालः + अपि → बालोऽपि.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What does क्रमात् mean in unit 60?
optionExplain: That is the opposite of क्रमात्.
No contrary motion is named.
That is मातृहृदयात् in unit 59.
Right: क्रमात् (abl. of क्रम) = in sequence.
questions.explain: ततः क्रमात् नाभिम्: then, in sequence, to the navel.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 60 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Then → in sequence → to the navel.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Unit 60 reads ततः क्रमात् ____ (to the navel). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: नाभिम् is the accusative of नाभि (navel): to the navel.
questions.teaches: नाभिम् (acc. of नाभि) = to the navel.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of क्रमान्नाभिम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् before the nasal न may become न् (optional; द् is also correct): क्रमात् + नाभिम् → क्रमान्नाभिम्.
That would give क्रमं नाभिम् or क्रमन्नाभिम्, with a short अ; the print has क्रमा-.
न्नाभिम् is not a word of the card.
अन्नाभिम् is not a word of the card.
questions.explain: क्रमात् (in sequence) + नाभिम् (to the navel).
questions.rule: त् + न → न्न (optional; द् is also correct).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What does unit 60 lack that a full sentence needs?
optionExplain: नाभिम् is a noun.
Right: The data notes that no verb is printed and none is supplied.
क्रमात् is an ablative.
ततः means 'then'.
questions.explain: ततः, क्रमात् and नाभिम् are there; a verb is not.
questions.rule: A fragment lacks its own finite verb.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in क्रमान्नाभिम्, how may तत् + नगरम् be written?
optionExplain: No vowel is inserted after त्.
च् comes before च/छ, not before न.
Right: त् before न may become न् (optional; तद्नगरम् is also correct), as in क्रमान्नाभिम्.
त् does not become स् here.
questions.explain: क्रमात् + नाभिम् → क्रमान्नाभिम्; so तत् + नगरम् → तन्नगरम्.
questions.rule: त् + nasal → न् + nasal (optional; द् is also correct).
questions.teaches: A final त् before a nasal such as न may become न् (optional; द् is also correct): तत् + नगरम् → तन्नगरम्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 61, where is the rasa cooked?
optionExplain: The mother's heart is where it sets out, unit 59.
The aparā is reached in unit 59; cooking is not said there.
Hair-pores belong to unit 62.
Right: गर्भस्य पक्वाशये: in the embryo's pakvāśaya.
questions.explain: पक्वाशय = site of digested matter, probably the large intestine.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 61 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Place, fire, being cooked, the cause (abundance of prasāda), the result, the verb.
questions.rule: पक्वाशये → स्वकायाग्निना → पच्यमानः → प्रसादबाहुल्यात् → धात्वादिपुष्टिकरः → सम्पद्यते.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 61 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Fire cooks it; the abundance of the clear part makes it nourishing.
questions.teaches: प्रसाद is the clear, pure part of what is digested; its abundance nourishes the dhātus.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of बाहुल्याद्धात्वादि is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् before the voiced ध becomes द्: बाहुल्याद्धात्वादि.
हात्वादि is not a word of the card.
द्धात्वादि is not a word of the card.
म् before ध would not give द्ध.
questions.explain: प्रसादबाहुल्यात् (from abundance of the clear part) + धात्वादि (dhātus and the rest).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: In unit 61, what does सः (it) stand for, given its masculine form?
options: The rasa of food of unit 59
optionExplain: हृदय is neuter; सः is masculine.
Right: The data reads सः as that rasa (masculine रसः).
नाडी is feminine; सः is masculine.
अपरा is feminine; सः is masculine.
questions.explain: सः (m.) = the āhāra-rasa that reached the aparā in unit 59.
questions.rule: A pronoun agrees in gender with what it stands for.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in बाहुल्याद्धात्वादि, how is मार्गात् + गच्छति written?
optionExplain: त् cannot stay voiceless before ग.
न् comes before a nasal, not before ग.
Right: त् before the voiced ग becomes द्.
त् does not become ग् here.
questions.explain: बाहुल्यात् + धातु → बाहुल्याद्धातु; so मार्गात् + गच्छति → मार्गाद्गच्छति.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced consonant: मार्गात् + गच्छति → मार्गाद्गच्छति.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 62, through what is there moistening (upasneha)?
optionExplain: No mouth is named in this unit.
The nāḍī is named in unit 58, not here.
The dhamanīs carry rasa in unit 59.
Right: रोमकूपैः उपस्नेहः: moistening through the hair-pores.
questions.explain: रोम (hair) + कूप (pit, pore): the hair-pores.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 62 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Likewise, through the hair-pores, moistening; the rasa itself, and, having become payas.
questions.rule: तथा → रोमकूपैः → उपस्नेहः → रसः एव → च → पयोभूतः.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 62 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: तथा links the line to what precedes; उपस्नेह is the moistening; एव stresses रसः.
questions.teaches: उपस्नेह means moistening; तथा (likewise) adds it to the ways named before.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of रोमकूपैरुपस्नेहो is right?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel.
रुपस्नेहः is not a word of the card.
म् + उ would give रोमकूपमुपस्नेहः.
रोमकूपैर is no full word; the ending is -ऐः.
questions.explain: रोमकूपैः (through the hair-pores) + उपस्नेहः (moistening).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What form is रोमकूपैः in unit 62?
options: Locative plural: in and inside the hair-pores
Genitive plural: belonging to the hair-pores
optionExplain: The locative plural would be रोमकूपेषु.
Right: -ऐः is the instrumental plural of an अ-stem.
The genitive plural would be रोमकूपाणाम्.
The nominative singular would be रोमकूपः.
questions.explain: रोमकूपैः = by / through the hair-pores (inst. pl.).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the join in रोमकूपैरुपस्नेहो, how is अश्वैः + आगतम् written?
optionExplain: The visarga cannot simply drop here.
स् comes before त/थ, not before a vowel.
Right: Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel.
ऐः does not turn into आय्.
questions.explain: रोमकूपैः + उपस्नेहः → रोमकूपैरुपस्नेहः; so अश्वैः + आगतम् → अश्वैरागतम्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel: अश्वैः + आगतम् → अश्वैरागतम्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 63, what does not arise in the unborn embryo?
optionExplain: The rasa is there; it is free of mala.
Sleep is unit 56's topic; not named here.
No fire is named in this unit.
Right: स्थूलमलासम्भवः: non-arising of gross waste.
questions.explain: स्थूल (gross) + मल (waste) + असम्भव (non-arising).
questions.rule: स्थूलमलासम्भव = gross waste does not arise.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 63 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Of the unborn; because food and drink do not enter directly; and because the rasa is stainless; of the embryo; no gross waste.
questions.rule: अजातस्य → अन्नपान-अननुप्रवेशात् → अमलत्वात् च रसस्य → गर्भस्य → स्थूलमलासम्भवः.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 63 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four of the words carry the negative अ-/अन्-: अजात (unborn), अननुप्रवेश (non-entry), अमलत्व (being free of waste), असम्भव (non-arising).
questions.teaches: अ- or अन्- before a word negates it: अजात = unborn, अननुप्रवेश = non-entry.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which two reasons does unit 63 give?
options: The mother's fire burns the waste
Food and drink do not enter directly
The hair-pores carry the waste out
The rasa is free from mala
optionExplain: No fire is named in this unit.
Right: साक्षात् अन्नपान-अननुप्रवेशात्.
Hair-pores are not named here.
Right: अमलत्वात् रसस्य.
questions.explain: Two ablatives of reason: अननुप्रवेशात् and अमलत्वात्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What does unit 63 say about fine (subtle) waste in the embryo?
options: Nothing: it speaks only of gross waste
That no waste of any kind arises
That fine waste leaves by the navel
optionExplain: Right: स्थूल limits the statement to gross waste.
The unit does not say so.
Only gross (स्थूल) waste is denied.
Nothing of the kind is said.
questions.explain: The text denies only स्थूल मल; about fine waste it is silent.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the negative in अननुप्रवेश, how is the negative of उदय (rise) formed?
optionExplain: अ- stands only before a consonant.
Right: Before a vowel the negative prefix is अन्-: अन् + उदय.
न + उदय is a sandhi of two words, not the prefix.
No द् comes into the negative prefix.
questions.explain: अन् + अनुप्रवेश → अननुप्रवेश; so अन् + उदय → अनुदय. Before a consonant: अ + जात → अजात.
questions.rule: Negative prefix: अ- before a consonant, अन्- before a vowel.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अ- before a consonant (अजात, असम्भव) and अन्- before a vowel (अननुप्रवेश, अनुदय).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 64, in what position does the child come out at birth?
optionExplain: The unit says head downward, not feet first.
No sideways position is named in unit 64.
Right: अवाक्शिराः निष्क्रामति: he comes out head downward, after turning round.
The head comes first: अवाक्शिराः.
questions.explain: After turning round (परिवृत्त्या), the child comes out head downward.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 64 in the line's order.
questions.explain: At birth, through contact with the wind of parturition, by turning round, head downward, he comes out; then the aparā, detached.
questions.rule: जन्मकाले → प्रसूतिमारुतयोगात् → परिवृत्त्या → अवाक्शिराः → निष्क्रामति → अपरा च्युता.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 64 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These five words carry the whole sequence of the birth.
questions.teaches: अवाक्शिराः is a bahuvrīhi: अवाक् (downward) + शिरस् (head) = one whose head is downward.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of निष्क्रामत्यनु is right?
optionExplain: ए + अ would give निष्क्रामतेऽनु, with ए kept.
यनु is not a word; the particle is अनु.
निष्क्रामत्य is not a verb form; the verb is निष्क्रामति.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: निष्क्रामति + अनु → निष्क्रामत्यनु.
questions.explain: निष्क्रामति (comes out) + अनु (afterwards): इ + अ → य.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 64, from where does the aparā (placenta) come away?
optionExplain: Right: मातृहृदयात् च्युता: detached from the mother's heart, as printed.
No navel is named in unit 64.
The printed word is हृदय, heart, not belly.
Channels are not named in unit 64.
questions.explain: The line ends अपरा च्युता मातृहृदयात्: the aparā, detached from the mother's heart.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of अवाक्शिरा निष्क्रामति, how is बालाः + गच्छन्ति (the boys go) written?
optionExplain: ओ comes from a visarga after short अ, not after आ.
Right: After आ the visarga drops before a voiced consonant, as अवाक्शिराः + निष्क्रामति.
The visarga becomes र् only after vowels other than अ and आ.
The visarga becomes श् only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: बालाः + गच्छन्ति = बाला गच्छन्ति, like अवाक्शिराः + निष्क्रामति = अवाक्शिरा निष्क्रामति.
questions.rule: आः before a voiced consonant → आ (visarga dropped).
questions.teaches: A visarga after आ is dropped before a voiced consonant: अवाक्शिराः + निष्क्रामति → अवाक्शिरा निष्क्रामति.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: What does unit 65 call the course of birth described in unit 64?
optionExplain: विकृति is the word of unit 66, for the other case.
No disease is named in unit 65.
Right: एषा प्रकृतिः: this is the natural state.
The line calls it the natural, normal state.
questions.explain: The birth of unit 64 is called प्रकृति, the natural state.
questions.rule: एषा प्रकृतिः = this is the natural state.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: In unit 65, what does प्रकृति mean?
optionExplain: The data notes say it is not the constitution term here.
No temperament of the mother is named.
No medicine is named in unit 65.
Right: The card reads प्रकृति here as the normal course of things.
questions.explain: प्रकृति in this line = the natural, normal state.
questions.rule: प्रकृति here = the natural course, not body constitution.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: This is the natural state: एषा ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is एषा प्रकृतिः.
questions.teaches: प्रकृति = the natural, normal state; its counterpart विकृति (deviation) is named in unit 66.
questions.rule: एषा प्रकृतिः = this is the natural state.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which grammar label does the card give एषा?
optionExplain: Right: The card labels एषा f. nom. sg.
The masculine form is एषः.
The neuter form is एतत्.
The accusative form is एताम्.
questions.explain: एषा = this, feminine nominative singular, with the feminine noun प्रकृतिः.
questions.rule: एषा = f. nom. sg. of this.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which statements about unit 65 are right?
options: The line prints a verb meaning is
The copula is understood, not printed
प्रकृति here means the normal course
It is a metrical verse line
optionExplain: No verb is printed; is is understood.
Right: only two words, no verb.
Right: not the constitution term.
It is a prose unit, not a verse.
questions.explain: Two words of prose, the copula understood, प्रकृति in its plain sense of natural state.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Built like एषा प्रकृतिः, which word fits the invented line ____ सुखम् (this is happiness), सुखम् being neuter?
optionExplain: एषा is feminine, as with प्रकृतिः.
Right: A neuter noun takes the neuter this: एतत् सुखम्.
एताम् is an accusative, not the subject.
एषाम् is a genitive plural, of these.
questions.explain: एतत् सुखम्, as एषा प्रकृतिः: the pronoun takes the noun's gender.
questions.teaches: The pronoun this takes the gender of its noun: एषा प्रकृतिः (f.), एतत् सुखम् (n.).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 66, what is called vikṛti (abnormality)?
options: Only a birth with the feet first
optionExplain: The line names no particular kind of birth.
That is प्रकृति, its counterpart.
Right: अतः अन्यथा: otherwise than this, the natural state.
No disease is named in unit 66.
questions.explain: Anything otherwise than the natural state is vikṛti.
questions.rule: विकृतिः अतः अन्यथा = otherwise than this is abnormality.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 66 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Abnormality, than this, otherwise.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 66 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words make the whole line.
questions.teaches: अतः here means than this; with अन्यथा (otherwise) it gives otherwise than this.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of विकृतिरतोऽन्यथा is right?
optionExplain: ई + अ would give य्: विकृत्यतो.
ए + अ keeps ए: it would read विकृतिरतेऽन्यथा.
न्यथा is not a word; the word is अन्यथा.
Right: Visarga after इ → र् before अ; अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.explain: विकृतिः (abnormality) + अतः (than this) + अन्यथा (otherwise).
questions.rule: Visarga after इ → र् before a vowel; अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Why is अतः written अतो before अन्यथा in unit 66?
options: अः + अ → ओ, and the next अ drops as ऽ
A visarga becomes स् before a vowel
अतो is a different word from अतः
A visarga becomes र् before any vowel
optionExplain: Right: अतः + अन्यथा → अतोऽन्यथा; ऽ marks the dropped अ.
A visarga does not become स् before a vowel.
The card gives the word as अतः, than this.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, as in विकृतिरतः.
questions.explain: अतः + अन्यथा = अतोऽन्यथा: अः before अ gives ओ, and the अ is marked by ऽ.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of विकृतिरतः, how is मतिः + अस्ति (there is thought) joined?
optionExplain: इ becomes य् only when no visarga stands after it.
Right: After इ a visarga becomes र् before a vowel, as विकृतिः + अतः → विकृतिरतः.
A visarga does not become स् before a vowel.
ऽ marks an अ dropped after ए or ओ, not here.
questions.explain: मतिः + अस्ति = मतिरस्ति, like विकृतिः + अतः = विकृतिरतः.
questions.rule: Visarga after इ → र् before a vowel.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ becomes र् before a vowel: विकृतिः + अतः → विकृतिरतः.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 67, which foot does the woman who bears a son put forward first?
optionExplain: The text says दक्षिणम्, right.
One foot, the right, is named.
Right: दक्षिणं पादं पूर्वमभिहरति: she puts the right foot forward first.
It names the right foot (दक्षिणं पादम्).
questions.explain: The first sign of the list: the right foot put forward first.
questions.rule: दक्षिणं पादं पूर्वम् अभिहरति = puts the right foot forward first.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these signs and the result of unit 67 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Right foot, right arm, dreams with male names, clear face; then the result: she bears a son.
questions.rule: पाद → बाहु → स्वप्न → मुखवर्ण → पुत्रं प्रसूते.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 67 to its meaning.
pairs: with a clear complexion of the face
questions.explain: These words come from the sure parts of the list.
questions.teaches: दौर्हृद is the longing of pregnancy; here its objects are male-named ones.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 67, what is born in the opposite case (तद्विपर्यये)?
optionExplain: The napuṃsaka goes with a mixture (संकरे).
A son goes with the signs themselves.
Twins are not named in unit 67.
Right: तद्विपर्यये कन्याम्: in the opposite of that, a girl.
questions.explain: Signs → son; their opposite → girl; a mixture → napuṃsaka.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which signs does unit 67 list for the woman who bears a son?
options: She puts the left foot forward first
She sees dreams bearing male names
optionExplain: The text says the right foot.
Right: दक्षिणश्च ... बाहुर्बलवान्.
The text says keen hunger (तीक्ष्णक्षुत्).
Right: पुन्नामधेयांश्च स्वप्नान् पश्यति.
questions.explain: The right arm is strong and the dreams bear male names; foot and hunger are the other way.
questions.rule: दक्षिण बाहु बलवान्; पुन्नामधेय स्वप्न; तीक्ष्ण क्षुत्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of तद्विपर्यये, how is तत् + वचनम् (that word) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A final त् before a voiced sound becomes द्, as तत् + विपर्यये → तद्विपर्यये.
Before the voiced व the त् does not stay त्.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
त् becomes च् only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: तत् + वचनम् = तद्वचनम्, like तत् + विपर्यये = तद्विपर्यये.
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a voiced sound.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced sound: तत् + विपर्यये → तद्विपर्यये.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 68, by what is the embryo's sex declared at the time of the question?
options: By the dreams she reports that night
By the gender of what she touches
By the shape and height of her belly
By the day on which the question falls
optionExplain: Dreams belong to unit 67, not to this unit.
Right: तल्लिंगम् ... गर्भम् आदिशेत्: of the same gender as the thing touched.
No belly is named in unit 68.
No day is named, only the time of the question.
questions.explain: Whatever limb or external thing of a gender she touches, the embryo is declared of that gender.
questions.rule: स्पर्श की वस्तु का लिंग = गर्भ का लिंग, as the text states.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 68 in the line's order.
questions.explain: At the time of the question, the woman ... or an external substance, touches; of that gender, her embryo, one should declare.
questions.rule: प्रश्नकाले नारी → बाह्यद्रव्यं वा → परामृशति → तल्लिंगमस्या → गर्भमादिशेत्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 68 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These five words carry the whole rule.
