questions.teaches: आदिशेत् is an optative (3 sg.): one should declare; its subject is not printed.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of तल्लिंगमस्या is right?
optionExplain: तल् is not a word; the pronoun is तत्.
स्याः is not a word of the card; the word is अस्याः.
Right: त् + ल → ल्ल; अस्याः drops its visarga before गर्भम्.
लिङ्गमस् and याः are not words of the card.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + लिङ्गम् (gender) + अस्याः (her).
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 68, if the woman touches a thing of female gender at the question, what is declared?
optionExplain: The embryo takes the gender of the thing touched.
Neuter would follow a thing of neuter gender.
An external substance (बाह्यद्रव्य) counts as well.
Right: तल्लिंगम्: the embryo is declared of that same gender.
questions.explain: Same gender as the thing touched: here female.
questions.rule: तल्लिंगमस्या गर्भमादिशेत्: the embryo is declared of the gender of the thing touched.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of तल्लिंगम्, how is तत् + लभते (gets that) joined?
optionExplain: Right: त् before ल becomes ल्, as तत् + लिङ्गम् → तल्लिङ्गम्.
Before ल the त् becomes ल्, not द्.
The त् does not stay unchanged before ल.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: तत् + लभते = तल्लभते, like तत् + लिङ्गम् = तल्लिङ्गम्.
questions.teaches: A final त् before ल becomes ल्: तत् + लिङ्गम् → तल्लिङ्गम्.
questions.section: गर्भ की स्थिति, पोषण, जन्म और लिंग-लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 69, what does the Vāta that has gone astray dry up?
options: The mother's milk in her breast
The seed of father and mother
optionExplain: Milk is not named in unit 69.
Right: गर्भस्य रसवाहिनी स्रोतांसि शोषयति.
The aparā is not named in this unit.
Seed (bīja) is not named in unit 69.
questions.explain: Vāta gone astray dries up the embryo's rasa-carrying channels.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Put these words of unit 69 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When Vāta gone astray dries up the embryo's rasa-carrying channels, then he is born Vāta-diseased and deficient.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 69 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Cause (Vāta astray, channels dried) and result (वातरोगी, हीन).
questions.teaches: शोषयति is a causative of √शुष् (to dry): it makes dry, dries up.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of तून्मार्गगो is right?
optionExplain: ए + उ does not give ऊ.
ओ + उ does not give ऊ.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ; अः → ओ before the voiced व of वातः.
That would be written with a short उ: तुन्मार्ग.
questions.explain: तु (but) + उन्मार्गगः (gone astray): two उ sounds become one long ऊ.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which statements does the card make about unit 69?
options: It names no specific Vāta illness
It says in what the child is deficient
The channels dried are the mother's
The Vāta has gone off its path
optionExplain: Right: only वातरोगी, suffering from a Vāta disease.
It does not say in what (हीन only).
They are the embryo's (गर्भस्य).
Right: उन्मार्गगः.
questions.explain: Vāta off its path; no named illness; deficiency unspecified; the channels are the embryo's.
questions.rule: उन्मार्गगो वातः; गर्भस्य स्रोतांसि; वातरोगी हीनः.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of उन्मार्गगो वातो, how is देवः + जयति (the god wins) written?
optionExplain: After अ the visarga drops only before vowels other than अ.
र् comes only after vowels other than अ and आ.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ, as उन्मार्गगः + वातः → उन्मार्गगो वातः.
questions.explain: देवः + जयति = देवो जयति, like हीनः + जायते = हीनो जायते.
questions.rule: अः before a voiced consonant → ओ.
questions.teaches: A visarga after short अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: हीनः + जायते → हीनो जायते.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By unit 70, for how long may he stay in the belly?
optionExplain: Right: बहूनि वर्षाणि: for many years.
The text says वर्षाणि, years.
No days are named in unit 70.
बहूनि means many, not one.
questions.explain: बहूनि वा वर्षाण्युदरे तिष्ठति: or he stays in the belly for many years.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Put the words of unit 70 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Many, or, years, in the belly, stays.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 70 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words carry the whole line; वा (or) seems to add it to the outcome of unit 69.
questions.teaches: An accusative of time tells how long: बहूनि वर्षाणि = for many years.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: In unit 70, what does उदर mean?
optionExplain: The data notes say no illness is named here.
Right: The card reads उदरे as in the belly, not as a disease.
The heart (हृदय) is named in unit 64, not here.
Channels are named in unit 69, not here.
questions.explain: उदरे = in the belly (locative).
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of वर्षाण्युदरे is right?
optionExplain: ए + उ does not give यु.
अ + उ would give ओ: वर्षाण्योदरे.
Right: इ before उ becomes य्: वर्षाणि + उदरे → वर्षाण्युदरे.
वर्षाणु and दरे are not words of the card.
questions.explain: वर्षाणि (years) + उदरे (in the belly): इ + उ → यु.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of वर्षाण्युदरे, how is अस्ति + उदकम् (there is water) joined?
optionExplain: The two vowels do not stand side by side; इ becomes य्.
इ + उ does not give ओ.
The इ is not lost; it becomes य्.
Right: इ + उ → य् + उ, as वर्षाणि + उदरे → वर्षाण्युदरे.
questions.explain: अस्ति + उदकम् = अस्त्युदकम्, like वर्षाणि + उदरे = वर्षाण्युदरे.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: वर्षाणि + उदरे → वर्षाण्युदरे.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By unit 71, for whom is the purpose accomplished equally?
options: For the woman and the man
optionExplain: Right: स्त्रीपुंसयोः समम्: equally for woman and man.
Both are named: स्त्री and पुंस्.
Both are named in one dual compound.
No physician is named in unit 71.
questions.explain: The condition concerns both woman and man, equally (समम्).
questions.rule: स्त्रीपुंसयोः समम् = equally for woman and man.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Put the words of unit 71 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When, for woman and man, equally, the purpose, is accomplished.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 71 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words make the whole condition.
questions.teaches: स्त्रीपुंसयोः is a dvandva in the dual: woman and man, the two together.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: What kind of form does the card call स्त्रीपुंसयोः?
options: A dvandva in the dual: woman and man
optionExplain: The ending is dual, for two persons.
Right: The card labels it a dvandva, dual.
The card calls it a dvandva, woman and man.
Two persons are named; it is dual.
questions.explain: स्त्री + पुंस् joined as a dvandva, in the dual.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which statements about unit 71 are right?
options: Both woman and man are named
The unit says what the purpose is
It gives the age of the woman
optionExplain: Right: स्त्रीपुंसयोः.
It does not say what the artha is.
Right: समम् ... निष्पद्यते.
No age is given in unit 71.
questions.explain: Both are named and the purpose is accomplished equally; what the purpose is, is not said.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of सममर्थः, how is फलम् + अस्ति (there is fruit) joined?
optionExplain: Anusvara stands only before a consonant, not a vowel.
The म् is not lost before a vowel.
Right: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins it, as समम् + अर्थः → सममर्थः.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not from अम्.
questions.explain: फलम् + अस्ति = फलमस्ति, like समम् + अर्थः = सममर्थः.
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joined with the vowel.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins the vowel: समम् + अर्थः → सममर्थः.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By unit 72, what is said of the seed (bīja) of the two?
options: Spoiled in one of its parts
Dried up by Vāta gone astray
Of equal portion and face to face
optionExplain: That is the opposite of समांश and संमुख.
Spoiling in a part is in unit 73.
Drying by Vāta is in unit 69.
Right: समांशं संमुखं च.
questions.explain: The seed of the two is of equal portion (समांशम्) and face to face (संमुखम्).
questions.rule: समांशं संमुखं च = of equal portion and face to face.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Put the words of unit 72 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Seed, or, of the two, of equal portion, face to face, and.
questions.rule: बीजम् → वा → तयोः → समांशम् → संमुखम् → च.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 72 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words carry the description; वा and च link it.
questions.teaches: समांश = सम (equal) + अंश (portion): of equal portion.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of समांशम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: सम + अंशम् → समांशम्.
A final म् before a vowel stays: it would give सममंशम्.
अः + अ would give ओऽ, not आ.
ए + अ keeps ए; it would give समेऽंशम्.
questions.explain: सम (equal) + अंशम् (portion): two short अ sounds become आ.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: How does the card treat bīja (seed) in unit 72?
options: Seed of each parent; no exact modern term
A plant seed used as medicine
optionExplain: The card does not equate bīja with the embryo.
Right: Probably semen and the female element; no modern term is forced.
No medicine is named in unit 72.
The bīja is of the two (तयोः), not of one.
questions.explain: bīja = the generative matter of each parent; the card forces no modern equivalent.
questions.rule: बीज = seed of each parent (no exact modern term).
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of समांशम्, how is हिम + अंशुः (cool-rayed, the moon) joined?
optionExplain: One अ is not simply dropped.
अ + अ does not give ए.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as सम + अंशम् → समांशम्.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: हिम + अंशुः = हिमांशुः, like सम + अंशम् = समांशम्.
questions.teaches: Two short अ sounds meeting at a joint become one long आ: सम + अंशम् → समांशम्.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By unit 73, when does a napuṃsaka come to be?
options: When the seed is of equal portion
When Vāta dries up the channels
When the woman touches a neuter thing
When the seed is spoiled in a part
optionExplain: Equal portion is the wording of unit 72.
That is unit 69, with another result.
That is the sign of unit 68, not a cause.
Right: बीजं भागे दुष्यति ... नपुंसकं भवति.
questions.explain: Vitiation of the seed in a part → a napuṃsaka with two natures and two seeds.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Put these words of unit 73 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When the seed is vitiated in a part, then a napuṃsaka of two natures and two seeds comes to be.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 73 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Cause (दुष्यति in a part) and result (the napuṃsaka with two marks).
questions.teaches: द्वि- in a bahuvrīhi: द्विप्रकृति = having two natures, द्विरेतस् = having two seeds.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of द्विप्रकृतिर्द्विरेतो is right?
optionExplain: Right: इः → इर् before the voiced द्; अः → ओ before the voiced न्.
A final ई would not bring in a र्.
म् would give द्विप्रकृतिं द्विरेतः.
A final ए stays ए; it would not give ओ.
questions.explain: द्विप्रकृतिः (two natures) + द्विरेतः (two seeds).
questions.rule: Visarga after इ → र् before a voiced sound; अः → ओ before a voiced sound.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which statements about unit 73 are right?
options: The text names which part of the seed is spoiled
प्रकृति here is the body-constitution term
Male and female natures: suggested, not stated
The napuṃsaka has two natures and two seeds
optionExplain: It says only भागे, in a part.
The notes say plain nature.
Right: the context suggests it; the text does not say so.
Right: द्विप्रकृतिः, द्विरेतः.
questions.explain: Two natures (probably male and female, by context) and two seeds; the part is not named.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of द्विप्रकृतिर्द्वि, how is हरिः + गच्छति (Hari goes) written?
optionExplain: After इ the visarga is not simply dropped.
Right: After इ a visarga becomes र् before a voiced consonant, as द्विप्रकृतिः + द्वि-.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
स् comes only before त or थ.
questions.explain: हरिः + गच्छति = हरिर्गच्छति, like द्विप्रकृतिः + द्विरेतः = द्विप्रकृतिर्द्विरेतः.
questions.rule: Visarga after इ → र् before a voiced consonant.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ becomes र् before a voiced consonant: द्विप्रकृतिः + द्विरेतः → द्विप्रकृतिर्द्विरेतः.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By unit 74, which partner first has the purpose accomplished?

questions.explain: पश्चात् (afterwards) + शुक्रम् (semen): त् + श → च्श or च्छ; the print has च्छ.
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ).

questions.q: By the rule of पश्चाच्छुक्रम्, how may तत् + श्रुत्वा (having heard that) be written?
optionExplain: त् does not become द् before the unvoiced श.
Right: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (च्श also correct), as पश्चात् + शुक्रम् → पश्चाच्छुक्रम्.
त् does not become स् before श.
त् may become a nasal (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: तत् + श्रुत्वा = तच्छ्रुत्वा, like पश्चात् + शुक्रम् = पश्चाच्छुक्रम्.
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel.
questions.teaches: A final त् before श becomes च्, and श may become छ (before a vowel or semivowel): च्श or च्छ: पश्चात् + शुक्रम् → पश्चाच्छुक्रम्.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of वातमेवोत्सृजति is right?
optionExplain: अः before उ would drop the visarga and not join: एव उत्.
म् + इव would give वातमिव, not वातमेव.
अ + ओ would give औ, not ओ.
Right: म् joins the vowel; अ + उ → ओ.
questions.explain: वातम् (Vāta) + एव (only) + उत्सृजति (releases).

questions.q: By the rule of एवोत्सृजति, how is सूर्य + उदयः (sunrise) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ, as एव + उत्सृजति → एवोत्सृजति.
अ + उ gives ओ, not औ.
The अ is not lost; it joins with उ.
अ does not turn into व्.
questions.explain: सूर्य + उदयः = सूर्योदयः, like एव + उत्सृजति = एवोत्सृजति.
questions.teaches: A short अ before उ joins into ओ: एव + उत्सृजति → एवोत्सृजति.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: Which split of अनुपघ्नन्नेव is right?
optionExplain: अ + ए would join as ऐ: अनुपघ्नन्नैव.

म् before a vowel would give अनुपघ्नमेव.
questions.explain: अनुपघ्नन् (not damaging) + एव (just): the न् is doubled because a short vowel stands before it.
questions.rule: Short vowel + न् + vowel → न्न् + vowel.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

questions.q: By the rule of स्रोतोमुखम्, how is तपः + वनम् written when joined?

questions.teaches: A visarga after short अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant.
questions.section: वात से विकृत गर्भ, द्विरेतस् और क्लीबता

Only य् is added; the अ stays short.
इ + अ does not give ए.
questions.explain: हि + अस्याः → ह्यस्याः; so प्रति + अक्षम् → प्रत्यक्षम्.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्.

questions.q: Unit 89 opens with यदा (when). Which word of the line answers it?
optionExplain: तस्य is a genitive pronoun, not the 'then' word.
अवयवः is a noun, part or limb.
Right: यदा … तदा is the when … then pair; तदा is printed after अवयवः.
पुनः is not printed in this line.
questions.explain: The line is a when … then frame: यदा तस्य अवयवः … तदा …

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 89 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These four are the sure words of the line; the rest is unclear in print.
questions.rule: यदा = when; तस्य = of that; अवयव = part; तदा = then.

questions.q: Put the sure words of unit 89 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The line reads यदा तस्यावयवस्तदा…: when, of that, part, then.
questions.teaches: The four sure words are printed as यदा तस्यावयवस्तदा, with two joins inside one token.

questions.q: Which split of अवयवस्तदा is right?
optionExplain: The plural अवयवाः would join as अवयवास्तदा, with a long आ.
म् before त would be written अवयवं तदा, not with स्.
स्तदा is not a word.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्: अवयवः + तदा → अवयवस्तदा.
questions.explain: अवयवः (part, nom. sg.) + तदा (then): visarga → स् before त.

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 89 by the card?
options: It gives the full result in its own words
It is a prose line, not a verse
तस्य is a genitive: its, of that
Its verb जनयति is printed in it
optionExplain: The clause has no predicate; nothing is completed here.
Right: the unit is prose.
Right: the card gives तस्य as m./n. gen. sg.
जनयति is not printed; the data only takes it as understood from unit 88.
questions.explain: Unit 89 is a short prose line; तस्य is genitive; no verb is printed.
questions.rule: Prose, no predicate; तस्य = of that.

questions.q: By the rule of तस्यावयवः, how is तस्य + अश्वः (his horse) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as in तस्य + अवयवः → तस्यावयवः.
The two short अ do not lose a vowel; they merge into आ.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
अ + अ does not give ऐ.
questions.explain: तस्य + अवयवः → तस्यावयवः; so तस्य + अश्वः → तस्याश्वः.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial अ merge into one long आ.

questions.q: By unit 90, what happens to each one born of her?
optionExplain: Deafness is not named in this line.
Right: जातं जातं म्रियते: each one born dies.
Barrenness is not named in this line.
The verb म्रियते says it dies.
questions.explain: Of her, each one born dies.

questions.q: Put the three parts of unit 90 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Of her … each one born … dies.

questions.q: Match each part of unit 90 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The three parts make the whole line: of her, each one born dies.
questions.rule: तस्याः = of her; जातं जातम् = each one born; म्रियते = dies.
questions.teaches: A word said twice (जातं जातम्) means each and every one: each one born.

questions.q: Why is तस्याः printed as तस्या before जातम्?
options: Visarga after आ drops before ज
A letter is lost in the print
optionExplain: र् comes only after vowels other than अ/आ.
Visarga becomes श् only before a palatal च, छ or श, never before voiced ज.
Right: ज is voiced, so तस्याः + जातम् → तस्या जातम्.
The note calls it regular sandhi, not a print loss.
questions.explain: आः before a voiced consonant loses its visarga: तस्या जातम्.

questions.q: Which English of तस्या जातं जातं म्रियते is right?
options: Of him, each one born dies
Of her, each one born lives
Of her, each one born dies
optionExplain: तस्याः is feminine: of her, not of him.
तस्याः is genitive; she is not the one who dies.
म्रियते means dies, not lives.
Right: तस्याः = of her; जातं जातम् = each one born; म्रियते = dies.
questions.explain: Feminine genitive, repeated participle, verb 'dies'.

questions.q: Built like जातं जातम्, what does an invented गृहे गृहे mean?
optionExplain: Right: A word said twice means each one: house after house.
Repetition means every one, not just two.
Repetition does not mean size here.
Nothing in it denies.
questions.explain: जातं जातम् = each one born; गृहे गृहे = in each house.
questions.teaches: A word repeated means each and every one: जातं जातम्, गृहे गृहे.

questions.q: By unit 91, that part (avayava) is one part of what?
options: Of the whole of the mother's blood
Of the uterus of the mother itself
Of the father's body as a whole
optionExplain: Blood is not named in this line.
Right: निर्वर्तका ये बीजांशाः, तेषाम् एकदेशः.
The uterus is not named in this line.
No father is named in this line.
questions.explain: The part is one part (एकदेश) of those seed-portions (बीजांश) that produce (निर्वर्तक).

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 91 in their printed order.
questions.explain: When again, that part, of the female-making and the body-dependent (ones), the producing seed-portions, one part of those.
questions.rule: यदा पुनः → सोऽवयवः → स्त्रीकरणां च → शरीरसंश्रयाणाम्… → निर्वर्तका ये बीजांशाः → तेषामेकदेशः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 91 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words carry the sure frame of the sentence.
questions.teaches: एकदेश = एक (one) + देश (part, place): one part of a whole.

questions.q: Which split of सोऽवयवः is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would join as सावयवः.
सो and वयवः are not the card's words.
Right: अः before अ gives ओ and the अ is shown by ऽ: सोऽवयवः.
सः before a consonant loses its visarga (स वयवः), with no ओ or ऽ; and वयवः is not a word.
questions.explain: सः (that) + अवयवः (part): अः + अ → ओऽ.

questions.q: Which two does unit 91 state plainly, by the card?
options: That part is one part (एकदेश) of those seed-portions
The full list after आदि (etc.) is given
optionExplain: Right: तेषाम् एकदेशः.
आदि (beginning with) gives no list here.
The line has no predicate; the result follows in unit 92.
Right: निर्वर्तका ये बीजांशाः.
questions.explain: The sure frame: that part is one part of the producing seed-portions.

questions.q: By the rule of बीजांशास्तेषाम्, how is देवाः + तत्र written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga drops only before a voiced sound; त is voiceless.
आः does not turn into ओ.
र् is not used after आ.
Right: Visarga before त becomes स्: देवास्तत्र.
questions.explain: बीजांशाः + तेषाम् → बीजांशास्तेषाम्; so देवाः + तत्र → देवास्तत्र.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त or थ becomes स्.

questions.q: By unit 92, what is the one produced named?
optionExplain: Right: वार्तां नाम जनयति: it produces (one) named vārtā.
The barren one is what is produced in unit 88.
That name belongs to the man's side, in unit 94.
No such name is printed here.
questions.explain: The one produced is named vārtā.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 92 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Then … mostly of form and shape … a non-woman … named vārtā … it produces.
questions.rule: तदा → रूपाकृतिप्रायाम् → अस्त्रियम् → वार्तां नाम → जनयति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 92 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words describe the one produced and what the unstated subject does.
questions.teaches: -प्राय at the end of a compound = mostly, chiefly: रूपाकृतिप्राया = mostly of form and shape.

questions.q: Which split of प्रायामस्त्रियम् is right?
optionExplain: Then no अ would follow म; the print has मस्त्रि, and the card reads non-woman.
Right: म् joins the next vowel अ: प्रायामस्त्रियम्.
That would join as प्रायमस्त्रियम्, with a short अ before म.
मस्त्रियम् is not a word.
questions.explain: प्रायाम् (f. acc. sg.) + अस्त्रियम् (non-woman).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joins the vowel.

questions.q: What does अस्त्रियम् tell about the one produced in unit 92?
options: She is a woman of great beauty
She is mostly of male shape
She is a woman who bears twins
optionExplain: अ- denies, it does not praise.
Male shape is said of the man's side, in unit 94.
Right: अ- negates स्त्री: a non-woman.
Nothing about twins is said.
questions.explain: अस्त्री = अ + स्त्री: not a woman.

questions.q: By the pattern of अस्त्री (अ + स्त्री), what does अदृष्ट (अ + दृष्ट, seen) mean?
optionExplain: अ- does not strengthen the word.
अ- does not mean before.
अ- does not mean all.
Right: अ- negates: अदृष्ट = not seen.
questions.explain: अ + स्त्री → अस्त्री (non-woman); अ + दृष्ट → अदृष्ट (not seen).
questions.teaches: The prefix अ- before a consonant negates the word: अस्त्री, अदृष्ट.

questions.q: By unit 93, what do they call her?
optionExplain: Right: तां स्त्रीव्यापदम् आचक्षते.
The barren one is named in unit 88.
Pregnancy is not named in this line.
The ṣaṇḍha kinds (impotent men) belong to earlier units.
questions.explain: They call her a strī-vyāpad.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 93 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Her … a strī-vyāpad … they call.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 93 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four words make the line: her, woman, defect, they call.
questions.teaches: व्यापद् means ruin, failure or defect; स्त्रीव्यापद् is kept as a term.

questions.q: Which split of स्त्रीव्यापदमाचक्षते is right?
optionExplain: That would join as …दमचक्षते, with a short अ.
Right: म् joins the vowel आ: …दमाचक्षते.
आ + आ would join as …दाचक्षते, with no म.
माचक्षते is not a word.
questions.explain: स्त्रीव्यापदम् (acc. sg.) + आचक्षते (they call).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joins the vowel.

questions.q: Who is the subject of आचक्षते in unit 93?
options: The woman herself, as the speaker
optionExplain: She is the object ताम्, and the verb is plural.
The verb is plural, not singular.
Right: आचक्षते is 3rd person plural; no subject is printed.
No father is named, and the verb is plural.
questions.explain: The verb is 3 pl.: they call; the speakers are not named.
questions.rule: आचक्षते = 3 pl. pres. ātm.: they call.

questions.q: Built like तां स्त्रीव्यापदम् आचक्षते, what does an invented तं वैद्यम् आचक्षते mean?
optionExplain: तम् is the singular object; the verb is plural.
वैद्यम् is accusative, not the subject.
आचक्षते is present, not past.
Right: तम् (him) + वैद्यम् (a physician) + आचक्षते (they call).
questions.explain: As तां … आचक्षते = they call her …, तं वैद्यम् आचक्षते = they call him a physician.
questions.rule: Object + name in the accusative + आचक्षते = they call X Y.
questions.teaches: आचक्षते takes two accusatives: the one named and the name (they call X Y).

questions.q: By unit 94, the deformity of which further parts is explained by this same account?
options: Parts born of sātmya, rasa and sattva
Parts born of Vāta, Pitta and Kapha
Parts born of the five great elements
Parts born of the six seasons of the year
optionExplain: Right: सात्म्यजानां रसजानां सत्त्वजानां च अवयवानां विकृतिः व्याख्याता.
The doṣas are not the three groups named here.
The elements are not named in this unit.
Seasons are not named in this unit.
questions.explain: By the account of mother-born and father-born parts, those born of sātmya, rasa and sattva are explained too.
questions.rule: सात्म्यज, रसज, सत्त्वज: explained by this.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 94 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The man's case, the rule applied, what is produced, then the two explained groups and the three further ones.
questions.rule: पुंसः → योजयेत् → वन्ध्यम् → अपुरुषम् → मातृज/पितृज → सात्म्यज/रसज/सत्त्वज.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 94 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The first two groups are explained; by them the last three are explained as well.
questions.rule: -ज = born of: मातृ, पितृ, सात्म्य, रस, सत्त्व.
questions.teaches: -ज at the end of a compound means born of: मातृज = born of the mother.

questions.q: What does एवमेव पुंसो … इत्यादि योजयेत् ask the reader to do?
options: Learn a new rule unlike the woman's
Apply the woman's pattern to the man
Leave out the man's case altogether
Treat the man with Vāta-pacifying remedies
optionExplain: एवमेव (in just the same way) says it is the same pattern.
Right: The quoted 'when … the seed is vitiated' repeats unit 88's pattern for the man.
योजयेत् says the pattern should be applied.
No remedy is named in this unit.
questions.explain: एवमेव = in just the same way; योजयेत् = one should apply (it).
questions.rule: एवम् एव … इत्यादि योजयेत् = apply the same pattern.

questions.q: Which two does unit 94 name among what is produced on the man's side?
options: One mostly of male shape, a non-male
One who is deaf and mute (बधिर, मूक)
optionExplain: Right: वन्ध्यम् is printed.
That is the woman's side, in unit 92.
Right: पुरुषाकृतिप्रायम् अपुरुषम्.
Deaf and mute are Vāta effects in the embryo, in unit 97.
questions.explain: On the man's side it produces a barren one and one mostly of male shape, a non-male.

questions.q: By the pattern of मातृज (born of the mother), what does an invented जलज mean?
optionExplain: -ज means born of, not giving.
-ज does not mean lord.
Right: जल (water) + -ज (born of).
-ज does not mean free of.
questions.explain: मातृ + ज = born of the mother; जल + ज = born of water.
questions.teaches: -ज (from √जन्, to be born) after a noun means born of it.

questions.q: By unit 95, where does the deformity arise?
options: In all the limbs at once
optionExplain: The line ties it to that one limb-part only.
The uterus is not named in this line.
No father is named in this line.
Right: तस्य तस्य अङ्गावयवस्य विकृतिः उपजायते.
questions.explain: The deformity arises in the very limb-part whose seed or seed-portion is concerned.
questions.rule: यस्य … तस्य तस्य = of whichever … of that very.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 95 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Of whichever limb-part … in seed or seed-portion … (printed) origin occurs … of that very limb-part … deformity arises.
questions.rule: यस्य … → बीजे बीजांशे वा → उत्पत्तिर्भवति → तस्य तस्य … → विकृतिरुपजायते.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 95 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five words carry the sure parts of the rule.
questions.teaches: विकृति = deformity, abnormality; उपजायते = arises, is produced.

questions.q: Which split of अंगावयवस्य is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: अङ्गावयवस्य.
म् + अ would give अङ्गमवयवस्य.
That would be अङ्गवयवस्य, with a short अ.
ई + अ would give अङ्ग्यवयवस्य.
questions.explain: अङ्ग (limb) + अवयवस्य (of the part).

questions.q: A translation reads: 'of whichever limb-part … an origin occurs, of all other limb-parts a deformity arises.' Which words are wrong?
optionExplain: यस्य = of whichever: this is right.
Right: तस्य तस्य = of that very (limb-part), not of all others.
विकृतिः = deformity: this is right.
उपजायते = arises: this is right.
questions.explain: The text says: of that very limb-part a deformity arises.
questions.rule: तस्य तस्य = of that very one.

questions.q: By the rule of विकृतिरुपजायते, how is an invented मतिः + अस्ति written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga and the अ cannot both vanish.
That would need मति without a visarga.
Right: Visarga after इ becomes र् before a vowel.
The short अ of अस्ति stays short.
questions.explain: विकृतिः + उपजायते → विकृतिरुपजायते; so मतिः + अस्ति → मतिरस्ति.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ (or any vowel but अ/आ) becomes र् before a vowel.

questions.q: By unit 96, why does (the deformity) not arise?
options: Because of the mother's daily diet
Because of the father's great age
Because of the season of the birth
optionExplain: Diet is not named in this line.
Age is not named in this line.
No season is named in this line.
Right: अनुपतापात्: from the absence of affliction.
questions.explain: It does not arise because of the absence of affliction.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 96 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words make the line: not, arises, because of no affliction.

questions.q: What does the ending -आत् of अनुपतापात् express here?
optionExplain: Right: The ablative here gives the reason: because of the absence of affliction.
Place would be a locative, ending -ए.
That would be a vocative.
उपजायते (arises) takes no object.
questions.explain: -आत् is the ablative singular of an अ-stem; here it gives the reason.
questions.teaches: The ablative ending -आत् can give the reason: X-आत् = because of X.

questions.q: Which split of नोपजायते is right?
optionExplain: That would give न उपजायते, with a gap.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: नोपजायते.
पजायते is not a word.
ओपजायते is not a word.
questions.explain: न (not) + उपजायते (arises).

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 96 by the card?
options: It names the limb that is affected
Its subject, the deformity, is understood, not printed
It is a metrical verse line
optionExplain: No limb is named in this line.
Right: the subject comes from unit 95.
The unit is prose.
Right: अ + उ → ओ.
questions.explain: A short prose line; its subject is understood from unit 95.

questions.q: By the rule of उपजायतेऽनुपतापात्, how is an invented वने + अस्मिन् written when joined?
optionExplain: ए does not turn into आ.
ए + अ does not give आय here.
Right: A final ए before अ stays ए; the अ is shown by ऽ.
ए does not turn into ओ.
questions.explain: उपजायते + अनुपतापात् → उपजायतेऽनुपतापात्; so वने + अस्मिन् → वनेऽस्मिन्.
questions.teaches: A final ए before अ stays ए and the अ is dropped, shown by ऽ (avagraha).

questions.q: By unit 97, what does the pregnant woman resort to that sets this off?
optionExplain: Pitta is not named in this unit.
Kapha is not named in this unit.
Nothing of the kind is named.
Right: वातलानि आसेवते: she resorts to Vāta-increasing (ones).
questions.explain: She resorts to Vāta-increasing (vātala; standard) things; her Vāyu is provoked.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 97 in their printed order.
questions.explain: She resorts to Vāta-increasing things → Vāyu is provoked → moves along the body → lodges in the uterus → produces Vāta disorders in the embryo.
questions.rule: सेवन → प्रकोप → अनुसर्पण → गर्भाशय में स्थिति → विकार.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Match each item of unit 97's list to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Six of the items that provoked Vāyu produces in the embryo.
questions.rule: जड, बधिर, मूक, खंज, कुब्ज, वामन.
questions.teaches: The list is one long compound; the ending -त्व (-ness) applies to every member.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which pair of opposites stands in unit 97's list?
options: Deafness and blindness of the eyes
optionExplain: Right: हीनाङ्ग and अधिकाङ्ग are both printed.
Blindness is not in this unit's list.
Only dwarfism (वामन) is named.
Only muteness (मूक) is named.
questions.explain: हीनाङ्ग (deficient in limbs) and अधिकाङ्ग (excessive in limbs) close the list.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which two are in unit 97's list of Vāta effects in the embryo?
optionExplain: Baldness is named under Pitta in unit 98.
Kuṣṭha is named under Kapha in unit 99.
Right: गद्गद is printed in the list.
Right: मिन्मिण is printed; its sense is probable.
questions.explain: गद्गद and मिन्मिण are in the list; baldness and kuṣṭha belong to the next units.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By the -त्व of unit 97's list, what does an invented बधिरत्वम् mean?
optionExplain: That would be बधिरः, without -त्व.
Right: -त्व makes an abstract noun: the state of being deaf.
-त्व does not mean causing.
-त्व is not a plural ending.
questions.explain: जड … अधिकाङ्ग-त्वानि = the states of being dull … ; बधिर + त्व = deafness.
questions.teaches: -त्व after an adjective makes the abstract noun: बधिर (deaf) → बधिरत्व (deafness).
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By unit 98, which doṣa is said to act like Vāyu?
optionExplain: Kapha follows in unit 99.
Blood is not named in this line.
Right: वायुवत् पित्तम् अपि: Pitta too, like Vāyu.
Rasa is not named in this line.
questions.explain: Likewise Pitta too, like Vāyu.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Match each firm word of unit 98 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These five firm words open the line.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: What does पैंगल्य mean on the card?
optionExplain: That is पलित.
That is खलति, baldness.
The nails are only in the damaged middle, not firm.
Right: पैंगल्य = tawny colour, as the data glosses it.
questions.explain: पैंगल्य आदि (tawniness and so on) closes the firm list.
questions.teaches: पैंगल्य = tawniness, a yellowish-brown colour; आदि = and so on.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which split of पित्तमपि is right?
optionExplain: Right: म् joins the vowel अ: पित्तमपि.
आ + अ would join as पित्तापि.
मपि is not a word.
पित्तम and पि are not the card's words.
questions.explain: पित्तम् (Pitta) + अपि (also).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joins the vowel.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Put the firm items of unit 98 in their printed order (the damaged middle is left out).
questions.explain: Baldness, grey hair, then (after the damaged part) tawniness and so on.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By the pattern of वायुवत् (like Vāyu), what does an invented सिंहवत् mean?
optionExplain: -वत् does not mean without.
Right: -वत् here = like: सिंहवत् = like a lion.
-वत् does not mean after.
-वत् does not mean against.
questions.explain: वायु + वत् = like Vāyu; सिंह + वत् = like a lion.
questions.teaches: The indeclinable -वत् after a noun means like it: वायुवत् = like Vāyu.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By unit 99, which doṣa is named with kuṣṭha and kilāsa?
optionExplain: Pitta is named in unit 98.
Vāyu is named in unit 97.
Right: श्लेष्मा तु कुष्ठकिलास…आदीनि.
Blood is not named in this line.
questions.explain: Kapha, however: kuṣṭha, kilāsa and so on.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Put the firm parts of unit 99 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Kapha, however: kuṣṭha, kilāsa, (an unclear item), and so on.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Match each word of unit 99 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Four firm words; the third member of the compound is unclear.
questions.teaches: Kuṣṭha (standard) and kilāsa (probable) are the two firm Kapha disorders named.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: What form is श्लेष्मा in unit 99?
options: A feminine आ-stem noun, nom. sg.
Nom. sg. of the n-stem श्लेष्मन्
optionExplain: It ends in आ only because the n-stem drops its न्.
That would be श्लेष्मणः.
It is a noun, Kapha.
Right: The card: śleṣmā is the nominative of śleṣman (m.).
questions.explain: श्लेष्मन् → nominative singular श्लेष्मा.
questions.rule: n-stem: nom. sg. drops the final न्.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: What does the ending -आदीनि tell about unit 99's list?
options: More disorders are meant than named
Only kuṣṭha is really meant here
The list closes the whole chapter here
optionExplain: Right: आदि = and so on: the list is open.
आदि leaves the list open.
Kilāsa is named as well.
आदि says nothing about the chapter's end.
questions.explain: आदीनि (and so on) marks the named items as examples.
questions.rule: आदि = beginning with, and so on.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By the pattern of श्लेष्मन् → श्लेष्मा, what is the nominative singular of राजन् (king)?
optionExplain: The bare stem is not the nom. sg.
Right: The n-stem drops its न् in the nom. sg. and lengthens अ: राजा.
The n-stem does not take -ः here.
No visarga is added in the nom. sg.
questions.explain: श्लेष्मन् → श्लेष्मा; राजन् → राजा.
questions.teaches: A masculine -अन् stem makes its nominative singular in -आ: श्लेष्मन् → श्लेष्मा, राजन् → राजा.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which word of unit 100 is sure, by the card?
optionExplain: त्रिवर्गौमिश्रान् is unclear in print.
मिश्र is part of a guess, not firm.
Right: Only विकारान् (m. acc. pl.) is a sure word.
No verb is printed in this line.
questions.explain: The line is unclear except for विकारान् (disorders).
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: What does विकार mean?
optionExplain: A remedy would be औषध or चिकित्सा.
A season is ऋतु.
Seed is बीज.
Right: विकार = disorder, change for the worse.
questions.explain: विकारान् = disorders.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Match each form of विकार to its case and number.
questions.explain: विकारान्, printed in unit 100, is the accusative plural of the अ-stem विकार.
questions.rule: -आन् = acc. pl. (m.); -आः = nom. pl.; -अम् = acc. sg.; -अः = nom. sg.
questions.teaches: A masculine अ-stem makes its accusative plural in -आन्: विकारान्.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which word of unit 100 is unclear in print?
optionExplain: Right: The data keeps it as printed; any reading of it is a guess.
विकारान् is the one sure word.
No verb is printed in this line.
That word is printed in unit 97, not here.
questions.explain: Only विकारान् is sure; त्रिवर्गौमिश्रान् is unclear.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 100 by the card?
options: No verb is printed in it
optionExplain: Right: the unit is prose.
Right: the line is elliptical.
It is unclear; any reading is a guess.
-आन् is accusative plural.
questions.explain: Unit 100: unclear prose, no verb; only विकारान् is sure.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By the pattern of विकारान्, what is the accusative plural of an invented रोगः (disease)?
optionExplain: That is the nominative plural.
Right: m. अ-stem acc. pl. -आन्, like विकारान्.
That is the accusative singular.
That is the locative plural.
questions.explain: विकार → विकारान्; रोग → रोगान्.
questions.teaches: A masculine अ-stem makes its accusative plural in -आन्: रोगान्, विकारान्.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: What does the formula अपिच of unit 101 mean?
optionExplain: Therefore is तस्मात्, as in unit 104.
Namely is तद्यथा, as in unit 107.
Right: अपि = also, च = and: together, moreover.
In brief is समासतः, as in unit 109.
questions.explain: अपि च = and also, moreover: a formula that opens a further point.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Put the steps of reading the printed अपिच in order.
questions.explain: The printed word is split into its two words, each word is glossed, and the two glosses give the sense.
questions.rule: अपिच → अपि + च → also + and → moreover.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: The printed अपिच splits into ____ + च. Type the first word in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अपि (also) + च (and) → अपिच, written together with no change.
questions.teaches: अपि means also, even; with च it makes 'and also, moreover'.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which split of the printed अपिच is right?
optionExplain: A visarga before च would give अपिश्च.
A long ई would show in print as अपीच.
इच is not a word; the card gives अपि and च.
Right: Both words keep their sounds; they are only written together.
questions.explain: अपि (also) + च (and), with no sandhi change.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 101, by the card?
options: No sound changes when अपि and च are joined
optionExplain: No: the unit is prose, one formula.
Right: अपि + च → अपिच, only written together.
No verb is printed; the unit is one formula.
Right: अपि (also) + च (and).
questions.explain: Unit 101 is the prose formula अपि च, moreover, written as one word without any change.
questions.rule: अपि च = moreover; no sandhi change.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: In an invented line अपि च बालो गच्छति, what do the opening words add?
optionExplain: Right: अपि च at the head adds a further point: moreover.
Therefore would need तस्मात्.
Namely would need तद्यथा.
No न is printed; nothing is denied.
questions.explain: अपि च opens a further point: moreover, the boy goes.
questions.teaches: अपि च at the head of a sentence adds a further point: moreover.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By unit 102, what is congenital blindness (jātyandhatva)?
options: Vāta that has dried up the share of sight
Tejas that has not reached the share of sight
Blood that has filled up the share of sight
Kapha that has covered the share of sight
optionExplain: Vāta only gives one kind of it; it is not the definition.
Right: दृष्टिभागमप्रतिपन्नं तेजो जात्यंधत्वं.
Blood (rakta) only gives one kind: red eyes.
Kapha only gives one kind: white eyes.
questions.explain: Tejas (light, fire) not reaching the share of sight is congenital blindness.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Match each companion of the blindness in unit 102 to the eyes it gives.
questions.explain: Vāta: विकृतरूक्षारुणाक्ष; Pitta: पिंगाक्ष; Kapha: शुक्लाक्ष; rakta: रक्ताक्ष.
questions.rule: Each companion gives its own eyes.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Put the four companions of the blindness in the order of unit 102.
questions.explain: The line runs वातानुगतं …, पित्तानुगतं …, श्लेष्माऽनुगतं …, रक्तानुगतं ….
questions.teaches: The unit runs Vāta, Pitta, Kapha, then rakta, each with its own eyes.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Why is तेजः printed as तेजो before जात्यंधत्वं?
options: तेजो is a separate dual form
Visarga becomes ओ before any sound
अः before a voiced sound becomes ओ
A letter is lost in the print
optionExplain: The card gives तेजः, n. nom. sg.; the ओ is sandhi.
Before a voiceless त it would become स्, not ओ.
Right: ज is voiced: तेजः + जात्य… → तेजो जात्य….
This is regular sandhi, not a loss in print.
questions.explain: तेजः (n. nom. sg.) + जात्यंधत्वं: अः before voiced ज → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: Someone is blind from birth and has tawny eyes. By unit 102, which companion is it?
optionExplain: Vāta gives deformed, dry, reddish eyes.
Kapha gives white eyes.
Rakta gives red eyes.
Right: पित्तानुगतं पिंगाक्षं: with Pitta, tawny eyes.
questions.explain: Tawny eyes (पिंगाक्ष) go with Pitta in this line.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By the pattern of पिंगाक्षं (पिङ्ग + अक्षम्), how is नील + अक्षम् joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as in पिङ्ग + अक्षम् → पिङ्गाक्षम्.
The two अ merge into one long आ; none is lost.
अ + अ does not give ए.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: पिङ्ग + अक्षम् → पिङ्गाक्षम्; so नील + अक्षम् → नीलाक्षम्, having dark-blue eyes.
questions.teaches: अ + अ → आ; X + अक्ष as a bahuvrīhi means 'having X eyes'.
questions.section: गर्भ में दोषज विकार और जात्यन्धता

questions.q: By unit 103, the pregnant woman has the same welfare as whom?
optionExplain: No husband is named in this line.
Right: गर्भसमानयोगक्षेमा: the same welfare as the embryo.
No mother of hers is named here.
No physician is named here.
questions.explain: Her welfare (योगक्षेम) is the same as the embryo's.

questions.q: Put the four words of unit 103 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Same-welfare-as-the-embryo, for, the pregnant woman, is.

questions.q: Match each part of unit 103 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The compound गर्भ-समान-योगक्षेमा and the words हि and भवति are matched here; the line's other word is गर्भिणी, the pregnant woman.
questions.rule: गर्भ = embryo; समान = same; योगक्षेम = welfare; हि = for; भवति = is.
questions.teaches: योगक्षेम = योग (attainment) + क्षेम (preservation), read here as welfare.

questions.q: Why does गर्भसमानयोगक्षेमा end in -आ?
options: It is a plural ending of the compound
It is an ablative ending meaning from
It is a bahuvrīhi agreeing with गर्भिणी
It names the embryo as a feminine word
optionExplain: The card gives f. nom. sg., not a plural.
The card gives nom. sg.; nothing means from here.
Right: As a bahuvrīhi it takes the gender of गर्भिणी: f. nom. sg.
गर्भ is masculine; the -आ form describes the woman.
questions.explain: A bahuvrīhi describes another word and takes its gender: here feminine, for गर्भिणी.
questions.rule: Bahuvrīhi agrees with the word it qualifies.

questions.q: Which English of unit 103 is right?
options: For the embryo has more welfare than the pregnant woman
So the pregnant woman has the same welfare as the embryo
For the pregnant woman has a welfare unlike the embryo's
For the pregnant woman has the same welfare as the embryo
optionExplain: समान means same, not more.
हि means for, giving a reason, not so.
समान means same, not unlike.
Right: हि = for; समान = same; योगक्षेम = welfare.
questions.explain: हि (for) + समान (same) + योगक्षेम (welfare): she shares the embryo's welfare.
questions.rule: गर्भसमानयोगक्षेमा हि = for (she) has the same welfare as the embryo.

questions.q: Built like गर्भसमानयोगक्षेमा गर्भिणी, what does an invented पितृसमानबला कन्या mean?
options: A girl whose strength equals a father's
A girl who equals a father in age
A father who is as strong as a girl
A girl who gives strength to a father
optionExplain: Right: A bahuvrīhi: पितृ + समान + बल, made feminine to agree with कन्या.
बल is strength, not age.
The compound qualifies कन्या; the girl is the one described.
समान means same, equal; nothing means giving.
questions.explain: X-समान-Y-आ + a feminine noun = (she) whose Y is the same as X's.
questions.rule: Bahuvrīhi X-समान-Y = having Y the same as X.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi such as X-समान-Y describes a noun whose Y equals X's, and takes that noun's gender.

questions.q: By unit 104, from what should she be protected?
options: From her own family and friends
From things that injure the embryo
From the cold and the strong wind
From all kinds of food and drink
optionExplain: No family or friends are named in this line.
Right: गर्भोपघातकरेभ्यः: from those causing injury to the embryo.
Cold and wind are not named in this line.
No food or drink is named in this line.
questions.explain: She is guarded from what injures the embryo, by what is pleasant and beneficial.

questions.q: Put the printed parts of unit 104 in their order.
questions.explain: Therefore especially her, by the pleasant and beneficial, from the embryo-injuring (things), should protect.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 104 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: These words carry the conclusion: therefore, especially, her, by the pleasant and beneficial, should protect.
questions.teaches: One act, रक्षेत्, has both a means (प्रियहित) and a danger to guard against (गर्भोपघातकर).

questions.q: Which split of तस्माद्विशेषतस्तां is right?
optionExplain: तस्मा and द्विशेषतः are not the card's words.
ताः is plural and would not give तां; the card gives ताम्, her.
Right: त् → द् before voiced व; ः → स् before त; म् → ं before प.
तस्ताम् is not a word.
questions.explain: तस्मात् (therefore) + विशेषतः (especially) + ताम् (her).
questions.rule: त् + voiced → द्; ः + त → स्त; final म् → ं before a consonant.

questions.q: What does the verb रक्षेत् of unit 104 express?
optionExplain: The present would be रक्षति.
No past form is printed.
The future would be रक्षिष्यति.
Right: The card gives 3 sg. optative: should protect.
questions.explain: रक्षेत् is an optative: an instruction, should protect.

questions.q: By the rule of तस्माद्विशेषतः, how is तस्मात् + भवति written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: त् before the voiced भ becomes द्.
Before a voiced sound the त् cannot stay.
भ is not a nasal, so त् does not become न्.
त् becomes च् before a palatal such as च, not before भ.
questions.explain: तस्मात् + विशेषतः → तस्माद्विशेषतः; so तस्मात् + भवति → तस्माद्भवति.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced sound: तस्माद्विशेषतः, तस्माद्भवति.

questions.q: By unit 105, what happens to the woman as the embryo grows?
optionExplain: क्षय is loss, not growth.
Right: स्त्रियाः बलक्षयः: loss of the woman's strength.
Appetite is not named in this line.
Sleep is not named in this line.
questions.explain: As the embryo grows, the woman's strength wanes.
questions.rule: वृद्धि (of the embryo) ↔ बलक्षय (of the woman).

questions.q: Put the sure parts of unit 105 in their printed order.
questions.explain: As … the embryo grows … so … the woman's loss of strength (the unclear token stands before the last part).
questions.rule: यथा यथा च → गर्भो वृद्धिमाप्नोति → तथा तथा → स्त्रियाबलक्षयः.

questions.q: Match each part of unit 105 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The frame pairs two changes: the embryo's growth and the woman's loss of strength.
questions.rule: यथा यथा … तथा तथा = as … so.
questions.teaches: यथा यथा … तथा तथा ties two changes that go together: as one grows, so the other.

questions.q: Why is स्त्रियाः printed as स्त्रिया before बलक्षयः?
options: आः becomes ओ before a voiced sound
The visarga becomes स् before the ब
आः drops its visarga before a voiced sound
A letter has been lost from the print here
optionExplain: ओ comes from अः, not from आः.
स् comes before त or थ, not before ब.
Right: ब is voiced: स्त्रियाः + बल… → स्त्रिया बल….
The note calls it regular sandhi.
questions.explain: स्त्रियाः (of the woman) before voiced ब loses its visarga.

questions.q: Which two does unit 105 state plainly, by the card?
options: As the embryo grows, the woman's strength wanes
The causes in भाराहारसापचारात् are a firm reading
यथा यथा … तथा तथा means as … so
A remedy for the loss is given
optionExplain: Right: गर्भो वृद्धिमाप्नोति … स्त्रिया बलक्षयः.
No: that token is unclear; the causes are a conjecture.
Right: the frame of the line.
No remedy is named in this line.
questions.explain: The sure content: as the embryo grows, so the woman's strength wanes.

questions.q: Built like unit 105, what does an invented यथा यथा वृक्षो वर्धते तथा तथा छाया वर्धते mean?
options: The tree grows because the shade grows
As the tree grows, so the shade wanes
Neither the tree nor the shade grows
As the tree grows, so the shade grows
optionExplain: The frame pairs two changes; it does not say because.
वर्धते (grows) stands in both halves.
No न is printed; nothing is denied.
Right: यथा यथा … तथा तथा pairs two changes: as … so.
questions.explain: यथा यथा X … तथा तथा Y = as X, so Y.
questions.rule: यथा यथा … तथा तथा = as … so.
questions.teaches: यथा यथा … तथा तथा pairs two changes that go together: as one, so the other.

questions.q: By unit 106, what are इमे (these)?
options: Things causing injury to the embryo
Things helping the embryo to grow
Signs that the embryo is a male
optionExplain: Right: गर्भोपघातकराः: causers of injury to the embryo.
उपघात is injury, not help.
No such signs are named here.
No months are named here.
questions.explain: These are the causes of injury to the embryo.
questions.rule: गर्भ + उपघात + कर = causing injury to the embryo.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 106 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: In this matter, these are the embryo-injury-causing (things).

questions.q: Put the members of गर्भोपघातकराः in their order.
questions.explain: गर्भ (embryo) + उपघात (injury) + कराः (causing).
questions.teaches: Such a compound is read from its last member back: causers (कर) of injury (उपघात) to the embryo (गर्भ).

questions.q: Which split of तत्रेमे is right?
optionExplain: तत्रे is not a word; मे would mean to me.
Right: अ + इ → ए.
एमे is not a word; the card gives इमे.
A visarga before इ would drop and leave तत्र इमे, with no ए.
questions.explain: तत्र (in this matter) + इमे (these): अ + इ → ए.

questions.q: Which English of तत्रेमे गर्भोपघातकराः is right?
options: In this matter, these guard the embryo from injury
In this matter, these cause injury to the mother
In this matter, these cause injury to the embryo
Then these were the causes of the embryo's growth
optionExplain: कर means causing, not guarding.
गर्भ is the embryo, not the mother.
Right: तत्र = in this matter; इमे = these; गर्भोपघातकराः = causing injury to the embryo.
No past is printed, and उपघात is injury.
questions.explain: In this matter (तत्र), these (इमे) are the causes of injury to the embryo.
questions.rule: तत्र इमे … = in this matter, these are ….

questions.q: By the rule of गर्भोपघात (अ + उ → ओ), how is सूर्य + उदयः joined?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or औ, not from अ + उ.
The अ is not simply lost before उ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in गर्भ + उपघात → गर्भोपघात.
questions.explain: गर्भ + उपघात → गर्भोपघात; so सूर्य + उदयः → सूर्योदयः.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial उ merge into ओ.

questions.q: What does तद्यथा of unit 107 mean?
optionExplain: Right: तत् + यथा: that, as, i.e. namely.
Likewise is तथा, as in unit 110.
Moreover is अपि च, as in unit 101.
Therefore is तस्मात्, as in unit 104.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = namely: it opens a list.

questions.q: Match each piece to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as) make the formula तद्यथा, namely.

questions.q: Put the steps that make तद्यथा in order.
questions.explain: The two words meet; य is voiced; the त् turns into द्; the joined form results.
questions.rule: तत् + यथा → voiced य → द् → तद्यथा.
questions.teaches: A final त् turns into द् before a voiced sound such as य.

questions.q: Which split of तद्यथा is right?
optionExplain: तदा + यथा would stay तदा यथा.
Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्.
That would join as तदयथा.
तः and द्यथा are not words.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as).

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 107, by the card?
options: It names the first item of a list
It is a stock formula meaning namely
Its द् comes from त् before य
It is a metrical verse line
optionExplain: No: it names no item; it only opens the list.
Right: तत् + यथा, namely.
Right: त् + voiced य → द्.
No: the unit is prose.
questions.explain: तद्यथा is a prose formula, namely, joined as तत् + यथा.

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is तत् + गृहम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Before a voiced sound the त् cannot stay.
त् becomes च् before a palatal such as च, not before ग.
Right: त् before the voiced ग becomes द्.
ग is not a nasal, so त् does not become न्.
questions.explain: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा; so तत् + गृहम् → तद्गृहम्.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced sound: तद्यथा, तद्गृहम्.

questions.q: Which of these does unit 108 name in its list?
optionExplain: Milk is not named in this line.
Red garments come in unit 111, not in this line.
Bathing is not named in this line.
Right: दिवास्वप्न is in the printed list.
questions.explain: Day sleep stands in the list, after night waking and before holding back urges.

questions.q: Match each item of unit 108 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five sure items of the list with their meanings.

questions.q: Put these first four items of unit 108 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The print opens व्यवायव्यायामकर्शनाभिघात…: intercourse, exertion, emaciating, blows.
questions.teaches: The list opens with intercourse and exertion, then emaciating (things) and blows.

questions.q: Which split of भयोत्रास in unit 108 is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ: fear and fright.
A visarga before उ would leave भय उत्रास, with no ओ.
ए before उ does not give ओ.
भयो is not a stem; the card gives भय and उत्रास.
questions.explain: भय (fear) + उत्रास (fright): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: A pregnant woman does these things. Which two are named in unit 108's list?
options: She holds back her natural urges
optionExplain: That is in unit 111, not in this line.
Water is not named in this line.
Right: दिवास्वप्न.
Right: वेगविधारण.
questions.explain: Day sleep and holding back urges both stand in the list.

questions.q: By the rule of कठिनासन (कठिन + आसन), how is देव + आलयः joined?
optionExplain: The long आ cannot be lost.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as in कठिन + आसन → कठिनासन.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + आ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + आ.
questions.explain: अ + आ → आ: कठिनासन, देवालयः.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial अ or आ merge into one long आ.

questions.q: By unit 109, which food and drink is meant, in brief?
options: Excessively light, cool, mild and oily
Any food or drink taken at night
Excessively heavy, hot, sharp and dry
Food and drink that are sweet or sour
optionExplain: Those are not the qualities named.
Night is not named in this line.
Right: अतिगुरूष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षम् अन्नपानम्.
Tastes are not named in this line.
questions.explain: All food and drink that is excessively heavy, hot, sharp and dry.

questions.q: Put the four qualities of unit 109 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The print reads अतिगुरूष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षम्: heavy, hot, sharp, dry.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 109 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: In brief: excessive food and drink, and harsh activities.
questions.teaches: समासतः sums up: food and drink of four qualities under अति, and harsh activities.

questions.q: Which split of गुरूष्ण is right?
optionExplain: अ + उ would give गुरोष्ण.
A visarga after उ before a vowel would give गुरुरुष्ण.
ष्ण is not a word, and no ऊ would arise.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ.
questions.explain: गुरु (heavy) + उष्ण (hot): उ + उ → ऊ.

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 109, by the card?
options: It names light and cool food (लघुशीत)
It prints a verb: should avoid (वर्जयेत्)
optionExplain: Right: समासतः, in brief.
No: it names heavy, hot, sharp and dry.
No verb is printed; nothing is supplied.
Right: harsh activities.
questions.explain: In brief: excessive food and drink of four qualities, and harsh activities; no verb.

questions.q: Built like अतिगुरु (excessively heavy), what does an invented अतिशीतं जलम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: अति- before a quality means excessively.
अति means excess, not a little.
अति does not deny; there is no न.
No food is named; जलम् is water alone.
questions.explain: अति + गुरु = excessively heavy; अति + शीत = excessively cold.
questions.teaches: अति- before a quality means excessively: अतिगुरु, अतिशीत.

questions.q: What does तथा, standing alone in unit 110, mean?
optionExplain: Namely is तद्यथा, as in unit 107.
Right: तथा alone adds a further point: likewise.
In brief is समासतः, as in unit 109.
Therefore is तस्मात्, as in unit 104.
questions.explain: तथा alone = likewise, also.

questions.q: Match each formula on the card to its meaning.
questions.explain: Alone, तथा adds a point; with यथा it answers 'as'; तद्यथा opens a list.
questions.rule: तथा = likewise; यथा … तथा = as … so; तद्यथा = namely.

questions.q: The one word of unit 110, meaning likewise, is ____. Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तथा = likewise, also.
questions.teaches: तथा means in that way: likewise, also.

questions.q: Which word does तथा answer when the two stand as a pair, as in unit 105?
optionExplain: यदा is answered by तदा (then).
यत्र is answered by तत्र (there).
Right: यथा … तथा = as … so.
यतः is answered by ततः (thence).
questions.explain: The pair is यथा … तथा: as … so.

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 110, by the card?
options: It means namely and opens a list
It is a metrical verse line
It stands alone here, not paired with यथा
optionExplain: Right: one word of prose.
No: that is तद्यथा.
No: the unit is prose.
Right: so it means likewise, also.
questions.explain: A lone prose तथा: likewise, also.

questions.q: In an invented line रामो गच्छति तथा सीता, what does तथा mean?
optionExplain: Therefore would need तस्मात्.
Namely would need तद्यथा.
No न is printed; nothing is denied.
Right: तथा alone adds: likewise, Sītā (goes too).
questions.explain: A lone तथा adds a further item: likewise.
questions.teaches: A lone तथा adds a further item in the same way: likewise, also.

questions.q: By unit 111, which garments should she not wear?
optionExplain: Right: न रक्त्तानि (रक्तानि) वासांसि धारयेत्.
White garments are not named here.
Wet garments are not named here.
Old garments are not named here.
questions.explain: She should not wear red garments.

questions.q: Put the three forbidden things of unit 111 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Not to wear red garments, not to mount a vehicle, not (to consume) madya and meat.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 111 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Garments are worn (धारयेत्), a vehicle is mounted (अधिरोहेत्); मद्य is an intoxicating drink.
questions.teaches: Each prohibition is न with an optative verb: न धारयेत्, न अधिरोहेत्.

questions.q: Which split of रक्षोऽनुपचय is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would give रक्षानुपचय, with no ओ.
Right: अः before अ gives ओ, and the lost अ is marked by ऽ.
नुपचय is not a word; the card gives अनुपचय.
Before न the visarga would give रक्षो नुपचय, without ऽ.
questions.explain: रक्षः (rakṣas) + अनुपचय (non-increase): अः + अ → ओऽ.

questions.q: What does न … धारयेत् express in unit 111?
options: A past fact: she did not wear
A future: she will not wear
A prohibition: she should not wear
A question: does she not wear?
optionExplain: No past form is printed.
धारयेत् is an optative, not a future.
Right: न + optative: should not.
Nothing marks a question.
questions.explain: न with the optative forbids: she should not wear.

questions.q: Built like न यानमधिरोहेत्, what does an invented न दिवा स्वपेत् mean?
options: One did not sleep by day
One should not sleep by day
optionExplain: स्वपेत् is not a past.
न denies; nothing says only.
स्वपेत् is an optative, not a future.
Right: न + optative स्वपेत्: should not sleep.
questions.explain: न + optative = should not: न अधिरोहेत्, न स्वपेत्.
questions.teaches: न with an optative (-एत्) states a prohibition: should not.

questions.q: By unit 112, who may say whatever else?
optionExplain: Right: वृद्धस्त्रियो ब्रूयुः: old women may say.
Physicians are not named here.
No husband is named here.
Teachers are not named here.
questions.explain: Whatever else old women may say.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 112 in their order.
questions.explain: Whatever, and, else, also, old women, may say.
questions.rule: यत् → च → अन्यत् → अपि → वृद्धस्त्रियः → ब्रूयुः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 112 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Whatever else old women may also say.
questions.teaches: यत् … अन्यत् अपि = whatever else, also.

questions.q: Why is स्त्रियः printed as स्त्रियो before ब्रूयुः?
options: अः before any consonant becomes ओ
अः before a voiced sound becomes ओ
A letter is lost in the print
optionExplain: Before a voiceless sound such as त it becomes स्, not ओ.
Right: ब is voiced: स्त्रियः + ब्रूयुः → स्त्रियो ब्रूयुः.
The card gives f. nom. pl.; the ओ is sandhi.
This is regular sandhi, not a loss in print.
questions.explain: स्त्रियः (nom. pl.) + voiced ब → स्त्रियो.

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 112, by the card?
options: ब्रूयुः is a past tense: they said
The unit lists what they say
यत् … अन्यत् अपि means whatever else, also
optionExplain: No: it is an optative, may say.
Right: वृद्धस्त्रियः.
No: nothing they say is listed.
Right: यच्चान्यदपि.
questions.explain: Old women are the speakers; यत् … अन्यत् अपि = whatever else; ब्रूयुः = may say.

questions.q: By the rule of यच्च (यत् + च), how is तत् + च written when joined?
optionExplain: Before च the त् becomes च्, not द्.
त् cannot stay unchanged before च.
Right: त् before च becomes च्.
च is not a nasal, so त् does not become न्.
questions.explain: यत् + च → यच्च; so तत् + च → तच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes च् before च: यच्च, तच्च.

questions.q: By unit 113, how does the woman lie in this case?
optionExplain: No side is named in this line.
Sitting is not named in this line.
उत्तान is face up, the opposite.
Right: उत्तानशायिनी: she sleeps face up.
questions.explain: She sleeps face up (and stretched out, a less sure word).
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the printed parts of unit 113 in their order.
questions.explain: Of her who sleeps stretched out and face up, of the fetus, the nāḍī on the navel, winding round the neck, causes a mishap.
questions.rule: शायिन्याः → गर्भस्य → नाडी → कण्ठम् अनुवेष्ट्य → व्यापत्तिं करोति.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 113 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Face up; on the navel; around the neck; having wound; a mishap.
questions.teaches: The chain runs: resting on the navel, wound around the neck, a mishap.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Why does अनुवेष्ट्य end in -य and not in -त्वा?
options: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य
-य marks an optative verb of wishing
-य marks a verb in the future tense
optionExplain: Right: अनु- is a prefix, so the ending is -य: having wound around.
The optative ends in -एत्, as in रक्षेत्.
The card gives an absolutive, not a noun.
The card gives an absolutive: having wound.
questions.explain: A verb with a prefix makes its absolutive in -य, not -त्वा.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which two does unit 113 state plainly, by the card?
options: The unit names the nāḍī as the umbilical cord
The mishap is tied to how the woman sleeps
नाभ्याश्रया means resting on the navel
The unit says it is the mother's neck
optionExplain: No: the cord is a probable reading, not stated.
Right: प्रतानोत्तानशायिन्याः.
Right: नाभि + आश्रया.
No: whose neck is not stated.
questions.explain: Sure: the posture of sleep and the word नाभ्याश्रया; probable: the cord; unstated: whose neck.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the rule of अनुवेष्ट्य, what is the absolutive of प्र + √विश् (to enter)?
optionExplain: With a prefix the ending is -य, not -त्वा.
Right: With the prefix प्र the absolutive takes -य: having entered.
That is a past participle: entered.
That is an optative: should enter.
questions.explain: अनु + √वेष्ट् → अनुवेष्ट्य; प्र + √विश् → प्रविश्य.
questions.teaches: A verb with a prefix makes its absolutive (having done) in -य, not -त्वा.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 114, what is produced by she who sleeps uncovered and she who roams at night?
optionExplain: Apasmāra (epilepsy) is the result in unit 115.
Blindness is not named in this line.
Right: चोन्मत्तं जनयति: she produces a mad one.
Short life is a result in unit 116.
questions.explain: The two habits lead to a mad (उन्मत्त) child.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the words of unit 114 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Sleeping uncovered … roaming at night … and a mad one … produces.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 114 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The two compounds name the habits; उन्मत्त names the result.
questions.teaches: नक्त + चारिणी: -चारिणी at the end of a compound = she who roams in X, here at night.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of चोन्मत्तं is right?
optionExplain: अः before उ loses the visarga and leaves a gap: च उन्मत्तम्.
न्मत्तम् is not a word; the card has उन्मत्त.
ओन्मत्त is not a word; the card has उन्मत्त.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: च + उन्मत्तम् → चोन्मत्तम्.
questions.explain: च (and) + उन्मत्तम् (a mad one, acc.): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 114 by the card?
options: जनयति (produces) is printed in this unit
It says she must have both habits
It is a prose line, not a verse
A word for pregnant is printed in it
optionExplain: Right: the verb is printed here and carried on to unit 125.
The wording leaves open whether both or either one is meant.
Right: the unit is prose.
Pregnancy is understood from the context; no such word is printed.
questions.explain: A prose line whose verb जनयति serves the following units too.
questions.rule: जनयति is printed here; the rest of the series borrows it.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the join of चोन्मत्तम्, how is च + उदकम् (water) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in च + उन्मत्तम् → चोन्मत्तम्.
औ comes from अ + ओ or औ, not from अ + उ.
The अ does not vanish; it merges with उ into ओ.
व् replaces उ, not अ; here अ comes first.
questions.explain: च + उन्मत्तम् → चोन्मत्तम्; so च + उदकम् → चोदकम्.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial उ merge into ओ: च + उन्मत्तम् → चोन्मत्तम्.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 115, what does a woman quarrelsome by nature produce?
optionExplain: The mad one is the result of unit 114.
Right: कलहशीला अपस्मारिणम्: one with apasmāra.
Stoutness is a result in unit 122.
Jealousy is a result in unit 117.
questions.explain: Quarrelsome nature → a child with apasmāra.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each part of unit 115 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The habit, the disease, and the verb borrowed from unit 114.
questions.rule: कलह = quarrel; शील = habit; अपस्मार = epilepsy.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: The woman of unit 115 is ____-शीला, quarrelsome by nature. Type the first part in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: कलहशीला = कलह (quarrel) + शीला (having as habit).
questions.teaches: -शील at the end of a compound = having X as habit or nature: कलहशीला = quarrelsome by nature.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of कलहशीलाऽपस्मारिणं is right?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give कलहशीलोऽपस्मारिणम्, with ओ.
ए + अ would give कलहशीलेऽपस्मारिणम्, with ए.
Right: आ + अ → आ; the print marks the lost अ with ऽ.
पस्मारिन् is not a word; ऽ marks a lost अ.
questions.explain: कलहशीला (f. nom. sg.) + अपस्मारिणम् (acc. sg.).
questions.rule: आ + अ → आ, shown by ऽ.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By its case, who is कलहशीला in unit 115?
options: A nurse who looks after the child
The father of the child to come
The woman, the subject (f. nom. sg.)
optionExplain: The child is अपस्मारिणम्, in the accusative.
No nurse is named in this line.
No father is named; the form is feminine.
Right: Nominative: she is the one who produces.
questions.explain: Nominative = the mother (subject); accusative = the child (object).
questions.rule: f. nom. = she who produces; acc. = the one produced.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the pattern of कलहशीला, what does an invented क्रोधशीला mean (क्रोध = anger)?
options: She who is angry by nature
She who is free of anger
She who fears anger in others
She who is born out of anger
optionExplain: Right: -शीला = having X as habit: anger as her nature.
-शील means having the habit, not being free of it.
-शील names her own habit, not a fear.
-शील does not mean born of.
questions.explain: कलहशीला = quarrelsome by nature; क्रोधशीला = angry by nature.
questions.rule: X-शीला = she who has X as habit.
questions.teaches: -शील at the end of a compound = having X as one's habit or nature.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 116, which result may a woman given to intercourse (vyavāya) produce?
optionExplain: The mad one is the result of unit 114.
Right: व्यवायशीला दुर्वपुषम्: an ill-shaped one.
Apasmāra is the result of unit 115.
Red eyes are a result in unit 121.
questions.explain: Vyavāya as habit → an ill-shaped, (conjecturally) shameless or womanish one.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 116 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: One habit word and four result words of the two lines.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put these words of unit 116 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Line 1: the habit, then its results closed by वा; line 2 (after शॉकनित्या): timid, wasted, short-lived, वा.
questions.rule: व्यवायशीला → दुर्वपुषम् → स्त्रैणं वा → भीरुम् → अपचितम् → अल्पायुषं वा.
questions.teaches: Each line gives the habit first (nominative), then its results (accusative), and वा (or) closes the list.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of अल्पायुषं is right?
optionExplain: म् before आ would give अल्पमायुषम्.
अः before आ would leave a gap: अल्प आयुषम्.
Right: अ + आ → आ: अल्प + आयुषम् → अल्पायुषम्.
युषम् is not a word; the card has आयुस्.
questions.explain: अल्प (short) + आयुषम् (life): a short-lived one.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which English of भीरुमपचितमल्पायुषं वा is right?
optionExplain: अल्प means little, short: short-lived.
भीरु means timid, not brave.
अपचित is wasted here, not well-fed.
Right: भीरु = timid; अपचित = wasted; अल्पायुस् = short-lived.
questions.explain: Three results, joined by वा: timid, wasted, short-lived.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the pattern of दुर्वपुस् (दुः + वपुस्, body), what does दुर्बुद्धि mean (बुद्धि = mind)?
optionExplain: Right: दुः- = bad, ill: a bad mind.
दुः- means bad, not great.
दुः- is not द्वि (two).
दुः- does not mean quick.
questions.explain: दुः + वपुस् → दुर्वपुस् (ill-shaped); दुः + बुद्धि → दुर्बुद्धि (of bad mind).
questions.teaches: दुः- before a word means bad or ill; before a voiced sound its visarga becomes र्: दुर्वपुस्.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 117, which result may a covetous (abhidhyāyinī) woman produce?
optionExplain: Baldness is a result in unit 123.
Right: अभिध्यायिनी … ईर्ष्यालुम्: a jealous one.
The timid one is a result in unit 116.
Drowsiness is a result in unit 119.
questions.explain: Covetous → one who torments others, a jealous or a womanish one.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the words of line 1 of unit 117 in their printed order.
questions.explain: The covetous one … tormenting others … jealous … or womanish.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 117 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The habit word of line 1 and four result words of both lines.
questions.teaches: पर (others) + उपतापन (tormenting) = परोपतापन, one who torments others.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which English of परोपतापनमीर्ष्यालुं स्त्रैणं वा is right?
options: One who comforts others, a jealous or womanish (one)
