One who torments others, a jealous or womanish (one)
One who torments others, a generous or womanish (one)
optionExplain: उपतापन is tormenting, not comforting.
पर means others, not oneself.
Right: पर = others; उपतापन = tormenting; ईर्ष्यालु = jealous.
ईर्ष्यालु means jealous, not generous.
questions.explain: Three results, closed by वा: tormenting others, jealous, womanish.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 117 by the card?
options: The split स्तेना तु … of line 2 is certain
अभिध्यायिनी is the woman, the subject (f. nom. sg.)
The verb जनयति is printed in this unit
ईर्ष्यालुम् is accusative: it describes the one produced
optionExplain: The card calls the split probable, not certain.
Right: the habit word is nominative.
It is carried from unit 114, not printed here.
Right: results stand in the accusative.
questions.explain: Habit in the nominative, results in the accusative; the line-2 split is only probable.
questions.rule: f. nom. = the woman; acc. = the one produced.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the join of परोपतापन, how is पर + उपकार (help) written as one word?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or औ, not from अ + उ.
The अ does not vanish; it merges with उ into ओ.
अ + उ gives ओ, not a long ऊ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as in पर + उपतापन → परोपतापन.
questions.explain: पर + उपतापन → परोपतापन; so पर + उपकार → परोपकार (helping others).
questions.teaches: अ + उ merge into ओ inside a compound: पर + उपतापन → परोपतापन.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 118, which sure result may an intolerant (amarṣaṇā) woman produce?
optionExplain: Right: अमर्षणा चण्डम्: a fierce one.
The mute one is a result in unit 122.
Short life is a result in unit 116.
Aśmarī is a result in unit 120.
questions.explain: Intolerant → a fierce or a probably deceitful one.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 118 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Habit, sure result, the closing particle, and the borrowed verb.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 118 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Intolerant … fierce … (probably) deceitful … or.
questions.teaches: As in the whole series, the habit (nominative) comes first, then the results (accusative), then वा.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of चंडमौपधिकंवा is right?
optionExplain: अ + औ would give चण्डौपधिकम्, with no म.
Right: म् joins the next vowel औ; वा is printed joined by a spacing slip.
पधिक is not a word of the card.
वा (or) is a separate word; the print only runs it on.
questions.explain: चण्डम् (fierce, acc.) + औपधिकम् (acc.) + वा (or).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel: म joins the vowel.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: In unit 118, which word describes the one produced?
optionExplain: The nominative names the woman, not the child.
वा only means or.
Right: The results stand in the accusative: a fierce one.
The verb is not printed here; it is carried from unit 114.
questions.explain: Nominative = the woman; accusative = the one produced.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the print habit of चंडम् (read चण्डम्), how is a printed दंड read?
optionExplain: न् is the nasal of त-class, not of ड.
म् is the nasal of प-class, not of ड.
ङ् is the nasal of क-class, not of ड.
Right: Anusvāra before ड stands for ण्, the nasal of its class.
questions.explain: चंड = चण्ड; so दंड = दण्ड.
questions.teaches: Before a stop, the printed anusvāra stands for that stop's own nasal: ं before ड = ण्.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 119, which result may a woman given to sleep (svapnaśīlā) produce?
optionExplain: Right: स्वप्नशीला निद्रालुम्: a drowsy one.
The hostile one is a result in unit 117.
The fierce one is the result of unit 118.
Baldness is a result in unit 123.
questions.explain: Given to sleep → drowsy, foolish, or weak in digestion.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 119 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three results of line 1 and two of line 2.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the words of line 2 of unit 119 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Given to madya … prone to thirst … of poor memory … or unsteady.
questions.teaches: -नित्या at the end of a compound = constant in, given to: मद्यनित्या = constantly given to madya.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of अल्पाग्निं is right?
optionExplain: म् before अ would give अल्पमग्निम्.
Right: अ + अ → आ: अल्प + अग्निम् → अल्पाग्निम्.
अः before अ would give अल्पोऽग्निम्.
ग्निम् is not a word; the card has अग्नि.
questions.explain: अल्प (small) + अग्निम् (fire): one with weak digestive fire.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: In unit 119, which result belongs to the woman given to madya, not to the one given to sleep?
optionExplain: निद्रालुम् is in line 1, after स्वप्नशीला.
अबुधम् is in line 1, after स्वप्नशीला.
Right: अल्पस्मृतिम् stands in line 2, after मद्यनित्या.
अल्पाग्निम् is in line 1, after स्वप्नशीला.
questions.explain: Each result belongs to the habit printed just before it.
questions.rule: Results follow their own habit word.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the pattern of अनवस्थित (अन् + अवस्थित), how is the negative of आदि (beginning) formed?
optionExplain: Before a vowel अ- takes the form अन्-.
The negative prefix keeps its अ.
अन् + आ gives ना, not ने.
Right: Before a vowel the negative is अन्-: अन् + आदि → अनादि.
questions.explain: अन् + अवस्थित → अनवस्थित (unsteady); अन् + आदि → अनादि (without beginning).
questions.rule: Negative prefix before a vowel = अन्-.
questions.teaches: Before a vowel the negative prefix is अन्-: अन् + अवस्थित → अनवस्थित, not steady.
questions.section: माता के शयन-स्वभाव से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 120, which result may a woman constantly given to godhā-flesh produce?
optionExplain: Right: गोधामांसनित्याऽश्मरिणम्: one with aśmarī.
Prameha is a result in unit 122.
Red eyes are a result in unit 121.
Baldness is a result in unit 123.
questions.explain: Godhā-flesh → one with urinary stone, or one who (probably) passes urine slowly.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 120 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The long first token: what she takes, how often, and the result.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 120 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Godhā … flesh … given to … one with aśmarī … or one who passes urine slowly.
questions.rule: गोधा → मांस → नित्या → अश्मरिणम् → शनैर्मेहिनं वा.
questions.teaches: In an X-नित्या compound the thing she takes comes first: गोधामांस-नित्या = given to godhā-flesh.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Why is शनैः printed as शनैर् before मेहिनम्?
options: Visarga becomes स् before every म
Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a voiced sound
The र् belongs to the stem शनैर्
optionExplain: स् comes before त or थ, not before म.
Right: म is voiced, so शनैः + मेहिनम् → शनैर्मेहिनम्.
Before a voiced consonant such as म the visarga drops only after आ (after अ it gives ओ); here ऐ comes before it.
The word is शनैः; र् comes only from the join.
questions.explain: After a vowel other than अ or आ, a visarga before a voiced sound becomes र्.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 120 by the card?
options: The exact species of godhā is stated as certain
optionExplain: The species is only probable.
Right: the card labels it standard (godhā = monitor lizard, standard).
Right: the card labels it standard (aśmarī = urinary stone, standard).
Its sense is not firm: it may also mean one with meha.
questions.explain: Standard: godhā = monitor lizard, aśmarī = urinary stone; not firm: species, शनैर्मेहिन्.
questions.rule: Keep the data's labels: standard, probable, not firm.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the join of शनैर्मेहिनम्, how is शनैः + याति (goes) written when joined?
optionExplain: स् comes before त or थ, not before य.
After ऐ the visarga does not simply drop before य.
Right: ऐः before a voiced sound: visarga → र्.
श् comes before च or छ, not before य.
questions.explain: शनैः + मेहिनम् → शनैर्मेहिनम्; so शनैः + याति → शनैर्याति.
questions.teaches: After a vowel other than अ/आ, a visarga before a voiced sound becomes र्.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 121, which result may a woman constantly given to varāha-flesh produce?
optionExplain: Slow blinking is a result in unit 122.
Apasmāra is the result of unit 115.
The dusky one is a result in unit 125.
Right: वराहमांसनित्या रक्ताक्षम्: a red-eyed one.
questions.explain: Varāha-flesh → red-eyed, krathana (uncertain), or very rough-haired.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Put the words of unit 121 in their printed order.
questions.explain: Given to varāha-flesh … red-eyed … krathana … or very rough-haired.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 121 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The words of the habit and of the two clear results.
questions.teaches: अति- before an adjective = very: अतिपरुष = very rough.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which English of अतिपरुषरोमाणम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अति = very; परुष = rough; रोमन् = hair.
परुष means rough, not soft.
रोमन् means hair, not skin.
परुष means rough, not little.
questions.explain: A bahuvrīhi: one whose hair is very rough.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Which split of रक्ताक्षं is right?
optionExplain: अः before अ would give रक्तोऽक्षम्.
Right: अ + अ → आ: रक्त + अक्षम् → रक्ताक्षम्.
म् before अ would give रक्तमक्षम्.

questions.explain: रक्त (red) + अक्षम् (eye): one whose eyes are red.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Built like रक्ताक्ष (one whose eyes are red), what does दीर्घबाहु mean (दीर्घ long, बाहु arm)?
options: A long arm, the limb itself
The arm of a tall man
optionExplain: A bahuvrīhi names the owner, not the limb.
The two words are one compound, not a list.
Right: A bahuvrīhi names the one who has long arms.
दीर्घ describes बाहु; no man is named.

questions.q: Put the words of line 2 of unit 122 in their printed order.

questions.q: Which result in unit 122 belongs to fish-flesh, not to the sweet?

questions.q: By the join of स्तब्धाक्षम् (स्तब्ध + अक्षम्), how is मृग + अक्षी (doe-eyed) written?
optionExplain: The second अ cannot simply vanish; अ + अ gives आ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as in स्तब्ध + अक्षम् → स्तब्धाक्षम्.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
अ + अ does not give ऐ.
questions.explain: स्तब्ध + अक्षम् → स्तब्धाक्षम्; so मृग + अक्षी → मृगाक्षी.
questions.teaches: Two short अ across a join merge into one long आ: स्तब्ध + अक्ष → स्तब्धाक्ष.

questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 123 to its meaning on the card.

questions.q: Which split of त्वगक्षिरोगिणं is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give त्वगाक्षि, with a long आ.
अः + अ would give त्वगोऽक्षि, with ओ.

questions.explain: त्वक् (skin) + अक्षि (eye) + रोगिणम् (one with disease).

questions.q: Which English of शीघ्रबलीपलितं खलतिकं वा is right?
options: One with early wrinkles and greying, or a bald (one)
One with late wrinkles and greying, or a bald (one)
One with early strength and greying, or a bald (one)
One with early wrinkles and greying, and long hair
optionExplain: Right: शीघ्र = early; बली = वली, wrinkle; पलित = greying.
शीघ्र means early, quick, not late.
बली here is वली, wrinkle, not बल, strength.
खलतिक means bald, not long-haired.
questions.explain: The salty taste: early wrinkles and greying, or baldness.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the join of त्वगक्षि (त्वक् + अक्षि), how is वाक् + ईश (lord) written as one word?
optionExplain: Before a vowel क् becomes ग्; it does not stay क्.
Right: क् becomes ग् before a vowel: वाक् + ईश → वागीश.
No nasal is added in this join.
ग् + ई stays गी; ई does not turn into ए.
questions.explain: त्वक् + अक्षि → त्वगक्षि; so वाक् + ईश → वागीश.
questions.teaches: A final क् before a vowel becomes ग्: त्वक् + अक्षि → त्वगक्षि.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By unit 124, which result may a woman constantly given to the pungent (kaṭuka) produce?

Baldness belongs to the salty, in unit 123.

questions.explain: Bitter → śoṣa, weak, wasted; pungent → weak, little śukra, no offspring.

questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Both tastes of unit 124 lead to a weak one. Which two words say weak?

questions.q: By the pattern of अबल (अ + बल, strength), what does अभय mean (भय = fear)?
optionExplain: Right: अ- before a consonant = without: अभय = fearless.

questions.rule: अ- before a consonant = without, not.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 125 in their printed order.

questions.q: Which split of श्याममानाहिनम् is right?

questions.q: By the pattern of आनाहिन् (one with ānāha), what does ज्वरिन् mean (ज्वर = fever)?

questions.q: By unit 126, what offspring does a pregnant woman bear who indulges in the cause of a disease?

questions.q: Which split of व्याधेर्निदानम् is right?

questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the rule of यत् + च → यच्च, how is तत् + च written when joined?

questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Match each word of unit 127 to its meaning on the card.

questions.q: Why is पितृजाः printed as पितृजा before अपि?
options: Visarga becomes र् before a vowel
Visarga with आ turns into ओ
Visarga after आ drops before a vowel
A letter is lost in the print

ओ comes from अः, not from आः.
Right: पितृजाः + अपि → पितृजा अपि: regular sandhi.

questions.explain: आः before a vowel or a voiced consonant loses its visarga.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: By the card, who should look after themselves in line 2 of unit 127?

questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Built like इच्छन्तौ (two wishing), which invented form means two going?
optionExplain: Right: Present participle stem गच्छत् + -औ: two going.
That is one going (singular).
That is many going (plural).

questions.explain: इच्छन्तौ = two wishing; गच्छन्तौ = two going.
questions.rule: -न्तौ = nom. dual of a masculine present participle.
questions.teaches: A masculine present participle of the अ-class (इच्छति, गच्छति) ends in -न्तौ in the nominative dual: इच्छन्तौ, गच्छन्तौ.
questions.section: माता के आहार-रस से संतान के दोष

questions.q: Whom does unit 128 single out?

questions.q: Which two are right about unit 128 by the card?
options: It names the father as the one meant
नारी is the object, in the accusative

optionExplain: नारी is the woman; no father is named.
Right: the unit is prose.

questions.q: Built like विशेषेण, which invented form is the instrumental singular of सुख (ease)?

These are recommended in unit 129, not forbidden here.
These are recommended in unit 129, not forbidden here.
questions.explain: Emesis and the rest are not to be applied to her.

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 130 in their order.
questions.explain: Not, and for her, emesis and the rest, one should apply.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 130 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Five words make the whole prohibition.
questions.teaches: वमन is therapeutic emesis; -आदि adds the rest of the group without naming them.

questions.q: What does आदि in वमनादीनि tell, by the card?
options: Only emesis is meant, nothing else
Other procedures follow, not named here
Emesis is to be given first of all
The full list is printed in this line
optionExplain: आदि adds others to emesis.
Right: आदि = and the rest: the other cleansing procedures.
आदि means and the rest, not first.
The others are not listed here.
questions.explain: वमन-आदि = emesis and the rest; the rest are not listed in this line.

questions.q: Which English of न चास्या वमनादीनि प्रयोजयेत् is right?
options: And one should apply emesis and the rest to her
And one should not apply emesis and the rest to him
And one should not apply emesis and the rest to her
And one should not apply emesis alone to her
optionExplain: This drops न, the not.
अस्याः is feminine: her.
Right: न = not; अस्याः = for her (f.); वमनादीनि = emesis and the rest.
आदि means and the rest, not alone.
questions.explain: Each wrong English changes one word: न, the gender of अस्याः, or आदि.

questions.q: Built like वमनादीनि, what does an invented स्नानादीनि mean?
optionExplain: आदि adds others; it is not only.
आदि does not mean first here.
आदि does not mean after.
Right: स्नान + आदि: bathing and the others of its group.
questions.explain: वमन + आदि → वमनादीनि; स्नान + आदि → स्नानादीनि.
questions.teaches: -आदि at the end of a compound means X and the rest: वमनादीनि, स्नानादीनि.

questions.q: By unit 131, from which month are āsthāpana and anuvāsana spoken of?
optionExplain: Right: अष्टमं मासमुपादाय: beginning from the eighth month.
The word printed is अष्टमम्, eighth.
The word printed is अष्टमम्, eighth.
The word printed is अष्टमम्, eighth.
questions.explain: The line names the eighth month (अष्टम मास).

questions.q: Put these words of unit 131 in their order.
questions.explain: Only, but the eighth, month beginning from, āsthāpana, or anuvāsana.
questions.rule: केवलं → त्वष्टमं → मासमुपादाय → आस्थापनम् → अनुवासनं वा.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 131 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two enemas, the month, and the words that frame them.
questions.teaches: आस्थापन is a decoction enema and अनुवासन an oil enema (standard identifications).

questions.q: Which split of त्वष्टमम् is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would join as त्वाष्टमम्, with आ.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तु + अष्टमम् → त्वष्टमम्.
ए + अ would join as तेऽष्टमम्.
That would join as त्वमष्टमम्.
questions.explain: तु (but) + अष्टमम् (eighth).
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + that vowel.

questions.q: Which two does unit 131 state plainly, by the card?
options: Both enemas are given together daily
The two enemas are joined by वा, or
Emesis is named again in this line
optionExplain: वा means or; no frequency is given.
Right: अष्टमं मासम्.
Right: आस्थापनम् अनुवासनं वा.
Emesis is in unit 130, not in this line.
questions.explain: Sure in the line: the eighth month, and two enemas with or between them.

questions.q: By the rule of तु + अष्टमम्, how is मधु + अस्ति written when joined?
optionExplain: उ + अ does not give ओ.
उ + अ does not give a long ऊ.
Right: उ + अ → व: मधु + अस्ति → मध्वस्ति.
The first vowel does not change.
questions.explain: तु + अष्टमम् → त्वष्टमम्; so मधु + अस्ति → मध्वस्ति.
questions.teaches: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व् and the vowel follows: त्वष्टमम्, मध्वस्ति.

questions.q: Which disorders does unit 132 speak of?
options: Those of the newborn after birth
Those that arise only at delivery
Those emesis and the rest would cure
optionExplain: The newborn is not named in this line.
That is unit 127, not this line.
Delivery is not named in this line.
Right: वमनादिसाध्येषु विकारेषु.
questions.explain: The line speaks of disorders that emesis and the rest would cure.
questions.rule: वमनादिसाध्य = curable by emesis and the rest.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 132 in their order.
questions.explain: In curable-by-emesis-etc., disorders, with mild (ones), with those doing that purpose, one should proceed.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 132 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Where (disorders curable by emesis), with what (mild or same-purpose means), and the verb.
questions.teaches: तद्-अर्थ-कारिन् = that-purpose-doing: a means that does the same work.

questions.q: Which split of वोपक्रमेत् is right?
optionExplain: Right: आ + उ → ओ: वा + उपक्रमेत् → वोपक्रमेत्.
आ + अ would join as वापक्रमेत्.
आः before a vowel loses its visarga and stays apart (वा उपक्रमेत्): no ओ. And वा here is the indeclinable, or.
पक्रमेत् is not a word.
questions.explain: वा (or) + उपक्रमेत् (one should proceed).

questions.q: A pregnant woman has a disorder that emesis would usually cure. By unit 132, what is done?
options: Give emesis at full strength anyway
Treat with mild or same-purpose means
optionExplain: The line turns to mild or same-purpose means instead.
Right: मृदुभिस्तदर्थकारिभिर्वा उपक्रमेत्.
The line says one should proceed to treat.
No bloodletting is named in this line.
questions.explain: Mild means, or means that do the same work, are used.

questions.q: Built like विकारेषु (in disorders), which is the locative plural of व्याधि (disease)?
optionExplain: That is the accusative plural.
That is the instrumental plural.
Right: इ-stem + -षु: in diseases.
That is the genitive or ablative singular.
questions.explain: विकार → विकारेषु; व्याधि → व्याधिषु.
questions.teaches: The locative plural ends in -सु, which becomes -षु after इ, उ, ए and similar sounds: विकारेषु, व्याधिषु.

questions.q: To what does unit 133 compare the pregnant woman?
optionExplain: The vessel is full (पूर्ण), and of oil.
No lamp is named.
The vessel is of oil (तैल), not water.
Right: पूर्णम् इव तैलपात्रम्.
questions.explain: Like a full vessel of oil, she is attended without shaking.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 133 in their order.
questions.explain: Full, like, oil-vessel, not shaking, the pregnant woman, one should attend to.
questions.rule: पूर्णम् → इव → तैलपात्रम् → असंक्षोभयन् → गर्भिणीम् → उपाचरेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 133 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words make the simile; two name the manner and the one cared for.
questions.teaches: इव after a word makes a simile: पूर्णम् इव तैलपात्रम् = like a full vessel of oil.

questions.q: Which split of उपाचरेदिति is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्: उपाचरेदिति.
A visarga here would give उपाचरेरिति.
ईति would show a long ई: उपाचरेदीति.
दिति is not the card's word.
questions.explain: उपाचरेत् (one should attend to) + इति (thus, closing).

questions.q: A carer follows unit 133. Which manner of care fits it?
options: Steady care that does not shake her
Care that leaves her alone entirely
optionExplain: That is the shaking the line forbids.
Right: असंक्षोभयन्: without shaking, like a full oil-vessel.
The line is about the pregnant woman (गर्भिणी).
उपाचरेत् says one should attend to her.
questions.explain: Attend to her, but without agitating, as one carries a full vessel of oil.

questions.q: Built like पूर्णम् इव तैलपात्रम्, which invented phrase means like a lamp?
optionExplain: विना means without.
प्रति means towards.
Right: इव after a noun: like that thing.
ऋते means except.
questions.explain: इव follows the thing compared: तैलपात्रम् इव, दीपम् इव.
questions.teaches: इव placed after a word means like: the thing compared comes before इव.

questions.q: What does unit 134 do?
options: It gives a remedy for her
It leads in to what follows
optionExplain: The colophon comes in unit 138.
No disease is named here.
No remedy is named here.
Right: भवन्ति चात्र: and on this there are (these).
questions.explain: A standard lead-in formula: and on this matter there are these.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 134 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Three words: there are, and, in this matter.

questions.q: In unit 134 the word for here, in this matter is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: चात्र = च + अत्र; अत्र = here, in this matter.
questions.teaches: अत्र means here; in a text it means in this matter.

questions.q: Which split of चात्र is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: च + अत्र → चात्र.
That would be written चत्र, with no आ.
Neither चा nor त्र is the card's word.
ए + अ would give चेऽत्र.
questions.explain: च (and) + अत्र (here).

questions.q: What is भवन्ति, by the card's grammar?
optionExplain: That would be भवति.
Right: 3 pl. pres. √भू.
That would be भविष्यन्ति.
That would be भवेयुः.
questions.explain: भवन्ति is the present third plural of √भू.

questions.q: By the rule of च + अत्र → चात्र, how is न + अस्ति written when joined?
optionExplain: The two अ do not lose a vowel; they merge into आ.
अ + अ does not give ए.
Right: अ + अ → आ: न + अस्ति → नास्ति.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: च + अत्र → चात्र; so न + अस्ति → नास्ति.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial अ merge into one long आ: चात्र, नास्ति.

questions.q: By verse 135, what may be used in a very severe (अत्यधिक) disease?
options: Nothing; the disease is left alone
Only fasting for some days at home
optionExplain: For a very severe disease the verse names even sharp means.
The verse says to protect her even with sharp means.
Fasting is not named in this verse.
Right: तीक्ष्णैरपि क्रियायोगैः.
questions.explain: In a very severe disease even sharp treatments are used, protecting the woman with care.

questions.q: Put the four printed quarters of verse 135 in their order.
questions.explain: Thus in a non-critical disease, the rule; in a very severe one again, even with sharp treatments, protect the woman with care.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 135 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Two words name the two kinds of disease; the rest give the treatment and the care.
questions.rule: अनात्ययिक, अत्यधिक, तीक्ष्ण, क्रियायोग, यत्नेन, पालयेत्.
questions.teaches: अनात्ययिक (non-critical) and अत्यधिक (very severe) are the two cases the verse sets apart.

questions.q: Which split of विधिरत्यधिके is right?
optionExplain: Right: इः before a vowel becomes इर्: विधिरत्यधिके.
ई + अ would join as विध्यत्यधिके.
That would join as विधिमत्यधिके.
रत्यधिके is not a word.
questions.explain: विधिः (rule, nom. sg.) + अत्यधिके (in a very severe one).
questions.rule: Visarga after इ becomes र् before a vowel.

questions.q: Which pairing is right by verse 135?
options: Non-critical: even sharp means; very severe: the rule given
Non-critical: the rule given; very severe: even sharp means
Both cases: only sharp means at once
Both cases: no treatment, only waiting
optionExplain: This swaps the two cases.
Right: इति अनात्ययिके विधिः; अत्यधिके पुनः तीक्ष्णैरपि.
The non-critical case keeps the rule given.
Treatment is named for both cases.
questions.explain: The verse sets the non-critical case (the rule already given) against the very severe case (even sharp means).

questions.q: Built like अनात्ययिक (अन् + आत्ययिक), which invented word means without end?
optionExplain: Before a vowel the negative is अन्-, not अ-.
The negative prefix keeps its अ.
Right: अन् + अन्त: before a vowel the negative is अन्-.
That is end itself, with no negation.
questions.explain: अन् + आत्ययिक → अनात्ययिक; अन् + अन्त → अनन्त.
questions.rule: Negative अ- before a consonant, अन्- before a vowel.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अ- before a consonant and अन्- before a vowel: अनात्ययिक, अनन्त.

questions.q: By verse 136, of what is woman the root (मूल)?
optionExplain: The verse says offspring, not disease.
Wealth is not named.
The doṣas are not named.
Right: मूलम् अपत्यानाम्: root of offspring.
questions.explain: Woman is the root of offspring.

questions.q: Put the four printed quarters of verse 136 in their order.
questions.explain: Root of offspring; protected, she protects; of all āśramas, first; the householder's state, blameless.
questions.rule: मूलमपत्यानां → रक्षति रक्षिता → सर्वाश्रमाणां प्रथमं → गृहस्थत्वमनिंदितं.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 136 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Line 1 is about woman; line 2 about the āśramas and the householder.
questions.rule: मूल, अपत्य, रक्षिता, आश्रम, गृहस्थत्व, अनिन्दित.
questions.teaches: अनिन्दित = अ (not) + निन्दित (blamed): blameless.

questions.q: Which split of गृहस्थत्वमनिंदितम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: म् joins the next vowel अ: blameless.
Before न the म् would be an anusvara, गृहस्थत्वं निन्दितम्: no मनि.
आ + अ would join as गृहस्थत्वानिन्दितम्.
मनिन्दितम् is not a word.
questions.explain: गृहस्थत्वम् (householder's state) + अनिन्दितम् (blameless).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joins the vowel.

questions.q: Which three does verse 136 state?
options: Woman is the root of disease
Woman is the root of offspring
The householder's state is first and blameless
optionExplain: The verse says root of offspring.
Right: स्त्री हि मूलमपत्यानाम्.
Right: स्त्री हि रक्षति रक्षिता.
Right: प्रथमं गृहस्थत्वमनिन्दितम्.
questions.explain: Root of offspring; protected, she protects; the householder's state first and blameless.
questions.rule: मूलम् अपत्यानाम्; रक्षति रक्षिता; गृहस्थत्वम् अनिन्दितम्.

questions.q: Built like अपत्यानाम् (of offspring), which is the genitive plural of फल (fruit)?
optionExplain: That is the nominative or accusative plural.
Right: अ-stem + -आनाम्: of the fruits.
That is the instrumental plural.
That is the locative plural.
questions.explain: अपत्य → अपत्यानाम्; फल → फलानाम्.
questions.teaches: The genitive plural of an अ-stem ends in -आनाम् (-आणाम् after र or ष): अपत्यानाम्, आश्रमाणाम्.

questions.q: By verse 137, what does the one in the womb not do?
optionExplain: Movement is not spoken of here.
Growth is not spoken of here.
Right: न गर्भस्थः प्ररोदिति.
Food is not spoken of here.
questions.explain: The one in the womb does not cry out.

questions.q: Put the four printed quarters of verse 137 in their order.
questions.explain: Mouth covered by the jarāyu; throat wrapped in Kapha; path of vāyu blocked; so it does not cry.
questions.rule: मुख → कण्ठ → वायु का मार्ग → न प्ररोदिति.

questions.q: Match each word of verse 137 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: Each of the three causes has a word for what is done: covered, wrapped, obstructed.
questions.teaches: Three causes: mouth covered (छन्न), throat wrapped (वेष्टित), path obstructed (निरोध).

questions.q: By verse 137, what covers the mouth?
optionExplain: Kapha wraps the throat, not the mouth.
It is the path of vāyu that is blocked.
No such covering is named.
Right: जरायुणा मुखे छन्ने.
questions.explain: The jarāyu covers the mouth; Kapha wraps the throat; the path of vāyu is blocked.

questions.q: Which English of कंठे चकफवेष्टिते is right?
options: And the throat being wrapped in Kapha
And the mouth being wrapped in Kapha
And the throat being free of Kapha
And the throat being wrapped in jarāyu
optionExplain: Right: कण्ठे (throat, loc.) च कफवेष्टिते.
कण्ठ is the throat, not the mouth.
वेष्टित means wrapped, not free.
The throat is wrapped in Kapha, not the jarāyu.
questions.explain: Each wrong English changes one word: the organ, the state, or what wraps it.

questions.q: By the rule of वायोः + मार्ग → वायोर्मार्ग, how is गुरोः + वचनम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Only अः and आः drop the visarga like this; after ओ it becomes र्.
Right: ओः before the voiced व becomes ओर्.
स् comes before त, not before व.
The visarga does not simply vanish here.
questions.explain: वायोः + मार्ग → वायोर्मार्ग; so गुरोः + वचनम् → गुरोर्वचनम्.
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound.
questions.teaches: A visarga after ओ (or any vowel but अ, आ) becomes र् before a voiced sound: वायोर्मार्ग, गुरोर्वचनम्.

questions.q: By unit 138, what is chapter two named?
optionExplain: That name is not printed here.
That name is not printed here.
Right: इति गर्भावक्रान्तिर्नाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः.
That name is not printed here.
questions.explain: The colophon names the chapter गर्भावक्रान्ति, the descent of the embryo.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 138 in their order.
questions.explain: Thus, Garbhāvakrānti, named, second, chapter.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 138 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: A colophon: thus, the chapter named X, second.
questions.teaches: A colophon opens with इति and gives the chapter's name (X नाम) and number.

questions.q: Which split of द्वितीयोऽध्यायः is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would join as द्वितीयाध्यायः.
ए + अ would give द्वितीयेऽध्यायः, with ए.
ध्यायः is not the card's word.
Right: अः before अ gives ओ and the अ is shown by ऽ.
questions.explain: द्वितीयः (second) + अध्यायः (chapter): अः + अ → ओऽ.

questions.q: In unit 138 the word for chapter is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अध्यायः = chapter; with द्वितीयः it is printed द्वितीयोऽध्यायः.
questions.teaches: अध्याय means chapter; ऽ shows its lost अ after द्वितीयो.

questions.q: By the rule of द्वितीयोऽध्यायः, how is रामः + अपि written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अः + अ → ओऽ: रामोऽपि.
अः + अ does not give आ.
र् does not come after अ here.
अः + अ does not give ए.
questions.explain: द्वितीयः + अध्यायः → द्वितीयोऽध्यायः; so रामः + अपि → रामोऽपि.
questions.teaches: अः before अ becomes ओ and the following अ is shown by ऽ: द्वितीयोऽध्यायः, रामोऽपि.

questions.q: By unit 1, what will the speakers expound in this chapter?
options: The Garbhāvakrānti Śārīra, the embryo's descent
The Garbhopacaraṇīya, care of the embryo
The six tastes and the actions of each one
The signs that foretell the death of a patient
optionExplain: That title opened chapter 2; this line names Garbhopacaraṇīya.
Right: गर्भोपचरणीयं शारीरं व्याख्यास्यामः.
The line names no such subject.
The line names no such subject.
questions.explain: The line announces the Garbhopacaraṇīya Śārīra: what is to be attended to regarding the embryo.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the words of unit 1 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Now, therefore, the Garbhopacaraṇīya, the Śārīra, we shall expound.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words make the whole opening formula.
questions.rule: अथ, अतः, गर्भ, उपचरणीय, शारीरम्, व्याख्यास्यामः.
questions.teaches: गर्भोपचरणीय = गर्भ (embryo) + उपचरणीय (to be attended to): the chapter is on care regarding the embryo.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of गर्भोपचरणीयम् is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga; अः before उ would lose the visarga and leave गर्भ उपचरणीयम्.
पचरणीयम् is not the word of the card; the word is उपचरणीयम्.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: गर्भ + उपचरणीयम् = गर्भोपचरणीयम्.
अ + ओ would give औ, and ओपचरणीयम् is not a word.
questions.explain: गर्भ (embryo) + उपचरणीयम् (to be attended to): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the card, what form is व्याख्यास्यामः?
options: Present, first person plural: we now expound
Future, third person plural: they will expound
Optative, third singular: one should expound
Future, first person plural: we shall expound
optionExplain: The -स्य- marks the future, not the present.
Third person plural would end in -स्यन्ति.
The optative of this chapter looks like पिबेत्; -स्यामः is future.
Right: Labelled 1 pl. fut. of वि-आ-√ख्या.
questions.explain: व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall expound: future, first person plural.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the ending of व्याख्यास्यामः, which form says we shall do, from √कृ?
optionExplain: Right: -ष्यामः is future, first person plural, like -स्यामः in व्याख्यास्यामः.
-ष्यन्ति is future third plural: they will do.
कुर्मः is present: we do.
अकुर्म is past (imperfect): we did.
questions.explain: करिष्यामः = we shall do, like व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall expound.
questions.teaches: The future first person plural ends in -स्यामः / -ष्यामः: व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall expound, करिष्यामः = we shall do.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 2, what should the pregnant woman drink in the first month?
optionExplain: Ghee and honey join the milk in unit 8, the third (month).
Right: गर्भिणी क्षीरमुपसंस्कृतं … शीतं … पिबेत्.
No honey is named in unit 2.
Fresh butter is named in unit 9, the fourth (month).
questions.explain: In the first month she drinks milk, prepared, in measure, cool, at the time.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 2 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the first month, the pregnant woman, milk prepared, in measure cool, at the time, should drink.
questions.rule: प्रथमेमासि → गर्भिणी → क्षीरमुपसंस्कृतं → मात्रावच्छीतं → काले → पिबेत्.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words say what she drinks and how.
questions.teaches: मात्रावत् = in measure: the milk is taken in a measured amount, which the line does not fix.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of मात्रावच्छीतं is right?
optionExplain: छीतम् is not a word; the word is शीतम्, cool.
वच्छीतम् is not a word; -वत् belongs to मात्रा.
Right: त् before श becomes च्, and the श may become छ before a vowel (च्श also correct); the print has च्छ.
वच् is not the ending; the ending is -वत्.
questions.explain: मात्रावत् (in measure) + शीतम् (cool): here त् + श is written च्छ (च्श also correct).
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which points does unit 2 leave unstated?
options: That the milk should be cool
How the milk is to be prepared
Who is to drink the milk
optionExplain: Stated: शीतम्.
Right: the note says the preparation is not stated.
Stated: गर्भिणी, the pregnant woman.
Right: the note says the text does not say which time.
questions.explain: Cool and the drinker are stated; the preparation and the time are not.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By पिबेत् of unit 2, which invented sentence says the child should drink water?
optionExplain: पिबति is present: drinks, a statement, not should.
अपिबत् is past: drank.
पास्यति is future: will drink.
Right: पिबेत् is optative: should drink.
questions.explain: बालो जलं पिबेत् = the child should drink water, like गर्भिणी क्षीरं पिबेत्.
questions.teaches: पिबेत् is the optative (3 sg.) of √पा: should drink, the form the text uses for what is to be done.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 3, what does she drink for the first twelve nights?
options: Ghee arising from milk, boiled with herbs
Milk cooked with sweet medicines alone
Milk joined with fresh butter in a measure
Cool water by itself, with no ghee at all
optionExplain: Right: क्षीरोद्भवं सर्पिः … शृतं … पिबेत्.
That is unit 7, the second (month).
That is unit 9, the fourth (month).
Cool water is the after-drink; the drink itself is ghee.
questions.explain: For the first twelve nights: ghee from milk, boiled with śāliparṇī and palāśa.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put these printed words of unit 3 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Twelve nights, arising from milk, ghee, with śāliparṇī and palāśa, boiled, should drink.
questions.rule: द्वादशरात्रं → क्षीरोद्भवं → सर्पिः → शालिपर्णीपलाशाभ्यां → शृतं → पिबेत्.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 3 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words say for how long, what, how prepared, and what follows.
questions.teaches: अनुपान = after-drink: what is drunk after the main preparation; here cool water.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which statement keeps the card's identification and label right?
optionExplain: Palāśa = Butea monosperma is labelled probable, not standard.
Right: The data: śāliparṇī = Desmodium gangeticum, standard.
Butea monosperma is given for palāśa, not śāliparṇī.
Desmodium gangeticum is given for śāliparṇī, not palāśa.
questions.explain: Śāliparṇī = Desmodium gangeticum (standard); palāśa = Butea monosperma (probable).
questions.rule: Keep each plant with its own name and label.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of तस्मिन्नपि is right?
optionExplain: There is no word तस्मिन्न; the word is तस्मिन्, in that.
Neither piece is a word.
Right: After a short vowel a final न् is doubled before a vowel: न्न.
नपि is not a word; the word is अपि, also.
questions.explain: तस्मिन् (in that) + अपि (also): न् after short इ doubles before a vowel.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of तस्मिन्नपि, how is कस्मिन् + अपि (in any) written when joined?
optionExplain: After a short vowel the न् is doubled, not kept single.
अ does not change to ए here.
The न् does not become anusvara before a vowel.
Right: न् after the short इ doubles before अ, as in तस्मिन्नपि.
questions.explain: कस्मिन् + अपि = कस्मिन्नपि, like तस्मिन् + अपि = तस्मिन्नपि.
questions.teaches: A final न् after a short vowel is doubled before a vowel: तस्मिन् + अपि → तस्मिन्नपि.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 4, at what times is the food to be given?
options: Only once a day, at noon
optionExplain: Right: सायं प्रातराहारयेत्: evening and morning.
The line names सायं and प्रातः, not midday or midnight.
Two times are named, evening and morning.
The line names evening and morning.
questions.explain: The two times are सायम् (evening) and प्रातर् (morning).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 4 in the line's order.
questions.explain: (Sweet?) and cool, mostly liquid, suitable, and, in the evening, in the morning one should have her take.
questions.rule: खादुशीतं → द्रवप्रायं → सात्म्यं → च → सायं → प्रातराहारयेत्.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 4 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These sure words say what kind of food and when.
questions.teaches: -प्राय at the end of a compound = mostly: द्रवप्राय = mostly liquid.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which printed word of unit 4 does the card mark as doubtful?
optionExplain: A sure word: mostly liquid.
Right: खादु is not a word; स्वादु is only a conjecture.
A sure word: suitable, agreeable.
A sure word: in the evening.
questions.explain: Only खादुशीतं carries the doubtful खादु.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of प्रातराहारयेत् is right?
optionExplain: राहारयेत् is not a word; the verb is आहारयेत्.
अ + आ → आ would give प्राताहारयेत्, with no र्.
Right: र् stays before a vowel and joins it.
प्रातरा is not a word; the verb is आहारयेत्, from आ-√हृ.
questions.explain: प्रातर् (in the morning) + आहारयेत् (should have her take as food).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By -प्राय in द्रवप्रायम्, what does जलप्रायम् (of a dish, a new example) mean?
optionExplain: Without would need a word like निर्-; -प्राय means mostly.
-प्राय does not mean a little.
-प्राय does not mean made for.
Right: -प्राय = mostly, as द्रवप्राय = mostly liquid.
questions.explain: जलप्राय = mostly water, like द्रवप्राय = mostly liquid.
questions.teaches: -प्राय at the end of a compound means mostly: द्रवप्राय = mostly liquid, जलप्राय = mostly water.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 5, which two things should she not resort to?
optionExplain: Right: न चाभ्यंगोद्वर्तनानि सेवेत.
Milk and ghee are prescribed in units 2 and 3, not forbidden.
Neither is named in unit 5.
These are added in later months (units 8, 9), not forbidden here.
questions.explain: She should avoid अभ्यङ्ग (oil massage) and उद्वर्तन (rubbing with powders).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 5 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words make the whole line.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: In unit 5, oil massage is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: अभ्यङ्ग = oil massage; printed अभ्यंग.
questions.teaches: अभ्यङ्ग = oil massage; अभ्यंग and अभ्यङ्ग are two spellings of one word.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of अभ्यंगोद्वर्तनानि is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga; अः before उ would leave अभ्यङ्ग उद्वर्तनानि.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: अभ्यङ्ग + उद्वर्तनानि.
द्वर्तनानि is not a word; the word is उद्वर्तनानि.
अ + ओ would give औ, and ओद्वर्तनानि is not a word.
questions.explain: अभ्यङ्ग (oil massage) + उद्वर्तनानि (rubbings with powder): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: In unit 5, what makes the sentence a prohibition?
options: The plural ending of the compound
The particle च, read as not
A future verb: she will not resort
optionExplain: A noun ending does not forbid; न does.
च means and; न means not.
Right: न + optative = she should not resort to.
सेवेत is optative, not future.
questions.explain: न + सेवेत = she should not resort to.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By न … सेवेत, which invented sentence says and she should not go to the village?
optionExplain: गच्छति is present: does not go, a statement.
Without न it says she should go.
गमिष्यति is future: will not go.
Right: न + optative गच्छेत् = should not go.
questions.explain: न च ग्रामं गच्छेत् = and she should not go to the village, like न च … सेवेत.
questions.teaches: न with an optative verb forbids: न … सेवेत = she should not resort to; न … गच्छेत् = she should not go.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the sure words of unit 6, what should she avoid?
options: Milk that is prepared and cool
optionExplain: Right: यथोक्तानि च दोषकराणि परिहरेत्.
Milk is prescribed in unit 2, not avoided.
Ghee is prescribed in unit 3, not avoided.
Such food is given in unit 4, not avoided.
questions.explain: She avoids the doṣa-causing things, as stated before.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the sure words of unit 6 in the line's order.
questions.explain: As stated, and, the doṣa-causing, she should avoid.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 6 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These four words are the sure part of the line.
questions.teaches: -कर at the end of a compound = causing, making: दोषकर = causing doṣa (disturbance of the humours).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which part of unit 6 does the card call only a conjecture?
options: That something is to be avoided
optionExplain: Sure: परिहरेत्, should avoid.
Right: आर्पचमान् is not a word; आपञ्चमात् is a guess.
Sure: दोषकराणि.
Sure: यथोक्तानि, as stated.
questions.explain: Only the month limit rests on a guessed reading.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of यथोक्तानि is right?
optionExplain: Neither piece is a word.
आ + ओ would give औ, and ओक्तानि is not a word.
Right: आ + उ → ओ: यथा + उक्तानि.
There is no word यथः; the word is यथा, as.
questions.explain: यथा (as) + उक्तानि (stated): आ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of यथोक्तानि, how is महा + उत्सवः (a great festival) written when joined?
optionExplain: आ + उ does not give औ.
The उ is not dropped after आ.
The आ is not dropped before उ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ, as यथा + उक्तानि.
questions.explain: महा + उत्सवः = महोत्सवः, like यथा + उक्तानि = यथोक्तानि.
questions.teaches: आ (or अ) followed by उ joins as ओ: यथा + उक्तानि → यथोक्तानि.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 7, what should she drink in the second (month)?
optionExplain: Right: मधुरौषधसिद्धं पयः पिबेत्.
That is unit 3, the first month's twelve nights.
That is unit 8, the third (month).
That is unit 9, the fourth (month).
questions.explain: In the second, milk cooked with sweet medicines.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the words of unit 7 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Especially, in the second, cooked with sweet medicines, milk, she should drink.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 7 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Six members carry the whole line.
questions.rule: विशेषेण, द्वितीये, मधुर, औषध, सिद्धम्, पयः.
questions.teaches: -सिद्ध at the end of a compound = cooked with: मधुरौषधसिद्ध = cooked with sweet medicines.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of मधुरौषध is right?
optionExplain: षध is not a word; the word is औषध, medicine.
Right: अ + औ → औ: मधुर + औषध.
रौषध is not a word.
A compound member has no visarga; अः before औ would leave मधुर औषध.
questions.explain: मधुर (sweet) + औषध (medicine): अ + औ → औ.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which statements does unit 7 make?
options: The milk is cooked with sweet medicines
The sweet medicines are named one by one
The milk is taken with honey
optionExplain: Right: मधुरौषधसिद्धं पयः.
None is listed here.
Right: द्वितीये.
Honey comes in unit 8, the third.
questions.explain: Milk cooked with sweet medicines, in the second (month); none is named.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of मधुरौषध, how is वन + औषधम् (a forest medicine) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + औ does not give ओ.
अ + औ does not give ए.
Right: अ + औ → औ, as मधुर + औषध.
No व् is put between अ and औ.
questions.explain: वन + औषधम् = वनौषधम्, like मधुर + औषध = मधुरौषध.
questions.teaches: अ followed by औ joins as औ: मधुर + औषध → मधुरौषध.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 8, with what is the same (milk) taken in the third (month)?
optionExplain: Fresh butter is unit 9, the fourth.
Cool water is the after-drink of unit 3.
No gruel is named in unit 8.
Right: तदेव सर्पिर्मधुभ्याम्.
questions.explain: The same milk, with ghee and honey.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 8 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five members make the whole line.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: In unit 8, honey is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: सर्पिर्मधुभ्याम् = with ghee (सर्पिः) and honey (मधु).
questions.teaches: मधु = honey; with सर्पिः (ghee) it makes the pair सर्पिर्मधु.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the card, what does the ending of सर्पिर्मधुभ्याम् show?
options: Plural: with many kinds of ghee
Genitive: of ghee and of honey
optionExplain: Right: Labelled inst. du., a dvandva of two members: ghee and honey.
Two members, ghee and honey, take the dual.
The genitive dual would end in -योः.
The drinker is the pregnant woman; this word is instrumental.
questions.explain: -भ्याम् here = with the two: ghee and honey.
questions.rule: सर्पिर्मधुभ्याम् = inst. du.: with ghee and honey.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of सर्पिर्मधु is right?
optionExplain: इर्मधु is not a word; the word is मधु, honey.
Right: A visarga after इ becomes र् before the voiced म.
Neither piece is a word of the card.
A final म् would give सर्पिम्मधु, with no र्.
questions.explain: सर्पिः (ghee) + मधु (honey): इः → इर् before a voiced sound.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of सर्पिर्मधु, how is धनुः + धरः (bow-holder) written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga is not simply dropped after उ.
स् stays only before त/थ, not before ध.
Right: A visarga after उ becomes र् before the voiced ध.
The उ is not lengthened; the visarga becomes र्.
questions.explain: धनुः + धरः = धनुर्धरः, like सर्पिः + मधु = सर्पिर्मधु.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ or उ becomes र् before a voiced sound: सर्पिः + मधु → सर्पिर्मधु.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 9, what is joined (to the milk) in the fourth (month)?
options: Ghee and honey (सर्पिः, मधु), both together
Śāliparṇī and palāśa, boiled into ghee
Fresh butter (नवनीत), an akṣa in measure
optionExplain: Ghee and honey are unit 8, the third.
Sweet medicines are unit 7, the second.
These are unit 3, the first month.
Right: अक्षमात्रनवनीतयुक्तम्.
questions.explain: In the fourth: fresh butter in the measure of an akṣa.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the members of unit 9's single printed word in order.
questions.explain: In the fourth, akṣa, measure, fresh butter, joined with.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each member of unit 9 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five members make the one printed word.
questions.teaches: अक्ष here is a measure of weight, a synonym of karṣa; अक्षमात्र = in the measure of an akṣa.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of चतुर्थेऽक्ष is right?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ: the अ is dropped and shown by ऽ.
अः + अ would give चतुर्थोऽक्ष, with ओ.
एक्ष is not a word; the word is अक्ष.
आक्ष is not the card's word, and the avagraha marks a dropped short अ.
questions.explain: चतुर्थे (in the fourth) + अक्ष (a measure): ए + अ → एऽ.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: What does the sign ऽ in चतुर्थेऽक्ष show?
options: A long vowel to be sounded
A short अ dropped after ए
A letter lost in the scan
optionExplain: ऽ does not mark length.
Right: The avagraha marks the elided अ of अक्ष.
ऽ is not punctuation.
The note says the avagraha is printed correctly.
questions.explain: ऽ = a short अ dropped after ए (or ओ).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of चतुर्थेऽक्ष, how is वने + अस्मिन् (in this forest) written when joined?
optionExplain: ए + अ here does not give य.
ए + अ does not give आ.
Right: ए + अ: the अ drops and is shown by ऽ.
ओऽ comes from अः or ओ, not from ए.
questions.explain: वने + अस्मिन् = वनेऽस्मिन्, like चतुर्थे + अक्ष = चतुर्थेऽक्ष.
questions.teaches: A word-final ए before a short अ drops the अ, shown by ऽ: चतुर्थे + अक्ष → चतुर्थेऽक्ष.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 10, what is named for the fifth (month)?
optionExplain: Fresh butter is unit 9, the fourth.
Honey is unit 8, the third.
Cool water is the after-drink of unit 3.
Right: पंचमे क्षीरसर्पिः.
questions.explain: The fifth (month) names क्षीरसर्पिः.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each member of unit 10 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three members make the whole line.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: In unit 10, the word for ghee is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: क्षीरसर्पिः = क्षीर (milk) + सर्पिः (ghee).
questions.teaches: सर्पिः (stem सर्पिस्) = ghee.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which statements are true of unit 10?
options: It gives a measure in akṣa
optionExplain: Right: the verb is carried over.
The akṣa measure is unit 9.
Honey is unit 8.
Right: पंचमे, in the fifth.
questions.explain: A two-word line: the fifth (month) and milk-ghee, with no verb.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Why is the printed पंचमे the same word as पञ्चमे?
options: Anusvara before च stands for ञ्
पंचमे is a dual form of पञ्चमे
The anusvara marks a long vowel
पंचमे is a misprint for पचमे
optionExplain: Right: An anusvara before a stop stands for that class's nasal.
The anusvara is spelling only; it changes no ending.
Anusvara is a nasal, not a length mark.
There is no word पचमे; the nasal is real.
questions.explain: पंचमे = पञ्चमे: anusvara before च = ञ्.
questions.rule: anusvara before a stop = that class's nasal.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By पंचमे = पञ्चमे, how is printed संकल्प written with the class nasal?
optionExplain: ञ् belongs before च-class letters, not before क.
Right: Before क (the क-class) the nasal is ङ्.
न् belongs before त-class letters, not before क.
म् belongs before प-class letters, not before क.
questions.explain: संकल्प = सङ्कल्प, as पंचमे = पञ्चमे.
questions.rule: anusvara before a stop = that class's nasal.
questions.teaches: An anusvara before a stop may be written as that stop's class nasal: पंचमे = पञ्चमे, संकल्प = सङ्कल्प.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 11, how is that same (drink) prepared in the sixth (month)?
optionExplain: Fresh butter is unit 9.
Ghee and honey are unit 8.
Right: तदेव मधुरौषधसिद्धम्.
Śāliparṇī is unit 3.
questions.explain: In the sixth, that same, cooked with sweet medicines.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put the words of unit 11 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the sixth, that, same, cooked with sweet medicines.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Match each word of unit 11 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five members carry the whole line.
questions.teaches: एव stresses the word before it: तत् एव = that very, the same.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which split of तदेव is right?
optionExplain: अ + ए would give ऐ: तदैव, not तदेव.
There is no word तदे.
देव (god) is not the card's word; the words are तत् and एव.
Right: त् → द् before a vowel: तत् + एव = तदेव.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + एव (same): त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Which of these are printed in unit 11?
optionExplain: Not printed: the verb is carried over.
Right: printed.
Right: printed.
Not printed: fresh butter is unit 9.
questions.explain: Printed: षष्ठे, तदेव, मधुरौषधसिद्धं; the verb is carried over.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the rule of तदेव, how is जगत् + ईशः (lord of the world) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: त् → द् before a vowel, as तत् + एव.
A final त् before a vowel becomes द्, not त्.
The ई does not change to ए.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
questions.explain: जगत् + ईशः = जगदीशः, like तत् + एव = तदेव.
questions.teaches: A word-final त् becomes द् before a vowel: तत् + एव → तदेव.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 12, which month is named?
optionExplain: षष्ठे is unit 11.
Right: सप्तमे च: and in the seventh.
No eighth is named here.
पञ्चमे is unit 10.
questions.explain: Unit 12 names the seventh (month).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: Put these ordinal words in counting order, ending with unit 12's word.
questions.explain: Third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: And in the seventh: ____ च (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is सप्तमे च.
questions.teaches: सप्तमे = in the seventh: locative singular of the ordinal सप्तम.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: What does unit 12 print for the seventh (month)?
options: Fresh butter, an akṣa in measure
optionExplain: That is unit 8, the third.
That is unit 9, the fourth.
Right: The note: no substance or verb is given.
That is unit 7, the second (month).
questions.explain: Unit 12 prints only सप्तमे च.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By the card, what form is सप्तमे?
optionExplain: That would be सप्तमः.
That would be सप्तमम्.
That would be सप्तमेन.
Right: Labelled loc. sg.
questions.explain: सप्तमे = in the seventh (locative).
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By सप्तमे, how is in the eighth (month), from अष्टम, said?
optionExplain: Right: Locative singular -ए, as सप्तम → सप्तमे.
अष्टमः is nominative: the eighth.
अष्टमेन is instrumental: by the eighth.
अष्टमम् is accusative.
questions.explain: अष्टम → अष्टमे = in the eighth, like सप्तम → सप्तमे.
questions.teaches: The locative singular of an a-stem ordinal ends in -ए: सप्तम → सप्तमे (in the seventh), अष्टम → अष्टमे.
questions.section: गर्भिणी-चर्या: पहले से सातवें मास तक

questions.q: By unit 13, what do the women say causes the mother's burning (विदाह)?
options: The mother's diet in that month
The arising of the embryo's hair
The ghee and honey she drinks
optionExplain: The women name no food as the cause.
Right: गर्भस्य केशोत्पत्त्या मातुर्विदाहो भवति.
No turning is named in unit 13.
Ghee and honey are unit 8, and no cause is tied to them.
questions.explain: The women's view: the embryo's hair arising causes the mother's burning.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Put these printed parts of unit 13 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And in that, by the arising of the embryo's hair, the mother's burning occurs, so women say; not so, Ātreya.
questions.rule: तस्मिंश्च → गर्भस्यकेशोत्पत्त्या → मातुर्विदाहो भवतीति → स्त्रियो भाषंते → नेति → भगवान्आत्रेयः.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 13 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the women's claim.
questions.rule: केश, उत्पत्ति, मातुः, विदाह, स्त्रियः, भाषन्ते.
questions.teaches: विदाह = burning, probably a heartburn-like sensation; the text gives no further definition.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: In unit 13, who holds which view?
options: Ātreya: hair causes it; women: not so
Women and Ātreya both: hair causes it
Women: hair causes it; Ātreya: not so
Ātreya gives the true cause here
optionExplain: The roles are reversed: the women make the claim.
Ātreya says नेति, not so.
Right: स्त्रियो भाषंते … नेति भगवानात्रेयः.
His own reason is not in this unit.
questions.explain: The women claim; Ātreya denies.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Which sandhi joins from unit 13 are stated rightly?
optionExplain: Wrong: अ + इ → ए, giving नेति.
Wrong: अः before a voiced sound → ओ: विदाहो भवति.
Right: two इ make ई.
Right: उः before the voiced व → उर्.
questions.explain: भवतीति and मातुर्विदाहः are right; नेति and विदाहो are the true forms of the others.
questions.rule: अ + इ → ए; अः + voiced → ओ; इ + इ → ई; उः + voiced → उर्.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of नेति, how is न + इच्छति (does not wish) written when joined?
optionExplain: ऐ comes from अ + ए/ऐ, not from अ + इ.
The अ is not dropped; अ + इ gives ए.
No य् is put between अ and इ.
Right: अ + इ → ए, as न + इति → नेति.
questions.explain: न + इच्छति = नेच्छति, like न + इति = नेति.
questions.teaches: अ followed by इ joins as ए: न + इति → नेति.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By unit 14, from what do the doṣas reach the heart and burn?
options: From the pressure of the embryo
From the arising of the embryo's hair
From eating too much salty food
From scratching the skin of the belly
optionExplain: Right: गर्भोत्पीडनात्: from the pressure of the embryo.
That is the women's view in card 13, which Ātreya rejects.
No food is named in unit 14.
Scratching is named in card 20, not as a cause here.
questions.explain: The cause given is the pressure of the embryo.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 14 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Pressure of the embryo, the doṣas reach the heart, they burn, then itching arises.
questions.rule: उत्पीडन → हृदय तक दोष → दाह → ततः कण्डू.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 14 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words carry the cause, the place, the action and the result.
questions.teaches: ततः = then: it links the burning to the itching that follows.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Why does प्राप्य (having reached) end in -य and not in -त्वा?
options: The ending -य marks a plural subject, the doṣas
Its verb has the prefix प्र-
The ending -य makes it a command: let them reach
The ending -य shows a future: they will reach
optionExplain: -य does not mark number; the absolutive has no person or number.
Right: The data: absolutive of प्र + √आप्; a prefixed verb takes -य.
A command would be an imperative; प्राप्य is an absolutive.
No future ending is here; the data gives absolutive.
questions.explain: प्र + √आप् + य = प्राप्य, having reached.
questions.rule: Absolutive: -त्वा without a prefix, -य with a prefix.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Which statements does unit 14 make?
options: The embryo's hair causes the burning
The doṣas reach the heart and burn
A medicine for the burning is named
optionExplain: That is the women's view of card 13, not this line.
Right: दोषा हृदयं प्राप्य विदहन्ति.
Right: ततः कण्डूर्जायते.
No medicine is named in unit 14; the treatment starts in card 15.
questions.explain: Pressure → doṣas reach the heart and burn → then itching.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of कण्डूर्जायते, how is वधूः + गच्छति (the bride goes) written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga after ऊ is not simply dropped.
स् comes only before त or थ, not before ग.
Right: A visarga after ऊ becomes र् before a voiced sound, as कण्डूः + जायते.
The long ऊ is not shortened.
questions.explain: वधूः + गच्छति = वधूर्गच्छति, like कण्डूः + जायते = कण्डूर्जायते.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound: कण्डूः + जायते → कण्डूर्जायते.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By unit 15, what should be given to her?
options: A paste of sandalwood and lotus stalk
Water cooked with mālatī and madhuka
optionExplain: That is the eighth-month drink of card 23.
That paste is for rubbing, in card 16.
That water is for pouring, in card 19.
Right: नवनीतस्य मधुरौषधसिद्धस्य.
questions.explain: Fresh butter (navanīta) cooked with sweet medicines.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Put these words of unit 15 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In that case, of fresh butter, cooked with sweet medicines, a palm's measure, to her, one should give.
questions.rule: तत्र → नवनीतस्य → मधुरौषधसिद्धस्य → पाणितलमात्रम् → अस्यै → दद्यात्.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 15 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Six members give what, cooked how, and how much.
questions.rule: नवनीत, मधुर, औषध, सिद्ध, पाणितल, मात्र.
questions.teaches: -मात्र at the end = the measure of: पाणितलमात्रम् = as much as a palm holds.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: Which split of मधुरौषध is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + औ → औ: मधुर + औषध = मधुरौषध.
A compound member has no visarga; अः before औ would give मधुर औषध.
A final म् would stay: मधुरमौषध.
षध is not a word; the word is औषध (medicine).
questions.explain: मधुर (sweet) + औषध (medicine): अ + औ → औ.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By unit 15, to whom is the butter given (अस्यै)?
options: To the women who speak in card 13
optionExplain: अस्यै is feminine; the embryo (गर्भ) is masculine.
Right: अस्यै = to her (f. dative); the data: the pregnant woman.
अस्यै is feminine; no man is meant.
अस्यै is singular: one woman.
questions.explain: अस्यै: dative feminine singular, to her.
questions.rule: अस्यै दद्यात् = one should give to her.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By the dative अस्यै, what does बालिकायै फलं दद्यात् mean?
options: One should take a fruit from the girl
One should give the girl's fruit
One should give a fruit to the girl
The girl should give a fruit
optionExplain: From would be ablative बालिकायाः.
Of would be genitive बालिकायाः.
Right: -ऐ (-यै) is the feminine dative: to the girl.
The girl would then be nominative बालिका.
questions.explain: बालिकायै = to the girl, as अस्यै = to her.
questions.teaches: The feminine dative in -ऐ marks the receiver: अस्यै दद्यात् = one should give to her.
questions.section: सातवाँ मास: विदाह, खुजली और उपचार

questions.q: By unit 16, which parts of the body are named for the pastes?
optionExplain: No head or feet are named.
No back or loins are named.
