ए + इ would not give नेति; ने is not the word.
नः is not the word; the word is न (not).
questions.explain: न (not) + इति (thus).
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the -मती of सर्पिष्मतीम्, what does बुद्धिमती कन्या mean?
optionExplain: -मती means having, not lacking.
बुद्धिमती describes कन्या; it is not a genitive.
Right: -मती (f. of -मत्) = having, agreeing with a feminine noun.
-मती does not mean giving.
questions.explain: बुद्धिमती = having intelligence, as सर्पिष्मती = having ghee.
questions.teaches: -मत् (feminine -मती) = having: सर्पिष्मती यवागू = gruel having ghee.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 24, what does the line grant?
options: That there is no affliction at all
That the gruel cures the tawny colour
That the affliction falls on the mother
optionExplain: अस्ति = there is.
No cure is said.
The line does not say on whom.
Right: अस्ति पैङ्गल्याबाधः.
questions.explain: The affliction is granted.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put the words of unit 24 in the line's order.
questions.explain: There is the affliction; even so, thus one should act.
questions.rule: अस्ति → पैङ्गल्याबाधः → तथा → अपि → एवम् → कुर्वीत.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 24 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Grant, concession, and the advice.
questions.teaches: तथापि = even so: it keeps an advice after granting a drawback.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of अप्येवं (अप्येवम्) is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + ए → ये: अपि + एवम्.
अ + ए would give ऐ: अप्यैवम्.
इ + इ would give ई: अपीवम्.
Neither अप् nor येवम् is the word here.
questions.explain: अपि (even) + एवम् (thus).
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 24, what stance does the line take?
options: It denies that there is any risk
It grants the risk but keeps the advice
It drops the advice because of the risk
optionExplain: अस्ति grants it.
Right: अस्ति ... तथाप्येवं कुर्वीत.
तथापि ... कुर्वीत keeps it.
No new drink is named.
questions.explain: A concession: yes, but still do it.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the rule of पैङ्गल्याबाधस्तथा, how is रामः + तत्र (Rāma there) joined?
optionExplain: अः → ओ only before a voiced sound; त is unvoiced.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्, as आबाधः + तथा.
The visarga is not simply dropped before त.
questions.explain: रामः + तत्र = रामस्तत्र.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त/थ becomes स्: पैङ्गल्याबाधः + तथा → पैङ्गल्याबाधस्तथा.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 25, what is the child first said to be?
options: Born early, in the seventh month
optionExplain: Tawny colour is the feared affliction of cards 23-24.
No early birth is named.
The child is endowed with strength (बल).
Right: नीरुजम्: free of disease.
questions.explain: The child is free of disease.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put these words of unit 25 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Free of disease; strength, complexion, sattva, build; child.
questions.rule: नीरुजम् → बल → वर्ण → सत्त्व → संहनन → अपत्यम्.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 25 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The qualities of the child.
questions.rule: नीरुज, बल, वर्ण, सत्त्व, संहनन, अग्रगण्य.
questions.teaches: सम्पद् = excellence, उपेत = endowed with: बल...संहननसम्पदुपेतम् = endowed with the excellence of these four.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of जनयतीति is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + इ → ई: जनयति + इति.
ति is not a word here; इति is the quoting word.
ए + इ would give जनयत इति or जनयतयिति, not जनयतीति.
ईति is not the word; the word is इति.
questions.explain: जनयति (she produces) + इति (thus).
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 25, among whom is the child foremost?
options: Among the children of its age
optionExplain: No physicians are named.
Right: ज्ञातीनामग्रगण्यम्: foremost among kinsmen.
The line says kinsmen (ज्ञाति).
Ātreya is the speaker, not a group.
questions.explain: ज्ञातीनाम् = among kinsmen.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the rule of जनयतीति, how is गच्छति + इति (thus he goes) joined?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not इ + इ.
य् comes before a different vowel, not before इ.
Right: इ + इ → ई, as जनयति + इति.
The two इ do not shorten to one इ.
questions.explain: गच्छति + इति = गच्छतीति.
questions.teaches: Two इ join as ई: जनयति + इति → जनयतीति.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 26, which procedure is named?
optionExplain: That is card 18.
That is card 19.
That is card 23.
Right: आस्थापयेत्: one should give an āsthāpana.
questions.explain: The verb आस्थापयेत् names the decoction enema.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put these substances of unit 26 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Milk, curd, whey, oil, salt, ... honey.
questions.rule: पयः → दधि → मस्तु → तैल → लवण → मधु.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 26 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The base water and five of the added substances.
questions.rule: बदर, पयस्, दधि, मस्तु, लवण, मधु.
questions.teaches: The base of the enema is बदरोदक, jujube water; the others are joined (युक्त) to it.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of बदरोदकेन is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ: बदर + उदकेन.
दकेन is not a word; the word is उदक (water).
अः before उ would give बदर उदकेन.
A final म् would give बदरमुदकेन.
questions.explain: बदर (jujube) + उदक (water).
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which substances does unit 26 name?
optionExplain: Sandalwood is in cards 16 and 21.
Right: पयोदधि.
Right: मस्तु.
Turmeric is in card 17.
Right: मधुयुक्तेन.
questions.explain: Curd, whey and honey are in the list.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the rule of पयोदधि (पयस् + दधि), how is मनस् + रथः (wish) joined in a compound?
optionExplain: The स् does not stay before a voiced consonant.
Right: Stem-final -अस् becomes ओ before a voiced consonant, as पयस् + दधि → पयोदधि.
The -अस् is not simply dropped.
ऽ marks a lost अ; रथः does not begin with अ.
questions.explain: मनस् + रथः = मनोरथः, like पयस् + दधि = पयोदधि.
questions.teaches: A stem in -अस् shows -ओ before a voiced consonant: पयस् + दधि → पयोदधि.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 27, which kind of enema is given with the cooked oil?
options: A picu, a cotton swab in the yoni
A daily bath with a cooled decoction
optionExplain: The āsthāpana with jujube water is unit 26; here the verb is अनुवासयेत्.
The picu comes in unit 31, in the ninth (month).
Right: तैलेनानुवासयेत्: one should give an anuvāsana with the oil.
The daily bath is unit 36.
questions.explain: The oil cooked with sweet medicines is given as an anuvāsana.
questions.rule: तैलेन अनुवासयेत् = should give an oil enema with the oil.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put these words of unit 27 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With oil cooked with madhuka and the other sweet medicines, one should give an anuvāsana, for the anulomana of vāyu. The damaged first word is left out.
questions.rule: मधुकादि… सिद्धेन → च → तैलेन → अनुवासयेत् → अनुलोमनाय → वायोः.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 27 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words name the oil and the purpose of the enema.
questions.teaches: -आदि = beginning with: madhuka heads a group of sweet medicines that the line does not name.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of तैलेनानुवासयेत् is right?
optionExplain: नुवासयेत् is not a word; the verb is अनुवासयेत्.
अः before अ would give तैलेनोऽनुवासयेत्.
A final म् would give तैलेनमनुवासयेत्.
Right: अ + अ → आ: तैलेन + अनुवासयेत् = तैलेनानुवासयेत्.
questions.explain: तैलेन (with oil) + अनुवासयेत् (should give an oil enema): अ + अ → आ.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: In unit 27, what purpose does the dative अनुलोमनाय (with वायोः) state?
options: The downward movement of the wind
The oiling of the embryo's passage
The softening of belly and back
A cooling of the woman's skin
optionExplain: Right: अनुलोमनाय वायोः: for the anulomana of vāyu.
That purpose belongs to the picu of unit 31.
Softening is the result stated in unit 32.
No cooling of the skin is named in unit 27.
questions.explain: The sure purpose of the line: to make vāyu move downward.
questions.rule: अनुलोमनाय वायोः = for the downward movement of the wind.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the dative of अनुलोमनाय (for anulomana), what does रक्षणाय mean?
optionExplain: By protection would be the instrumental रक्षणेन.
Right: -आय is the dative singular of an अ-stem: for, for the purpose of.
From protection would be the ablative रक्षणात्.
Of protection would be the genitive रक्षणस्य.
questions.explain: रक्षण + आय = for protection, like अनुलोमन + आय = for anulomana.
questions.teaches: The dative of an अ-stem ends in -आय and states a purpose: अनुलोमनाय = for the downward movement.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 28, how does she give birth when the wind moves downward?
options: Slowly, after a long, hard labour
optionExplain: सुखम् means easily; no long or hard labour is named.
No time of birth is named in unit 28.
Right: सुखमनुपद्रवा प्रसूते: easily, without complications.
No pain is named; सुखम् means easily.
questions.explain: With the wind moving downward, the birth is easy and free of complications.
questions.rule: अनुलोमे हि मारुते सुखम् अनुपद्रवा प्रसूते.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put the words of the first sentence of unit 28 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For when the wind is downward, easily, free of complications, she gives birth.
questions.rule: अनुलोमे → हि → मारुते → सुखम् → अनुपद्रवा → प्रसूते.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 28 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The condition, the result, and the two enemas of the second sentence.
questions.teaches: Before a vowel the negative prefix is अन्-: अन् + उपद्रवा = अनुपद्रवा, without complications.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of सुखमनुपद्रवा is right?
optionExplain: अः before अ would give सुखोऽनुपद्रवा.
मनुपद्रवा is not a word.
पद्रवा is not a word; the word is अनुपद्रवा.
Right: A final म् before a vowel joins to it: सुखमनुपद्रवा.
questions.explain: सुखम् (easily) + अनुपद्रवा (free of complications).
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म joined to the vowel.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 28, how is the pregnant woman placed for the enema?
options: Lying on her back, face up
optionExplain: Right: गर्भिणीं तु न्युब्जाम्: face down, prone.
न्युब्ज is face down, the opposite.
No seat is named; the word is न्युब्जा.
No side is named; the word is न्युब्जा.
questions.explain: न्युब्जा: the woman is face down for the enema; the posture is not described further.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the rule of अनुपद्रवा (अन् + उपद्रवा), how is the negative of आदि (beginning) formed?
optionExplain: अ- is the negative only before a consonant.
Right: Before a vowel the negative is अन्-: अन् + आदि = अनादि.
No ओ arises; अन् simply joins the vowel.
That is अन्य + आदि, 'the other and so on', not a negative.
questions.explain: अन् + आदि = अनादि, like अन् + उपद्रवा = अनुपद्रवा.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अ- before a consonant and अन्- before a vowel: अन् + उपद्रवा → अनुपद्रवा.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 29, what follows from her passage being open?
optionExplain: That is stated in unit 33.
That is stated in unit 34.
Right: सम्यगौषधमनुप्रविशति: the medicine enters properly.
That is stated in unit 32.
questions.explain: Because the passage is open, the medicine enters properly.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put these words of unit 29 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In that way, her, because of the open passage, the medicine properly, enters.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 29 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words carry the reason and the result.
questions.teaches: विवृतमार्गतया: -ता makes the abstract noun (having an open passage); the instrumental gives the reason.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which split of सम्यगौषधम् is right?
optionExplain: गौषधम् is not a word.
That would give सम्यगोषधम्, with ओ; the print has औ.
A visarga would not give ग्; सम्यः is not the word.
Right: क् → ग् before a vowel: सम्यक् + औषधम् = सम्यगौषधम्.
questions.explain: सम्यक् (properly) + औषधम् (medicine): क् → ग् before a vowel.
questions.rule: Final क् → ग् before a vowel.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Which statements does unit 29 make?
options: The medicine is given by mouth
The passage is defined as the uterus
optionExplain: No mouth is named; the medicine enters the open passage.
Right: विवृतमार्गतया.
The passage is not defined in unit 29.
Right: सम्यगौषधमनुप्रविशति.
questions.explain: Open passage, so the medicine enters properly; the passage is not defined.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the pattern of विवृतमार्गतया, what does दुर्बलतया (from दुर्बल, weak) mean?
optionExplain: Right: -ता makes the abstract noun; the instrumental gives the reason.
That would be the dative दुर्बलतायै.
No negative is in the word.
The comparative would be दुर्बलतर.
questions.explain: दुर्बल + ता + instrumental = because of weakness, like विवृतमार्गतया = because of the open passage.
questions.teaches: An abstract noun in -ता in the instrumental gives a reason: विवृतमार्गतया = because the passage is open.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 30, whose view closes the line?
optionExplain: Ātreya's name closes unit 25, not unit 30.
Right: इति भगवान् धन्वन्तरिः.
No Suśruta is named in unit 30.
No Kāśyapa is named in unit 30.
questions.explain: The line ends: so (says) the venerable Dhanvantari.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 30 in the line's order.
questions.explain: After this, with unctuous gruels and dry-land broths, one should treat, until delivery: so Dhanvantari.
questions.rule: अतः ऊर्ध्वम् → यवागूभिः → जाङ्गलरसैः → उपाचरेत् → आप्रसवकालात् → धन्वन्तरिः.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 30 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two foods of the treatment and the verb.
questions.teaches: आ with the ablative means up to, until: आप्रसवकालात् = until the time of delivery.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: Why is अतः printed without its visarga in अतऊर्ध्वं?
options: A visarga drops before every vowel
The visarga became the ऊ of ऊर्ध्वम्
After अ, a visarga drops before a vowel other than अ
optionExplain: Before अ it gives ओऽ: अतः + अत्र → अतोऽत्र.
ऊ is the first letter of ऊर्ध्वम् itself.
Right: अतः + ऊर्ध्वम् → अत ऊर्ध्वम्.
ऊर्ध्वम् begins with the vowel ऊ.
questions.explain: अतः + ऊर्ध्वम्: after अ, the visarga drops before ऊ, and no further join follows.
questions.rule: अः + vowel other than अ → अ (visarga drops).
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By unit 30, until when does this treatment continue?
optionExplain: The line says until delivery, not until the ninth.
No count of days is named.
Itching is not named in unit 30.
Right: आप्रसवकालात्: up to the time of delivery.
questions.explain: आ + प्रसवकालात् = until the time of delivery.
questions.section: आठवाँ मास: घृतयुक्त यवागू और बस्ति

questions.q: By the rule of आप्रसवकालात्, what does आमरणात् mean?
optionExplain: Right: आ with the ablative = up to, until.
After death would be मरणात् परम्.
आ- here is 'until', not a cause.
Without would need a negative such as अ- or विना.
questions.explain: आ + मरणात् = until death, like आ + प्रसवकालात् = until delivery.

questions.q: Which split of एवानुवासन- (in तत एवानुवासनतैलात्) is right?

questions.section: नवाँ मास: पिचु, सुखप्रसव और स्नान

questions.q: By the form योनौ (in the yoni), what is the locative singular of अग्नि (fire)?

questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel: प्रथममासात् + आरभ्य → प्रथममासादारभ्य.
questions.section: नवाँ मास: पिचु, सुखप्रसव और स्नान

questions.q: By the rule of चेष्टम् (च + इष्टम्), how is न + इति joined?

questions.q: By the rule of सर्वगन्धोदक, how is गङ्गा + उदकम् (Gaṅgā water) joined?

questions.q: Which split of सर्वर्तुसुखम् is right?

तुसुखम् is not a word; the word is ऋतु.
अ + अ would give आ: सर्वार्तु.

questions.explain: सर्व (all) + ऋतु (season) + सुखम् (comfortable): अ + ऋ → अर्.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 37, which way does the chamber's door face?

वा (or) gives the east as the other choice.

questions.q: By the rule of प्राग्द्वारम्, how is वाक् + देवी (goddess of speech) joined?
optionExplain: Before the voiced द the क् does not stay क्.
क् → ङ् only before a nasal.
Right: क् → ग् before a voiced sound, as प्राक् + द्वारम् → प्राग्द्वारम्.
ओ arises from a visarga, not from क्.
questions.explain: वाक् + देवी = वाग्देवी, like प्राक् + द्वारम् = प्राग्द्वारम्.
questions.rule: Final क् → ग् before a voiced sound.
questions.teaches: A final क् becomes ग् before a voiced sound: प्राक् + द्वारम् → प्राग्द्वारम्, उदक् + द्वारम् → उदग्द्वारम्.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 38, what does she do at the end of the line?
optionExplain: Gruel with ghee is unit 42.
The chamber is to be built in unit 37 (कारयेत्).
The daily bath is unit 36.
Right: प्रसवकालमुदीक्षेत: she should await the time of delivery.
questions.explain: The line ends with the waiting for delivery.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 38 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Favourable stars, the puṇyāha utterance, entering, hardship-bearing attendants, devoted to rites, awaiting.
questions.rule: नक्षत्रादिषु → पुण्याहशब्देन → प्रविश्य → क्लेशक्षमाभिः → स्वस्त्ययनपरा → उदीक्षेत.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 38 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Words from the sure parts of the long sentence.
questions.teaches: -परा at the end of a compound means devoted to: स्वस्त्ययनपरा = devoted to auspicious rites.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which split of स्वस्त्ययन is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: स्वस्ति + अयन = स्वस्त्ययन.
अ + अ would give आ: स्वस्त्यायन.
स्वस्त and ययन are not the words here.
A visarga after इ before a vowel would give र्: स्वस्तिरयन.
questions.explain: स्वस्ति (well-being) + अयन (going, rite): इ + अ → य.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which statements does unit 38 make, on its sure words?
options: The stars and the rest are favourable
She has the chamber built here
optionExplain: No gruel is named in unit 38.
Right: अनुकूलेषु नक्षत्रादिषु.
The chamber is built in unit 37; here she enters it and waits.
Right: पुण्याहशब्देन.
questions.explain: Favourable stars and the puṇyāha utterance; no gruel, and the chamber was built in unit 37.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of स्वस्त्ययनपरा, what does धर्मपरः mean?
optionExplain: -पर does not mean against.
Right: -पर at the end of a compound = devoted to, intent on.
-पर is not a negative.
Fear would need a word such as भीत.
questions.explain: धर्म + पर = devoted to dharma, like स्वस्त्ययन + परा = devoted to auspicious rites.
questions.teaches: -पर / -परा at the end of a compound means devoted to: स्वस्त्ययनपरा.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 39, what should one insert even in a slight obstruction of stool and urine?
optionExplain: Gruel with ghee is given to drink in unit 42, not here.
Lukewarm oil is for anointing in unit 46.
Right: फलवर्तीः प्रणिदध्यात्: one should insert phalavartis.
A powder of drugs is given in unit 44.
questions.explain: Even a slight obstruction calls for phalavartis.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put the words of unit 39 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Even in a slight, and, obstruction of stool and urine, phalavartis, one should insert.
questions.rule: स्वल्पे → अपि च → विण्मूत्रविबंधे → फलवर्तीः → प्रणिदध्यात्.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 39 to its meaning.
questions.explain: विट् + मूत्र + विबन्ध: obstruction of stool and urine; the phalavarti is a wick-like roll.
questions.teaches: विबन्ध = obstruction: विण्मूत्रविबन्ध = obstruction of stool and urine.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which split of स्वल्पेऽपि is right?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give स्वल्पोऽपि, with ओ, not ए.
अ + अ would give स्वल्पापि, with no ऽ.
पि is not a word; the word is अपि (even).
Right: ए + अ → ए with the अ dropped, marked by the avagraha (ऽ).
questions.explain: स्वल्पे (in a slight) + अपि (even): the अ of अपि is dropped after ए and marked ऽ.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which statements does unit 39 make?
options: It names the substance phala as a known drug
Even a slight obstruction is enough reason
Both stool and urine are named
It says where the phalavarti is inserted
optionExplain: The note: the substance phala is not specified here.
Right: स्वल्पेऽपि, even in a slight one.
Right: विट् and मूत्र, in विण्मूत्रविबन्धे.
The note: the insertion site is not stated.
questions.explain: Slight obstruction of stool and urine; the substance and the site are not stated.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of स्वल्पेऽपि, how is ग्रामे + अपि (even in the village) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: ए + अ → एऽ, as स्वल्पे + अपि.
A final ए before अ keeps ए and drops the अ; it does not become अय्.
The ए does not vanish before अ.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ (ग्रामः + अपि), not from ए.
questions.explain: ग्रामे + अपि = ग्रामेऽपि, like स्वल्पे + अपि = स्वल्पेऽपि.
questions.teaches: A word-final ए before अ stays ए and the अ is dropped, marked ऽ: स्वल्पे + अपि → स्वल्पेऽपि.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 40, which of these is a sign that delivery is near?
options: A belly grown firm and tight
optionExplain: The unit says the opposite: अन्नानभिलाषः, no desire for food.
Right: क्लमो ग्लानिः: the first two signs named.
The unit says the opposite: अधोगुरुत्वम्, heaviness below.
The unit says the opposite: शिथिलकुक्षिता, a loose belly.
questions.explain: Exhaustion and weariness open the list of signs.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put these signs of unit 40 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Exhaustion, weariness, eyes as if loosened, much spitting, urine and stool, loose belly, heaviness below.
questions.rule: क्लमः → ग्लानिः → मुक्तबन्धने इवाक्षिणी → निष्टीविका... बाहुल्यम् → शिथिलकुक्षिता → अधोगुरुत्वम्.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each sign named in unit 40 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five of the signs of near delivery.
questions.teaches: अन्- negates before a vowel: अभिलाष (desire) → अनभिलाष (lack of desire).
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Why is क्लमः printed क्लमो before ग्लानिः in unit 40?
options: ओ is the dual ending of क्लम
अः becomes ओ before every consonant
अः before voiced ग becomes ओ
optionExplain: क्लमः is nominative singular in the data, not dual.
Before an unvoiced consonant (क, त, प ...) it does not become ओ.
Right: Visarga after अ before a voiced sound: अः → ओ.
The vocative of क्लम would be क्लम; the data reads nominative.
questions.explain: क्लमः + ग्लानिः = क्लमो ग्लानिः: ग is voiced.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: A woman near delivery has no wish to eat. Which word of unit 40 names this?
optionExplain: This is heaviness below.
This is looseness of the belly.
This is exhaustion.
Right: अन्न (food) + अनभिलाष (lack of desire).
questions.explain: No desire for food = अन्नानभिलाषः.
questions.rule: अन्न + अनभिलाष = lack of desire for food.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of क्लमो ग्लानिः, how is रामः + गच्छति (Rāma goes) written?
optionExplain: Right: अः before the voiced ग becomes ओ.
Before a voiced consonant the visarga after अ does not stay.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, not after अ.
अः does not become आ.
questions.explain: रामः + गच्छति = रामो गच्छति, like क्लमः + ग्लानिः = क्लमो ग्लानिः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: क्लमः + ग्लानिः → क्लमो ग्लानिः.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 41, what flows after that?
options: Hot water poured over her body
Lukewarm oil rubbed on her back
optionExplain: Hot water is sprinkled on her in unit 42; it is not a flow here.
Right: गर्भोदकप्रवाहः: flow of the water of the embryo (probably amniotic fluid).
Abundance of urine and stool is a sign in unit 40.
Lukewarm oil is unit 46.
questions.explain: The water of the embryo flows.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put the words of unit 41 in the line's order.
questions.explain: After that, of the āvīs, the appearance, the flow of the water of the embryo, and.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 41 to its meaning.
pairs: water of the embryo (probably amniotic fluid)
questions.explain: Two events after that: appearance of the āvīs, flow of the garbhodaka.
questions.teaches: प्रादुर्भाव = appearance, coming forth; प्रवाह = flow.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which split of गर्भोदक is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga; अः + उ would not give ओ here.
दक is not a word; the word is उदक (water).
Right: अ + उ → ओ: गर्भ + उदक = गर्भोदक.
ओदक is not a word, and अ + ओ would give औ.
questions.explain: गर्भ (embryo) + उदक (water): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which statements does unit 41 make?
options: No verb is printed in the line
It gives the hours the flow lasts
optionExplain: Right: the note says there is no verb, and none is supplied.
The identification labour pains is only probable.
No time is given.
Right: तदनन्तरमावीनां प्रादुर्भावः.
questions.explain: A verbless line: after that, the āvīs appear and the garbhodaka flows.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of गर्भोदक, how is हित + उपदेशः (good advice) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + उ does not give औ.
The अ is not simply dropped before उ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as गर्भ + उदक.
questions.explain: हित + उपदेशः = हितोपदेशः, like गर्भ + उदक = गर्भोदक.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by उ joins as ओ: गर्भ + उदक → गर्भोदक.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 42, what is she made to drink?
optionExplain: Right: सघृतां यवागूं पाययेत्.
No milk is named in unit 42.
Hot water is sprinkled on her, not drunk.
Lukewarm oil is for anointing in unit 46.
questions.explain: She drinks gruel with ghee.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put her five descriptions in unit 42 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Embryo come forward, rites done, fruit in hand, well anointed, sprinkled with hot water.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each description in unit 42 to its meaning.
pairs: with a male-named fruit in hand
questions.explain: Four descriptions of her and the drink she is given.
questions.rule: उपस्थितगर्भा, पुंनामफलहस्ता, स्वभ्यक्ता, उष्णोदकपरिषिक्ता, सघृता यवागू.
questions.teaches: स- = with: सघृता = with ghee.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which split of अथैनाम् is right?
optionExplain: अथ has no visarga; अः + ए would leave अथ एनाम्.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ: अथ + एनाम् = अथैनाम्.
अथै and नाम् are not the words here; एनाम् = her.
अथे is not a word, and ए + न would give no ऐ.
questions.explain: अथ (then) + एनाम् (her): अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which of these is NOT among her preparations in unit 42?
options: Being given smoke of birch bark
Having done kautuka and auspicious rites
optionExplain: Named in unit 42: स्वभ्यक्ताम्.
Named in unit 42: उष्णोदकपरिषिक्ताम्.
Right: That is unit 45, not unit 42.
Named in unit 42: कृतकौतुकमङ्गलाम्.
questions.explain: Smoke of birch bark comes later, in unit 45.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of स्वभ्यक्ता (सु + अभ्यक्ता), how is सु + आगतम् (welcome) written?
optionExplain: उ and आ are not left side by side.
उ + आ does not give ओ.
The उ becomes व्, with no अ after स.
Right: उ + a different vowel → व्: सु + आगतम् = स्वागतम्.
questions.explain: सु + आगतम् = स्वागतम्, like सु + अभ्यक्ता = स्वभ्यक्ता.
questions.teaches: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: सु + अभ्यक्ता → स्वभ्यक्ता.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 43, how do the attending women speak to her?
options: In silence, saying nothing at all
With stern orders to push at once
optionExplain: Right: सूनृताभिर्वाणीभिराश्वासयन्त्यः.
The unit names words (वाणीभिः) that comfort her.
The words are pleasant and true, and they comfort her.
Puṇyāha is named in unit 38, not here.
questions.explain: They comfort her with pleasant, true words.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Put these descriptions of the women in unit 43 in the line's order.
questions.explain: New clothes, trustworthy, pleasant to see, older, bold, nails cut.
questions.rule: अहतवाससः → अशङ्कनीयाः → प्रियदर्शनाः → परिणतवयसः → प्रगल्भाः → कृत्तनखाः.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 43 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Her posture and four qualities of the women.
questions.teaches: अहत = unworn, new: अहतवाससः = women in new clothes.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: Which split of अहतवाससोऽशङ्कनीयाः is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give आ (अहतवाससाशङ्कनीयाः), not ओऽ.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ: the अ of अशङ्कनीयाः is dropped and marked ऽ.
ए + अ would give एऽ (अहतवाससेऽशङ्कनीयाः), not ओऽ.
No अ follows, so no ओ and no ऽ would appear.
questions.explain: अहतवाससः (in new clothes) + अशङ्कनीयाः (trustworthy).
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 43, on what does the woman in labour lie?
options: A raised cot spread with a white cloth
A bed of grass laid close to the fire
A soft ground-bed with a red bull's hide
A low seat, sitting with her back upright
optionExplain: The bed is on the ground (भूमिशयन), covered with hide.
Grass and fire are not named in unit 43.
Right: सुरक्तार्षभचर्मप्रच्छदे मृदुनि भूमिशयने.
She lies face upward (उत्तानाम्), not seated.
questions.explain: A soft ground-bed with a very red bull's hide covering.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By the rule of अहतवाससोऽशङ्कनीयाः, how is रामः + अपि (Rāma too) written?
optionExplain: अः + अ does not give आ.
र् appears after vowels other than अ/आ, not after अ.
Before अ the visarga after अ does not stay.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.explain: रामः + अपि = रामोऽपि, like अहतवाससः + अशङ्कनीयाः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ before अ: अः becomes ओ and the next अ is dropped (ऽ): अहतवाससः + अशङ्कनीयाः → अहतवाससोऽशङ्कनीयाः.
questions.section: सूतिकागार, आसन्न प्रसव के लक्षण, परिचारिकाएँ

questions.q: By unit 44, in what form are the drugs given to her?
optionExplain: Right: ...चिरबिल्वचूर्णम्: the compound ends in चूर्ण, powder.
Gruel with ghee is unit 42.
Oil is unit 46.
Phalavartis are unit 39.
questions.explain: The drugs are given as a powder.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Put these drugs of unit 44 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Kuṣṭha, elā, lāṅgalī, vacā, (unclear cyanya), citraka.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 44 to the identification its data gives.
questions.explain: Five drugs with standard identifications.
questions.teaches: चूर्ण = powder: the drug names stand in one compound ending in चूर्णम्.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Which split of कुष्ठैला is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga; अः + ए would not give ऐ.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ: कुष्ठ + एला = कुष्ठैला.
इ + ए would give ये (कुष्ठ्येला), not ऐ.
ला is not a drug; the word is एला (cardamom).
questions.explain: कुष्ठ (costus) + एला (cardamom): अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Which drug of unit 44 has only a probable identification in its data?
optionExplain: Sweet flag: tagged standard.
Small cardamom: tagged standard.
Right: The data tags cirabilva (Indian elm) as probable.
Leadwort: tagged standard.
questions.explain: cirabilva = Holoptelea integrifolia is probable; the others are standard.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of कुष्ठैला, how is तत्र + एव (right there) written when joined?

questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 45, whose smoke is given?

questions.q: By the rule of रसान्यतम, how is न + अस्ति (is not) written when joined?
optionExplain: The two अ do not shrink to one short अ.

questions.q: Why is अस्याः printed अस्या before मृद्गीयात् in unit 46?

questions.q: By the -य of अभ्यज्य (having anointed), what does प्रविश्य mean, from प्र-√विश् (enter)?

questions.q: By the join एवमवाक् (एवम् + अवाक्), how is किम् + अपि (anything) written?

म् + अ gives म, not मो.

questions.q: By the order of विमुच्य ... आविशति, what does गृहं विमुच्य वनमाविशति mean?

Entering the house, he leaves the forest
He enters the forest without leaving home
Having left the forest, he enters the house

questions.q: Which split of चेदेवं is right?

questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of चेदेवम्, how is जगत् + ईशः (lord of the world) written?

Before a vowel the final त् becomes द्.
The long ई does not become short.
त् + ई does not give ते.
questions.explain: जगत् + ईशः = जगदीशः, like चेत् + एवम् = चेदेवम्.

questions.q: In unit 51, whose view is stated?

questions.q: By the -अनीय of आहनीयम्, what does करणीयम् mean, from √कृ (do)?

questions.teaches: तु sets a statement against what went before: others say so, but that is not right.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 52, what does तत् (that) point back to?
options: The view of others in unit 51
optionExplain: That is the content of unit 53, which follows.
The turning is not what the line rejects.
Right: The data note: तत् refers to the view reported in unit 51, the pestle and mortar.
The pressing comes later, in unit 55.
questions.explain: तत् = that view: striking a grain-filled mortar with a pestle.
questions.rule: तत् here = the view of others (unit 51).
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: That, however, is not right: तत्तू न ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is तत्तू न सम्यक्.
questions.teaches: सम्यक् = rightly, properly; with न it gives not right.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: In the invented line रामो गच्छति सीता तु तिष्ठति, what does तु do, as in unit 52?
options: Adds Sītā to Rāma: and also
Sets Sītā against Rāma: but, however
optionExplain: and also would be च or अपि, not तु.
A reason would be marked by हि, as in unit 53.
तु does not make a question.
Right: तु marks a contrast with what went before, as in तत् तु न सम्यक्.
questions.explain: Rāma goes; Sītā, however, stays: तु marks the contrast.
questions.teaches: तु sets one statement against another: अन्ये ... आहुः, तत् तु न सम्यक् (others say ..., but that is not right).
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 53, what is constantly prescribed for a pregnant woman?
options: Striking a mortar with a pestle
optionExplain: Right: दारुणव्यायामवर्जनम्: avoidance of severe exertion.
The line prescribes avoiding it, not doing it.
That is the view of others in unit 51, rejected in unit 52.
Walking is not named in unit 53.
questions.explain: Severe exertion is to be avoided by a pregnant woman.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Put the words of unit 53 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Avoidance of severe exertion, for, of a pregnant woman, constantly, is prescribed.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 53 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Read the compound from the end: avoidance of exertion that is severe.
questions.teaches: A tatpuruṣa is read from its last member: दारुण-व्यायाम-वर्जन = the avoidance of severe exertion.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: What kind of form is उपदिश्यते in unit 53?
optionExplain: The active would be उपदिशति.
Right: The data labels it 3 sg. pres. pass. of upa-√diś.
An optative ends in -एत्, as उपदिशेत्.
A future would have -स्य-, as उपदेक्ष्यति.
questions.explain: उपदिश्यते = is prescribed: the data labels it 3 sg. present passive (root दिश् + -य- + middle ending).
questions.rule: -य- + middle ending on the root (दिश्यते) = present passive here; but 4th-class verbs such as जायते, मन्यते also end in -यते.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 53?
options: It names one particular exercise to avoid
It is a metrical verse line
गर्भिण्याः names the person it concerns
optionExplain: No particular exercise is named, only severe exertion.
Right: सततम् उपदिश्यते, constantly prescribed.
It is a prose unit, not a verse.
Right: genitive, for a pregnant woman.
questions.explain: Constant prescription, for the pregnant woman, of avoiding severe exertion.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Built like उपदिश्यते, what does दीयते mean in the invented line औषधं रोगिणे दीयते?
optionExplain: The active would be ददाति.
should give would be an optative, दद्यात्.
Right: -यते is the present passive: medicine is given to the patient.
will give would be a future, दास्यति.
questions.explain: औषधं रोगिणे दीयते = medicine is given to the patient.
questions.teaches: A present passive ends in -यते: उपदिश्यते (is prescribed), दीयते (is given).
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 54, what might the stirred-up wind (vāyu) injure?
optionExplain: No bones are named in unit 54.
No eyes are named in unit 54.
No attendant is named in unit 54.
Right: प्राणान् हिंस्यात्: it might injure the vital breaths.
questions.explain: The danger named is harm to the vital breaths (prāṇa).
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Put these sure parts of unit 54 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Especially, at the time of delivery, of her whose dhātus and doṣas are all set in motion, because of delicacy, having found, might injure the vital breaths.
questions.rule: विशेषतश्च → प्रसवकाले → प्रचलितसर्वधातुदोषायाः → सौकुमार्यात् → लब्ध्वा → प्राणान् हिंस्यादिति.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 54 to its meaning.
questions.explain: When, why, and what might happen to whom.
questions.teaches: An ablative in -आत् can give a cause: सौकुमार्यात् = because of delicacy.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: What does the optative हिंस्यात् say in unit 54?
optionExplain: Right: The data note: हिंस्यात् states what might happen, not a certain result.
A past event would need a past form; this is an optative.
The optative here gives a possibility, not a certainty.
The line warns of harm; it orders none.
questions.explain: हिंस्यात् = might injure: a possibility, the reason for the caution.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: In unit 54, whose dhātus and doṣas are all set in motion?
optionExplain: The compound is feminine; गर्भ (fetus) is masculine.
Right: प्रचलितसर्वधातुदोषायाः is feminine genitive: of her (the woman in labour).
वायुः is the subject that is stirred up, not the one described.
No striker is named in this compound.
questions.explain: The bahuvrīhi is feminine genitive: of her whose dhātus and doṣas are all in motion.
questions.rule: प्रचलित-सर्व-धातु-दोषा = she in whom all dhātus and doṣas are set in motion.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By the rule of हिंस्यादिति, how is भवेत् + इति (thus it might be) joined?
optionExplain: त् does not stay unvoiced before a vowel in sandhi.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal, not before इ.
Right: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel, as हिंस्यात् + इति → हिंस्यादिति.
त् becomes च् only before च or छ.
questions.explain: भवेत् + इति = भवेदिति, like हिंस्यात् + इति = हिंस्यादिति.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel: हिंस्यात् + इति → हिंस्यादिति.
questions.section: गर्भ का घूमना और मूसल-प्रहार का खंडन

questions.q: By unit 55, with what does the skilled woman press the two buttocks?
options: With a cloth soaked in oil
optionExplain: Hands are not named; the line says पादाभ्याम्, with the feet.
The pestle belongs to the rejected view of unit 51.
No cloth or oil is named in unit 55.
Right: स्फिजौ पादाभ्यां पीडयेत्: she should press the buttocks with the feet.
questions.explain: The two buttocks are pressed with the two feet.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 55 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Her whose fetus has turned, placing her on the paryaṅka, from the foot-side of her seated, anointing the yoni in the natural direction, comfortably, she should press the buttocks with the feet.
questions.rule: परिवृत्तगर्भां → पर्यंकमेनामारोप्य → पादतोऽस्या निषण्णाया → योनिमनुलोममनुसुखमभ्यज्य → स्फिजौ पादाभ्यां पीडयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 55 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Who acts, on whom, and what she does.
questions.rule: परिवृत्तगर्भा, कुशला स्त्री, अभ्यज्य, स्फिजौ, पीडयेत्.
questions.teaches: परिवृत्तगर्भा is a bahuvrīhi: she whose (गर्भ) fetus has (परिवृत्त) turned.

questions.q: Which split of पादतोऽस्या is right?
optionExplain: Right: अः + अ → ओ with the next अ dropped (ऽ); अस्याः loses its visarga before न of निषण्णाया.
ए + अ would keep ए: it would read पादतेऽस्याः.
आ + अ would merge into आ: पादतास्याः, with no ओ.
स्याः is not the word; ऽ marks the dropped अ of अस्याः.
questions.explain: पादतः (from the foot-side) + अस्याः (of her).

questions.q: Which statements does unit 55 support?
options: The substance used for anointing is named (स्नेहद्रव्य)
The anointing goes in the natural direction (अनुलोम)
The line says how long to press (काल)
optionExplain: No substance is named in unit 55.
Right: निषण्णायाः, as she sits.
Right: योनिम् अनुलोमम् अभ्यज्य.
No duration is given.
questions.explain: Seated, anointed in the natural direction; no substance and no duration are named.

questions.q: By the rule of आरोप्य and अभ्यज्य, what is the absolutive (having entered) of प्र + √विश्?
optionExplain: -त्वा is used without a prefix; with प्र the ending is -य.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य, as आ-रोप्य, अभि-अज्य.
प्रविष्टः is a past participle, entered, not an absolutive.
प्रविशति is the present, enters.
questions.explain: प्र + √विश् → प्रविश्य, having entered, like आरोप्य and अभ्यज्य.
questions.teaches: With a prefix the absolutive ends in -य (आरोप्य, अभ्यज्य); without a prefix in -त्वा (लब्ध्वा).

questions.q: By unit 56, what should be done to the yoni again and again?
options: It should be washed with cold water
It should be bound with cloth
optionExplain: No washing or water is named in unit 56.
No cloth is named in unit 56.
Right: योनिं च पुनःपुनः प्रसारयेत्.
The line asks for stretching, again and again.
questions.explain: The yoni is to be stretched out again and again.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 56 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words: what, how often, what to do.

questions.q: And she should stretch out the yoni again and again: योनिं च पुनःपुनः ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is योनिं च पुनःपुनः प्रसारयेत्.
questions.teaches: प्रसारयेत् = should stretch out: causative of प्र-√सृ with the optative ending -एत्.

questions.q: Who is the subject of प्रसारयेत् in unit 56?
options: The pregnant woman, named in the line
Unstated; the skilled woman of unit 55
optionExplain: No woman is named in unit 56; only the yoni is.
अन्या appears in unit 58, not here.
No physician is named in unit 56.
Right: The data note: the subject (the skilled woman) is not stated here.
questions.explain: The verb has no stated subject; it carries on from the skilled woman of unit 55.
questions.rule: Subject of प्रसारयेत् = understood from unit 55.

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 56?
options: The line says how the stretching is done
प्रसारयेत् is an optative: should stretch out
The line names an oil for it
optionExplain: Right: again and again.
The data note: it does not say how.
Right: the -एत् ending.
No oil is named in unit 56.
questions.explain: Repeated stretching is asked; the manner is not given.
questions.rule: पुनःपुनः प्रसारयेत् = should stretch out again and again.

questions.q: Built like प्रसारयेत्, which form of धारय- (cause to hold) means should hold?
optionExplain: Right: -एत् on the causative stem gives the optative, as प्रसारय- → प्रसारयेत्.
धारयति is the present, holds.
धारयित्वा is an absolutive, having held.
धारयन् is a present participle, holding.
questions.explain: धारय- + -एत् = धारयेत्, should hold, like प्रसारयेत्.
questions.teaches: The optative third singular of अ-stem and causative verbs ends in -एत् (should ...): प्रसारयेत्, पीडयेत्, धारयेत्; other verbs take -यात् (ब्रूयात्, हिंस्यात्).

questions.q: By unit 57, how is the woman in labour told to bear down?
options: With all her force at once
optionExplain: The line says शनैः शनैः, gently.
Right: शनैः शनैः प्रवाहयस्व: bear down gently, gently.
No breath-holding is named in unit 57.
No physician is named in unit 57.
questions.explain: She is told to bear down gently, step by step.
questions.rule: शनैः शनैः प्रवाहयस्व = bear down gently, gently.

questions.q: Put these printed words of unit 57 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And she should say: O fortunate one, gently gently bear down; ... face-colour ... a son.
questions.rule: ब्रूयाच्च → सुभगे → शनैः शनैः → प्रवाहयस्व → मुखवर्णः → पुत्रं.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 57 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Who speaks, to whom, and what she is told.
questions.teaches: सुभगे is a vocative (f. sg.): a word of address, O fortunate one.

questions.q: Which word of unit 57 is a command addressed to the woman herself?
optionExplain: 3 sg. optative: she (the attendant) should say; an instruction about the attendant.
A vocative, O fortunate one: an address, not a command.
Right: 2 sg. imperative: bear down (you).
A noun, colour of the face; no command.
questions.explain: प्रवाहयस्व is the second-person imperative: the woman is told to bear down.

questions.q: In unit 57, who speaks these words to the woman in labour?
optionExplain: She is the one addressed (सुभगे), not the speaker.
No husband is named in unit 57.
The mantra comes in unit 58, from another woman.
Right: Probable, by the data note: ब्रूयात् names no speaker; the data note: the speaker (the attendant) addresses the woman in labour.
questions.explain: ब्रूयात् (she should say): the attendant speaks, the woman in labour is addressed.

questions.q: By the rule of ब्रूयाच्च, how is तत् + च (and that) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A final त् before च becomes च्: त् + च → च्च.
त् becomes द् before a voiced sound; च is unvoiced.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
त् becomes ज् only before ज or झ.
questions.explain: तत् + च = तच्च, like ब्रूयात् + च = ब्रूयाच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् before च becomes च्: ब्रूयात् + च → ब्रूयाच्च.

questions.q: By unit 58, into which ear is the mantra muttered?
optionExplain: The line says वाम, left.
Right: वामकर्णेऽस्याः: in her left ear.
Only one ear is named: the left.
अस्याः = her, the woman in labour.
questions.explain: The mantra is muttered into the left ear of the woman in labour.

questions.q: Put the first six names of the mantra in unit 58 in order.
questions.explain: Earth, water, sky, fire, wind, Viṣṇu (then Prajāpati).
questions.rule: क्षितिः → जलम् → वियत् → तेजः → वायुः → विष्णुः.

questions.q: Match each name in the mantra of unit 58 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The first five names of the mantra.
questions.teaches: वियत् = sky, space; तेजस् = fire: two less common names in the list.

questions.q: Why is तेजः printed तेजो before वायुः in unit 58?
options: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ
A visarga after अ becomes र् before व
optionExplain: It is nominative, a name in the list; not an address.
तेजः is singular; ओ comes from the sandhi.
Right: तेजः + वायुः → तेजो वायुः: व is voiced.
That would give तेजर्वायुः; after अ it becomes ओ.
questions.explain: तेजः + वायुः = तेजो वायुः: visarga after अ before a voiced sound → ओ.

questions.q: In unit 58, who mutters the mantra?
optionExplain: The mantra goes into her ear (अस्याः), so she hears it.
अन्या is feminine; no priest is named.
No husband is named in unit 58.
Right: अन्या is feminine: another woman, the noun not stated.
questions.explain: अन्या तु ... जपेत्: another woman should mutter it.

questions.q: By the rule of क्षितिर्जलम्, how is मतिः + दृढा (the mind is firm) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga after इ becomes र् before a voiced sound, as क्षितिः + जलम्.
The vowel is lengthened with the visarga dropped only before र.
स् comes only before त or थ.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: मतिः + दृढा = मतिर्दृढा, like क्षितिः + जलम् = क्षितिर्जलम्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ becomes र् before a voiced sound: क्षितिः + जलम् → क्षितिर्जलम्.

questions.q: In unit 59, what is the woman told to do in the second line?
optionExplain: No resting is named in unit 59.
Right: प्रसूष्व त्वम्: give birth, you.
No fast is named in unit 59.
No silence is named in unit 59.
questions.explain: The second line tells her: give birth, unharmed.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 59 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: You with the fetus, may (it) protect at all times, or also grant freedom from the dart; give birth, you unharmed ... , O fair-faced one.
questions.rule: सगर्भां त्वां → सदापातु → वैशल्यं वा दधात्वपि → प्रसूष्व → त्वमविक्ळिष्टमविक्ळिष्टा → शुभानने.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 59 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The wishes, the command and the address.
questions.teaches: -तु is the third-person imperative (may it ...): पातु, दधातु; प्रसूष्व is a second-person command.

questions.q: Which split of दधात्वपि is right?
optionExplain: इ + अ would give य्: दधात्यपि.
ओ + अ would give दधातोऽपि.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: दधातु + अपि → दधात्वपि.
पि is not a word; the particle is अपि.
questions.explain: दधातु (may it grant) + अपि (also).
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + that vowel.

questions.q: In unit 59, which word calls the mother herself unharmed?
optionExplain: Not feminine nominative; the data reads it with the son, or as an adverb.
A vocative, O fair-faced one: an address, not unharmed.
Freedom from the dart: a thing granted, not her state.
Right: Feminine nominative singular, with त्वम् (you): you, unharmed.
questions.explain: अविक्लिष्टा agrees with त्वम्: the mother herself is to be unharmed.

questions.q: By the rule of दधात्वपि, how is मधु + अस्ति (there is honey) joined?
optionExplain: Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्, as दधातु + अपि → दधात्वपि.
उ is lengthened only before another उ.
उ does not become ओ before अ.
The अ of अस्ति is not simply dropped.
questions.explain: मधु + अस्ति = मध्वस्ति, like दधातु + अपि = दधात्वपि.
questions.teaches: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: दधातु + अपि → दधात्वपि.

questions.q: By unit 60, whose splendour is the son wished to have?
optionExplain: Indra is not named in unit 60.
Right: कार्तिकेयद्युतिं पुत्रम्: a son with the splendour of Kārtikeya.
The sun is not named in unit 60.
No father is named in unit 60.
questions.explain: Kārtikeya is named twice: for the splendour and for the protection.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 60 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Having Kārtikeya's splendour, a son, protected by Kārtikeya: thus.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 60 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The son, his two qualities, and the closing word.
questions.teaches: इति at the end closes a quotation or mantra: here the mantra begun in unit 58 ends.

questions.q: How do the two compounds of unit 60 differ?
options: द्युति one is tatpuruṣa, अभिरक्षित one bahuvrīhi
द्युति one is bahuvrīhi, अभिरक्षित one tatpuruṣa
optionExplain: The data labels them the other way round.
Neither lists items joined by and.
Right: कार्तिकेयद्युति = (a son) whose splendour is Kārtikeya's; कार्तिकेयाभिरक्षित = protected by Kārtikeya.
Only the second means protected; the first means splendour.
questions.explain: One describes the son by what he has (bahuvrīhi); the other says by whom he is protected (tatpuruṣa).

questions.q: What does इति at the end of unit 60 do?
options: It turns the line into a question
optionExplain: इति closes; the new mantra is introduced by तथा in unit 61.
Here it marks the end of the quoted words.
इति does not make a question.
Right: The data note: the closing इति ends the mantra.
questions.explain: इति marks the end of the quoted mantra.

questions.q: By the rule of कार्तिकेयाभिरक्षितम्, how is राम + अभिरक्षितः (protected by Rāma) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as कार्तिकेय + अभिरक्षितम् → कार्तिकेयाभिरक्षितम्.
The two अ merge into a long आ; neither is lost.
अ + इ gives ए; here the second vowel is अ.
अ + उ gives ओ; here the second vowel is अ.
questions.explain: राम + अभिरक्षितः = रामाभिरक्षितः.
questions.teaches: अ + अ → आ: कार्तिकेय + अभिरक्षितम् → कार्तिकेयाभिरक्षितम्.

questions.q: What does unit 61, the single word तथा, mean?
optionExplain: Negation would need न.
Right: तथा = likewise, in the same way.
here would be इह or अत्र.
when would be यदा.
questions.explain: तथा = likewise.

questions.q: What kind of unit is 61?
options: A prose line of one word
optionExplain: One word is not a metrical line.
No names are in unit 61.
Right: The data type is prose: the single word तथा.
Unit 61 has no verb.
questions.explain: Unit 61 is one indeclinable on its own printed line.

questions.q: Likewise: ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The whole unit is तथा.
questions.teaches: तथा = likewise, so; an indeclinable, the partner of यथा (as).

questions.q: Which word means as and pairs with तथा (so) in Sanskrit?
optionExplain: यदा means when; its partner is तदा.
तदा means then, the partner of यदा.
अथ means now, then: it opens a topic.
Right: यथा ... तथा = as ... so.
questions.explain: यथा ... तथा = as ... so.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 61 are right?
options: It has no verb of its own
optionExplain: Right: the data labels it ind.
No deity is named in unit 61.
Right: one word, no verb.
It is prose.
questions.explain: One indeclinable, no verb, prose.

questions.q: In the invented line यथा गुरुस्तथा शिष्यः, what does तथा mean?
optionExplain: Right: यथा ... तथा = as the teacher, so the pupil.
when would be यदा.
not would be न.
here would be इह or अत्र.
questions.explain: As the teacher, so the pupil: तथा answers यथा.
questions.teaches: तथा (so, likewise) answers यथा (as): यथा गुरुस्तथा शिष्यः, as the teacher, so the pupil.

questions.q: By unit 62, where are they asked to dwell?
optionExplain: No forest is named in unit 62.
Right: मन्दिरे निवसन्तु: may they dwell in the house.
No sky is named in unit 62.
No sea is named in unit 62.
questions.explain: The wish is that they dwell in the house.
questions.rule: मन्दिरे निवसन्तु = may they dwell in the house.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 62 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: Here nectar, and Soma, and Citrabhānu, O lady; and Uccaiḥśravas the horse; in the house may they dwell.
questions.rule: इहामृतं → चसोमश्च → चित्रभानुश्च → भामिनि → उच्चैःश्रवाश्च तुरगो → मंदिरे निवसंतुते.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 62 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What dwells, where, and the address to the woman.
questions.teaches: -अन्तु is the third-person plural imperative: निवसन्तु = may they dwell.

questions.q: Which split of उच्चैःश्रवाश्च is right?
optionExplain: With a short final अ the join would be उच्चैःश्रवच, with no श्.
श्च is not a word; the particle is च.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्: श्रवाः + च → श्रवाश्च.
ए + च would stay उच्चैःश्रवे च.
questions.explain: उच्चैःश्रवाः (the horse's name) + च (and).

questions.q: In unit 62, what is Uccaiḥśravas called?
optionExplain: No river is named in unit 62.
The line says तुरगः, horse.
The line says तुरगः, horse.
Right: उच्चैःश्रवाश्च तुरगः: Uccaiḥśravas, the horse.
questions.explain: तुरगः = horse: the line names Uccaiḥśravas as a horse.

questions.q: By the rule of सोमश्च, how is बालः + च (and the boy) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before च becomes श्, as सोमः + च → सोमश्च.
अः → ओ comes before a voiced sound; च is unvoiced.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, and before voiced sounds.
स् comes before त or थ, not before च.
questions.explain: बालः + च = बालश्च, like सोमः + च = सोमश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च becomes श्: सोमः + च → सोमश्च, उच्चैःश्रवाः + च → उच्चैःश्रवाश्च.

questions.q: By unit 63, from what was the nectar (amṛta) drawn up?
optionExplain: No sky is named in unit 63.
Right: अमृतम् अपां समुद्धृतम्: nectar drawn up from the waters.
No milk is named in unit 63.
No moon is named in unit 63.
questions.explain: The nectar is drawn up from the waters.
questions.rule: अपां समुद्धृतम् = drawn up from the waters.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 63 in the line's order.
questions.explain: This nectar of the waters, drawn up indeed, your, quickly, this fetus, may it release, O woman.
questions.rule: इदममृतमपां → समुद्धृतं वै → तव → लघु → गर्भमिमं → प्रमुंचतु स्त्रि.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 63 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What, from where, and what it is asked to do.
questions.teaches: प्रमुञ्चतु is a third-person imperative: may it release.

questions.q: Which form addresses the woman in unit 63?
optionExplain: The nominative, woman, as a subject.
The accusative, woman, as an object.
Right: The vocative of स्त्री: O woman.
Genitive or ablative: of or from the woman.
questions.explain: स्त्रि (short इ) is the regular vocative of स्त्री.

questions.q: In unit 63, what is the nectar asked to do?
optionExplain: Dwelling in the house is the wish of unit 62.
No attendant is named in unit 63.
The splendour of Kārtikeya is in unit 60.
Right: गर्भमिमं प्रमुञ्चतु: may it release this fetus.
questions.explain: The wish of this line: may the nectar release the fetus.

questions.q: By the rule of गर्भमिमम्, how is फलम् + अस्ति (there is fruit) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins it, as गर्भम् + इमम् → गर्भमिमम्.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not from अम्.
The म् is not dropped before a vowel.
Anusvāra stands before a consonant; and the अ of अस्ति is not lost.
questions.explain: फलम् + अस्ति = फलमस्ति, like गर्भम् + इमम् = गर्भमिमम्.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel joins it: गर्भम् + इमम् → गर्भमिमम्, इदम् + अमृतम् → इदममृतम्.

questions.q: By unit 64, what are they asked to grant?
optionExplain: A son is named in unit 60, not here.
Right: दिशन्तु शान्तिम्: may they grant peace.
No long life is named in unit 64.
No wealth is named in unit 64.
questions.explain: The mantra ends with a wish for peace.
questions.rule: दिशन्तु शान्तिम् = may they grant peace.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 64 in the line's order.
questions.explain: (Read as: therefore fire, wind, sun, Indra; corrected reading) ..., together with, the bearers of salt water, may they grant, peace: thus.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 64 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sure words of the wish.
questions.teaches: सह takes the instrumental: लवणाम्बुधरैः सह = together with the bearers of salt water.

questions.q: Which split of लवणांबुधरैर्दिशंतु is right?
optionExplain: अः before द would give ओ: लवणाम्बुधरो दिशन्तु.
आः before द would drop the visarga: लवणाम्बुधरा दिशन्तु.
Right: A visarga after ऐ becomes र् before the voiced द.
र्दिशन्तु is not a word; the verb is दिशन्तु.
questions.explain: लवणाम्बुधरैः (instrumental plural, with सह) + दिशन्तु (may they grant).

questions.q: Which word of unit 64 shows that more than one is asked to grant?
optionExplain: Accusative singular: the thing granted.
A closing particle: thus.
An indeclinable, together with; it does not mark the verb's number.
Right: 3rd plural imperative: may they grant.
questions.explain: The plural ending -अन्तु in दिशन्तु shows several subjects.

questions.q: By the rule of लवणाम्बुधरैर्दिशन्तु, how is देवैः + दत्तम् (given by the gods) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a voiced sound.
After ऐ the visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound; it is dropped only after आ (after अ it gives ओ).
स् comes only before त or थ.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: देवैः + दत्तम् = देवैर्दत्तम्, like लवणाम्बुधरैः + दिशन्तु.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound: लवणाम्बुधरैः + दिशन्तु → लवणाम्बुधरैर्दिशन्तु.

questions.q: By unit 65, who should give the instruction?
optionExplain: No physician is named in unit 65.
Right: परा is feminine: another woman should instruct.
No husband is named in unit 65.
The line says another (परा), not she herself.
questions.explain: तथा परा अनुशिष्यात्: likewise another woman should instruct.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 65 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, another (woman), should instruct.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 65 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words make the whole line.
questions.teaches: अनुशिष्यात् is an optative, 3rd person singular, of अनु-√शास्: (she) should instruct.

questions.q: Which split of पराऽनुशिष्यात् is right?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give ओऽ: परोऽनुशिष्यात्.
ए + अ would keep ए: परेऽनुशिष्यात्.
Right: आ + अ → आ; the print marks the merged अ with ऽ.
नुशिष्यात् is not a word; the verb is अनुशिष्यात्.
questions.explain: परा (another woman) + अनुशिष्यात् (should instruct).
questions.rule: आ + अ → आ (ऽ may mark the merged अ).

questions.q: Which statements about unit 65 are right?
options: The line gives the words of the instruction
The one who instructs is a woman
The person instructed is named in the line
The verb is an optative: should instruct
optionExplain: No words of the instruction are in this line.
Right: परा is feminine.
The object is not stated in the line.
Right: अनुशिष्यात्, 3rd singular optative.
questions.explain: A woman (परा) should instruct (optative); neither the person instructed nor the words are in the line.
questions.rule: तथा परा अनुशिष्यात्: who and what kind of command, nothing more.

questions.q: By the rule of पराऽनुशिष्यात्, how is सा + अत्र (she, here) joined?
optionExplain: ओऽ comes from अः + अ, as सः + अत्र, not from आ.
ए comes from अ/आ + इ, not from आ + अ.
य् comes from इ before a vowel, not from आ.
Right: आ + अ → आ, as परा + अनुशिष्यात् → परानुशिष्यात् (printed with ऽ).
questions.explain: सा + अत्र = सात्र, like परा + अनुशिष्यात्.
questions.teaches: Two अ-sounds merge into आ: परा + अनुशिष्यात् → परानुशिष्यात्, सा + अत्र → सात्र.

questions.q: By unit 66, when is she told not to bear down?
options: Once the child's head is seen
When the pain is at its height
optionExplain: Right: अनागतायां वेदनायाम्: when the pain has not come.
No head is named in unit 66.
The placenta is not named in unit 66.
The line speaks of pain not yet come.
questions.explain: Before the pain (वेदना) has come, she must not bear down.
questions.rule: अनागतायां वेदनायाम् = when the pain has not come.

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 66 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Not come, pain, do not, bear down (printed form).

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 66 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The time (two locatives) and the prohibition.
questions.teaches: Two agreeing locatives set the time of an action: अनागतायां वेदनायाम् = when the pain has not come.

questions.q: Why is the negative prefix अन्- (not अ-) in अनागतायाम्?
options: Before a vowel, अ- becomes अन्-
optionExplain: The feminine is shown by -आयाम्, not by अन्-.
Right: आगत begins with आ, so अ- becomes अन्-: अन् + आगता.
अन्- negates: अनागत = not come.
The locative is the ending -आयाम्.
questions.explain: अन् + आगतायाम् = अनागतायाम्, not yet come.
questions.rule: Negative अ- → अन्- before a vowel.

questions.q: In unit 66, what does मा do?
options: It means now, setting the time
optionExplain: The time is set by the locatives, not by मा.
Like is इव (unit 67), not मा.
Right: मा with the verb gives a prohibition: do not bear down.
And is च, not मा.
questions.explain: मा is the particle of prohibition.

questions.q: Built like अनागतायां वेदनायाम्, which phrase says when the physician (वैद्य, m.) has not come?
optionExplain: अनागतायाम् is feminine; वैद्य is masculine.
Nominative: the physician who has not come, not a time.
Instrumental: by the physician, not when.
Right: Both words in the masculine locative singular, agreeing.
questions.explain: अनागते वैद्ये = when the physician has not come, like अनागतायां वेदनायाम्.
questions.rule: Agreeing locatives = when ... (time of the action).
questions.teaches: A noun and its participle in the locative, agreeing in gender, set the time: अनागते वैद्ये, when the physician has not come.

questions.q: By unit 67, bearing down at the wrong time is likened to what?
options: Forcing out the urges of feces and urine
Holding back the urges of feces and urine
Lifting a heavy load during the labour
Fasting through the whole of labour
optionExplain: Right: विण्मूत्रादिवेगानाम् इव उदीरणम्: like forcing out those urges.
Holding back (विधारण) is the likeness of unit 68.
No load is named in unit 67.
No fasting is named in unit 67.
questions.explain: Untimely bearing down is like forcing out the natural urges.

questions.q: Put the harms named in unit 67 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Breathlessness, cough, wasting, hunchedness, and so on (आदि).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 67 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The likeness (उदीरण) and the four named harms.
questions.teaches: -कारित्वात् is an ablative of reason: because of causing (breathlessness and the rest).

questions.q: Which split of इवोदीरणम् is right?
optionExplain: That would print एवोदीरणम्, with ए.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: इव + उदीरणम् → इवोदीरणम्.
अ + ओ → औ would print इवौदीरणम्.
अः before उ would give इव उदीरणम्, unjoined.
questions.explain: इव (like) + उदीरणम् (forcing out).

questions.q: A woman strains hard at the wrong time (अकाल). How does unit 67 judge it?
options: Helpful, as it hastens the birth
Harmless, if it is done gently
Needed, so that the fetus turns
optionExplain: The line calls it useless, not helpful.
The line names no gentle exception.
Right: अनर्थकरम् अहितं च: useless and unwholesome.
Turning is not named in unit 67.
questions.explain: Untimely bearing down is useless and unwholesome and causes the harms listed.

questions.q: Built like -कारित्वात् (because of causing), which form of गुरुत्व says because of heaviness?
optionExplain: Nominative or accusative: heaviness itself.
Genitive: of heaviness.
Dative: for heaviness.
Right: The ablative in -आत् gives the reason, as -कारित्वात्.
questions.explain: गुरुत्वात् = because of heaviness, like श्वास...कारित्वात्, because of causing.
questions.teaches: An ablative in -त्वात् gives the reason: श्वासकास...कारित्वात्, because of causing breathlessness, cough and the rest.

questions.q: By unit 68, what does not bearing down when there is pain lead to?
optionExplain: Right: अप्रवाहणम् उपघाताय: not bearing down is for injury.
The line says injury, not ease.
No rest is named in unit 68.
No son is named in unit 68.
questions.explain: Holding back when the pain has come leads to injury.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 68 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, of those very, like the holding back, when there is pain, not bearing down, is for injury.
questions.rule: तथा → तेषामेव → विधारणमिव → वेदनायाम् → अप्रवाहणम् → उपघाताय.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 68 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The likeness and its result.
questions.teaches: उपघाताय is a dative of purpose: for injury, that is, it leads to injury.

questions.q: Which word of unit 68 means not bearing down?
optionExplain: Without अ- it is bearing down itself.
Right: अ (not) + प्रवाहणम् (bearing down).
Holding back: the likeness, not the act named.
For injury: the result.
questions.explain: अ- negates: अप्रवाहणम् = not bearing down.

questions.q: A woman feels strong pains but holds back from bearing down. What does unit 68 say of this?
options: It shields the fetus until the end
It is right until the head is seen
It is neither good nor harmful
optionExplain: The line calls it injurious, not protective.
No such stage is named in unit 68.
Right: वेदनायाम् अप्रवाहणम् उपघाताय, like विधारण of the urges.
The line says it is for injury.
questions.explain: Not bearing down when the pain is there is as harmful as suppressing urges.

questions.q: Built like उपघाताय (for injury), which form of आरोग्य (n.) says for health?
optionExplain: Ablative: from or because of health.
Instrumental: by health.
Genitive: of health.
Right: The dative in -आय gives the purpose, as उपघाताय.
questions.explain: आरोग्याय = for health, like उपघाताय = for injury.
questions.teaches: A dative in -आय states the purpose or result: उपघाताय, for injury; आरोग्याय, for health.

questions.q: By unit 69, how is the first bearing down to be done?
optionExplain: Right: शनैः शनैः ... पूर्वम्: gently, at first.
The line says gently, not hard.
The line says to do it, gently.
No head is named in unit 69.
questions.explain: At first, the bearing down is gentle.
questions.rule: शनैः शनैः = gently, gently; पूर्वम् = at first.

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 69 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, as stated, do, gently gently and, at first, bear down (printed form).
questions.rule: ततो → यथोक्तं → कुरुष्व → शनैः शनैश्च → पूर्वं → प्रबाहिष्टाः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 69 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The command and how and when to carry it out.
questions.teaches: कुरुष्व is the 2nd person singular middle imperative of √कृ: (you) do.

questions.q: Why is शनैः written शनैश् before च in unit 69?
options: A visarga before च becomes र्
A visarga before च becomes श्
The word itself ends in श्
A visarga before any consonant is श्
optionExplain: र् comes after a vowel other than अ/आ before a voiced sound; च is unvoiced.
Right: शनैः + च → शनैश्च.
The word is शनैः, with a visarga.
Before त it becomes स्; after ऐ before a voiced sound, र्.
questions.explain: शनैः + च = शनैश्च: visarga → श् before च or छ (before श it may stay, as in the printed शनैः शनैः).

questions.q: By the word यथोक्तम् in unit 69, how is she to act?
options: Only as the omens will show
optionExplain: The line points to what was said, not to her own wish.
यथा means as, in the same way, not against.
Right: यथा + उक्तम्: as (it was) said.
No omens are named in unit 69.
questions.explain: यथोक्तम् = यथा + उक्तम्, as stated.

questions.q: By the rule of ततो यथोक्तम्, how is रामः + याति (Rāma goes) written?
optionExplain: The visarga drops before a voiced sound after आ, not after अ.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
A visarga becomes श् before च or छ (optionally श), not before य.
Right: अः before a voiced sound → ओ, as ततः + यथोक्तम् → ततो यथोक्तम्.
questions.explain: रामः + याति = रामो याति, like ततः + यथोक्तम्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after short अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: ततः + यथोक्तम् → ततो यथोक्तम्.

questions.q: By unit 70, when is she to bear down more strongly (बाढतरम्)?
options: Before the pains of labour begin
At the very first, gentle stage
After the placenta has come out
optionExplain: Right: योनिमुखप्रतिपत्तौ बाढतरम्: on arrival at the mouth of the yoni.
Unit 70 names no stage before the pains.
बाढतरम् is the last stage here, not the first.
The stage lasts until delivery, not after it.
questions.explain: Strongly at the exit, more strongly at the mouth of the yoni, until delivery.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 70 in the line's order.
questions.explain: At the exit, strongly, of the fetus; on arrival at the mouth of the yoni, more strongly, until delivery: thus.
questions.rule: निर्गमे → बाढं → गर्भस्य → योनिमुखप्रतिपत्तौ → बाढतरम् → आप्रसवादिति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 70 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two stages and how long the second lasts.
questions.rule: निर्गमे, बाढम्, प्रतिपत्तौ, बाढतरम्, आ प्रसवात्.
questions.teaches: The suffix -तर makes a comparative: बाढम् strongly, बाढतरम् more strongly.

questions.q: In unit 70, what does the suffix -तर in बाढतरम् add?
optionExplain: Most would be -तम: बाढतमम्.
Right: -तर is the comparative suffix.
-तर raises the degree; it does not lower it.
Repetition is not the sense of -तर.
questions.explain: बाढतरम् = more strongly than बाढम्.

questions.q: The fetus has reached the mouth of the yoni. By unit 70, how should she bear down?
options: Not at all, by holding back
optionExplain: Gentle bearing down belongs to the first stage, not this one.
Unit 70 names only stronger bearing down.
Right: योनिमुखप्रतिपत्तौ बाढतरम् आ प्रसवात्.
The line says until delivery, with no pause.
questions.explain: At the mouth of the yoni the bearing down is stronger still, until the birth.

questions.q: Built like बाढतरम् from बाढम्, which word says more slowly from मन्दम् (slowly)?
optionExplain: -तम makes the superlative: most slowly.
अति- means very or too, not the comparative.
Plain slowly, without the comparative.
Right: -तर makes the comparative: more slowly.
questions.explain: मन्दम् → मन्दतरम्, like बाढम् → बाढतरम्.
questions.teaches: -तर forms the comparative: बाढम् → बाढतरम्, मन्दम् → मन्दतरम्.

questions.q: By unit 71, what cry should they raise while she bears down?
options: She has given birth: a blessed son!
Push harder, the child is near now!
Hold back, it is not yet the time!
A daughter is born to you today!
optionExplain: Right: प्रजाता प्रजाता धन्यं धन्यं पुत्रम् इति.
No such words are in unit 71.
The cry announces a birth; it gives no order.
The cry names a son (पुत्रम्).
questions.explain: The cry announces a birth and a blessed son.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 71 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of that woman, bearing down, they should make the cry: she has given birth, twice; a blessed, blessed son.
questions.rule: तस्यास्तु → प्रवाहमानायाः → स्त्रियाः → शब्दं कुर्युः → प्रजाता प्रजाता → धन्यंधन्यं पुत्रमिति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 71 to its meaning.
questions.explain: When, what is done, and the words of the cry.
questions.teaches: कुर्युः is the 3rd person plural optative of √कृ: they should make.

questions.q: Why is तस्याः written तस्यास् before तु in unit 71?
options: A visarga before त becomes श्
A visarga before त becomes स्
A visarga before त becomes र्
The word itself ends in स्
optionExplain: A visarga becomes श् before च or छ (optionally श), not before त.
Right: तस्याः + तु → तस्यास्तु.
र् never comes before an unvoiced त.
The word is तस्याः, with a visarga.
questions.explain: तस्याः (of that woman) + तु (but) = तस्यास्तु.

questions.q: By unit 71, at what time is the cry raised?
options: After the placenta has come out
Once the son has been seen
optionExplain: The placenta is not named in unit 71.
The cry is raised during bearing down.
Right: प्रवाहमानायाः is a present participle: while she bears down.
The participle says she is bearing down now.
questions.explain: The present participle places the cry in the time of bearing down.

questions.q: Built like कुर्युः (they should make), which form of √कृ says he should make?
optionExplain: 1st person singular: I should make.
2nd person singular: you should make.
Present indicative: they make.
Right: 3rd person singular optative.
questions.explain: कुर्यात् = he should make; कुर्युः = they should make.
questions.teaches: The optative of √कृ: कुर्यात् he should make, कुर्युः they should make.

questions.q: By unit 72, by what are her vital breaths (प्राण) nourished?
options: By a mantra in her ear
optionExplain: Right: हर्षेण प्राणा आप्याय्यन्ते: nourished by joy.
No food is named in unit 72.
The mantra is earlier (unit 58), not here.
No rest is named in unit 72.
questions.explain: Joy nourishes her vital breaths.

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 72 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus her, by joy, vital breaths, are nourished.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 72 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Whose, by what, what, and what happens.
questions.teaches: आप्याय्यन्ते is a present passive, 3rd plural: (they) are nourished; the agent हर्ष stands in the instrumental.

questions.q: Which split of तथाऽस्या हर्षेण is right?
optionExplain: अस्य would print short: तथास्य हर्षेण.
Right: आ + अ → आ (ऽ); आः drops its visarga before the voiced ह.
ए + अ would print तथेऽस्या.
अः + अ would print तथोऽस्या.
questions.explain: तथा (thus) + अस्याः (her) + हर्षेण (by joy).
questions.rule: आ + अ → आ; आः + voiced sound → आ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 72 are right?
options: The child's breaths are meant here
The verb is passive: are nourished
A medicine for strength is named
optionExplain: Right: हर्षेण प्राणा आप्याय्यन्ते.
अस्याः is feminine: her breaths.
Right: आप्याय्यन्ते, present passive.
No medicine is named in unit 72.
questions.explain: Her vital breaths are nourished by joy; the verb is passive.

questions.q: By the rule of प्राणा आप्याय्यन्ते, how is देवाः + आगच्छन्ति (the gods come) written?
