optionExplain: After the visarga drops, the two vowels are not joined again.
ओ comes from अः before a voiced consonant or अ, never from आः.
Right: आः drops its visarga before a vowel, and no further join is made.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
questions.explain: देवाः + आगच्छन्ति = देवा आगच्छन्ति, like प्राणाः + आप्याय्यन्ते.
questions.rule: आः + vowel → आ, with a gap.
questions.teaches: A visarga after आ drops before a vowel and the words stay apart: प्राणाः + आप्याय्यन्ते → प्राणा आप्याय्यन्ते.

questions.q: By unit 73, what is to be done to the yoni in garbha-saṅga?
options: It is to be cooled with water
optionExplain: No water is named in unit 73.
No washing is named in unit 73.
No bandage is named in unit 73.
Right: योनिं धूपयेत्: one should fumigate the yoni.
questions.explain: In garbha-saṅga the yoni is fumigated.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 73 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In garbha-saṅga, however, the yoni, one should fumigate, with black-snake slough, or with piṇḍītaka.
questions.rule: गर्भसंगे → तु → योनिं → धूपयेत् → कृष्णसर्पनिर्मोकेन → पिंडीतकेन वा.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 73 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The condition, the act and the two fumigants.
questions.teaches: वा (or) offers piṇḍītaka as an alternative to the snake slough.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which statement about piṇḍītaka in unit 73 is right?
options: The skin a snake has sloughed
optionExplain: Right: The data labels the identification probable.
The data does not call it standard.
That is निर्मोक, the other fumigant.
The data gives a probable candidate.
questions.explain: piṇḍītaka = probably emetic nut (Randia dumetorum), labelled probable.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: In garbha-saṅga no snake slough is at hand. What does unit 73 allow instead?
optionExplain: The line names a fumigant for each case.
Right: निर्मोकेन पिण्डीतकेन वा: the two are alternatives.
वा offers piṇḍītaka as the other choice.
Only the two named things are given.
questions.explain: वा (or) makes piṇḍītaka an alternative to the slough.
questions.rule: X-ena Y-ena वा = with X or with Y.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Built like निर्मोकेण (with the slough), which form of घृत (ghee, n.) says with ghee?
optionExplain: Nominative or accusative: ghee itself.
Dative: for ghee.
Right: Instrumental singular: the means, with ghee.
Genitive: of ghee.
questions.explain: घृतेन = with ghee, like निर्मोकेण, with the slough.
questions.teaches: The instrumental names the means of the act: निर्मोकेण धूपयेत्, fumigate with the slough.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 74, which part of hiraṇyapuṣpī is to be tied?
optionExplain: पुष्पी is in the plant's name; the part tied is मूल.
No leaf is named in unit 74.
No bark is named in unit 74.
Right: हिरण्यपुष्पीमूलम्: the root of hiraṇyapuṣpī.
questions.explain: The root is tied on the hand and foot.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the words of unit 74 in the line's order.
questions.explain: One should tie, and, the root of hiraṇyapuṣpī, on the hand and foot.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 74 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The act, the thing and the place.
questions.teaches: हस्तपादे is a collective (samāhāra) dvandva: hand-and-foot as one group, neuter singular, here locative.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of बध्नीयाच्च is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् + च → च्च.
A visarga before च would print बध्नीयाश्च.
म् before च would print बध्नीयाञ्च or बध्नीयांच.
च्च is not a word; the particle is च.
questions.explain: बध्नीयात् (one should tie) + च (and).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 74, where is the root tied?
optionExplain: No waist is named in unit 74.
Right: हस्तपादे: on the hand and foot (whose is not said).
No neck is named in unit 74.
No hair is named in unit 74.
questions.explain: The place is हस्तपादे, the hand and foot.
questions.rule: हस्तपादे = on the hand and foot.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of बध्नीयाच्च, how is पिबेत् + च (and one should drink) joined?
optionExplain: द् comes before voiced sounds; च is not voiced.
श् comes from a visarga before च, not from त्.
Right: त् before च becomes च्: पिबेत् + च → पिबेच्च.
त् does not stay unchanged before च.
questions.explain: पिबेत् + च = पिबेच्च, like बध्नीयात् + च = बध्नीयाच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes च् before च: बध्नीयात् + च → बध्नीयाच्च.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 75, what should be done with suvarcalā or viśalyā?
options: It should be burnt as smoke
It should be ground to paste
It should be drunk in milk
optionExplain: Fumigation is the act of unit 73.
No paste is named in unit 75.
No drink is named in unit 75.
Right: धारयेत्: one should hold.
questions.explain: The plant is to be held.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the words of unit 75 in the line's order.
questions.explain: One should hold, and, suvarcalā, viśalyā, or.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 75 to what the card says of it.
questions.explain: The act, the two plants with their labels, and the choice.
questions.teaches: Plant names keep the data's label: suvarcalā disputed, viśalyā probable (= lāṅgalī).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: In unit 75, why do सुवर्चलाम् and विशल्याम् end in -आम्?
options: Accusative: they are what is held
Locative: the holding is in them
Genitive: they are of the woman
optionExplain: Right: Feminine accusative singular, the object of धारयेत्.
The feminine locative would be -आयाम्.
The feminine genitive would be -आयाः.
The nominative would be -आ.
questions.explain: Both are objects of धारयेत्: f. acc. sg.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: A student says: viśalyā in unit 75 is certainly lāṅgalī. What should the card answer?
options: Yes: the identity is a standard one
Probably so: the label is probable
No: viśalyā is the same as suvarcalā
optionExplain: The data does not call it standard.
Right: The data tags viśalyā = lāṅgalī as probable.
They are two plants joined by वा (or).
The data gives lāṅgalī as probable.
questions.explain: viśalyā is probably lāṅgalī (Gloriosa superba); the card keeps the label probable.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Built like सुवर्चलाम् (object), what is the object form of माला (garland, f.)?
optionExplain: Nominative: the garland as subject.
Locative: in or on the garland.
Right: Feminine accusative singular in -आम्.
Genitive or ablative: of or from the garland.
questions.explain: मालां धारयेत् = one should hold (wear) the garland, like सुवर्चलां ... धारयेत्.
questions.teaches: A feminine noun in -आ takes -आम् as the object: सुवर्चला → सुवर्चलाम्, माला → मालाम्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 76, what problem is being treated?
options: The pains not coming at all
optionExplain: Turning is not the problem of unit 76.
Pains are not named in unit 76.
Milk is not named in unit 76.
Right: न चेदपरा पतति: if the placenta does not fall.
questions.explain: The procedure is for a placenta that has not come out after delivery.
questions.rule: अपरा = placenta; न पतति = does not fall.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 76 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With the right hand, from above the navel, pressing firmly, gripping from behind, one should shake.
questions.rule: दक्षिणेन पाणिना → नाभेरुपरिष्ठात् → बलवदुपपीड्य → पृष्ठत उपसंगृह्य → विधूनुयात्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 76 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The problem, the hand, the place and the two acts.
questions.rule: अपरा, दक्षिणेन पाणिना, नाभेः, उपपीड्य, विधूनुयात्.
questions.teaches: उपपीड्य and उपसङ्गृह्य are absolutives with a prefix (-य): having pressed, having gripped.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Why do उपपीड्य and उपसङ्गृह्य end in -य, not -त्वा?
options: -य marks an action still to come
-य turns the verb into a command
optionExplain: Right: उप- and उप-सम्- are prefixes, so -य, not -त्वा.
-य marks an action done before the main verb.
The command is the optative विधूनुयात्.
These are absolutives, not passives.
questions.explain: Prefixed verbs form the absolutive in -य: उपपीड्य, having pressed.
questions.rule: Absolutive: -त्वा without a prefix, -य with one.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: The placenta has already come out after the birth. Does unit 76's procedure apply?
options: Yes: it is done after every birth
No: only if it has not fallen
Yes: it hastens the next delivery
No: it is only for a fetus not turning
optionExplain: The line sets a condition with चेत् (if).
Right: न चेदपरा पतति: only if the placenta does not fall.
No next delivery is named in unit 76.
Turning is not the condition of unit 76.
questions.explain: The condition is न चेत् ... पतति: if it does not fall.
questions.rule: चेत् = if; the procedure applies only then.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of नाभेरुपरि- (नाभेः + उपरि-), how is हरेः + आज्ञा (Hari's command) joined?
optionExplain: A visarga drops before a vowel only after आ, or after अ before a vowel other than अ.
A visarga does not become स् before a vowel.
Right: A visarga after ए becomes र् before a vowel, as नाभेः + उपरि- → नाभेरुपरि-.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not from एः.
questions.explain: हरेः + आज्ञा = हरेराज्ञा, like नाभेः + उपरि- = नाभेरुपरि-.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ becomes र् before a vowel: नाभेः + उपरि- → नाभेरुपरि-.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 77, which part of the body is struck?
optionExplain: The navel is named in unit 76, not struck here.
No back is named in unit 77.
No head is named in unit 77.
Right: श्रोणिम् आकुट्टयेत्: one should strike the hip.
questions.explain: The hip region is struck.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the words of unit 77 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With the heel (printed form), or, the hip, one should strike.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each sure word of unit 77 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The choice, the place and the act.
questions.teaches: आकुट्टयेत् is a 3rd singular optative of आ-√कुट्ट: one should strike.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of श्रोणिमाकुट्टयेत् is right?
optionExplain: Right: A final म् before a vowel joins it: श्रोणिमा...
That would print श्रोणीमा... with long ई.
Visarga after इ before a vowel would print श्रोणिरा...
That would print श्रोणिमकु... with short अ.
questions.explain: श्रोणिम् (the hip) + आकुट्टयेत् (one should strike).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: What kind of statement does the optative आकुट्टयेत् make in unit 77?
optionExplain: A past tense would be needed for that.
Right: The optative gives the rule of what to do.
No मा or न stands in unit 77.
A future tense would be needed for that.
questions.explain: Like the other lines of this procedure, unit 77 instructs with an optative.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of श्रोणिमाकुट्टयेत्, how is जलम् + आनयेत् (one should bring water) joined?
optionExplain: ओऽ comes from अः + अ, not from अम्.
The म् is not dropped before a vowel.
Right: A final म् before a vowel joins it: जलम् + आनयेत्.
The आ of आनयेत् stays long.
questions.explain: जलम् + आनयेत् = जलमानयेत्, like श्रोणिम् + आकुट्टयेत्.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel joins it: श्रोणिम् + आकुट्टयेत् → श्रोणिमाकुट्टयेत्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 78, what is gripped and then pressed thoroughly?
options: The hip, struck with the heel
optionExplain: Striking the hip with the heel is unit 77, not this one.
Touching the throat and palate is unit 79.
Pressing above the navel is unit 76.
Right: स्फिजौ वोपसंगृह्य सुपीडितं पीडयेत्.
questions.explain: The two buttocks are gripped and pressed thoroughly.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the words of unit 78 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The two buttocks, or, having gripped, well pressed, one should press.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 78 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words: what, having done what, how, and the action.
questions.teaches: सुपीडितं पीडयेत् is a cognate expression: press so that it is well pressed, i.e. press thoroughly.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of वोपसंगृह्य is right?
optionExplain: Right: आ + उ → ओ: वा (or) + उपसंगृह्य (having gripped).
Neither वो nor पसंगृह्य is a word; the absolutive is उपसंगृह्य.
ए + उ does not give ओ; and वे is not the word for or.
आः drops its visarga before a vowel and no ओ arises; वाः is not the word.
questions.explain: वा (or) + उपसंगृह्य (having gripped): आ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: What does सुपीडितं पीडयेत् ask for in unit 78?
options: Pressing thoroughly, so that it is well pressed
Not pressing what is already pressed
optionExplain: सु- (well) with the same verb asks for thorough pressing, not light.
Right: The note: a cognate expression, press so that it is well pressed.
No anointing is named in unit 78.
There is no negation in the line.
questions.explain: सुपीडितम् + पीडयेत्: press thoroughly.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of वोपसंगृह्य, how is यथा + उक्तम् (as said) written when joined?
optionExplain: आ + उ does not give औ.
The आ is not simply dropped before उ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ, as वा + उपसंगृह्य → वोपसंगृह्य.
The उ is not dropped after आ.
questions.explain: यथा + उक्तम् = यथोक्तम्, like वा + उपसंगृह्य.
questions.teaches: A final आ before उ joins as ओ: वा + उपसंगृह्य → वोपसंगृह्य.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 79, what is to be touched?
optionExplain: Gripping the buttocks is unit 78.
Striking the hip is unit 77.
Pressing above the navel is unit 76.
Right: च कण्ठतालु परामृशेत्.
questions.explain: The throat (कण्ठ) and palate (तालु) are touched.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 79 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With a braid, or with a finger, wound with hair, and the throat and palate, one should touch.
questions.rule: वेण्या → अङ्गुल्या वा → केशवेष्टितया → च कण्ठतालु → परामृशेत्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 79 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two tools, what the finger is wound with, and the two places touched.
questions.teaches: कण्ठतालु is a dvandva: throat and palate, both touched.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: In unit 79, what case are वेण्या and अङ्गुल्या?
options: Instrumental singular: with a braid, with a finger
Locative singular: in a braid, in a finger
Genitive singular: of a braid, of a finger
optionExplain: Right: The data: f. inst. sg. for both.
The locative would be वेण्याम्, अङ्गुल्याम्.
The genitive is वेण्याः, अङ्गुल्याः (it would also print as -या here), but केशवेष्टितया, clearly instrumental, agrees with अङ्गुल्या: so this is instrumental.
The nominative plural would be वेण्यः, अङ्गुलयः.
questions.explain: -या here is the feminine instrumental singular: with.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which statements does unit 79 support?
options: It states what the touch brings about
The finger is wound round with thread
A braid may be used for the touch
Both throat and palate are named
optionExplain: The text states no effect of the touch.
The word is केश, hair, not thread.
Right: वेण्या, with a braid.
Right: कण्ठतालु, a dvandva.
questions.explain: A braid or a hair-wound finger; throat and palate; no effect stated.
questions.rule: वेण्याऽङ्गुल्या वा केशवेष्टितया च कण्ठतालु परामृशेत्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the form अङ्गुल्या (with a finger, from अङ्गुलि), how is with intelligence said from बुद्धि?
optionExplain: -इना is the masculine/neuter pattern (मुनिना), not the feminine.
Right: Feminine इ-stem: -इ → -या in the instrumental, as अङ्गुलि → अङ्गुल्या.
बुद्धेः is genitive or ablative: of or from intelligence.
बुद्धौ is locative: in intelligence.
questions.explain: बुद्धि → बुद्ध्या, like अङ्गुलि → अङ्गुल्या.
questions.teaches: A feminine इ- or ई-stem makes its instrumental singular in -या: अङ्गुलि → अङ्गुल्या, वेणी → वेण्या.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 80, what is to be done to the yoni?
options: It is to be anointed with ghee
It is to be washed with water
It is to be smeared with paste
optionExplain: Anointing with ghee is in unit 81, not here.
No washing is named in unit 80.
Right: योनिं धूपयेत्: one should fumigate the yoni.
Smearing comes in units 82 and 83.
questions.explain: The yoni is to be fumigated.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 80 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Birch bark ... and snake slough, the yoni, one should fumigate, or with bhūrja and guggulu.
questions.rule: भूर्जपत्र → सर्पनिर्मोकैश्च → योनिं → धूपयेत् → भूर्जगुग्गुलुभ्यां वा.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 80 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The fumigants, the action and the place.
questions.teaches: निर्मोक = slough, the cast-off skin: सर्पनिर्मोक = snake slough.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: In unit 80, what does the closing वा (or) set apart?
options: A second place to fumigate, the head
A second time of day for fumigating
A second set of fumigants: bhūrja and guggulu
optionExplain: No other place is named; the yoni is the only place.
The only verb in unit 80 is धूपयेत्.
No time of day is named in unit 80.
Right: भूर्जगुग्गुलुभ्यां वा: or with bhūrja and guggulu.
questions.explain: Two sets of fumigants, joined by वा.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Why does भूर्जगुग्गुलुभ्याम् take a dual ending?
options: It names two drugs, bhūrja and guggulu
It names the two hands of the helper
It is plural, for many kinds of resin
It names two snakes and their sloughs
optionExplain: Right: A dvandva of two members takes the dual: inst. du., with the two.
No hands are named in unit 80.
-भ्याम् is a dual ending, not plural.
The snake slough is in the first set, inst. pl.
questions.explain: भूर्ज + गुग्गुलु: two members, dual instrumental.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of सर्पनिर्मोकैश्च, how is रामः + च (and Rāma) written when joined?
optionExplain: अः → ओ only before a voiced sound; च is voiceless.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्, as सर्पनिर्मोकैः + च → सर्पनिर्मोकैश्च.
र् comes from a visarga after vowels other than अ/आ, and only before voiced sounds.
The visarga is not simply dropped before च.
questions.explain: रामः + च = रामश्च, like सर्पनिर्मोकैः + च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च/छ becomes श्: सर्पनिर्मोकैः + च → सर्पनिर्मोकैश्च.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 81, the ghee (सर्पिस्) is cooked with what?
options: Bhūrja bark and guggulu resin together
A paste of jaggery and dry ginger
The root of śāli, a rice variety
The leaves of the neem tree
optionExplain: Bhūrja and guggulu are fumigants in unit 80.
That paste is unit 83.
Right: शालिमूलसिद्धेन सर्पिषा: ghee cooked with the śāli root.
Neem is a fumigant here; no leaves or cooking with it.
questions.explain: Ghee cooked with śāli root.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 81 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With śāli-root-cooked, or, ghee, having anointed the yoni, ... with snake slough one should fumigate.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 81 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What the ghee is cooked with, the ghee itself, and one sure fumigant.
questions.teaches: शालिमूलसिद्ध = cooked (सिद्ध) with the root (मूल) of śāli: a tatpuruṣa.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of सर्पनिर्मोकैर्धूपयेत् is right?
optionExplain: अः before a voiced sound would give ओ: सर्पनिर्मोको धूपयेत्.
A final म् would give सर्पनिर्मोकं धूपयेत्, with no र्.
र्धूपयेत् is not a word; the verb is धूपयेत्.
Right: Visarga after ऐ before the voiced ध becomes र्.
questions.explain: सर्पनिर्मोकैः (with snake sloughs) + धूपयेत् (should fumigate).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which of these are named as fumigants in unit 81?
optionExplain: Guggulu is a fumigant of unit 80, not 81.
Right: निम्ब is in the fumigant list.
Jaggery is in the paste of unit 83.
Right: सर्पनिर्मोकैः closes the fumigant list.
questions.explain: Neem and snake slough are among the fumigants of unit 81.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of सर्पनिर्मोकैर्धूपयेत्, how is देवैः + दत्तम् (given by the gods) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga after ऐ before the voiced द becomes र्.
The visarga is not simply dropped after ऐ.
स् arises only before त/थ, not before द.
ओ comes from अः, not from ऐः.
questions.explain: देवैः + दत्तम् = देवैर्दत्तम्, like सर्पनिर्मोकैः + धूपयेत्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound: सर्पनिर्मोकैः + धूपयेत् → सर्पनिर्मोकैर्धूपयेत्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 82, what is the action enjoined?
optionExplain: Fumigation is units 80 and 81.
Right: The verb of the line is आलिम्पेत्, should smear.
Eating is unit 84.
Pouring over the head is unit 85.
questions.explain: One should smear.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 82 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For one not anointed, or, mixed with kaṭu oil, made into paste, or, smeared with oil, one should smear.
questions.rule: अनभ्यक्तां वा → कटुतैलमिश्रैः → कल्कीकृतैर्वा → तैलाक्तैः → आलिम्पेत्.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 82 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sure words of the unit; their nouns are not printed.
questions.teaches: कल्कीकृत = made (कृत) into a paste (कल्क): कल्क → कल्की + कृत, the cvi form: made into what it was not before.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of तैलाक्तैरालिम्पेत् is right?
optionExplain: A final म् before a vowel would give तैलाक्तमालिम्पेत्.
रालिम्पेत् is not a word; the verb is आलिम्पेत्.
Right: Visarga after ऐ before a vowel becomes र्.
ए before आ would not give ऐरा.
questions.explain: तैलाक्तैः (with ones smeared with oil) + आलिम्पेत् (should smear).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: What does अन्- add in अनभ्यक्ताम् (unit 82)?
optionExplain: Again would be पुनः, not अन्-.
अन्- does not mean fully.
अन्- is not a prefix of time.
Right: अन् + अभ्यक्ता = not anointed.
questions.explain: अन्- before a vowel negates: अनभ्यक्ता = not anointed.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of तैलाक्त (तैल + अक्त), how is घृत + अक्त (smeared with ghee) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as तैल + अक्त → तैलाक्त.
The two अ do not merge into a single short अ.
अ + अ does not give ए.
अ + अ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: घृत + अक्त = घृताक्त, like तैल + अक्त = तैलाक्त.
questions.teaches: Two short अ join as आ: तैल + अक्तैः → तैलाक्तैः.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 83, the paste is made of what?
optionExplain: The lāṅgalī root paste is unit 85.
Right: गुडनागरकल्केन: with a paste of guḍa and nāgara.
Kuṣṭha and elā are in unit 89.
Those are fumigants in unit 80.
questions.explain: A paste of jaggery and dry ginger.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 83 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two drugs, the form of the preparation, and the link to the options.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: In unit 83, the word for paste is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: गुडनागरकल्केन = with a paste (कल्क) of jaggery and dry ginger.
questions.teaches: कल्क = paste; कल्केन = with a paste (instrumental).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which verb is understood in unit 83?
optionExplain: The note names ālimpet, not dhūpayet.
पाययेत् is the verb of unit 86; the note names ālimpet here.
Right: The note: the verb ālimpet is carried from the previous line.
The note names ālimpet, not parāmṛśet.
questions.explain: The paste is for smearing; unit 84 adds eating as a further option.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: What does the ending of कल्केन show?
optionExplain: The locative would be कल्के.
The dative would be कल्काय.
The genitive would be कल्कस्य.
Right: -एन is the instrumental singular of an अ-stem.
questions.explain: कल्केन = with (by means of) a paste.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the form कल्केन (with a paste), how is with water said from जल?
optionExplain: Right: अ-stem instrumental singular -एन, as कल्क → कल्केन.
जलस्य is genitive: of water.
जले is locative: in water.
जलाय is dative: for water.
questions.explain: जल → जलेन, like कल्क → कल्केन.
questions.teaches: An अ-stem makes its instrumental singular in -एन: कल्क → कल्केन (with a paste), जल → जलेन.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 84, what should be done with that very one?
options: It should be poured on the head
It should be used to fumigate
It should be tied to the hand
optionExplain: Pouring over the head is unit 85.
Right: तदेव वा भक्षयेत्: or one should eat that very one.
Fumigation is units 80 and 81.
Nothing is tied in unit 84.
questions.explain: That very one should be eaten.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Put the words of unit 84 in the line's order.
questions.explain: That, very, or, one should eat.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Match each word of unit 84 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words make the whole line.
questions.teaches: एव after a word stresses it: तत् एव = that very one.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which split of तदेव is right?
optionExplain: आ + ए would give ऐ: तदैव.
अ + ए would give ऐ: तदैव.
Right: त् becomes द् before a vowel: तत् + एव → तदेव.
Neither तदे nor व is the word here.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + एव (very).
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: Which statements about unit 84 are right?
options: The noun that तत् stands for is not printed
The subject is named as the woman
A new drug is named in unit 84
optionExplain: Right: the noun is not stated; most probably the paste of unit 83.
The subject is not stated; the woman is only a probable reading.
No drug is named; तत् points back.
Right: 3 sg. optative of √भक्ष्.
questions.explain: Only तत्, एव, वा and भक्षयेत्: no noun, no subject, no new drug.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By the rule of तदेव, how is एतत् + एव (this very) written when joined?
optionExplain: त् does not stay voiceless before a vowel here.
The final त् does not merge its vowel with ए into ऐ.
The त् is not dropped.
Right: त् → द् before a vowel, as तत् + एव → तदेव.
questions.explain: एतत् + एव = एतदेव, like तत् + एव = तदेव.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel: तत् + एव → तदेव.
questions.section: गर्भसंग और अपरा न गिरने के उपाय

questions.q: By unit 85, what is smeared with the lāṅgalī paste?
optionExplain: Right: पाणिमुदरं चालिम्पेत्: one should smear the hand and the belly.
The throat and palate are touched in unit 79.
The buttocks are gripped and pressed in unit 78.
The head gets the poured milk of mahāvṛkṣa, not the paste.
questions.explain: The hand and the belly are smeared.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 85 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With lāṅgalī root paste, or, hand and belly one should smear; or mahāvṛkṣa milk on the head one should pour.
questions.rule: लाङ्गलीमुलकल्केन वा → पाणिमुदरं चालिम्पेत् → महावृक्षक्षीरं वा → मूर्ध्न्यनुषेचयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 85 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The places, the liquid and the action of the two lines.
questions.teaches: क्षीर of a plant = its milky sap (latex).

questions.q: Which split of मूर्ध्न्यनुषेचयेत् is right?
optionExplain: अः + अ would give ओऽ: मूर्ध्नोऽनुषेचयेत्.
Right: इ + अ → य: मूर्ध्नि (on the head) + अनुषेचयेत्.
ए + अ would give एऽ: मूर्ध्नेऽनुषेचयेत्.
नुषेचयेत् is not a word; the verb is अनुषेचयेत्.
questions.explain: मूर्ध्नि (loc., on the head) + अनुषेचयेत् (should pour over).

questions.q: In unit 85, what is done with the milk of mahāvṛkṣa?
options: It is smeared on the belly
It is poured over the head
optionExplain: The belly gets the lāṅgalī root paste.
No drinking is named in unit 85.
Right: महावृक्षक्षीरं वा मूर्ध्न्यनुषेचयेत्.
No fumigation is named in unit 85.
questions.explain: The milk (sap) is poured over the head.

questions.q: By the rule of चालिम्पेत् (च + आलिम्पेत्), how is न + आगच्छति (does not come) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + आ does not give ए.
अ + आ does not give औ.
The long आ is not shortened away.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as च + आलिम्पेत् → चालिम्पेत्.
questions.explain: न + आगच्छति = नागच्छति, like च + आलिम्पेत्.
questions.teaches: A short अ before आ merges into आ: च + आलिम्पेत् → चालिम्पेत्.

questions.q: By unit 86, what should be done?
options: Something should be given to drink
Something should be burnt as fumes
optionExplain: Right: पाययेत्: should be given to drink (causative of √पा).
Smearing is units 82 and 85.
Eating is unit 84.
Fumigation is units 80 and 81.
questions.explain: The verb is पाययेत्: give to drink.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 86 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Any one of bilva ... maṇḍa; or a sour one hot with vyoṣa; horse-gram juice; or madhuka-pippalī cooked together.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 86 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Sure words of the four vehicles.
questions.teaches: व्योष names a group of three pungents: dry ginger, long pepper and black pepper (standard).

questions.q: What does पाययेत् mean?
optionExplain: Drinking oneself would be पिबेत्, not the causative.
Right: The causative of √पा (drink): cause to drink.
पाययेत् is an optative, not a past form.
पाययेत् is not a future form.
questions.explain: पाययेत् = should give to drink.
questions.rule: Causative: cause someone to do the action.

questions.q: Which vehicles for the drink does unit 86 name?
optionExplain: That ghee is for anointing in unit 81.
Right: कुलत्थरसेन.
Right: मधुकपिप्पलीसंपाकेन.
That milk is poured over the head in unit 85.
questions.explain: Horse-gram juice and the madhuka-pippalī cooking are two of the four vehicles.

questions.q: By पाययेत् (should make drink), what does कारयेत्, causative of √कृ (to do), mean?
options: Should have it done, cause it to be done
optionExplain: Doing oneself would be कुर्यात्.
कारयेत् is an optative, not a past form.
Right: The causative adds cause to: √कृ do → कारयेत् cause to do.
Nothing in the form says unable.
questions.explain: कारयेत् = should have it done, like पाययेत् = should have (someone) drink.
questions.teaches: A causative adds cause to: √पा drink → पाययेत् should give to drink; √कृ do → कारयेत् should have it done.

questions.q: By unit 87, what is made of the listed drugs?
optionExplain: A decoction is in unit 90.
Fumigation is units 80 and 81.
Cooked ghee is unit 81.
Right: ...उपकुञ्चिकाकल्कं वा: or a paste of these.
questions.explain: The drugs are made into a paste.

questions.q: Put the first six drugs of unit 87 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Pippalī, elā, kola, viḍa, cavya, citraka, then upakuñcikā.
questions.rule: पिप्पली → एला → कोल → विड → चव्य → चित्रक.

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 87 to its identification, with the data's label.
questions.explain: Five of the seven drugs; viḍa and upakuñcikā are left out (no sure identification).
questions.teaches: An identification keeps its label: citraka = leadwort (standard), elā = cardamom (probable).

questions.q: Which split of पिप्पल्येला is right?
optionExplain: Right: ई + ए → ये: पिप्पली + एला = पिप्पल्येला.
अ + ए would give ऐ: पिप्पलैला.
अ + ए would give ऐ: पिप्पल्यैला.
ला is not a word; the drug is एला.
questions.explain: पिप्पली (long pepper) + एला (probably cardamom).

questions.q: Which verb is understood in unit 87?
options: Should be given to drink, from unit 86
optionExplain: The note names the drinking verb of unit 86.
Right: The note: the verb is carried from the line of unit 86.
The note names the drinking verb of unit 86.
The note names the drinking verb of unit 86.
questions.explain: वा adds this paste to the drink options of unit 86.

questions.q: By the rule of पिप्पल्येला, how is नदी + एव (the river itself) written when joined?
optionExplain: ई + ए does not give ऐ.
The ए is not dropped after ई.
Right: ई + ए → ये, as पिप्पली + एला → पिप्पल्येला.
ई + ए does not give a plain ए.
questions.explain: नदी + एव = नद्येव, like पिप्पली + एला.
questions.teaches: A final ई before a different vowel becomes य्: पिप्पली + एला → पिप्पल्येला.

questions.q: By unit 88, which ear is taken out?
optionExplain: The line says दक्षिणम्, right.
कर्णम् is singular: one ear.
The line names the right ear.
Right: दक्षिणं कर्णमुद्धृत्य: having taken out the right ear.
questions.explain: The right ear of a living donkey or bull.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 88 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of a living donkey or bull, take out the right ear, put it into one of the dips, take it out after a muhūrta, give that dip to drink.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 88 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The animals, the side, the liquid and the time.
questions.teaches: A chain of absolutives (उद्धृत्य, प्रक्षिप्य, उद्धृत्य) gives the steps in order, ending in one finite verb (पाययेत्).

questions.q: Why is जीवतः printed जीवतो before दक्षिणं?
options: अः becomes ओ before a voiced sound such as द
अः becomes ओ before every consonant
The stem of the word ends in ओ
The ओ marks a dual form
optionExplain: Right: जीवतः + दक्षिणम् → जीवतो दक्षिणम्.
Before a voiceless त it gives स्त, not ओ.
The stem is जीवत्; the form is जीवतः (gen. sg.).
जीवतः here is genitive singular, of a living (one).
questions.explain: जीवतः (of a living one) + दक्षिणम् (right).

questions.q: By unit 88, what is finally given to drink?
optionExplain: The ear is taken out of the dip; it is not given.
Right: तदाप्लवनं पाययेत्: one should give that dip to drink.
The drink is the dip in which the ear stayed.
No milk is named in unit 88.
questions.explain: The dip in which the ear stayed a muhūrta.

questions.q: By उद्धृत्य and प्रक्षिप्य, what is the absolutive (having deposited) of नि + √क्षिप्?
optionExplain: -त्वा is used without a prefix; with नि the ending is -य.
निक्षिप्तः is a past participle, deposited.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive takes -य, as प्र + √क्षिप् → प्रक्षिप्य.
निक्षिपति is the present, deposits.
questions.explain: नि + √क्षिप् → निक्षिप्य, like प्रक्षिप्य.
questions.teaches: With a prefix the absolutive ends in -य: प्रक्षिप्य (having put in), निक्षिप्य (having deposited).

questions.q: By unit 89, with what is the kuṣṭha and elā paste taken?
options: With ghee cooked with śāli root
optionExplain: Horse-gram juice is a vehicle of unit 86.
That ghee is for anointing in unit 81.
The ear-dip is unit 88.
Right: कुष्ठैलाकल्कं वा सुरया.
questions.explain: The paste goes with surā.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 89 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Kuṣṭha, elā, paste, or, with surā.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 89 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two drugs, the preparation and the vehicle.
questions.teaches: कुष्ठैलाकल्क = a paste of kuṣṭha and elā: a dvandva inside a tatpuruṣa.

questions.q: Which split of कुष्ठैला is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ए → ऐ: कुष्ठ + एला = कुष्ठैला.
अः before ए drops its visarga and does not join: कुष्ठ एला.
ला is not a word; the drug is एला.
ए before ए would not give ऐ.
questions.explain: कुष्ठ (costus) + एला (probably cardamom).

questions.q: What does the ending of सुरया show?
optionExplain: The locative would be सुरायाम्.
Right: The data: f. inst. sg., with surā.
The genitive would be सुरायाः.
The nominative would be सुरा.
questions.explain: सुरया = with surā.

questions.q: By the rule of कुष्ठैला, how is तत्र + एव (there itself) written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + ए gives ऐ, not ए.
अ + ए does not give औ.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ, as कुष्ठ + एला → कुष्ठैला.
य् arises from इ/ई, not from अ.
questions.explain: तत्र + एव = तत्रैव, like कुष्ठ + एला.
questions.teaches: A short अ before ए joins as ऐ: कुष्ठ + एला → कुष्ठैला.

questions.q: By unit 90, the decoction is mixed with what?
optionExplain: No honey is named in unit 90.
No ghee is named in unit 90.
No milk is named in unit 90.
Right: सुरोन्मिश्रम्: mixed with surā.
questions.explain: The decoction is mixed with surā.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 90 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sure words of the unit.

questions.q: Join सुरा + उन्मिश्रम्: ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: आ + उ → ओ: सुरा + उन्मिश्रम् = सुरोन्मिश्रम् (printed सुरोन्मिश्रं).
questions.teaches: A final आ before उ joins as ओ: सुरा + उन्मिश्रम् → सुरोन्मिश्रम्.

questions.q: In unit 90, what does उन्मिश्रम् say about the decoction?
optionExplain: Right: The data: surā-unmiśram, mixed with surā.
उन्मिश्र means mixed, not boiled down.
उन्मिश्र means mixed, not strained.
उन्मिश्र means mixed; nothing about cold.
questions.explain: उन्मिश्रम् = mixed: the decoction is mixed with surā.

questions.q: In unit 90, what kind of preparation is कषाय?
optionExplain: A paste is कल्क, as in units 87 and 89.
Right: The note: kaṣāya here is the preparation, decoction.
Fumigation is धूप, units 80 and 81.
Oil is तैल, as in unit 82.
questions.explain: कषाय = decoction.

questions.q: By the rule of सुरोन्मिश्रम्, how is महा + उत्सवः (a great festival) written when joined?
optionExplain: आ + उ does not give औ.
The आ is not simply dropped before उ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ, as सुरा + उन्मिश्रम् → सुरोन्मिश्रम्.
The उ is not dropped after आ.
questions.explain: महा + उत्सवः = महोत्सवः, like सुरा + उन्मिश्रम्.
questions.teaches: A final आ before उ joins as ओ: सुरा + उन्मिश्रम् → सुरोन्मिश्रम्.

questions.q: By unit 91, with what is the paste of kuṣṭha and lāṅgalī root taken?
optionExplain: अन्यतरेण means one of the two, not both together.
Neither ghee nor honey is named in unit 91.
Warm water is not named in unit 91.
Right: मद्यमूत्रान्यतरेण: with either one of the two, madya or urine.
questions.explain: The paste goes with one of two liquids: madya or urine.
questions.rule: मद्य-मूत्र-अन्यतरेण = with either madya or urine.

questions.q: Put the members of unit 91 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Kuṣṭha, lāṅgalī, root, paste; then the two liquids, madya and urine.
questions.rule: कुष्ठ → लाङ्गली → मूल → कल्क → मद्य → मूत्र.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 91 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words name the paste and how it is taken.
questions.teaches: अन्यतर = one of two: मद्यमूत्रान्यतरेण = with either madya or urine, not both.

questions.q: Which split of मद्यमूत्रान्यतरेण is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: मद्यमूत्र + अन्यतरेण = मद्यमूत्रान्यतरेण.
न्यतरेण is not a word; the word is अन्यतरेण.
अः before अ would give मद्यमूत्रोऽन्यतरेण.
A final म् would give मद्यमूत्रमन्यतरेण.
questions.explain: मद्यमूत्र (madya, urine) + अन्यतरेण (with either one): अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 91 are right?
options: The animal giving the urine is named
Unit 91 states a dose of the paste
Only one of the two liquids is used
Its verb is understood from unit 86
optionExplain: Not named: the data notes the urine is not specified.
No dose is printed.
Right: अन्यतरेण, with either one.
Right: the data takes पाययेत् as carried from unit 86.
questions.explain: One of two liquids; the verb carried from unit 86; no animal and no dose named.
questions.rule: अन्यतरेण = one of two; verb पाययेत् from unit 86.

questions.q: Built like मद्यमूत्रान्यतरेण, what does a new example दुग्धजलान्यतरेण mean?
optionExplain: अन्यतर means one of two, not both together.
Right: X-Y-अन्यतरेण = with one of the two, X or Y.
No boiling is said; अन्यतर picks one of two.
अन्यतरेण does not negate; it picks one.
questions.explain: दुग्ध + जल + अन्यतरेण = with either milk or water, as मद्य + मूत्र + अन्यतरेण.
questions.rule: अन्यतरेण = with either one of the two named.
questions.teaches: A dvandva followed by अन्यतर names two choices, of which one is used: दुग्धजलान्यतरेण = with milk or water.

questions.q: By unit 92, with what is the vatsakādi powder taken?
optionExplain: Urine is an option of unit 91, not unit 92.
Ghee is not named in unit 92.
Right: मद्येन: with madya, an intoxicating drink.
Water is not named in unit 92.
questions.explain: The powder is taken with madya.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 92 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The powder of the vatsaka group, or, with madya.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 92 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words make the whole option.
questions.teaches: चूर्ण is a dry powder, a different form from the कल्क (wet paste) of unit 91.

questions.q: In unit 92, what does वत्सकादि mean?
options: Every drug in the list except vatsaka
optionExplain: -आदि adds the rest of a group; it is not vatsaka alone.
No root is named; आदि means and the rest.
-आदि includes vatsaka as the first member.
Right: -आदि = beginning with: vatsaka heads a group not listed here.
questions.explain: वत्सकादि = vatsaka and the rest of its group; the members are not named in this unit.
questions.rule: X-आदि = the group beginning with X.

questions.q: Which split of वत्सकादि is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + आ → आ: वत्सक + आदि = वत्सकादि.
दि is not a word; the word is आदि.
A visarga after अ drops before आ, giving वत्सक आदि.
A final म् would give वत्सकमादि.
questions.explain: वत्सक + आदि: अ + आ → आ.

questions.q: Built like वत्सकादिचूर्णं वा मद्येन, what does a new example पिप्पल्यादिचूर्णं मधुना mean?
options: Powder of pippalī alone, with honey
Powder of the pippalī group, with honey
Pippalī with the powder of honey
A paste of the pippalī group, with honey
optionExplain: -आदि adds the rest of a group, not pippalī alone.
Right: पिप्पली + आदि + चूर्णम्, and मधुना = with honey.
मधुना is the instrumental: with honey.
चूर्ण is a powder, not a paste (कल्क).
questions.explain: पिप्पल्यादिचूर्णम् = powder of the group beginning with pippalī; मधुना = with honey.
questions.rule: X-आदि-चूर्णम् = powder of the X group; instrumental = with.
questions.teaches: X-आदि-चूर्णम् + an instrumental: the powder of the group beginning with X, taken with that liquid.

questions.q: By unit 93, what should be made to be held?
options: A cup of the cooked decoction to drink
A cotton wad of the cooked oil
A garland of the four herbs
optionExplain: Hiṅgu is cooked into the oil; no pill is named.
The line speaks of oil and a picu, not a decoction.
Right: तैलस्य पिचुं ग्राहयेत्: a picu of the oil, made to be held.
No garland is named in unit 93.
questions.explain: A picu (cotton wad) of the cooked oil is to be held.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Put the four substances cooked into the oil of unit 93 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Śatapuṣpā, kuṣṭha, madana, hiṅgu: then siddhasya, cooked (with them).
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Match each word of unit 93 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The substances, the picu, and the verb.
questions.teaches: ग्राहयेत् is a causative optative of √ग्रह्: should cause (her) to hold.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: In unit 93, what does सिद्धस्य तैलस्य mean?
options: Of raw oil mixed with them
optionExplain: सिद्ध says cooked, not raw mixing.
The oil is cooked with them, not pressed from them.
No soaking or night is in the text.
Right: सिद्ध = cooked; the four substances are cooked into the oil.
questions.explain: -सिद्ध at the end of a list = cooked with those things.
questions.rule: X-सिद्धस्य तैलस्य = of oil cooked with X.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Which statements about unit 93 are right?
options: The picu is to be soaked for a night
The place where the picu is held is not stated
Śatapuṣpā is identified as dill for certain
The oil is cooked with śatapuṣpā, kuṣṭha, madana and hiṅgu
optionExplain: No soaking or time is in the text.
Right: the data notes the place is not stated.
Dill is probable only; fennel is also proposed.
Right: these four are named.
questions.explain: Four named substances; the place of the picu is not stated; śatapuṣpā = dill is only probable.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Built like ग्राहयेत् (should cause to hold), what does a new example भोजयेत् mean?
optionExplain: Right: भोजयेत् is the causative optative of √भुज्, as ग्राहयेत् of √ग्रह्.
That would be the plain optative भुञ्जीत, not the causative.
-एत् here is an optative, not a past form.
No future is formed; it is an optative.
questions.explain: भोजयेत् = should make (someone) eat, like ग्राहयेत् = should make (her) hold.
questions.teaches: A causative stem in -अय- with the optative -एत् means should cause to: ग्राहयेत्, भोजयेत्.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: By unit 94, what is given at the time of anuvāsana?
options: A drink of madya with powder
optionExplain: The verb is अनुवासयेत्, not आस्थापयेत्.
Right: अनुवासनकाले अनुवासयेत्: at its time, give an anuvāsana.
The picu was unit 93; here the verb is अनुवासयेत्.
No drink is named in unit 94.
questions.explain: Then, at the anuvāsana time, an anuvāsana (oil enema).
questions.rule: अनुवासयेत् = should give an oil enema.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Put the words of unit 94 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And then, her, at the time of anuvāsana, one should give an anuvāsana.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Match each word of unit 94 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words carry the whole line.
questions.teaches: एनाम् is the feminine accusative singular her; it points back to the woman of the earlier units.
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Which split of ततश्चैनाम् is right?
optionExplain: चै and नाम् are not the words; they are च and एनाम्.
अ + इ gives ए: it would read ततश्चेनाम्.
Right: Visarga before च → श्; अ + ए → ऐ: ततश्चैनाम्.
त् before च would give तच्च, not तश्च.
questions.explain: ततः (then) + च (and) + एनाम् (her).
questions.section: अपरा-पातन: बस्ति और हस्त से निकालना

questions.q: Why is अनुवासनकाले + अनुवासयेत् written कालेऽनुवासयेत्?
options: ए and अ fuse into the vowel ऐ
The ऽ marks a dropped visarga here
ए turns into य् before the अ
ए stays, the next अ drops: ऽ
optionExplain: ए + अ does not give ऐ; ऐ comes from अ + ए.
No visarga stands here; ऽ marks the dropped अ.
ए becomes अय् before some vowels, never plain य्; before अ it stays and the अ drops.
Right: Final ए before अ stays; the अ is dropped and marked by ऽ.
