questions.explain: तस्याः (her) + चेत् (if): visarga → श् before च.

questions.q: Why is स्वस्थानतः written स्वस्थानतो in unit 109?
options: A visarga becomes ओ before any sound
अः before the voiced य becomes ओ
आः before a voiced sound gives ओ
स्वस्थानतो is a separate word form
optionExplain: Before a voiceless sound it does not become ओ.
Right: स्वस्थानतः + योनिः → स्वस्थानतो योनिः.
After आ the visarga simply drops.
The word is स्वस्थानतः; only the join changes it.
questions.explain: अः before a voiced consonant (here य) → ओ.

questions.q: By the join योनिः + भ्रश्येत् → योनिर्भ्रश्येत्, how do अग्निः + दहति (fire burns) join?
optionExplain: Before a voiced sound a visarga drops only after आ (or after अ before a vowel other than अ).
ओ comes from अः, not from इः.
Right: इः before a voiced sound → इर्, as योनिः → योनिर्.
श् comes only before च, छ or श.
questions.explain: अग्निः + दहति = अग्निर्दहति, like योनिः + भ्रश्येत् = योनिर्भ्रश्येत्.
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ / आ → र् before a voiced sound.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ, उ (or any vowel but अ / आ) becomes र् before a voiced sound: योनिः + भ्रश्येत् → योनिर्भ्रश्येत्.

questions.q: By unit 110, who should place the yoni back?
optionExplain: No physician is named in unit 110.
No husband is named in unit 110.
The line says skilled woman, not any servant.
Right: कुशला स्त्री निवेशयेत्: a skilled woman should place it back.
questions.explain: कुशला स्त्री: a skilled woman does it.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 110 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, with the blood of anyone whatever, having anointed the yoni, in its proper place, a skilled woman should place it.
questions.rule: ततो → यस्य कस्यचिच्छोणितेन → अभ्यज्य योनिं → यथास्थानं → कुशला स्त्री निवेशयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 110 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words carry the procedure.
questions.teaches: यथा + स्थानम् = यथास्थानम्, an indeclinable compound: according to (its) place.

questions.q: Which split of कस्यचिच्छोणितेन is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् + श → च्श / च्छ (optional, before a vowel); the print has च्छ: कस्यचित् + शोणितेन → कस्यचिच्छोणितेन.
छोणित is no word; the word is शोणित, blood.
कस्यचि is no form; the pronoun is कस्यचित्.
ओणित is no word; the word is शोणित.
questions.explain: कस्यचित् (of anyone) + शोणितेन (with blood).
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, and optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (as printed: च्छ).

questions.q: In unit 110, what does यस्य कस्यचित् tell about the blood used?
options: Of anyone whatever: no source named
optionExplain: The line does not say her own blood.
Right: One indefinite expression: of anyone at all.
No animal is named in unit 110.
No child is named in unit 110.
questions.explain: The source of the blood is left open: anyone whatever.

questions.q: Built like अभ्यज्य (prefix + root → -य), what is the absolutive of नि + विश् (having entered)?
optionExplain: -त्वा is used without a prefix, not with नि.
-त्वा is not used after a prefix like नि.
Right: With a prefix, the absolutive ends in -य: नि + विश् → निविश्य.
The ending is -य directly on the root: निविश्य.
questions.explain: नि + विश् → निविश्य, like अभि + अञ्ज् → अभ्यज्य.
questions.rule: Prefix + root → absolutive in -य; plain root → -त्वा.
questions.teaches: An absolutive with a prefix ends in -य (अभ्यज्य, having anointed); a plain root takes -त्वा.

questions.q: By unit 111, what is cooked with the paste of the listed drugs?
optionExplain: No ghee is named in unit 111.
No milk is named in unit 111.
Madirā belongs to unit 105.
Right: ...कल्कविपक्वेन तैलेन: oil well cooked with the paste.
questions.explain: The paste of the listed drugs is cooked into oil.
questions.rule: कल्कविपक्व तैल = oil cooked with a paste.

questions.q: Put these drugs of unit 111 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Aśoka, rohiṇī, (barhiṣa), uśīra, priyaṅgu, devadāru.

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 111 to the label its data gives.
questions.explain: Two standard, two disputed identifications.
questions.rule: अशोक, उशीर: standard; रोहिणी, प्रियङ्गु: disputed.
questions.teaches: Keep each plant's label: standard (aśoka, uśīra), disputed (rohiṇī, priyaṅgu), unidentified (barhiṣa).

questions.q: Which split of चाशोक is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ: च + अशोक → चाशोक.
चा is no word; the particle is च.
ए + अ keeps ए and marks ऽ: चेऽशोक.
अः + अ gives ओऽ: चोऽशोक, not चाशोक.
questions.explain: च (and) + अशोक (aśoka): अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which statements does unit 111 support?
options: The fomenting is done many times
The material for filling is named
The oil is well cooked with a paste
optionExplain: No: its identity is disputed.
Right: बहुशः, many times.
No: the object of पूरयेत् is not stated.
Right: कल्कविपक्वेन तैलेन.
questions.explain: Many times; oil cooked with a paste; what is filled is not said; rohiṇī disputed.
questions.rule: बहुशः = many times; विपक्व = well cooked.

questions.q: Built like निविष्टां (agreeing with योनि), which form fits ____ नारीम् (the seated woman, accusative)?
optionExplain: -अम् is masculine or neuter; नारी is feminine.
Right: Feminine accusative singular, like निविष्टाम् with योनिम्.
उपविष्टा is nominative; नारीम् is accusative.
उपविष्टाः is plural; नारीम् is singular.
questions.explain: उपविष्टाम् नारीम्, like निविष्टाम् (योनिम्): same gender, case and number.
questions.rule: A participle agrees with its noun in gender, case and number.
questions.teaches: A past participle in -त agrees with its noun: नि + विश् + त → निविष्ट, and निविष्टाम् is feminine accusative singular, like योनिम्.

questions.q: By unit 112, what do the spoken words tell the one addressed?
options: To come out of the body quickly
To go to your own place
optionExplain: No word for staying still is spoken.
The words say go to your own place.
Right: गच्छ ... स्वस्थानम्: go to your own place.
No word for strength is spoken.
questions.explain: The words: Go, O fortunate one, to your own place.
questions.rule: गच्छ स्वस्थानम् = go to your own place.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 112 in the line's order.
questions.explain: One should say, and: go, O fortunate one, to your own place, (end of quote).
questions.rule: ब्रूयात् → च → गच्छ → सुभगे → स्वस्थानम् → इति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 112 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words: the saying and the words said.
questions.teaches: इति after spoken words closes the quotation: ... स्वस्थानम् इति.

questions.q: Which split of ब्रूयाच्च is right?
optionExplain: A visarga before च gives श्च: ब्रूयाश्च.
च्च is no word; the particle is च.
म् before च gives anusvāra: ब्रूयां च.
Right: त् + च → च्च: ब्रूयात् + च → ब्रूयाच्च.
questions.explain: ब्रूयात् (should say) + च (and): त् + च → च्च.

questions.q: In unit 112, what does इति do?
options: Marks the end of the quoted words
It is the verb meaning go
It names who does the speaking
It means also, like the word च
optionExplain: Right: इति closes the quotation गच्छ सुभगे स्वस्थानम्.
The verb go is गच्छ.
The speaker is not named.
च means and; इति closes a quote.
questions.explain: इति marks where the spoken words end.

questions.q: By the join ब्रूयात् + च → ब्रूयाच्च, how do तत् + च (and that) join?
optionExplain: त् → द् happens before voiced sounds; च is voiceless.
Right: त् + च → च्च, as ब्रूयात् + च = ब्रूयाच्च.
ञ्च would need a nasal, and तत् has none.
श्च comes from a visarga before च, not from त्.
questions.explain: तत् + च = तच्च, like ब्रूयात् + च = ब्रूयाच्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes च् before च: ब्रूयात् + च → ब्रूयाच्च.

questions.q: In unit 113, what does अन्यतमा mean?
optionExplain: The data says अन्यतम is not other here.
No age is in the word अन्यतमा.
Right: अन्यतम = one of several; feminine अन्यतमा: any one (woman).
अन्यतमा is singular: any one.
questions.explain: अन्यतमा = any one (of several women).
questions.rule: अन्यतम = one of several, not other.

questions.q: Put the printed words of unit 113 in their order.
questions.explain: In the same way any one | woman, the just-born (child) only | the child | for the care of a child | (damaged verb).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 113 to its meaning.
pairs: for the care of a child
questions.explain: The sure words of unit 113.
questions.teaches: -वत् means like, in the manner of: तत् + वत् = तद्वत्, in the same way.

questions.q: Which split of बालोपचरणीयेन is right?
optionExplain: पचरणीय is no word; the word is उपचरणीय.
अः before उ loses its visarga: बाल उपचरणीयेन, two words.
ए before उ gives अय् or अ; it gives no ओ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: बाल + उपचरणीयेन → बालोपचरणीयेन.
questions.explain: बाल (child) + उपचरणीयेन (for the care): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: In unit 113, what case is बालं, and what is its role?
options: Accusative: the child is the object
Nominative: the child is the doer
optionExplain: Right: बालम्, m. acc. sg.: the one dealt with.
The nominative would be बालः.
The instrumental would be बालेन.
The genitive would be बालस्य.
questions.explain: बालम् = the child, object of the (damaged) verb.

questions.q: Built like तद्वत् (like that), what does the new example पूर्ववत् mean?
optionExplain: वत् means like, not after.
Right: पूर्व (former) + वत् (like): like the former, as before.
वत् carries no not.
No word for birth stands in पूर्ववत्.
questions.explain: पूर्व + वत् = as before, like तत् + वत् = in the same way.
questions.teaches: -वत् added to a word means like it: तद्वत् = like that, in the same way.

questions.q: By unit 114, when will that be taught?
options: It was already taught earlier on
optionExplain: The verb is future: it is not taught here.
The verb is future, not past.
Right: उपदेक्ष्यते ... उत्तरेषु: will be taught in the later (ones).
The line says it will be taught.
questions.explain: The teaching is postponed to the later (ones).

questions.q: Put the words of unit 114 in the line's order.
questions.explain: That, will be taught, but, in the later (ones).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 114 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words make the line.
questions.teaches: उत्तरेषु is locative plural of उत्तर, later: in the later (ones).

questions.q: Which split of तूत्तरेषु is right?
optionExplain: त्तरेषु is no word; the word is उत्तरेषु.
ए + उ gives अय् or अ; it gives no ऊ.
ओ + उ gives अव् or अ; it gives no ऊ.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ: तु + उत्तरेषु → तूत्तरेषु.
questions.explain: तु (but) + उत्तरेषु (in the later ones): उ + उ → ऊ.

questions.q: Which tense label does the data give उपदेक्ष्यते?
optionExplain: Right: The data labels it 3 sg. fut. mid. of upa-√diś.
A present would be उपदिशति / उपदिश्यते.
A perfect would be उपदिदेश.
An optative would be उपदिशेत्.
questions.explain: -स्य- marks the future: उपदेक्ष्यते, will be taught.

questions.q: By the join तु + उत्तरेषु → तूत्तरेषु, how do मधु + उदकम् join in a new example?
optionExplain: उ → व् only before a different vowel.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ, as तु + उत्तरेषु = तूत्तरेषु.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from उ + उ.
औ comes from अ + ओ, not from उ + उ.
questions.explain: मधु + उदकम् = मधूदकम्, like तु + उत्तरेषु = तूत्तरेषु.
questions.teaches: Two like vowels merge into the long one: उ + उ → ऊ (तु + उत्तरेषु → तूत्तरेषु).

questions.q: By unit 115, with what is the sūtikā anointed?
optionExplain: No ghee is named in unit 115.
Water is not named in unit 115.
Right: बलातैलेन: with balā oil.
The oil named is balā oil.
questions.explain: The sūtikā is anointed with balā oil.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 115 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, the sūtikā, with balā oil, one should anoint.

questions.q: Then one should anoint the ____ (woman who has recently given birth) with balā oil (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: The line is अथ सूतिकां बलातैलेनाभ्यज्यात्.
questions.teaches: सूतिका = a woman who has recently given birth; सूतिकाम् is its accusative.

questions.q: Which split of बलातैलेनाभ्यज्यात् is right?
optionExplain: भ्यज्यात् is no verb; the verb is अभ्यज्यात्.
ए + अ keeps ए with ऽ: ...तैलेनेऽभ्यज्यात्.
अः + अ gives ओऽ, not आ.
Right: अ + अ → आ: बलातैलेन + अभ्यज्यात्.
questions.explain: बलातैलेन (with balā oil) + अभ्यज्यात् (should anoint).

questions.q: Which label does the data give balā = country mallow here?
optionExplain: Right: Several plants are called balā, so Sida cordifolia is probable.
The data does not call it standard here.
The data says probable, not disputed.
The data does give an identification.
questions.explain: balā = Sida cordifolia: probable.

questions.q: By the join बलातैलेन + अभ्यज्यात्, how do घृतेन + अभ्यज्य (having anointed with ghee) join?
optionExplain: ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as बलातैलेन + अभ्यज्यात्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not from अ + अ.
questions.explain: घृतेन + अभ्यज्य = घृतेनाभ्यज्य, like बलातैलेन + अभ्यज्यात् = बलातैलेनाभ्यज्यात्.
questions.teaches: A final अ and an initial अ merge into one long आ: बलातैलेन + अभ्यज्यात् → बलातैलेनाभ्यज्यात्.

questions.q: By unit 116, to whom is the dose of sneha given?
options: To one whose sneha is digested
To one with no appetite at all
optionExplain: That woman is the subject of unit 117, not this one.
That is unit 119, where a yavāgū follows the digested sneha.
Right: बुभुक्षितां ... स्नेहमात्रां पाययेत्: the hungry one is made to drink it.
The line says hungry (बुभुक्षिता), the opposite.
questions.explain: The hungry one is given a dose of sneha.

questions.q: Put the items of the second powder of unit 116 in the line's order.
questions.explain: yavānī, upakuñcikā, cavya, citraka, vyoṣa, saindhava, then चूर्णेन (with the powder).
questions.rule: यवानी → उपकुञ्चिका → चव्य → चित्रक → व्योष → सैन्धव.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 116 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Who, what, how much, how fast and the verb of the line.
questions.teaches: यथासात्म्यम् = according to what suits her (sātmya); the dose follows her, not a fixed amount.

questions.q: In unit 116, what two things does वा (or) set side by side?
options: The sneha dose and a dose of plain water
The hungry woman and the woman unfit for sneha
Yavānī and upakuñcikā alone, as two choices
The pañcakola powder and the yavānī-group powder
optionExplain: No water is named in this line.
The unfit woman comes in unit 117.
Both stand inside one list of the second powder.
Right: The note: वा sits between the two powders.
questions.explain: वा: with pañcakola powder, or with the powder of yavānī and the rest.

questions.q: Which statements does unit 116 make?
options: The dose follows what suits her (यथासात्म्यम्)
The dose is given to the woman unfit for sneha (अस्नेह्या)
The sneha is taken with milk instead of powder (क्षीर)
Saindhava (rock salt) is in the second powder
optionExplain: Right: यथासात्म्यं स्नेहमात्राम्.
That woman is in unit 117; here she is hungry.
No milk is named; the sneha is joined with powder.
Right: ...व्योषसैन्धवचूर्णेन.
questions.explain: The dose suits her, and saindhava is one item of the second powder.

questions.q: By the rule of यवान्युपकुञ्चिका, how is नदी + उदकम् (river water, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: Right: ई + उ → यु, as यवानी + उपकुञ्चिका → यवान्युपकुञ्चिका.
The उ is not lost after ई.
ई + उ does not give यो.
ई + उ does not give ऊ.
questions.explain: नदी + उदकम् = नद्युदकम्, like यवानी + उपकुञ्चिका.
questions.rule: ई + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A final ई before a different vowel becomes य्: यवानी + उपकुञ्चिका → यवान्युपकुञ्चिका.

questions.q: By unit 117, who receives the vāta-relieving medicines or the lesser pañcamūla?
options: One who is no longer called a sūtikā
optionExplain: The hungry one gets the sneha dose in unit 116.
Right: स्नेहायोग्यां वातहरौषध... ह्रस्वपञ्चमूल... वा.
She gets a yavāgū in unit 119.
That is the end of the period, unit 125.
questions.explain: The woman unfit for sneha gets the vāta-relieving remedy instead.
questions.rule: स्नेहायोग्याम् = for one unfit for sneha.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 117 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Unfit for sneha, vāta-relieving medicines, or lesser pañcamūla; and for one who has drunk, anoint, wrap.
questions.rule: स्नेहायोग्याम् → वातहर… → ह्रस्वपञ्चमूल… → पीतवत्याः → यमकेन अभ्यज्य → वेष्टयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 117 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Six words carry the two clauses of the line.
questions.rule: स्नेहायोग्या, वातहर, पीतवती, वेष्टयेत्, उदरम्, वस्त्रेण.
questions.teaches: पीतवती = one who has drunk: -वत् (fem. -वती) on the past participle पीत makes 'having drunk'.

questions.q: Which split of स्नेहायोग्याम् is right?
optionExplain: A visarga after अ before अ would give स्नेहोऽयोग्याम्.
A final म् would give स्नेहमयोग्याम्.
Right: अ + अ → आ: स्नेह + अयोग्याम् = स्नेहायोग्याम् (unfit for sneha).
आयोग्या is not a word; the word is अयोग्या, unfit.
questions.explain: स्नेह (sneha) + अयोग्या (unfit): अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: By unit 117, what is done for the woman who has drunk?
options: Sprinkle her with hot water before the drinks
Give her a liquid yavāgū in measure
Anoint her with balā oil and let her rest
Anoint with yamaka, wrap the belly in cloth
optionExplain: Hot-water sprinkling is unit 120.
The yavāgū comes in unit 119.
Balā oil is unit 115.
Right: पीतवत्याश्च यमकेनाभ्यज्य वेष्टयेदुदरं वस्त्रेण.
questions.explain: After she has drunk: yamaka anointing, then the belly wrapped with cloth.

questions.q: By the rule of पीतवत्याश्च, how is रामः + च (and Rāma, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before च becomes श्, as पीतवत्याः + च → पीतवत्याश्च.
ओ comes from अः before a voiced sound; च is not voiced.
The visarga is not lost before च.
Before च the visarga becomes श्, not स्.
questions.explain: रामः + च = रामश्च, like पीतवत्याः + च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च becomes श्: पीतवत्याः + च → पीतवत्याश्च.

questions.q: By unit 118, why would vāyu not alter the belly?
options: Because of the gruel (यवागू) she drinks
optionExplain: Digested sneha is unit 119.
Right: अनवकाशत्वात्: because of the absence of space.
Hot-water sprinkling is unit 120.
No gruel is named in unit 118.
questions.explain: No space, so no alteration of the belly.
questions.rule: अनवकाशत्वात् = because of absence of space.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 118 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus not wind the belly's alteration would produce, because of no space.
questions.rule: तथा → न → वायुः → उदरविकृतिम् → उत्पादयेत् → अनवकाशत्वात्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 118 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words carry the whole statement.
questions.teaches: -त्वात् (ablative of the abstract -त्व) gives the reason: अनवकाशत्वात् = because of having no space.

questions.q: In unit 118, what does उदर mean, by the data's note?
options: The womb that held the foetus
optionExplain: The note rules this out for this line.
The word is उदर, belly; no womb word is used.
Right: The note: उदर is rendered belly, not the disease udara.
Agni is a different word, named in unit 121.
questions.explain: उदरविकृति = alteration of the belly.

questions.q: Why does the negative in अनवकाशत्वात् take the form अन्- and not अ-?
options: Because the whole word stands in the ablative case, -त्वात्
Because the subject वायुः is masculine
Because the next word अवकाश begins with a vowel
optionExplain: The case ending does not choose the prefix.
अन्- here is the negative: absence of space.
Gender does not choose the prefix.
Right: The negative prefix is अन्- before a vowel, अ- before a consonant.
questions.explain: अन् + अवकाश: अन्- before a vowel.
questions.rule: Negative prefix: अ- before a consonant, अन्- before a vowel.

questions.q: By the rule of अनवकाश, what is the negative of उचित (proper, a new example)?
optionExplain: Right: अन्- before a vowel, as अन् + अवकाश → अनवकाश.
Before a vowel the negative is अन्-, not अ-.
The उ of उचित does not lengthen.
The न is not doubled.
questions.explain: अन् + उचित = अनुचित, like अन् + अवकाश = अनवकाश.
questions.teaches: The negative prefix is अन्- before a vowel: अन् + अवकाश → अनवकाश; अन् + उचित → अनुचित.

questions.q: By unit 119, when is the yavāgū given?
options: Before any sneha is drunk at all
When the sneha has been digested
optionExplain: Unit 119 opens with the sneha already digested.
Right: जीर्णे तु स्नेहे: when the sneha is digested.
The twelve nights belong to unit 121.
That is a view on the end of the period, unit 126.
questions.explain: The yavāgū follows the digested sneha.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 119 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When digested, cooked with the earlier medicines, the vidārī group or milk, a yavāgū, in measure.
questions.rule: जीर्णे स्नेहे → पूर्वौषधैः → विदार्यादिगण… → क्षीरेण वा → यवागूम् → मात्रया पाययेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 119 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These words say when, and what kind of yavāgū.
questions.teaches: जीर्णे स्नेहे: two locatives together mark the time, 'when the sneha is digested'.

questions.q: Which split of पूर्वौषधैः is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give पूर्वमौषधैः.
अः before a vowel other than अ loses the visarga: पूर्व औषधैः, with a gap.
Right: अ + औ → औ: पूर्व + औषधैः = पूर्वौषधैः (the earlier medicines).
षधैः is not a word; the word is औषधैः, medicines.
questions.explain: पूर्व (earlier) + औषधैः (medicines): अ + औ → औ.

questions.q: By unit 119, with which may the yavāgū be cooked?
options: With the very same earlier medicines
optionExplain: Hot water is for sprinkling in unit 120.
Right: पूर्वौषधैरेव सिद्धाम्.
Jāṅgala broths come after twelve nights in unit 121.
Right: क्षीरेण वा.
questions.explain: Earlier medicines, the vidārī group, or milk; not hot water or broth.

questions.q: By the rule of पूर्वौषधैः, how is जल + औघः (flood of water, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: अ + औ does not give ओ.
अ + औ does not give आ.
No व is put between अ and औ.
Right: अ + औ → औ, as पूर्व + औषधैः → पूर्वौषधैः.
questions.explain: जल + औघः = जलौघः, like पूर्व + औषधैः.
questions.teaches: A final अ before औ merges into औ: पूर्व + औषधैः → पूर्वौषधैः.

questions.q: By unit 120, with what is the sprinkling (परिषेचन) done?
optionExplain: Right: उष्णोदकेन परिषेचयेत्.
Cooled water is for drinking, unit 122.
Balā oil is for anointing, unit 115.
Milk is a way to cook the yavāgū, unit 119.
questions.explain: Hot water is used for the sprinkling.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 120 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Before the drinkings of sneha and yavāgū, and at both times, with hot water, one should sprinkle.
questions.rule: प्राक् → स्नेहयवागूपानाभ्याम् → च → उभयकालम् → उष्णोदकेन → परिषेचयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 120 to its meaning.
questions.explain: When, how often, with what, and the action.
questions.teaches: प्राक् (before) takes the ablative: प्राक् स्नेहयवागूपानाभ्याम् = before the drinkings of sneha and yavāgū.

questions.q: Which split of उष्णोदकेन is right?
optionExplain: अः before उ loses the visarga and leaves a gap: उष्ण उदकेन.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: उष्ण + उदकेन = उष्णोदकेन (with hot water).
A final म् would give उष्णमुदकेन.
दकेन is not a word; the word is उदकेन, with water.
questions.explain: उष्ण (hot) + उदकेन (with water): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: By unit 120, when is the hot-water sprinkling done, relative to the drinks?
options: After drinking the sneha and the yavāgū
While she drinks the sneha and the yavāgū
Before drinking the sneha and the yavāgū
In place of the sneha and the yavāgū
optionExplain: प्राक् means before, not after.
प्राक् means before, not during.
Right: प्राक् = before.
The sprinkling is added, not a substitute.
questions.explain: प्राक् places the sprinkling before both drinks.

questions.q: By the rule of चोभयकालम्, how is च + उक्तम् (and said, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: अ + उ gives ओ, not औ.
The अ does not drop before उ.
No व is put between अ and उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as च + उभयकालम् → चोभयकालम्.
questions.explain: च + उक्तम् = चोक्तम्, like च + उभयकालम्.
questions.teaches: A final अ before उ merges into ओ: च + उभयकालम् → चोभयकालम्.

questions.q: By unit 121, from when are jāṅgala broths given?
options: After a month and a half
optionExplain: Right: द्वादशरात्रात्परं जाङ्गलरसादिभिः.
Three or five nights is the first stage, before the soup.
Broths come later, after twelve nights.
One and a half months ends the period, unit 125.
questions.explain: Jāṅgala broths come after twelve nights.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 121 in the line's order.
questions.explain: First nights; soup; light food; after twelve nights; jāṅgala broths; having regard to agni and strength.
questions.rule: त्रिरात्र… → यूष → अन्नपान → द्वादशरात्रात् परम् → जाङ्गलरस → अग्निबलादि.

questions.q: Match each food word of unit 121 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The soup's three items, the soup itself, and the later broth.
questions.teaches: जाङ्गल = of dry-land animals; used as a noun for their flesh, whose broths (रस) come after twelve nights.

questions.q: By unit 121, what does the nourishing have regard to (अपेक्ष्य)?
options: The season of the year and the hour
Digestive fire, strength and so on
The weight and the age of the child
Her wishes and her longings alone
optionExplain: No season or hour is named in unit 121.
Right: अग्निबलादीन्यपेक्ष्य: having regard to agni, strength and the rest.
The child is not named in unit 121.
The line names agni and strength, not wishes.
questions.explain: Agni (digestive fire) and bala (strength) guide the feeding.

questions.q: Which statements does unit 121 make?
options: Jāṅgala broths come before the twelfth night
The soup is of barley, jujube and horse gram
Light food and drink go with the soup
All the foods are given at once, from day one
optionExplain: They come after twelve nights (परम्).
Right: यवकोलकुलत्थयूषेण.
Right: लघुना चान्नपानेन.
क्रमात्: gradually, step by step.
questions.explain: The soup has three items and goes with light food; broths come later, gradually.

questions.q: By the rule of ततो यव..., how is रामः + गच्छति (Rāma goes, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: र् comes from a visarga after vowels other than अ/आ.
The visarga of आः drops; this is अः, which becomes ओ.
Right: अः before a voiced sound becomes ओ, as ततः + यव… → ततो यव….
स् stays only before त/थ, not before ग.
questions.explain: रामः + गच्छति = रामो गच्छति, like ततः + यव… = ततो यव….
questions.teaches: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ: ततः + यवकोल… → ततो यवकोल….

questions.q: By unit 122, what kind of water is given to drink?
options: Water mixed with milk, served warm
optionExplain: Hot water is for sprinkling, unit 120.
No milk is named in unit 122.
Broths are unit 121, not water here.
Right: कथितशीतं ... तोयम्: शीत = cooled.
questions.explain: The drinking water is cooled.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 122 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four sure words of the short line.

questions.q: What does the causative पाययेत् mean, beside पिबेत् (should drink)?
optionExplain: Right: The causative of पा: to make drink, to give to drink.
That is the plain पिबेत्.
That would be a past form such as पीतवती.
The optative is not a future.
questions.explain: पाययेत् = should give to drink.
questions.teaches: पाययेत् is the causative optative of पा: should make (her) drink, not drink oneself.

questions.q: How is शीतम् + च written, as in the print of unit 122?
optionExplain: श्च comes from a visarga before च; here the ending is म्.
Right: A final म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra: शीतं च.
The म् is not lost; it becomes anusvāra.
ओ comes from अः, and there is no visarga here.
questions.explain: शीतम् + च → शीतं च.
questions.rule: Final म् before a consonant → anusvāra.

questions.q: In unit 122, the word for water is ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तोयम् = water (n. acc. sg.), the object of पाययेत्.
questions.teaches: तोय = water.

questions.q: By the causative of पाययेत्, what does कारयेत् (from कृ, do) mean?
optionExplain: That is the plain कुर्यात्.
कारयेत् is not a past passive form.
Right: The causative makes 'cause to do', as पाययेत् = make drink.
The optative is not a future.
questions.explain: कारयेत् = should cause to do, like पाययेत् = should make drink.
questions.teaches: A causative makes the verb 'cause to ...': पा → पाययेत् (make drink); कृ → कारयेत् (cause to do).

questions.q: By unit 123, with which drugs are the preparations cooked (सिद्ध)?
options: Pungent, drying, bitter and strongly vāta-raising ones
Purging, emetic, sour and kapha-raising ones
Cooling, astringent, salty and pitta-raising ones
optionExplain: The line names sweet and vāta-relieving drugs.
None of these is named in unit 123.
None of these is named in unit 123.
Right: जीवनीयबृंहणीयमधुरवातहरसिद्धैः.
questions.explain: Four qualities: jīvanīya, bṛṃhaṇīya, madhura, vātahara.

questions.q: Put the four drug qualities of unit 123 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Life-promoting, nourishing, sweet, vāta-relieving, then सिद्ध (cooked).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 123 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sure means of care, the diet, and the verb.
questions.teaches: अन्नपान is a dvandva, food and drink; here plural (अन्नपानैः) with हृद्य, agreeable.

questions.q: The print shows अवगाहै रन्नपानैश्च; which split is right?
optionExplain: Right: ऐः before a vowel: the visarga becomes र्, printed across the gap.
रन्नपान is not a word; the र् is the visarga of अवगाहैः.
ए before अ would give अवगाहेऽन्नपानैः, with no र्.
अ + अ would give आ: अवगाहान्नपानैः.
questions.explain: अवगाहैः + अन्नपानैः: the visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel.
questions.rule: Visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ → र् before a vowel or voiced sound.

questions.q: Which means of care does unit 123 name?
optionExplain: Right: अभ्यंग… in the compound.
No purging is named in unit 123.
Right: …परिषेकावगाहैः.
No fasting is named; agreeable food is given.
questions.explain: Anointing, sprinkling and immersion are named; purging and fasting are not.

questions.q: By the rule of अवगाहैरन्नपानैः, how is देवैः + अपि (by the gods too, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: ओऽ comes from अः + अ; here the vowel is ऐ.
Right: Visarga after ऐ becomes र् before a vowel, as अवगाहैः + अन्नपानैः.
The visarga is not lost and the vowels do not merge.
Before a vowel the visarga becomes र्, not स्.
questions.explain: देवैः + अपि = देवैरपि, like अवगाहैः + अन्नपानैः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a vowel: अवगाहैः + अन्नपानैः → अवगाहैरन्नपानैः.

questions.q: By unit 124, what is the sūtikā's disease said to be?
options: Easy to cure, in a few days
optionExplain: The line says the opposite: hard to cure.
The line says hard to cure or incurable.
Right: कृच्छ्रसाध्यो भवत्यसाध्यो वा.
No fasting is named; careful treatment is.
questions.explain: Her disease is hard to cure or incurable.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 124 in the line's order.
questions.explain: She becomes new again; for that reason her disease is hard or incurable; so treat her with effort.
questions.rule: पुनर्नवीभवति → अत एव → व्याधिः → कृच्छ्रसाध्यः/असाध्यः → तस्मात् → उपचरेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 124 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sure words of the second and third sentences.
questions.rule: पुनर्नवीभवति, कृच्छ्रसाध्य, असाध्य, यथोक्तेन विधिना, प्रयत्नेन.
questions.teaches: नवी + भवति (the ई before भू): becomes new, what it was not; पुनः adds 'again'.

questions.q: In unit 124, what is the reason behind तस्मात् (therefore)?
options: She is hungry and needs sneha
The wind has no space in her belly
Her disease is hard to cure or incurable
optionExplain: Hunger is unit 116.
That is unit 118.
That is a view in unit 126.
Right: That sentence comes just before तस्मात्.
questions.explain: Because her disease is hard to cure, she must be treated with effort.

questions.q: Which split of भवत्यसाध्यो is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: भवति + असाध्यः → भवत्यसाध्यः (becomes incurable).
A final त् would give भवदसाध्यः.
There is no vowel to join: it would stay भवति साध्यः.
भवत्य is not a word; the verb is भवति.
questions.explain: भवति (becomes) + असाध्यः (incurable): इ + अ → य.

questions.q: By the rule of भवत्यसाध्यः, how is अस्ति + अत्र (is here, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: इ + अ does not give ए.
Right: इ + अ → य, as भवति + असाध्यः → भवत्यसाध्यः.
The इ is not dropped before अ.
इ + अ does not give ई.
questions.explain: अस्ति + अत्र = अस्त्यत्र, like भवति + असाध्यः.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: भवति + असाध्यः → भवत्यसाध्यः.

questions.q: By unit 125, for how long is she treated as a sūtikā?
optionExplain: Twelve nights marks the broths, unit 121.
That is the first stage of unit 121.
Right: अध्यर्धमासम्: for one and a half months.
अध्यर्ध is one and a half, not one.
questions.explain: The period is one and a half months.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 125 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus she, a month and a half, treated, gradually, released from restraint, would lose the name sūtikā.
questions.rule: एवं सा → अध्यर्धमासम् → उपसंस्कृता → क्रमेण → विमुक्त… → …सूतिकाभिधाना स्यात्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 125 to its meaning.
questions.explain: How long, how, from what, and what goes.
questions.rule: अध्यर्ध, मास, उपसंस्कृता, क्रमेण, यन्त्रणा, अभिधान.
questions.teaches: अध्यर्ध = one and a half: a half added to a whole (अधि + अर्ध).

questions.q: By unit 125, from what is she gradually released?
options: The care of the newborn child
The rule of daily oil massage
The house set apart for delivery
The restraint of food and conduct
optionExplain: No child is named in unit 125.
Massage is not named in unit 125.
No house is named in unit 125.
Right: आहारविहारयन्त्रणा: restraint of food (आहार) and conduct (विहार).
questions.explain: आहार = food, विहार = conduct; यन्त्रणा = restraint.

questions.q: Which split of साऽध्यर्द्धमासम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: आ + अ → आ; the ऽ marks the merged अ, as printed.
सः before अ would give सोऽध्यर्ध…, and the subject is feminine.
ध्यर्ध is not a word; the word is अध्यर्ध.
आध्यर्ध is not a word; the word is अध्यर्ध.
questions.explain: सा (she) + अध्यर्धमासम् (one and a half months).

questions.q: By the rule of साऽध्यर्ध…, how is सा + अपि (she too, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: That is सः + अपि, the masculine.
Right: आ + अ → आ, as सा + अध्यर्ध… → साऽध्यर्ध….
आ + अ does not give ए.
No य is put between आ and अ.
questions.explain: सा + अपि = सापि (also printed साऽपि).
questions.teaches: A final आ before अ merges into आ: सा + अध्यर्धमासम् → साऽध्यर्धमासम्.

questions.q: By unit 126, what event do some (एके) name?
options: The first full bath in hot water
optionExplain: Twelve nights belongs to unit 121.
No child's month is named in unit 126.
Right: पुनरार्तवदर्शनात्: from the menses appearing again.
Hot water is unit 120.
questions.explain: Some mark it by the menses appearing again.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 126 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Again, from the appearance of the menses, thus, some.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 126 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words make the whole view.
questions.teaches: इति एके = so some (say): it marks a view held by some, set beside another.

questions.q: Which split of पुनरार्त्तव… (पुनरार्तव) is right?
optionExplain: पुनर is not a word; the word is पुनः.
अर्तव is not a word, and र् + अ would give पुनरर्तव.
पुनरा and र्तव are not words.
Right: The visarga after उ becomes र् before a vowel.
questions.explain: पुनः (again) + आर्तव (menses): उः + vowel → उर्.
questions.rule: Visarga after उ → र् before a vowel.

questions.q: By unit 126, whose view is this?
options: The only view the text allows
optionExplain: Right: इति एके: so some (say).
It is a view of some, beside another account.
एके means some, not all.
एके is masculine plural: some (people), not the woman.
questions.explain: एके marks a view held by some.

questions.q: By the rule of इत्येके, how is इति + एव (thus indeed, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: The इ does not drop before ए.
Right: इ + ए → ये, as इति + एके → इत्येके.
इ + ए gives ये, not यै.
इ + ए does not give ऐ.
questions.explain: इति + एव = इत्येव, like इति + एके.
questions.teaches: A final इ before ए becomes य्: इति + एके → इत्येके.

questions.q: By unit 127, what has been shown well in every way?
options: The whole list of her possible diseases
The signs of a male child
optionExplain: No diseases are listed in unit 127.
Those signs are not in unit 127.
Right: विधिः सर्वः सर्वथा साधु दर्शितः.
No mantras are named in unit 127.
questions.explain: The verse closes: the whole procedure has been shown.

questions.q: Put the phrases of unit 127 in the verse's order.
questions.explain: Taking the first month, as long as again capable of a foetus the woman is, so long the whole procedure is shown.
questions.rule: इत्याद्यं → यावद्गर्भक्षमा → स्त्री स्यात्तावत् → विधिः सर्वः → सर्वथा साधु दर्शितः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 127 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The span (first month to fitness for a foetus) and the closing praise.
questions.teaches: यावत् ... तावत् = as long as ... so long: the two halves of one sentence.

questions.q: In unit 127, which word answers यावत् (as long as)?
optionExplain: पुनः means again, inside the यावत् clause.
सर्वथा means in every way, not so long.
इति opens the verse: thus.
Right: तावत् is the correlative of यावत्: so long.
questions.explain: यावत् ... तावत्: as long as ... so long.

questions.q: Why is यावत् printed यावद् before गर्भक्षमा?
options: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced sound
Because the metre needs a long syllable at that place
Because द् marks the plural here
optionExplain: Right: ग is voiced, so त् → द्.
Gender does not change a final consonant.
The change is sandhi, not metre.
यावत् is an indeclinable; it has no plural.
questions.explain: यावत् + गर्भक्षमा → यावद्गर्भक्षमा.
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a voiced sound.

questions.q: By the rule of यावद्गर्भ…, how is जगत् + ईशः (lord of the world, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: Before a vowel the final त् does not stay त्.
Right: त् → द् before a voiced sound (here a vowel), as यावत् + गर्भ… → यावद्गर्भ….
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal.
The ई of ईशः is not shortened.
questions.explain: जगत् + ईशः = जगदीशः, like यावत् + गर्भक्षमा → यावद्गर्भक्षमा.
questions.rule: Final त् → द् before a voiced sound or a vowel.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced sound: यावत् + गर्भक्षमा → यावद्गर्भक्षमा; तावत् + विधिः → तावद्विधिः.

questions.q: By unit 128, what is this chapter named?
optionExplain: Not the printed name; the name begins with garbha.
Not the printed name of this chapter.
Right: इति गर्भोपचरणीयो नाम तृतीयोऽध्यायः.
Not the printed name of this chapter.
questions.explain: The third chapter is Garbhopacaraṇīya.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 128 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus, Garbhopacaraṇīya, named, the third chapter.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 128 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words frame the chapter's name.
questions.teaches: नाम (indeclinable) = named: X नाम अध्यायः = the chapter named X.

questions.q: Which split of तृतीयोऽध्यायः is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give तृतीयमध्यायः.
ए + अ would give तृतीयेऽध्यायः.
आ + अ would give तृतीयाध्यायः.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ: the अ is merged and marked ऽ.
questions.explain: तृतीयः (third) + अध्यायः (chapter).

questions.q: By the data's note, what does the name Garbhopacaraṇīya refer to?
options: Care in pregnancy and after it
The bones and joints of the body
The rites for begetting a son
optionExplain: Right: The note: what is to be done for (the woman with) the foetus.
Not the sense given for this name.
Not the sense given for this name.
Not the sense given for this name.
questions.explain: garbha (foetus) + upacaraṇīya (to be attended to).

questions.q: By the rule of तृतीयोऽध्यायः, how is प्रथमः + अध्यायः (the first chapter, a new example) joined?
optionExplain: ए comes from a different ending, not अः.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ, as तृतीयः + अध्यायः.
र् comes from a visarga after vowels other than अ/आ.
Before a vowel the visarga does not become स्.
questions.explain: प्रथमः + अध्यायः = प्रथमोऽध्यायः, like तृतीयः + अध्यायः.
questions.teaches: अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ is marked ऽ: तृतीयः + अध्यायः → तृतीयोऽध्यायः.

questions.q: By unit 1, what does this chapter set out to explain?
options: The bones and the joints of the body
optionExplain: Bones and joints are not the topic named in unit 1.
Signs of death are not the topic named in unit 1.
Right: गर्भव्यापदम्: the mishaps (vyāpad) of the garbha.
No season is named; the topic is garbhavyāpad.
questions.explain: The chapter promises to explain garbhavyāpad, the mishaps of pregnancy.
questions.rule: गर्भव्यापदं व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall explain the mishaps of the garbha.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 1 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Now, therefore, the mishaps of the garbha, relating to the body, we shall explain.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 1 to its meaning.
questions.explain: अथ अतः opens the chapter; गर्भ + व्यापद् = mishap of the garbha.
questions.teaches: व्यापद् = mishap, disorder: गर्भव्यापद् = mishap of the garbha.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which split of अथातो is right?
optionExplain: तः is not a word; the word is अतः (therefore).
अथ has no visarga; it is an indeclinable.
आतः is not the word; the word is अतः.
Right: अ + अ → आ, and अः before the voiced ग becomes ओ.
questions.explain: अथ (now) + अतः (therefore) = अथातः; before गर्भ the visarga gives ओ: अथातो.
questions.rule: अ + अ → आ; अः + voiced consonant → ओ.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: What does the verb व्याख्यास्यामः of unit 1 express?
optionExplain: Right: The data labels it 1st person plural future.
-स्यामः is a future ending, not a past one.
-मः marks the 1st person plural: we.
-मः marks the 1st person plural, not you.
questions.explain: व्याख्यास्यामः = we shall explain: future, 1st person plural.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of अथ + अतः, how is न + अस्ति (is not) written when joined?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as अथ + अतः → अथातः.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
The avagraha marks an अ dropped after ए or ओ, not after अ.
questions.explain: न + अस्ति = नास्ति, like अथ + अतः = अथातः.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by a short अ joins as long आ: अथ + अतः → अथातः.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 2, what does the pregnant woman do that sets up the case?
options: She keeps every rule of her pregnancy
She has already given birth to the child
She indulges in things to be avoided
She takes a medicine to help conception
optionExplain: The case is the opposite: she indulges in the things to be avoided.
आपन्नगर्भा: she is pregnant, not delivered.
Right: परिहार्याणि (आ)सेवेत: she indulges in the avoidable.
She is already pregnant (आपन्नगर्भा); no medicine is named.
questions.explain: The case opens: if she indulges in things to be avoided.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 2 in the line's order.
questions.explain: A woman, if, pregnant, things to be avoided, should indulge in.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 2 to its meaning.
questions.explain: If a pregnant woman indulges in the things to be avoided.
questions.teaches: आपन्नगर्भा is a bahuvrīhi: आपन्न (come about) + गर्भ = she whose garbha has come about.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which split of चेदापन्न is right?
optionExplain: चेद is not a word; the particle is चेत् (if).
अपन्न is not the word, and a short अ would give चेदपन्न.
चे and दापन्न are not words; the words are चेत्, आपन्न.
Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्: चेत् + आपन्न → चेदापन्न.
questions.explain: चेत् (if) + आपन्न (come about): त् + vowel → द्.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 2?
options: It lists the things to be avoided
It is a conditional, an if-clause
It gives the treatment in this line
optionExplain: The note: the avoidable things are not named here.
Right: चेत् makes it a condition.
The treatment comes in later units.
Right: one whose garbha has come about.
questions.explain: An if-clause about a pregnant woman; the avoidables are not named.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the pattern of आपन्नगर्भा (she whose garbha has come about), what does जितक्रोधः mean?
options: One whose anger has been conquered
One who conquers by his anger
One who makes the others angry
optionExplain: Right: Bahuvrīhi: जित (conquered) + क्रोध, the person who has it.
जित is conquered, not conquering.
That would be an instrumental sense, not this compound.
Nothing in जित means making angry.
questions.explain: जितक्रोधः = he whose anger is conquered, as आपन्नगर्भा = she whose garbha has come about.
questions.rule: Bahuvrīhi: participle + noun = one who has that.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi names the person who has the thing: आपन्न + गर्भा = she whose garbha has come about.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 3, besides pain, which sign is named?
options: A high fever with thirst and burning
The sight of puṣpa, probably bleeding
A swelling of the feet and of the whole face
A loss of all desire for any food
optionExplain: No fever is named in unit 3.
Right: पुष्पदर्शनं वा: or the sight of the 'flower'.
No swelling is named in unit 3.
No loss of appetite is named in unit 3.
questions.explain: Pain, or the sight of puṣpa.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the places of pain in unit 3 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Bladder region, flanks, hips, mouth of the yoni.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 3 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four places of pain, and the second sign, puṣpadarśana.
questions.teaches: पुष्प (flower) is an idiom for bleeding, probably: पुष्पदर्शन = sight of the flower.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Why is यस्याः printed यस्या before बस्ति in unit 3?
options: After आ, the visarga becomes ओ before ब
यस्या is a nominative form meaning who
After आ, the visarga drops before a voiced sound
The visarga drops before every consonant
optionExplain: ओ comes from a visarga after short अ, not after आ.
The data reads यस्याः, genitive: of whom.
Right: ब is voiced, so यस्याः → यस्या.
Before unvoiced sounds it stays or changes; it is not dropped.
questions.explain: यस्याः + बस्ति = यस्या बस्ति: आः before a voiced sound loses its visarga.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which signs in unit 3 call for the treatment that follows?
optionExplain: Right: पार्श्व is one of the places of pain.
No fever is named.
Right: पुष्पदर्शनं वा.
No swelling is named.
questions.explain: Pain in the named places, or the sight of puṣpa.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of यस्या बस्ति, how is कन्याः + वदन्ति (the girls speak) written?
optionExplain: ओ comes from a visarga after short अ, not after आ.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
Before a voiced sound the visarga after आ does not stay.
Right: आः before the voiced व loses its visarga, as यस्याः + बस्ति.
questions.explain: कन्याः + वदन्ति = कन्या वदन्ति, like यस्याः + बस्ति = यस्या बस्ति.
questions.teaches: A visarga after आ is dropped before a voiced sound: यस्याः + बस्ति → यस्या बस्ति.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 4, how is her head placed?
optionExplain: Right: ईषदवनतशिरसम्: with the head slightly bent down.
The head is lowered, not raised.
She lies on a bed; she is not sitting.
No turning is named; the head is slightly lowered.
questions.explain: She lies with her head slightly lowered.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put these words of unit 4 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Her, on a soft cool bed, head slightly lowered, with cool plasters, sprinklings and the like, one should treat.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 4 to its meaning.
questions.explain: A cool bed, the head slightly lowered, cool plasters and sprinklings.
questions.rule: शिशिर, आस्तरण, ईषत्, अवनत, प्रदेह, परिषेक.
questions.teaches: प्रदेह = a plaster applied; परिषेक = sprinkling, pouring over.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which split of आदिभिरुपाचरेत् is right?
optionExplain: पाचरेत् is not the verb; the verb is उपाचरेत्.
Right: After इ, a visarga before a vowel becomes र्.
रुपाचरेत् is not a word; the र् comes from the visarga.
अः + उ would not give इर्; the data reads आदिभिः.
questions.explain: आदिभिः (with ... and the like) + उपाचरेत् (should treat): इः + vowel → इर्.
questions.rule: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ → र् before a vowel or voiced consonant.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: A pregnant woman has the pain of unit 3. By unit 4, which treatment is used?
options: Massage of the whole body with warm oil
optionExplain: The unit says cool (शीत), not hot.
No smoke or walking is named in unit 4.
Right: शीतप्रदेहपरिषेकादिभिः: cool plasters, sprinklings and the like.
No warm oil is named; the measures are cool.
questions.explain: She is treated with cool measures: plasters, sprinklings and the like.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of आदिभिरुपाचरेत्, how is मुनिः + आगच्छति (the sage comes) written?
optionExplain: य् comes from a vowel इ, not from इः.
The इ of मुनि does not change to ओ.
After इ the visarga becomes र्; it is not dropped.
Right: After इ, the visarga becomes र् before a vowel.
questions.explain: मुनिः + आगच्छति = मुनिरागच्छति, like आदिभिः + उपाचरेत् = आदिभिरुपाचरेत्.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a vowel: आदिभिः + उपाचरेत् → आदिभिरुपाचरेत्.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: What does तद्यथा in unit 5 do?
options: It introduces the list that follows
It closes the long list of the whole chapter
It names the drug to be given now
It states the dose of the remedy
optionExplain: Right: The note: it introduces the measures from unit 6 on.
It opens a list; it does not close one.
No drug is named in तद्यथा.
No dose is given in तद्यथा.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = that is as follows: a list comes next.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each part of unit 5 to its meaning.
questions.explain: तत् + यथा = तद्यथा, that is as follows.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: तत् and यथा are joined as ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तत् + यथा = तद्यथा: त् becomes द् before the voiced य.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel or a voiced consonant such as य (before a nasal it may also become न्, optional; before ल, ज, ड it assimilates): तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Why is तत् written तद् in तद्यथा?
options: द् marks the plural of तत्
त् becomes द् before the voiced य
य makes the sound before it unvoiced
द् marks the instrumental case here
optionExplain: Number is not marked by द्; it is sandhi.
Right: य is a voiced sound; त् takes the voiced द्.
The change goes the other way: त् becomes voiced द्.
Case is not marked by द्; it is sandhi.
questions.explain: Before the voiced य, the unvoiced त् becomes voiced द्.
questions.rule: त् + vowel or voiced ग, ब, य ... → द् (before a nasal optionally न्; before ल, ज, ड it assimilates).
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: In unit 5, what kind of line is तद्यथा?
options: A full verse (śloka) of four quarters
A full instruction with its own verb
A prose line leading into a list
A list of drugs for her to drink
optionExplain: It is one word of prose, not a verse.
There is no verb; it only introduces the list.
Right: The data types it prose; it introduces the measures.
It names no drug; the list comes after it.
questions.explain: A one-word prose line that opens the list of measures.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is सत् + गुणः (a good quality) written when joined?
optionExplain: Before a voiced ग the त् does not stay unvoiced.
त् becomes द् here; it does not copy the ग.
न् is not taken before ग here; the result is द्.
Right: त् before the voiced ग becomes द्, as तत् + यथा.
questions.explain: सत् + गुणः = सद्गुणः, like तत् + यथा = तद्यथा.
questions.rule: त् + voiced consonant → द् (before a nasal optionally न्; before ल, ज, ड it assimilates).
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel or a voiced consonant such as ग, ब, य (before a nasal it may instead become न्, optional; before ल, ज, ड it assimilates): तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 6, what is smeared below the navel?
options: The blood of the hare and deer
optionExplain: Right: सहस्रधौतेन सर्पिषा: with ghee washed a thousand times.
Honey with sugar is licked in unit 12, not smeared here.
These are sprinkled in unit 8, not smeared here.
The blood is drunk in unit 14, not smeared here.
questions.explain: Ghee washed a thousand times is smeared below the navel.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 6 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With thousand-washed ghee, below the navel, all round, one should smear.
questions.rule: सहस्रधौतेन → सर्पिषा → अधः → नाभेः → सर्वतः → प्रदिह्यात्.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 6 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Thousand-washed ghee is smeared all round below the navel.
questions.rule: सहस्र, धौत, सर्पिस्, नाभि, सर्वतः, प्रदिह्यात्.
questions.teaches: सहस्रधौत = washed a thousand times; सर्पिस् = ghee.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which split of अधोनाभेः is right?
optionExplain: उनाभेः is not a word; the word is नाभेः.
Right: अः before the voiced न becomes ओ.
अधौ is not a word; the word is अधः.
अधे is not a word; the ओ comes from अः.
questions.explain: अधः (below) + नाभेः (the navel): अः + voiced न → ओ.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 6, where exactly is the ghee smeared?
options: On the soles of both of the feet
optionExplain: अधः means below, not above.
The head is not named in unit 6.
Right: अधो नाभेः सर्वतः: all round below the navel.
The feet are not named in unit 6.
questions.explain: Below the navel, on all sides.
questions.rule: अधः = below; सर्वतः = on all sides.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of अधोनाभेः, how is अधः + मुखम् (face downward) written when joined?
optionExplain: The visarga after अ does not simply vanish before म.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
अः does not become आ before म.
Right: अः before the voiced म becomes ओ, as अधः + नाभेः.
questions.explain: अधः + मुखम् = अधोमुखम्, like अधः + नाभेः = अधोनाभेः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: अधः + नाभेः → अधोनाभेः.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 7, where is the soaked picu placed?
optionExplain: Right: योनिसमीपे स्थापयेत्: one should place it near the yoni.
The navel area is smeared in unit 6; the picu goes near the yoni.
The head is not named in unit 7.
The breasts are not named in unit 7.
questions.explain: The soaked pad is placed near the yoni.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the words of unit 7 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In madhuka-ghee, very cool, a picu, having soaked, near the yoni, one should place.
questions.rule: मधुकसर्पिषा → सुशीतेन → पिचुम् → आप्लाव्य → योनिसमीपे → स्थापयेत्.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 7 to its meaning.
questions.explain: A pad soaked in very cool licorice-ghee is placed near the yoni.
questions.teaches: मधुक = licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra, standard); पिचु = a pad or wad.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Why does आप्लाव्य end in -य and not in -त्वा?
options: The -य marks a passive verb form
It has the prefix आ-, so it takes -य
optionExplain: आप्लाव्य is an absolutive: having soaked.
Right: With a prefix the absolutive ends in -य.
The optative here is स्थापयेत्, not आप्लाव्य.
पिचुम् is singular; -य is not a number ending.
questions.explain: आ + प्लाव्य: a prefixed verb forms its absolutive with -य.
questions.rule: Absolutive: -त्वा without a prefix, -य with a prefix.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: The pad soaked in unit 7 is called ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पिचुमाप्लाव्य = पिचुम् + आप्लाव्य: having soaked a picu.
questions.teaches: पिचु = a pad or wad, often of cotton; पिचुम् is its accusative.
questions.rule: पिचुम् आप्लाव्य = having soaked a pad.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of आप्लाव्य, which is the absolutive (having known) of the prefixed verb वि-√ज्ञा?
optionExplain: -त्वा is not used when a prefix is present.
विज्ञायते is a present passive, not an absolutive.
Right: With the prefix वि-, the absolutive takes -य, as आ-प्लाव्य.
विज्ञास्यति is a future, not an absolutive.
questions.explain: वि + ज्ञा → विज्ञाय, like आ + प्लु (causative) → आप्लाव्य.
questions.teaches: A verb with a prefix forms its absolutive (having done) with -य, not -त्वा: आप्लाव्य = having soaked.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 8, what is done with cow's milk, madhuka-water or the nyagrodha decoction?
options: They are smeared below the navel
They are placed in the yoni
optionExplain: Smearing below the navel is ghee, in unit 6.
Licking with honey is unit 12.
Oils are placed in the yoni in unit 9.
Right: परिषेचयेत्: one should sprinkle.
questions.explain: These three liquids are for sprinkling.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put the liquids of unit 8 in the line's order.
questions.explain: With cow's milk, with madhuka-water, or with the decoction of nyagrodha and the others, one should sprinkle.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each word of unit 8 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Cow's milk, madhuka-water, decoction of the nyagrodha group.
questions.teaches: कषाय in a sprinkling liquid = decoction; न्यग्रोध = banyan (Ficus benghalensis, standard).
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: What does -आदि add in न्यग्रोधादिकषायेण?
options: And the others of its group
The bark of the nyagrodha tree
A second, later decoction of it
optionExplain: Right: न्यग्रोध + आदि = nyagrodha and so on.
-आदि adds others; it does not limit.
Bark is त्वक्; it is not named here.
-आदि does not mean a second decoction.
questions.explain: न्यग्रोधादि = nyagrodha and the others of its group.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which liquids does unit 8 name for sprinkling?
options: A decoction of nyagrodha and the others
optionExplain: Right: गव्येन पयसा.
No hot water is named in unit 8.
Right: मधुकम्बुना.
Right: न्यग्रोधादिकषायेण.
questions.explain: Cow's milk, madhuka-water, or the nyagrodha-group decoction.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the pattern of गव्येन पयसा, which phrase means with cool water (जल, neuter)?
optionExplain: शीतं is not instrumental; it must agree with जलेन.
Right: Adjective and noun both instrumental singular, as गव्येन पयसा.
जलम् is not instrumental; both words take -एन.
शीतस्य is genitive; it must agree in case.
questions.explain: शीतेन जलेन = with cool water, like गव्येन पयसा = with cow's milk.
questions.rule: An adjective agrees with its noun in case, number and gender.
questions.teaches: An adjective takes the same case as its noun: गव्येन (inst.) पयसा (inst.) = with cow's milk.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 9, what is to be placed in the yoni?
optionExplain: The blood is drunk in unit 14.
Rice-water is not named in unit 9.
Right: तैलानि योनौ निधापयेत्: one should have oils placed in the yoni.
Red ochre is in the powder of unit 12.
questions.explain: Oils are placed in the yoni.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Put these clear words of unit 9 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Oils, in the yoni, one should have placed; or of milk-and-ghee, a picu.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Match each clear word of unit 9 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Oils placed in the yoni; or a pad of cooked milk-and-ghee.
questions.teaches: योनौ is locative singular: in the yoni; सिद्ध = cooked, prepared.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which split of तच्छृङ्ग is right?
optionExplain: छृङ्ग is not a word; the word is शृङ्ग.
There is no द् here; the word is तत्, and श is unvoiced.
तः is not a word, and छृङ्ग is not one either.
Right: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ): तत् + शृङ्ग → तच्छृङ्ग.
questions.explain: तत् (that, its) + शृङ्ग: त् + श → च्श or च्छ; the print has च्छ.
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (the print has च्छ).
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 9?
options: The oils are placed in the yoni
The line itself names the tree of the śṛṅga
The line names the trees for the oils
Only परिपीत of the first compound is clear
optionExplain: Right: तैलानि योनौ निधापयेत्.
Only तत् (its) is printed; what it points to is not sure.
No trees are named in unit 9.
Right: the rest is damaged.
questions.explain: Oils in the yoni are clear; the compound and the śṛṅga are uncertain.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By the rule of तच्छृङ्ग, how is तत् + शरीरम् (that body) written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel (च्श also correct), as तत् + शृङ्ग → तच्छृङ्ग.
त् does not become द् before the unvoiced श.
त् does not become श् here.
ज् is voiced; it does not stand before the unvoiced श.
questions.explain: तत् + शरीरम् = तच्छरीरम्, like तत् + शृङ्ग = तच्छृङ्ग.
questions.rule: त् + श → च्श, optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel.
questions.teaches: A final त् with a following श gives च्श, or optionally च्छ before a vowel or semivowel: तत् + शृङ्ग → तच्छृङ्ग.
questions.section: आरंभ: गर्भिणी में पीड़ा व रक्तस्राव पर शीतल उपचार

questions.q: By unit 10, in which condition is an akṣa measure given?
options: When no blood has been seen
When the blood flows too much
When the fetus has turned down
When the pain has gone away
optionExplain: That case begins in unit 23.
Right: अतिस्रवति तु रक्ते: when the blood flows too much.
No turning is named in unit 10.
No end of pain is named in unit 10.
questions.explain: The measure is for excessive flow of blood.
questions.rule: अतिस्रवति रक्ते = when the blood flows too much.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 10 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Flowing too much, but, the blood, from that very, an akṣa measure, one should make her take.
questions.rule: अतिस्रवति → तु → रक्ते → ततः एव → अक्षमात्रम् → प्राशयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 10 to its meaning.
questions.explain: When blood flows too much, an akṣa of that very preparation is given.
questions.teaches: अति- = too much: अतिस्रवति = flowing too much.

questions.q: Which split of तत एव in unit 10 is right?
optionExplain: तत + एव would join to ततैव (अ + ए → ऐ).
ततो is not a base form; ओ is itself a sandhi result of ततः, and the word is ततः.
Right: After अ, a visarga before a vowel other than अ is dropped.
व is not the word; the word is एव.
questions.explain: ततः (from that) + एव (very): अः before ए → अ, with a gap left.
questions.rule: अः + vowel other than अ → अ (visarga dropped).

questions.q: A pregnant woman bleeds too much. By unit 10, what is done?
options: She is made to fast for a day
She is made to walk about and to yawn
She is made to take an akṣa measure
optionExplain: Unit 21 excludes the cleansing treatments.
No fasting is named in unit 10.
No walking or yawning is named in unit 10.
Right: अक्षमात्रं प्राशयेत्.
questions.explain: An akṣa measure of that very preparation is given.

questions.q: By the rule of तत एव, how is रामः + इति (thus, Rāma) written?
optionExplain: Right: अः before इ drops its visarga, as ततः + एव.
ओ comes before voiced consonants, not before इ.
After the visarga drops, the vowels are not joined again.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
questions.explain: रामः + इति = राम इति, like ततः + एव = तत एव.
questions.rule: अः + vowel other than अ → अ (visarga dropped).
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ is dropped before a vowel other than अ, and the gap stays: ततः + एव → तत एव.

questions.q: By unit 11, what is the other source of the measure?
optionExplain: Honey and sugar come in unit 12.
Right: केवलात् एव क्षीरसर्पिषः: from the plain milk-and-ghee.
The nyagrodha decoction is sprinkled in unit 8.
Hare's blood is unit 14.
questions.explain: Or from the plain milk-and-ghee.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 11 in the line's order.
questions.explain: From the plain, indeed, or, milk-and-ghee.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 11 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Or from the plain milk-and-ghee.
questions.teaches: क्षीरसर्पिस् = milk and ghee together; केवल = plain, alone.

questions.q: Which split of केवलादेव is right?
optionExplain: देव (god) has no place here; the word is एव.
अदेव is not the word; the words are केवलात्, एव.
Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्.
आः + ए would lose the visarga: केवला एव.
questions.explain: केवलात् (from the plain) + एव: त् + vowel → द्.

questions.q: Or from the plain milk-and-ghee: ____ एव वा क्षीरसर्पिषः (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: केवलादेव = केवलात् + एव.
questions.teaches: केवलात् is ablative singular of केवल: from the plain one.
questions.rule: केवलात् एव = from the plain one alone.

questions.q: By the rule of केवलादेव, how is जगत् + ईशः (lord of the world) written when joined?
optionExplain: Before a vowel the त् does not stay unvoiced.
The ई of ईशः does not change to ए.
त् does not become न् before a vowel.
Right: त् before a vowel becomes द्, as केवलात् + एव.
questions.explain: जगत् + ईशः = जगदीशः, like केवलात् + एव = केवलादेव.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a vowel: केवलात् + एव → केवलादेव.

questions.q: By unit 12, with what are the flower filaments licked?
optionExplain: Right: समधुशर्करम्: with honey and sugar (śarkarā).
Ghee and milk are not named in unit 12.
Salt and oil are not named in unit 12.
Goat's milk is not named in unit 12.
questions.explain: The filaments are licked with honey and sugar.
questions.rule: स + मधु + शर्करा = with honey and sugar.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 12 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The filaments, with honey and sugar, one should make her lick; dhātakī, the powder of gairika ..., with honey.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 12 to its meaning, with the data's label.
questions.explain: Lotus filaments with honey and sugar; dhātakī and red ochre in the powder.
questions.teaches: किञ्जल्क = the filaments of a flower; गैरिक = red ochre (standard).

questions.q: Which split of पद्मोत्पल is right?
optionExplain: A compound member has no visarga here.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: पद्म + उत्पल = पद्मोत्पल.
त्पल is not a word; the word is उत्पल.
ओत्पल is not a word, and अ + ओ would give औ.
questions.explain: पद्म (lotus) + उत्पल (probably a water lily): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: By unit 12, which of these goes into the powder licked with honey?
optionExplain: Sugar goes with the filaments; the powder is only समधु.
The filaments are the first lickable, not the powder.
Right: गैरिक is a member of the powder.
The nyagrodha bark-and-shoot paste is unit 13.
questions.explain: The powder: dhātakī, gairika, sarjarasa, rasāñjana, with honey.

questions.q: By the rule of समधु (with honey), what does सजलम् mean?
optionExplain: Without would be निर्- or अ-, not स-.
स- does not add honey; it means with.
स- does not mean much; it means with.
Right: स- = with: स + जल = with water, as स + मधु.
questions.explain: सजलम् = with water, like समधु = with honey.
questions.teaches: स- before a noun means with: स + मधु = समधु, with honey.

questions.q: By unit 13, which parts of the trees go into the paste?
optionExplain: Right: त्वक्प्रवाल: bark and tender shoots.
Roots and flowers are not named in unit 13.
Fruits and seeds are not named in unit 13.
Leaves and resin are not named in unit 13.
questions.explain: The paste is of bark and tender shoots.

questions.q: Put the parts of the compound of unit 13 in order.
questions.explain: Nyagrodha, and the others, bark, tender shoots, paste.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 13 to its meaning.
questions.explain: A paste of the bark and shoots of the nyagrodha group.
questions.teaches: कल्क = a paste of ground drugs; प्रवाल = a tender shoot.

questions.q: Why is कल्कम् printed कल्कं before वा in unit 13?
options: The ं marks the plural of कल्क
Final म् before a consonant becomes ं
Final म् becomes ं before vowels too
optionExplain: कल्कम् is singular; ं here is sandhi.
Right: व is a consonant, so कल्कम् → कल्कं.
कल्कम् is accusative; ं here is sandhi.
Before a vowel म् joins it: कल्कमत्र.
questions.explain: कल्कम् + वा = कल्कं वा: म् before a consonant → anusvāra.

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 13?
options: It is made from nyagrodha alone
The paste is of bark and tender shoots
How the paste is used is not stated
The paste is to be drunk with milk
optionExplain: -आदि adds the other trees of the group.
Right: त्वक्प्रवालकल्कम्.
