questions.explain: जल + ऊर्मिः = जलोर्मिः, like च + ऊर्ध्वम् = चोर्ध्वम्.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ऊ joins as ओ: च + ऊर्ध्वम् → चोर्ध्वम्.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 30, what kind of (ones) should one apply in that case?
optionExplain: The unit says cool and dry, the opposite.
Neither heavy nor warm is named in unit 30.
Right: रूक्षशीतानि: रूक्ष (dry) and शीत (cool).
Neither sour nor hot is named in unit 30.
questions.explain: Dry and cool (ones) are applied.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put the words of unit 30 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In that case, dry and cool (ones), one should apply.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 30 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words: the case, two qualities, and the verb.
questions.teaches: रूक्षशीतानि is a dvandva: रूक्ष and शीत, both qualities of the unstated (ones).
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By its data, what form is प्रयुञ्जीत in unit 30?
optionExplain: The data reads optative, not a past tense.
The data reads optative, not a future.
It is third person optative, not a second-person imperative.
Right: The data: 3 sg. optative middle of प्र-√युज्: one should apply.
questions.explain: -ईत here is the optative middle ending: one should apply.
questions.rule: प्रयुञ्जीत = 3 sg. optative middle: should apply.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Someone renders unit 30 as: In that case one should apply dry and cool foods. What is wrong?
options: No noun is printed in the line
तत्र means never, not in that case
optionExplain: Right: The data: the nouns are unstated, so it writes (ones).
रूक्ष means dry; oily would be स्निग्ध.
शीत means cool; hot would be उष्ण.
तत्र is glossed in that case; it is no negative.
questions.explain: Foods is added; the line names no noun.
questions.rule: रूक्षशीतानि: the noun is not stated.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the pattern of रूक्षशीतानि, what does a new example लघुशीतानि mean?
options: Cool, but not at all light
optionExplain: A dvandva joins with and; it gives no reason.
Right: A dvandva of two qualities, like रूक्ष + शीत: light and cool.
-आनि is a neuter plural of adjectives, not an abstract noun.
Nothing is negated; both qualities hold.
questions.explain: लघु (light) + शीत (cool) = light and cool (ones).
questions.rule: Quality + quality as a dvandva: X and Y (ones).
questions.teaches: Two quality words joined as a dvandva in the neuter plural mean 'X and Y (ones)': रूक्षशीतानि = dry and cool (ones).
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: What does तद्यथा do in unit 31?
options: Closes a list: thus it is ended
Gives a cause: because of it
optionExplain: Closing is done by इति; तद्यथा opens.
A cause would be तस्मात् or -त्वात्; यथा means as, namely.
Right: तत् (that) + यथा (as, namely): it opens a list.
After that would be ततः or तदनन्तरम्.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = that is as follows.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each part of unit 31 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two words make the phrase that is as follows.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Complete the split: तद्यथा = तत् + ____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तत् + यथा: the second word is यथा (as, namely).
questions.teaches: तद्यथा = तत् + यथा; त् before the voiced य becomes द्.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Which split of तद्यथा is right?
optionExplain: अथा is not a word, and त् + अ would give तदथा.
तद is not a word here, and it would give तदयथा.
तद्य and था are not the words; the words are तत् and यथा.
Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as, namely).
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Which rule makes तत् + यथा into तद्यथा?
options: त् before a voiced sound → द्
optionExplain: Right: य is voiced, so त् becomes द्.
च् would come before श, च or छ, not before य.
The त् stays as द्; it is not dropped.
No doubling: त् simply becomes द्.
questions.explain: A final त् before a voiced sound becomes द्.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is एतत् + युद्धम् (this battle) written when joined?
optionExplain: Before a voiced sound the त् does not stay.
Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्, as तत् + यथा.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal; य is not a nasal.
च् comes before श, च or छ, not before य.
questions.explain: एतत् + युद्धम् = एतद्युद्धम्, like तत् + यथा = तद्यथा.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a voiced sound becomes द्: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 32, what is done first?
optionExplain: No smoke is named in unit 32.
No oil rubbing is named in unit 32.
Right: प्रागुपवासम्: first, fasting.
No sleep is named in unit 32.
questions.explain: Fasting comes first: प्राक् = first.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 32 in the line's order.
questions.explain: First fasting; the drink of the drug list; the gruel as food; with soups of mudga and the like; when āma is overcome, unctuous and cool as before.
questions.rule: उपवास → पान → पेया-अशन → मुद्गादि-यूष → जिते आमे स्निग्धशीतानि.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 32 to the identification its data gives.
questions.explain: Six drugs of the list, each with the label its data gives.
questions.rule: अमृता, उशीर, अतिविषा, धान्यक: standard; पर्पटक: probable; दुरालभा: disputed.
questions.teaches: Drug names stand together in one compound that ends in -पानम् (drinking).
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Which split of त्वामे in जिते त्वामे is right?
optionExplain: उ + अ would give त्वमे, with a short अ.
ए + आ would give तयामे or त आमे, not त्वामे.
The words are तु (but) and आमे (when āma), not त्वा and मे.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: तु + आमे → त्वामे.
questions.explain: तु (but) + आमे (when āma): उ + आ → वा.
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + that vowel.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 32, when are unctuous and cool (ones) given, as before?
optionExplain: Right: जिते तु आमे: but when āma has been overcome.
The fast comes first; unctuous and cool come last.
The decoction is a separate measure; unctuous and cool come once āma is overcome.
No day is named; the condition is that āma is overcome.
questions.explain: Unctuous and cool (ones) follow once āma has been overcome.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the rule of त्वामे (तु + आमे), how is मधु + आनय (bring honey) written when joined?
optionExplain: उ and आ are not left side by side in sandhi.
Right: उ before a different vowel becomes व्: मधु + आनय → मध्वानय.
उ + आ does not give ओ.
ऊ comes from उ + उ, not from उ + आ.
questions.explain: मधु + आनय = मध्वानय, like तु + आमे = त्वामे.
questions.teaches: A final उ before आ becomes व्: तु + आमे → त्वामे.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 33, what is she made to drink when the āma-garbha has fallen?
optionExplain: Sugarcane juice is not named in unit 33.
Cold water with sugar is not named in unit 33.
Right: मद्यानामन्यतमं पाययेत्: any one of the madyas.
Buttermilk is not named in unit 33.
questions.explain: Any one of the intoxicating drinks (madya), according to capacity.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put the phrases of unit 33 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When the āma-garbha has fallen, any one of the madyas, according to capacity, one should make her drink, for cleansing the garbha-koṣṭha and for forgetting the pain.
questions.rule: आमगर्भे तु पतिते → मद्यानामन्यतमं → सामर्थ्यतः → पाययेत् → ...विशुद्ध्यर्थम् → ...विस्मरणार्थं च.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 33 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The event, the drink (any one), the measure, and the pain it helps to forget.
questions.teaches: अन्यतम = any one (of several): मद्यानाम् अन्यतमम् = any one of the madyas.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Which purposes of the drink does unit 33 name?
optionExplain: The embryo has fallen; growth is not a purpose here.
Right: गर्भकोष्ठविशुद्ध्यर्थम्.
Stopping bleeding is not named in unit 33.
Right: अर्तिविस्मरणार्थम्.
questions.explain: Two purposes: cleansing the garbha-koṣṭha and forgetting the pain.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the data of unit 33, what is the garbha-koṣṭha?
optionExplain: The data reads the embryo's storehouse, probably the womb.
The bladder is not how the data reads garbha-koṣṭha.
The mouth is not the storehouse of the embryo.
Right: garbha-koṣṭha = the storehouse of the embryo, probably the womb.
questions.explain: koṣṭha = storehouse; garbha-koṣṭha = probably the womb.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the pattern of अर्तिविस्मरणार्थम्, what does a new example रोगनाशार्थम् mean?
optionExplain: Right: -अर्थम् at the end of a compound = for the purpose of.
Because of would be an ablative such as -त्वात्.
-अर्थम् gives a purpose, not an agent.
After having would be an absolutive, not -अर्थम्.
questions.explain: रोग (disease) + नाश (destruction) + अर्थम् (for) = for destroying disease.
questions.rule: X-अर्थम् = for the purpose of X.
questions.teaches: -अर्थम् at the end of a compound means for the purpose of: अर्तिविस्मरणार्थम् = for forgetting the pain.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 34, with what is a non-drinker of madya treated?
optionExplain: No bath is named in unit 34.
Right: ...यवागूभिरुपाचरेत्: with yavāgūs, thick gruels.
No fruit juice is named in unit 34.
No milk is named in unit 34.
questions.explain: She is treated with thick gruels of uddālaka and the like.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put the words of unit 34 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The non-drinker, with gruels joined with digestives, without sneha and salt, with sesame, of uddālaka and the like, one should treat.
questions.rule: अमद्यपां → पाचनीय... → स्नेहलोणवर्जाभिः → सतिलाभिः → उद्दालकादियवागूभिः → उपाचरेत्.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 34 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Who is treated, and what the gruel is like.
questions.teaches: -वर्ज at the end of a compound = without: स्नेहलोणवर्ज = without sneha and salt.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 34, what is kept out of the gruels?
optionExplain: Sesame is added (सतिलाभिः); uddālaka is the grain of the gruel.
They are added: पाचनीयद्रव्योपहिताभिः.
Right: स्नेहलोणवर्जाभिः: without sneha and salt.
The gruel is of uddālaka and the like, with sesame.
questions.explain: Fat and salt are left out; digestives and sesame are added.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 34, for how long are the gruels given?
optionExplain: This reverses the line: days are counted by months.
No fixed number of days is printed.
No such end point is named in unit 34.
Right: यावन्तो मासास्तावन्त्यहानि: as many days as there are months.
questions.explain: The count of days equals the count of months.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the rule of मासास्तावन्ति (मासाः + तावन्ति), how is बालाः + तिष्ठन्ति (the boys stand) written?
optionExplain: Right: Visarga before त becomes स्, as मासाः + तावन्ति.
आः drops its visarga before a voiced sound; त is unvoiced.
Before त the visarga becomes स्, not श्.
The आ does not change to ओ.
questions.explain: बालाः + तिष्ठन्ति = बालास्तिष्ठन्ति, like मासाः + तावन्ति = मासास्तावन्ति.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त becomes स्: मासाः + तावन्ति → मासास्तावन्ति.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 35, what kind of foods are given then?
options: Sour, salty and heavy, in large measure
Raw, bitter and scanty, once a day
optionExplain: None of these qualities is named in unit 35.
Right: प्रीणनैर्बलानुरक्षिभिरस्नेहैराहारैः.
None of these qualities is named in unit 35.
None of these qualities is named in unit 35.
questions.explain: Foods that refresh, guard strength and are without sneha.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put the words of unit 35 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, with refreshing, strength-protecting, non-unctuous foods, until the cleansing of doṣa, dhātu and kleda.
questions.rule: ततः → प्रीणनैः → बलानुरक्षिभिः → अस्नेहैः → आहारैः → आ ...शुद्धेः.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 35 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three qualities of the foods and the end point (cleansing).
questions.teaches: अ- before a consonant negates: स्नेह → अस्नेह, without sneha.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: In आ दोषधातुक्लेदशुद्धेः, what does आ with the ablative mean here?
optionExplain: Without would be a word like विना or -वर्ज.
The data reads ā + ablative as until, not as a cause.
Right: The data: ā + ablative = until (the cleansing).
Together with would be सह or स-.
questions.explain: आ + ablative = until: until the cleansing of doṣa, dhātu and kleda.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: A cook adds ghee to these foods. Does that fit unit 35?
options: Yes: ghee will guard her strength
Yes: any refreshing food will do
No: the foods must all be raw
No: the foods are without sneha
optionExplain: The foods must guard strength, but they are also asneha.
Refreshing is not enough; the foods are without sneha.
Raw is not named; the reason is that they are without sneha.
Right: अस्नेहैः आहारैः: the foods are without sneha (oil, fat).
questions.explain: Ghee is a sneha, so it does not fit foods that are asneha.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the rule of अस्नेहैराहारैः (अस्नेहैः + आहारैः), how is पुष्पैः + अर्चति (worships with flowers) written?
optionExplain: Right: After ऐ the visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound (here a vowel).
Before a vowel the visarga after ऐ does not stay.
ऐ does not change to आ.
स् comes before त or थ, not before a vowel.
questions.explain: पुष्पैः + अर्चति = पुष्पैरर्चति, like अस्नेहैः + आहारैः = अस्नेहैराहारैः.
questions.rule: A vowel other than अ/आ + ः, before a voiced sound → र्.
questions.teaches: After a vowel other than अ or आ, the visarga becomes र् before a voiced sound: अस्नेहैः + आहारैः → अस्नेहैराहारैः.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 36, what follows if a remnant of the āma-garbha stays?
optionExplain: No fever is named in unit 36.
Right: पुनः पुनः शूलमनुषज्येत: pain would cling on again and again.
No swelling is named in unit 36.
No loss of hunger is named in unit 36.
questions.explain: A remnant brings pain again and again.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 36 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Because of a remnant, again and again, pain would cling on; therefore, with sharp ones, leaving nothing, one should treat.
questions.rule: शेष → पुनः पुनः → शूल → तस्मात् → तीक्ष्णैः → अनवशेषयन् उपाचरेत्.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: Match each word of unit 36 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The cause (remnant), its effect (pain again and again), and the remedy.
questions.rule: शेष, पुनः पुनः, शूल, तीक्ष्ण, अनवशेषयन्.
questions.teaches: अनवशेषयन् = अन् (not) + अवशेषयन् (making remain): making nothing remain.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: What jobs do हि and तस्मात् do in unit 36?
options: Both mark time: then, and then
हि negates; तस्मात् names a place
हि gives the cause; तस्मात् the result
optionExplain: Neither is a time word here; they give cause and result.
हि is not a negative, and तस्मात् is therefore.
Right: हि = for, because; तस्मात् = therefore.
The data glosses हि as for, because, and तस्मात् as therefore.
questions.explain: Cause (हि) in the first line, conclusion (तस्मात्) in the second.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By unit 36, how should one treat, given the risk of a remnant?
options: With mild ones, little by little
Not at all: wait till it passes
optionExplain: The unit says sharp (तीक्ष्ण), not mild.
The unit says sharp ones, leaving no remnant.
The unit says one should treat (उपाचरेत्).
Right: तीक्ष्णैः अनवशेषयन् उपाचरेत्.
questions.explain: Sharp measures, so that no remnant is left.
questions.section: तीन मास से पूर्व स्राव व आमगर्भ-पतन

questions.q: By the pattern of अनवशेषयन् (अन् + अवशेषयन्), how is the negative of उचित (proper) made?
optionExplain: Right: Before a vowel the negative is अन्-: अन् + उचित → अनुचित.
Before a vowel the negative is अन्-, not अ-.
The negative prefix is अ-/अन्-, not न-.
There is no व् in the negative prefix.
questions.explain: अन् + उचित = अनुचित, like अन् + अवशेषयन् = अनवशेषयन्.

questions.q: By the pattern of परिगृह्य and प्रतिपीड्य, which form is the absolutive of आ + √गम् (to come)?

questions.q: By the rule of नात्यल्पम् (न + अति), how is न + अस्ति (is not) joined?

questions.explain: The belly, though grown, diminishes; the names are upaśuṣkaka and nāgodara.
questions.teaches: नागोदर = नाग + उदर: the data keeps it as a name, literally 'nāga-belly'.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of वृद्धोऽपि is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give वृद्धापि, with आ and no ऽ.
ए + अ would give वृद्धेऽपि, with ए kept.
पि is not a word; the word is अपि (though).
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ: the अ of अपि is dropped and marked ऽ.
questions.explain: वृद्धः (grown) + अपि (though): अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which statements about unit 43 are right by the card?
options: The text explains what nāgodara means
It is not settled whether the two names are one condition or two
Printed चरिहीयते is kept as a real verb
नाग may mean serpent or elephant
optionExplain: The data says the text does not explain it.
Right: the note leaves it open.
It is read as परिहीयते, a near-certain correction (c for p).
Right: the note gives both senses.
questions.explain: The card leaves open both the sense of nāga and whether the names are one condition or two.
questions.rule: तदुपशुष्ककं नागोदरं च: names, not explained.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of तदुपशुष्ककम्, how is तत् + अन्नम् (that food) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्, as तत् + उपशुष्ककम्.
Before a vowel the final त् does not stay unvoiced; it becomes द्.
त् may become न् before a nasal such as न or म, not before a vowel.
त् + श gives च्श or च्छ; here no श follows.
questions.explain: तत् + अन्नम् = तदन्नम्, like तत् + उपशुष्ककम् = तदुपशुष्ककम्.
questions.teaches: A word-final त् becomes द् before a vowel: तत् + उपशुष्ककम् → तदुपशुष्ककम्.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 44, what does the woman do in the end, even after groups of years?
optionExplain: The unit says the opposite: she gives birth indeed (एव).
Right: वर्षगणैरपि प्रमदा प्रसूयत एव: she gives birth indeed.
Monthly ārtava is unit 42; unit 44 speaks of birth.
The unit says she does give birth, even after years.
questions.explain: Even after groups of years, she gives birth.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 44 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Those two, by the slight tejas of the mother's food, being nourished, when they become well nourished, then even after groups of years the woman gives birth.
questions.rule: तौ तु → मातुराहारतेजसाऽल्पेन → आप्यायमानौ → यदा पुष्टौ स्यातां → तदा वर्षगणैरपि → प्रमदा प्रसूयत एव.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 44 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Slow nourishment, then birth even after a long time.
questions.teaches: यदा ... तदा = when ... then: यदा पुष्टौ स्यातां तदा ... प्रसूयते.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of मातुराहार is right?
optionExplain: आ + आ would give माताहार, with no र्.
ऋ + आ would give मात्राहार, not मातुर्.
Right: उः before a vowel becomes उर्: मातुः (of the mother) + आहार.
मातुरा is not a form of माता; the genitive is मातुः.
questions.explain: मातुः (of the mother) + आहार (food): the visarga after उ becomes र् before आ.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: A woman in this state has not delivered for years. What does unit 44 say?
options: She must deliver within twelve years
Only the father's food can nourish the two of them
They grow strong on rich, abundant food
Once they are well nourished, she gives birth
optionExplain: No number of years is stated; the text says groups of years.
They are nourished by the tejas of the mother's food.
The tejas is slight (अल्पेन), not abundant.
Right: यदा पुष्टौ स्यातां तदा ... प्रसूयत एव.
questions.explain: When they become well nourished, she gives birth, even after groups of years.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of वर्षगणैरपि, how is देवैः + अपि (even by the gods) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga after ऐ before a vowel becomes र्, as गणैः + अपि.
The avagraha marks a dropped अ after ए or ओ, not after ऐः.
The word ends in a visarga, so ऐ does not meet the vowel and become आय्.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ (देवः + अपि), a different word.
questions.explain: देवैः + अपि = देवैरपि, like वर्षगणैः + अपि = वर्षगणैरपि.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a vowel: वर्षगणैः + अपि → वर्षगणैरपि.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 45, how is the stool passed under Vāta?
options: Not at all; it is held
optionExplain: The unit says the opposite: with sound (सशब्दम्), broken.
Right: सशब्दं फेनिलं विच्छिन्नं शकृदुपवेश्यते.
Blood and pus are not named in unit 45.
It is urine that is held back (उपरुध्यते); stool is passed.
questions.explain: Stool is passed noisy, frothy and broken.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Put these signs of unit 45 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Noisy, frothy, broken stool; urine held back; pain in waist, back and heart; loss of sleep; dry cough; hard digestion.
questions.rule: शकृत् → मूत्र → वेदना → निद्रानाश → शुष्ककास → दुःखेन जरण.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Match each 'as it were' (इव) sign of unit 45 to what it says.
pairs: the two ears, as it were, hum
the two temples, as it were, are pricked
the body, as it were, is joined with ants
as if cutting, it wanders in the belly
questions.explain: Four of the line's similes, each marked by इव (as it were).
questions.rule: क्ष्वेलेते इव कर्णौ, तुद्येते इव शंखौ, पिपीलिकाभिरिव संसृज्यते शरीरम्, परिकृन्तन्निव वायुर्भ्रमति.
questions.teaches: इव = as it were, like: it marks a sensation described by a comparison.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of निद्रानाशोऽभीक्ष्णम् is right?
optionExplain: अ + अ would give निद्रानाशाभीक्ष्णम्, with आ.
ए + अ would give निद्रानाशेऽभीक्ष्णम्, with ए.
Right: अः + अ → ओऽ: the अ of अभीक्ष्णम् is dropped and marked ऽ.
भीक्ष्णम् is not a word; the word is अभीक्ष्णम्.
questions.explain: निद्रानाशः (loss of sleep) + अभीक्ष्णम् (repeatedly): अः + अ → ओऽ.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which of these are Vāta signs named in unit 45?
options: Burning in the belly and heart
A sweet taste in the mouth
optionExplain: Right: शुष्ककासः.
Burning (दाह) is a Pitta sign, unit 46.
Right: स्फुटितविवर्णपरुषत्वक्त्वम्.
A sweet mouth is a Kapha sign, unit 47.
Right: निद्रानाशः.
questions.explain: Dry cough, loss of sleep and rough, cracked skin are Vāta signs; burning and a sweet mouth are not.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of वातेनोपविष्टक, how is सूर्य + उदयः (sunrise) joined?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or अ + औ, not from अ + उ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + उ.
The अ does not simply vanish before उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as वातेन + उपविष्टक.
questions.explain: सूर्य + उदयः = सूर्योदयः, like वातेन + उपविष्टक = वातेनोपविष्टक.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by उ joins as ओ: वातेन + उपविष्टक → वातेनोपविष्टक.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 46, where is burning felt under Pitta?
options: In the belly and the heart
In the hands and the feet
In the ears and the temples
In the waist and the back
optionExplain: Right: कुक्षिहृदयदाहः: burning of the belly and heart.
Hands and feet are white in the Kapha picture, unit 47.
Ears hum and temples are pricked under Vāta, unit 45.
Pain in waist and back is a Vāta sign, unit 45.
questions.explain: Burning is in the belly and the heart.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Put these signs of unit 46 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Vomiting, fainting, burning of belly and heart, (eyes, urine, nails coloured), dark, weak, constantly in pain.
questions.rule: छर्दिः → मूर्च्छा → कुक्षिहृदयदाहः → काली → दुर्बला → नित्यशूला.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 46 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five of the Pitta signs.
questions.teaches: नित्यशूला is a bahuvrīhi: she whose pain (शूल) is constant (नित्य).
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of छर्दिर्मूर्च्छा is right?
optionExplain: With no visarga, no र् would appear: छर्दिमूर्च्छा.
Right: A visarga after इ before a voiced sound becomes र्.
म् before म would give छर्दिम्मूर्च्छा or छर्दिं मूर्च्छा, not र्.
छर्दिर is not a word; the word is छर्दि (vomiting).
questions.explain: छर्दिः (vomiting) + मूर्च्छा (fainting): इः + voiced म → इर्.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 46, what does the woman become under Pitta?
options: White in her hands, feet, eyes
Plump, strong and free of pain
optionExplain: None of these is said of her in unit 46.
White hands, feet and eyes are the Kapha picture, unit 47.
Right: काली दुर्बला नित्यशूला च नारी भवति.
The unit says weak (दुर्बला) and constantly in pain.
questions.explain: She becomes dark, weak and constantly in pain.
questions.rule: काली दुर्बला नित्यशूला च नारी भवति.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By the abstract suffix of ...नखत्वम्, what does गुरुत्वम् mean?
options: A heavy man, one who is heavy
Of the teacher, the guru's own
optionExplain: That would be the adjective गुरुः used of a person.
A comparative is made with -तर (गुरुतर), not -त्व.
That would be a genitive (गुरोः), not an -त्व noun.
Right: -त्व makes an abstract noun: the state of being गुरु (heavy).
questions.explain: गुरु + त्व = गुरुत्वम्, the state of being heavy, as ...नख + त्व = the state of the nails (being so coloured).
questions.teaches: The suffix -त्व makes an abstract neuter noun, 'the state of being X': ...नेत्रमूत्रनखत्वम्.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 47, what taste is in the mouth under Kapha?
optionExplain: Right: मधुरास्यत्वम्: the state of a sweet mouth.
Bitterness is not named in unit 47.
Saltiness is not named in unit 47.
Pungency is not named in unit 47.
questions.explain: The mouth is sweet.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Put these signs of unit 47 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Sweet mouth, nausea, bringing up phlegm, aversion to food, white hands-feet-eyes, cough and breathlessness.
questions.rule: मधुरास्यत्वम् → उत्क्लेशः → श्लेष्मोद्वमनं → भक्तद्वेषः → श्वेतहस्तपादनेत्रता → कासः श्वासश्च.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Match each sign of unit 47 to its meaning.
pairs: whiteness of hands, feet and eyes
questions.explain: Five of the seven Kapha signs.
questions.teaches: भक्त = food, meal; द्वेष = aversion: भक्तद्वेष = aversion to food.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: Which split of श्लेष्मोद्वमनम् is right?
optionExplain: द्वमन is not a word; the word is उद्वमन.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: श्लेष्म (phlegm, compound form) + उद्वमन (bringing up).
ओद्वमन is not a word, and अ + ओ would give औ.
ए before उ does not give ओ.
questions.explain: श्लेष्म + उद्वमनम्: अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 47, what colour do the hands, feet and eyes take under Kapha?
optionExplain: Yellow eyes, urine and nails belong to the Pitta picture, unit 46.
Coppery-green is said of what is passed under Pitta, unit 46.
Right: श्वेतहस्तपादनेत्रता: whiteness of hands, feet and eyes.
The woman becomes dark (काली) under Pitta, unit 46.
questions.explain: Under Kapha the hands, feet and eyes are white.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By the rule of मधुरास्य (मधुर + आस्य), how is हिम + आलयः joined?
optionExplain: The long आ is not lost; अ + आ gives आ.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not from अ + आ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + आ.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as मधुर + आस्य → मधुरास्य.
questions.explain: हिम + आलयः = हिमालयः, like मधुर + आस्य = मधुरास्य.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by a long आ joins as आ: मधुर + आस्य → मधुरास्य.
questions.section: उपविष्टक, उपशुष्कक, नागोदर: कारण व लक्षण

questions.q: By unit 48, what is to be used for those two?
optionExplain: Right: सर्पिषामुपयोगः: the use of ghees cooked with medicines.
Bloodletting is not named in unit 48.
Ear drops are not named in unit 48.
Cold water on the head is not named in unit 48.
questions.explain: Ghees cooked with life-promoting, nourishing and sweet medicines.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 48 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For those two, life-promoting, nourishing, cooked with sweet medicines, of ghees, the use.
questions.rule: तयोः → जीवनीय → बृंहणीय → मधुरौषधसिद्धानां → सर्पिषाम् → उपयोगः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 48 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Ghees cooked with three kinds of medicine.
questions.teaches: सिद्ध after a list of drugs = cooked with them: ...औषधसिद्ध = cooked with the medicines.

questions.q: Which split of मधुरौषध is right?
optionExplain: अ + उ would give ओ (मधुरोषध), not औ.
Right: अ + औ → औ: मधुर (sweet) + औषध (medicine).
ए before औ would not give औ.
षध is not a word; the word is औषध.
questions.explain: मधुर + औषध: अ + औ → औ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 48 are right by the card?
options: It lists the members of the jīvanīya class
सर्पिषाम् is plural: more than one ghee
It gives the dose of each ghee
No verb is printed in the line
optionExplain: The members are not listed here.
Right: the note says plural.
No dose is given.
Right: the use 'is to be made' is understood.
questions.explain: Plural ghees, no verb, no list of class members and no dose.

questions.q: By the rule of तयोर्जीवनीय, how is गुरोः + वचनम् (the teacher's word) joined?
optionExplain: The visarga after ओ is not simply dropped before व.
The visarga becomes श् before च, छ or श, not before व.
Right: A visarga after ओ before a voiced sound becomes र्, as तयोः + जीवनीय.
ऽ marks a dropped अ; no अ follows here.
questions.explain: गुरोः + वचनम् = गुरोर्वचनम्, like तयोः + जीवनीय = तयोर्जीवनीय.
questions.teaches: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ becomes र् before a voiced sound: तयोः + जीवनीय → तयोर्जीवनीय.

questions.q: By unit 49, which of these is named, likewise, for use?
optionExplain: Madya is named in unit 33, for another case, not here.
Oil is not named in unit 49.
Honey is not named in unit 49.
Right: पयसाम्: of milks.
questions.explain: Milks, rasas and āmagarbhas are named.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 49 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, of milks, of rasas, of āmagarbhas, and.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 49 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Likewise, milks and the others, promoting growth.
questions.teaches: -कर at the end of a compound = making: गर्भवृद्धिकर = making the growth of the fetus.

questions.q: By the data, why is करः (making) masculine in unit 49?
options: It agrees with उपयोगः of unit 48
It agrees with the word पयसाम्
It agrees with the word गर्भ alone
It is a verb in the third person
optionExplain: Right: The note: masculine करः agrees with the understood उपयोगः.
पयस् is neuter, and पयसाम् is a genitive plural.
गर्भ is the first member of the compound, not the noun it qualifies.
करः is a noun-form ending (nom. sg.), not a verb.
questions.explain: करः qualifies the understood उपयोगः (use) of unit 48.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 49 are right by the card?
options: Rasa here certainly means meat broth
The sense of rasa is not settled
āmagarbha is kept as printed, sense uncertain
The text says whose āmagarbha is meant
optionExplain: The note: meat broth or other juices, not settled.
Right: the note leaves it open.
Right: kept as printed, not enriched.
The note: the text does not say whose.
questions.explain: Rasa and āmagarbha are kept open, as the data leaves them.

questions.q: By the rule of रसानामामगर्भाणाम्, how is फलानाम् + आम्राणाम् written joined?
optionExplain: The anusvāra stands before a consonant, not before a vowel.
Right: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins it, as रसानाम् + आमगर्भाणाम्.
The म् is not lost; it stays and the vowel follows it.
म् + आ does not make an ओ.
questions.explain: फलानाम् + आम्राणाम् = फलानामाम्राणाम्, like रसानाम् + आमगर्भाणाम्.
questions.rule: म् + vowel → म् joined to the vowel.
questions.teaches: A word-final म् before a vowel stays म् and is written joined to it: रसानाम् + आमगर्भाणाम् → रसानामामगर्भाणाम्.

questions.q: By unit 50, with what is the feeding done?
optionExplain: Meat is not named in unit 50.
Water is not named in unit 50.
Right: एतैरेव च घृतादिभिः: with these very ones, ghee and the others.
Unit 50 names feeding (संभोजन), not fasting.
questions.explain: With these very ones, ghee and the others.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 50 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, feeding, with these very ones, and, with ghee and the others.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 50 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Feeding with these very ones, ghee and the like.
questions.teaches: एव after a pronoun stresses it: एतैरेव = with these very ones.

questions.q: Which split of एतैरेव is right?
optionExplain: रेव is not a word; the word is एव (very).
ए + ए would give एत एव, with no र्.
एतैर is not a form; the instrumental is एतैः.
Right: A visarga after ऐ before a vowel becomes र्: एतैः + एव → एतैरेव.
questions.explain: एतैः (with these) + एव (very): ऐः + vowel → ऐर्.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 50 are right by the card?
options: It names a new drug not met before
It gives the amount of ghee
The nouns of एतैः are not stated
No verb is printed in the line
optionExplain: It refers back: these very ones, ghee and the like.
No amount is given.
Right: the note says they are not stated.
Right: the line is elliptical.
questions.explain: A verbless line that points back to ghee and the like.

questions.q: By the sense of घृतादिभिः, what does फलादिभिः mean?
optionExplain: Right: आदि closing a compound = and the others: फल + आदि.
आदि does not negate; 'without' would need a word like विना.
-भिः is plural (with), and आदि adds others.
आदि adds others; it does not restrict.
questions.explain: फल + आदि + भिः = with fruits and the like, as घृत + आदि + भिः = with ghee and the others.
questions.teaches: आदि at the end of a compound means 'and the others': घृतादिभिः = with ghee and the others.

questions.q: By unit 51, how often is the 'bringing about' (upapādana) done?
optionExplain: The unit says अभीक्ष्णम्, repeatedly.
Right: अभीक्ष्णम् = repeatedly.
No interval is named in unit 51.
No time of day is named in unit 51.
questions.explain: It is done repeatedly.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 51 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of one well fed, repeatedly, by carriages, vehicles and the like, by shaking, rubbing and yawning, the bringing about.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 51 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The words of the line; मार्जन and जृम्भण each have two senses in the data.
questions.teaches: उपपादन = bringing about, arranging; its object is not stated in unit 51.

questions.q: Which split of सुभिक्षाया अभीक्ष्णम् is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would merge into सुभिक्षायाभीक्ष्णम्, one word.
म् would stay and join: सुभिक्षायामभीक्ष्णम्.
Right: आः before a vowel drops its visarga, and the words stay apart.
अः + अ would give सुभिक्षायोऽभीक्ष्णम्, with ओऽ.
questions.explain: सुभिक्षायाः (of her well fed) + अभीक्ष्णम्: the visarga after आ drops before a vowel; no further joining.
questions.rule: आः + vowel → आ (visarga dropped, gap kept).

questions.q: Which statements about unit 51 are right by the card?
options: The object of उपपादन is not stated
The sense of the line is firm
Means or result: the instrumentals are open
optionExplain: Right: the note says it is not stated.
The data says the sense is not firm (low confidence).
Only यान, वाहन and the like (आदि) are named, in general.
Right: the note leaves this open.
questions.explain: The line's sense is not firm: the object and the role of the instrumentals are open.
questions.rule: सुभिक्षाया अभीक्ष्णं ... उपपादनम्: sense not firm.

questions.q: By the rule of सुभिक्षाया अभीक्ष्णम्, how is बालाः + आगच्छन्ति (the boys come) joined?
optionExplain: After the visarga drops, the two vowels are not merged again.
ओ comes from a visarga after short अ, not after आ.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
Right: After आ the visarga drops before a vowel, and the gap stays.
questions.explain: बालाः + आगच्छन्ति = बाला आगच्छन्ति, like सुभिक्षायाः + अभीक्ष्णम् = सुभिक्षाया अभीक्ष्णम्.
questions.rule: आः + vowel → आ (visarga dropped, no further sandhi).
questions.teaches: A visarga after आ is dropped before a vowel, and the vowels do not merge: सुभिक्षायाः + अभीक्ष्णम् → सुभिक्षाया अभीक्ष्णम्.

questions.q: By unit 52, what is given first, especially in Vāta?
options: A milk enema with rock salt
A fast of three whole days
optionExplain: Right: सैंधवोपहितं क्षीरबस्तिं दत्वा: a milk-basti with saindhava.
No purge is named in unit 52.
Oil on the head is not named in unit 52.
No fast is named in unit 52.
questions.explain: First a milk-basti provided with rock salt.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 52 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then especially in Vāta, first, a milk-basti with rock salt, having given, soft śāli rice, one should feed.
questions.rule: अथ विशेषेण वाते → पूर्वमेव → सैंधवोपहितं क्षीरबस्तिं → दत्वा → मृदु शाल्योदनं → भोजयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 52 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Rock salt in the milk enema first; then soft boiled rice.
questions.teaches: उपहित = provided with: सैन्धवोपहित = provided with rock salt.

questions.q: Which split of शाल्योदनम् is right?
optionExplain: अ + ओ would give औ (शाल्यौदनम्), not यो.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: शालि + ओदनम् → शाल्योदनम्.
ए before ओ does not give यो.
योदन is not a word; the word is ओदन (boiled rice).
questions.explain: शालि (śāli rice) + ओदनम् (boiled rice): इ + ओ → यो.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: By unit 52, what kind of rice is she fed?
optionExplain: Barley is not named in unit 52; the rice is soft (मृदु).
No gruel and no sour taste are named in unit 52.
Right: मृदु शाल्योदनं भोजयेत्.
ओदन is boiled rice, and it is soft.
questions.explain: Soft śāli rice, boiled (ओदन).

questions.q: By the rule of शाल्योदनम्, how is दधि + ओदनम् (curd-rice) joined?
optionExplain: The इ does not vanish; it becomes य्.
इ + ओ gives यो, not यौ.
इ + ओ does not give ए.
Right: इ before ओ becomes य्, as शालि + ओदनम्.
questions.explain: दधि + ओदनम् = दध्योदनम्, like शालि + ओदनम् = शाल्योदनम्.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: शालि + ओदनम् → शाल्योदनम्.

questions.q: By unit 53, what kind of enema is given then?
options: A milk enema with rock salt
optionExplain: Right: सर्पिषाऽनुवासयेत्: give an anuvāsana (unctuous enema) with ghee.
That is given first, in unit 52; unit 53 comes after it.
Cold water is not used for an enema in unit 53.
Honey is not named in unit 53.
questions.explain: Then an anuvāsana with ghee.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 53 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, prepared with the vidārī group, with ghee, one should give an anuvāsana.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 53 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Ghee prepared with the vidārī group, used for an anuvāsana.
questions.teaches: अनुवासन = an oil or ghee enema; अनुवासयेत् = one should give it.

questions.q: Which split of विदार्यादि is right?
optionExplain: आ + आ would give विदारादि, with no य्.
Right: ई before a different vowel becomes य्: विदारी + आदि → विदार्यादि.
ए before आ does not give या.
यादि is not a word; the word is आदि (and the others).
questions.explain: विदारी + आदि: ई + आ → या.
questions.rule: ई + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 53 are right by the card?
options: The ghee is prepared with the vidārī group
It lists all members of the vidārī group
The enema given here is of milk
optionExplain: Right: विदार्यादिगणसाधितेन सर्पिषा.
The members are not listed here.
Here it is an anuvāsana with ghee; the milk enema is unit 52.
Right: the data labels it probable.
questions.explain: Ghee prepared with the vidārī group (vidārī probably Pueraria tuberosa) is used for an anuvāsana.

questions.q: By the rule of ततो विदार्यादि, how is नरः + वदति (the man speaks) joined?
optionExplain: र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
The visarga after short अ does not leave a long आ.
Right: अः before a voiced sound becomes ओ, as ततः + विदारी.
Before a voiced sound the visarga after अ does not stay.
questions.explain: नरः + वदति = नरो वदति, like ततः + विदार्यादि = ततो विदार्यादि.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: ततः + विदार्यादि → ततो विदार्यादि.

questions.q: By unit 54, what should one resort to?
optionExplain: The unit says the opposite: निवात, shelter from the wind.
Bathing is not named in unit 54.
The unit names shelter from the wind, not open air.
Right: निवातं च सेवेत: resort to a wind-sheltered place.
questions.explain: Shelter from the wind (निवात).

questions.q: Put the words of unit 54 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Shelter from the wind, and, one should resort to.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 54 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Three words: and one should resort to shelter from the wind.
questions.teaches: सेवेत = optative middle of √सेव्: one should resort to, attend to.

questions.q: Which form of √सेव् means 'one should resort to'?
optionExplain: Right: Optative middle, 3 sg.: one should resort to.
Present middle: one resorts to (a fact, not 'should').
Past participle: resorted to, served.
Future: one will resort to.
questions.explain: सेवेत is the optative: 'one should'.

questions.q: Why is निवातम् printed निवातं before च in unit 54?
options: The ं marks a dual ending of the word
म् before a consonant is written ं
म् is always ं in every place
The ं is a later printer's error
optionExplain: निवातम् is accusative singular in the data, not dual.
Right: A final म् before a consonant becomes anusvāra (or the nasal of that consonant).
Before a vowel म् stays: निवातम् + एव → निवातमेव.
It is regular sandhi, not an error.
questions.explain: निवातम् + च → निवातं च: म् before a consonant → ं.

questions.q: By the form सेवेत (from सेवते), what does लभेत (from लभते, obtains) mean?
optionExplain: That is the present, लभते.
A past form would be e.g. अलभत, not लभेत.
Right: Like सेवेत, लभेत is the optative middle: one should obtain.
The future is लप्स्यते, not लभेत.
questions.explain: लभते → लभेत (one should obtain), like सेवते → सेवेत (one should resort to).
questions.teaches: For a thematic middle verb like सेवते, the optative 3 sg. ends in -एत: सेवेत = one should resort to.

questions.q: By unit 55, what should one drink in Pitta?
options: Clear surā with meat as its relish, three nights
Grape wine (mārdvīka) with meat as relish
Cold water after a milk enema with rock salt
Milk cooked with a madhuka-vidārī decoction
optionExplain: That is the Kapha remedy of unit 62.
Mārdvīka comes in unit 70, not in the Pitta line.
The milk enema with rock salt is for Vāta in unit 52; no water is drunk there.
Right: पित्ते मधुकविदारीनिर्यूहसिद्धं पयः पिबेत.
questions.explain: In Pitta the drink is milk cooked with a decoction of madhuka and vidārī.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 55 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In Pitta, madhuka, vidārī, cooked with the decoction, milk one should drink.
questions.rule: पित्ते → मधुक → विदारी → निर्यूहसिद्धम् → पयः पिबेत.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Match each word of unit 55 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two plants, their decoction, and the milk cooked with it.
questions.teaches: -सिद्ध at the end of a compound = cooked with: निर्यूहसिद्धं पयः = milk cooked with a decoction.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Why does पयः keep its visarga before पिबेत in unit 55?
options: A visarga stays before every consonant
पयः is the last member of a compound
The verb पिबेत begins with a vowel
optionExplain: Right: अः becomes ओ only before a voiced sound; before the unvoiced प the visarga stays.
Before a voiced consonant अः becomes ओ.
पयः is a separate noun, n. acc. sg.
पिबेत begins with the consonant प.
questions.explain: पयः + पिबेत = पयः पिबेत: प is unvoiced, so the visarga stays.
questions.rule: अः + voiced sound → ओ; before an unvoiced consonant the visarga stays.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: A learner writes: in Pitta, drink a decoction of madhuka and vidārī. What does unit 55 add?
options: Ghee is cooked with it, and the ghee is eaten
Milk is cooked with it, and the milk is drunk
Rock salt is added to it before it is drunk
Goat ghee is mixed in before it is given
optionExplain: No ghee is named in unit 55.
Right: निर्यूहसिद्धं पयः: milk cooked with the decoction is drunk.
Rock salt (saindhava) is in the Vāta enema of unit 52.
Goat ghee is in the gruel of unit 57.
questions.explain: The decoction is not drunk by itself: milk is cooked with it, and that milk is drunk.
questions.rule: निर्यूहसिद्धं पयः = milk cooked with the decoction.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By the rule of सिद्धम् + पयः → सिद्धं पयः, how is फलम् + खादति (he eats a fruit) written in a sentence?
optionExplain: ओ comes from अः before a voiced sound, not from म्.
म् does not turn into a visarga.
Right: A word-final म् before a consonant becomes anusvāra, as सिद्धम् + पयः → सिद्धं पयः.
No vowel is added after म्.
questions.explain: फलम् + खादति = फलं खादति, like सिद्धम् + पयः = सिद्धं पयः.
questions.teaches: A word-final म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra: सिद्धम् + पयः → सिद्धं पयः.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By unit 56, for which conditions is the preparation given?
options: A placenta that does not fall
optionExplain: Those are treated in unit 74.
Placenta-expelling drugs come in unit 66.
That is the topic of units 28 to 37.
Right: उपविष्टकविवर्द्धनार्थम् उपशुष्ककवृद्ध्यर्थं च.
questions.explain: The drink is for the growth in upaviṣṭaka and upaśuṣkaka.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 56 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Three large hens, an āḍhaka of husked black gram, with milk and water in a mortar, with that juice and ghee, having prepared, make her drink, for the increase of upaviṣṭaka.
questions.rule: तिस्रः स्थूलकुक्कुटीः → निस्तुषमाषाढकं च → क्षीरोदकेनोदूखले → तद्रसेन सर्पिषा च → साधयित्वा पाययेत् → उपविष्टकविवर्द्धनार्थम्.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Match each word of unit 56 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The things crushed, the measure, and the vessel they are crushed in.
questions.teaches: निस्- = without: निस्तुष = without husk (तुष); निस्तुषमाष = husked black gram.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which split of क्षीरोदकेनोदूखले is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ: क्षीरोदकेन + उदूखले → क्षीरोदकेनोदूखले.
अः before उ loses the visarga and leaves a gap; it does not give ओ.
नोदूखले is not a word; the word is उदूखले, in a mortar.
दूखले is not a word.
questions.explain: क्षीरोदकेन (with milk and water) + उदूखले (in a mortar): अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which statements does unit 56 make?
options: The size of the āḍhaka is given
Milk and water are used in the crushing
optionExplain: Right: तिस्रः स्थूलकुक्कुटीः.
The note: its size is not given here.
Right: क्षीरोदकेनोदूखले संक्षुध्य, crushed in a mortar with milk and water.
Its identity is disputed in the data.
questions.explain: Three hens and black gram are crushed with milk and water; the āḍhaka's size and kapiñjala's identity are open.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By the rule of तत् + रसेन → तद्रसेन, how is तत् + वचनम् (that word) joined?
optionExplain: त् does not stay unvoiced before the voiced व.
Right: त् before a voiced sound becomes द्, as तत् + रसेन → तद्रसेन.
त् becomes च् before च or छ (च्छ with श), not before व.
त् may become न् only before a nasal such as न or म, not before व.
questions.explain: तत् + वचनम् = तद्वचनम्, like तत् + रसेन = तद्रसेन.
questions.teaches: A word-final त् before a voiced sound becomes द्: तत् + रसेन → तद्रसेन.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By unit 57, what should one drink?
optionExplain: Surā with a meat relish is the Kapha drink of unit 62.
A black-gram soup (yūṣa) is in unit 68, with rice.
Right: यवागूं पिबेत: one should drink a yavāgū.
No cold water is named in unit 57.
questions.explain: The drink of unit 57 is a yavāgū, a thick gruel.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Put these words of unit 57 in the line's order (the jīvanīya word is left out).
questions.explain: With goat ghee, with milk, prepared, the gruel, one should drink.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Match each word of unit 57 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Goat ghee and milk prepare the gruel that is drunk.
questions.teaches: अजासर्पिस् = ghee of the she-goat: the first member names whose ghee it is.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which case is सर्पिषा in अजासर्पिषा?
optionExplain: The nominative is सर्पिः.
The genitive is सर्पिषः.
The locative is सर्पिषि.
Right: The data: n. inst. sg., with goat ghee.
questions.explain: अजासर्पिषा = with goat ghee, instrumental, like क्षीरेण (with milk).
questions.rule: सर्पिस्: nom. सर्पिः, inst. सर्पिषा, loc. सर्पिषि.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Why is संस्कृतां feminine accusative in unit 57?
options: It is an adverb of manner
optionExplain: Right: यवागू is feminine; संस्कृताम् describes it, f. acc. sg.
अजा is inside the instrumental compound अजासर्पिषा, not accusative.
क्षीरेण is neuter instrumental.
The data labels it a participle, f. acc. sg.
questions.explain: संस्कृतां यवागूम्: the participle takes the gender and case of the gruel.
