questions.q: By unit 64, how big is the lump that is eaten?
optionExplain: Badara powder is unit 65; the lump is bilva-sized.
Right: पिण्डं बिल्वमात्रम्: of the measure of a bilva.
āḍhaka is the measure of black gram in unit 56.
No thumb measure is named.
questions.explain: The lump is as big as a bilva fruit.
questions.rule: बिल्वमात्र = of the size of a bilva.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By the rule of शीत + छाग → शीतच्छाग, how is वृक्ष + छाया (shade of a tree) joined?
optionExplain: After a short vowel छ must be doubled to च्छ.
There is no visarga here to become श्.
Right: After the short अ of वृक्ष, छ is doubled to च्छ.
No ओ arises: वृक्ष ends in अ, with no visarga.
questions.explain: वृक्ष + छाया = वृक्षच्छाया, like शीत + छाग = शीतच्छाग.
questions.teaches: After a short vowel, छ is doubled to च्छ: शीत + छाग → शीतच्छाग.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By unit 65, the powder of which fruit is named?
optionExplain: Bilva leaves are in unit 63, and bilva gives the size in unit 64.
Sesame is one of the five of unit 63.
Mung bean is one of the five of unit 63.
Right: बदरचूर्णपात्रम्: a pātra of badara powder.
questions.explain: The powder is of badara, jujube (standard).
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Put the words of unit 65 in the line's order (the verb is left out).
questions.explain: Here, right, or, a pātra of badara powder, also.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Match each word of unit 65 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Here, also, a vessel-full of jujube powder.
questions.teaches: चूर्ण = powder: बदरचूर्ण = jujube powder; बदरचूर्णपात्र = a vessel-full of it.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which split of अत्रैव is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ए → ऐ: अत्र + एव → अत्रैव.
अ + इ would give ए: अत्रेव.
ए + ए does not give ऐ, and अत्रे is not the word.
अत्रै and व are not the words here.
questions.explain: अत्र (here) + एव (just): अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which statements about unit 65 are right?
options: Badara is labelled disputed in the data
वा marks this as another option
The noun of अत्र एव is not stated
The size of the pātra is given
optionExplain: Badara is jujube, standard.
Right: वा = or.
Right: the data notes the noun is not stated.
Its size is not stated.
questions.explain: Another option, right here; the noun and the pātra's size are not stated.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By the rule of अत्र + एव → अत्रैव, how is तत्र + एव (right there) joined?
optionExplain: That is तत्र + इव, where अ + इ → ए.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ, as अत्र + एव → अत्रैव.
अ + ए does not put a य between them.
The two vowels merge into ऐ; they do not stand apart.
questions.explain: तत्र + एव = तत्रैव, like अत्र + एव = अत्रैव.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ए joins as ऐ: अत्र + एव → अत्रैव.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By unit 66, with what should one purge when there is no growth?
optionExplain: Sweet, nourishing drugs serve growth in unit 48; here it is तीक्ष्णैः.
No water or milk is named in unit 66.
Right: तीक्ष्णैर्विरेचयेत्: one should purge with sharp ones.
No goat's milk or ghee is named in unit 66.
questions.explain: When there is no growth, the purge is with sharp ones.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Put the words of unit 66 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus, in no growth, with sharp ones, one should purge, with placenta-expelling ones, cause to fall.
questions.rule: एवम् → अवृद्धौ → तीक्ष्णैः → विरेचयेत् → अपरापातनीयैः → पातयेत्.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Match each word of unit 66 to its meaning.
questions.explain: No growth: purge with sharp ones, and cause to fall.
questions.teaches: अपरापातनीय = what causes the aparā (placenta) to fall.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: In विरेचयेदपरा..., why does त् become द्?
options: त् becomes द् before every sound
It is a print slip for त्
त् before a vowel becomes द्
optionExplain: Before an unvoiced sound it stays त्.
The optative ending is -एत्; द् comes from sandhi.
It is regular sandhi, not a slip.
Right: A vowel is voiced: विरेचयेत् + अपरा → विरेचयेदपरा.
questions.explain: विरेचयेत् + अपरा = विरेचयेदपरा: त् → द् before a vowel.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Which statements about unit 66 are right?
options: The object of पातयेत् is not stated
It says the fetus has grown well
The nouns of तीक्ष्णैः are not given
optionExplain: Right: the data notes the object is not stated.
The Sanskrit gives no names.
The case is अवृद्धि, no growth.
Right: only sharp ones; the nouns are not stated.
questions.explain: Two actions for no growth; no drug names and no object are given.
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: Built like अवृद्धि (no growth), what does अनिद्रा (निद्रा = sleep) mean?
optionExplain: Right: अ- negates, as in अवृद्धि.
अ- negates; it does not deepen.
अ- adds no time.
अ- does not mean again.
questions.explain: अनिद्रा = lack of sleep, like अवृद्धि = lack of growth.
questions.rule: अ- before a consonant = not, lack of.
questions.teaches: अ- before a consonant negates: अवृद्धि (no growth), अनिद्रा (no sleep).
questions.section: पित्त व कफ में चिकित्सा; वृद्धि न होने पर

questions.q: By unit 67, what name is given when the fetus clings and does not move?
optionExplain: Āmagarbha is named in units 49 and 60, not as this condition.
Right: तं लीनमित्याहुः: that they call līna.
Mūḍhagarbha comes later, in the section of units 78 to 88.
Upaviṣṭaka is a different condition, named in units 45 and 56.
questions.explain: A clinging fetus that does not move is called līna.
questions.rule: संलीनो गर्भः ... न स्पन्दते, तं लीनमित्याहुः.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 67 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of her however, the fetus clinging, does not move, that līna, thus they call.
questions.rule: यस्याः पुनः → संलीनो गर्भः → न स्पन्दते → तं लीनम् → इत्याहुः.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 67 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Vāta-afflicted channels, a clinging fetus that does not move: they call it līna.
questions.teaches: लीन = clinging, hidden: the name the text gives to a fetus that clings and does not move.

questions.q: Which split of इत्याहुः is right?
optionExplain: याहुः is not a word, and इ before य would not drop.
अः before आ drops the visarga, unjoined: इत आहुः.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: इति + आहुः → इत्याहुः.
इ + अ would give य: इत्यहुः, with short अ.
questions.explain: इति (thus) + आहुः (they call): इ + आ → या.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: A woman's channels are afflicted, and her fetus clings and does not move. By unit 67, which doṣa is at work?
optionExplain: Pitta is not named in unit 67.
Kapha is not named in unit 67.
Neither is named; the line names Vāta.
Right: वातोपसृष्टस्रोतांसि: channels afflicted by Vāta.
questions.explain: The channels are afflicted by Vāta.
questions.rule: वात + उपसृष्ट = वातोपसृष्ट, afflicted by Vāta.

questions.q: By the rule of संलीनः + गर्भः → संलीनो गर्भः, how is वृक्षः + भवति written?
optionExplain: Right: अः before the voiced भ becomes ओ.
That is the pattern of आः, not अः.
र् comes after vowels other than अ and आ.
Before a voiced sound the visarga after अ does not stay.
questions.explain: वृक्षः + भवति = वृक्षो भवति, like संलीनः + गर्भः = संलीनो गर्भः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: संलीनः + गर्भः → संलीनो गर्भः.

questions.q: By unit 68, which food is fed with the broth or soup?
optionExplain: Saktu comes in unit 69.
Right: रक्तशाल्योदनं भोजयेत्.
No wheat or honey is named in unit 68.
Yavāgū is the gruel of unit 57.
questions.explain: The food is boiled red śāli rice.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 68 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of hawk ... partridge, with the broth of any one, with plenty of ghee, with black-gram soup, or with radish soup, red śāli rice one should feed.
questions.rule: श्येनोत्क्रोश...तित्तिरीणाम् → अन्यतमस्य रसेन → भूरिसर्पिष्केण → माषयूषेण → मूलकयूषेण वा → रक्तशाल्योदनं भोजयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 68 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four of the eight animals, the radish, and the soup.
questions.rule: श्येन, उत्क्रोश, गोध, शिखिन्, मूलक, यूष.
questions.teaches: अन्यतम = any one of several: तित्तिरीणाम् अन्यतमस्य रसेन = with the broth of any one of them.

questions.q: Which split of शाल्योदनम् is right?
optionExplain: अ + ओ would give औ: शालौदनम्.
अः before ओ drops the visarga, unjoined: शाल्य ओदनम्.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: शालि + ओदनम् → शाल्योदनम्.
दनम् is not a word; the word is ओदन, boiled rice.
questions.explain: शालि (śāli rice) + ओदनम् (boiled rice): इ + ओ → यो.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: Which statements does unit 68 make?
options: The broth of any one animal is used
The broths of all eight are mixed
A soup of māṣa or mūlaka may be used
The rice named is red śāli
optionExplain: Right: अन्यतमस्य रसेन, with the broth of any one.
अन्यतमस्य = any one, not all mixed.
Right: माषयूषेण मूलकयूषेण वा.
Right: रक्तशाल्योदनम्, red śāli rice.
questions.explain: Red śāli rice with one animal's broth, or with a black-gram or radish soup.
questions.rule: अन्यतमस्य रसेन ... माषयूषेण मूलकयूषेण वा ... रक्तशाल्योदनं भोजयेत्.

questions.q: Built like तित्तिरीणाम् अन्यतमस्य (of any one of them), what does फलानाम् अन्यतमम् mean?
optionExplain: अन्यतम picks one, not all.
अन्यतम does not mean last.
अन्यतम is one of these, not another outside them.
Right: अन्यतम with a genitive plural = any one of them.
questions.explain: फलानाम् अन्यतमम् = any one of the fruits, like तित्तिरीणाम् अन्यतमस्य.
questions.rule: अन्यतम + genitive plural = any one of them.
questions.teaches: अन्यतम with a genitive plural = any one of them: ...तित्तिरीणाम् अन्यतमस्य = of any one of those animals.

questions.q: By unit 69, with what liquid is the saktu given?
optionExplain: Right: पयसा पाययेत्: one should make her drink it with milk.
Curd is not named in unit 69; the liquid is पयसा, with milk.
Ghee goes with the broths and soups of unit 68, not with this saktu.
Honey is not named in unit 69.
questions.explain: The saktu mixture is given with milk.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 69 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Or saktu, combined with sesame, black gram, bilva and śalāṭu, with milk, one should make her drink.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 69 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Saktu with sesame and black gram (and bilva, śalāṭu), given with milk.
questions.teaches: पाययेत् is the causative optative of √पा (drink): 'should make (her) drink', not 'should drink'.

questions.q: By unit 69, from which grain is the saktu made?
options: Black gram, as the line states
optionExplain: Barley is usual, but unit 69 names no grain for the saktu.
Right: The data: the grain is not stated; barley is usual but not said.
No rice is named in unit 69; the grain is not stated.
Black gram (माष) is mixed in; it is not named as the saktu's grain.
questions.explain: Unit 69 names saktu but not its grain.
questions.rule: Say only what the line states: सक्तून्, with no grain named.

questions.q: Which of these are printed in the compound joined to सक्तून् in unit 69?
optionExplain: Right: तिल-माष-बिल्व-शलाटु-युक्तान्.
Radish soup is in unit 68, not in this compound.
Right: the compound begins with तिल.
Madhuka is not named in unit 69.
Right: बिल्व stands third in the compound.
questions.explain: Sesame, black gram and bilva are printed in the compound; radish and madhuka are not.

questions.q: Built like तिलमाष...युक्तान् सक्तून्, what does मधुयुक्तं पयः mean?
options: Honey given in place of milk
optionExplain: युक्त means combined with, not in place of.
युक्त joins two things; it does not separate them.
Right: X-युक्त agrees with its noun: मधुयुक्तम् qualifies पयः, so milk combined with honey.
युक्त states a mixture, not an order of taking.
questions.explain: मधुयुक्तं पयः = milk combined with honey, as तिलमाष...युक्तान् सक्तून् = saktu combined with sesame and the rest.
questions.rule: X-युक्त + noun = the noun combined with X.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -युक्त (combined with) agrees with its noun: ...युक्तान् (m. acc. pl.) with सक्तून्.

questions.q: By unit 70, what is the relish (उपदंश) eaten with the drink?
optionExplain: Sesame and black gram go into the saktu of unit 69.
Red śāli rice is the food of unit 68.
Radish soup is an option of unit 68.
Right: मेद्यमांसोपदंशम्: meat (probably fatty) as the relish.
questions.explain: The relish (upadaṃśa) is meat, probably fatty.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 70 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Fatty (probable) meat as relish, or mārdvīka.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 70 to its meaning.
pairs: a relish eaten with a drink
questions.explain: Meat, probably fatty, as the relish: one more option.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi such as मांसोपदंशम् describes something else: 'having meat as its relish', here the drink.

questions.q: Which split of मांसोपदंशम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ: मांस + उपदंशम् → मांसोपदंशम्.
ए before उ would give मांसयुपदंशम् or मांस उपदंशम्, not ओ.
पदंशम् is not a word; the word is उपदंश, relish.
अः before उ drops the visarga and stays apart: मांस उपदंशम्.
questions.explain: मांस (meat) + उपदंशम् (relish): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 70 are right by the card?
options: The line names honey as the relish
The line has no verb of its own
Printed मार्द्दीकं is read as मार्द्वीकम्
The line names the kind of meat
optionExplain: The relish is meat, probably fatty; no honey is named.
Right: the verb of unit 69 is carried, not printed.
Right: a near-certain correction (द्व misread as द्द).
No animal is named; only meat, probably fatty.
questions.explain: The line has no verb, and its last word is a near-certain correction; medya is only probably 'fatty'.
questions.rule: मेद्यमांसोपदंशं वा मार्द्दीकं (= मार्द्वीकम्): no verb.

questions.q: By the rule of मांसोपदंशम्, how is हित + उपदेशः (good counsel) joined?
optionExplain: औ comes from अ + ओ or अ + औ, not from अ + उ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ, as मांस + उपदंशम् → मांसोपदंशम्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + उ.
The अ does not simply vanish before उ.
questions.explain: हित + उपदेशः = हितोपदेशः, like मांस + उपदंशम् = मांसोपदंशम्.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by उ joins as ओ: मांस + उपदंशम् → मांसोपदंशम्.

questions.q: By unit 71, with what does one anoint the belly and back?
optionExplain: Ghee is not named in unit 71; the line says तैलेन.
Milk is the liquid of unit 69, not an unguent here.
Right: तैलेन ... अभ्यञ्ज्यात्: with oil.
A paste (kalka) belongs to the enema of unit 76.
questions.explain: The anointing is done with oil.

questions.q: Put the body parts of unit 71 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Belly, groin, thighs, waist, flanks, back.
questions.rule: उदर → वंक्षण → ऊरु → कटी → पार्श्व → पृष्ठ.

questions.q: Match each body part of unit 71 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The six parts anointed with oil.
questions.rule: उदर, वंक्षण, ऊरु, कटी, पार्श्व, पृष्ठ.
questions.teaches: अभ्यञ्ज्यात् (abhi-√añj) = should anoint, rub with oil; अभीक्ष्णम् = repeatedly.

questions.q: Which split of वंक्षणोरु is right?
optionExplain: ए before उ would give वंक्षणयुरु or वंक्षण उरु, not ओ.
रु is not a word; the word is ऊरु, thigh.
अः before ऊ drops the visarga and stays apart: वंक्षण ऊरु.
Right: अ + ऊ → ओ: वंक्षण (groin) + ऊरु (thigh).
questions.explain: वंक्षण (groin) + ऊरु (thigh): अ + ऊ → ओ.

questions.q: A helper asks how often to anoint, and with which oil. What does unit 71 say?
options: Repeatedly; the kind of oil is not stated
Once a day; with sesame oil, as stated
Twice a month; with mustard oil, as stated
optionExplain: Right: अभीक्ष्णम् = repeatedly; तैलेन names no kind of oil.
No count per day and no kind of oil are given.
Madhuraka oil is for the enema of unit 75; here the anointing is repeated.
No such count or oil is in unit 71.
questions.explain: Repeatedly, with oil of a kind not stated.

questions.q: By the rule of पृष्ठान्यभ्यंज्यात्, how is दधि + अत्र (curd here) joined?
optionExplain: ई comes from इ + इ, not from इ + अ.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्, as पृष्ठानि + अभ्यञ्ज्यात्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + अ.
या would need इ + आ; अत्र begins with a short अ.
questions.explain: दधि + अत्र = दध्यत्र, like पृष्ठानि + अभ्यञ्ज्यात् = पृष्ठान्यभ्यञ्ज्यात्.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: पृष्ठानि + अभ्यञ्ज्यात् → पृष्ठान्यभ्यञ्ज्यात्.

questions.q: By unit 72, how often should one gladden her?
optionExplain: The line says मुहुर्मुहुः, again and again.
No time of day is named in unit 72.
Right: मुहुर्मुहुश्चैनां हर्षयेत्: again and again.
Meals are not named in unit 72.
questions.explain: One should gladden her again and again.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 72 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Again and again, and, her, one should gladden.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 72 to its meaning.
questions.explain: And one should gladden her again and again.
questions.teaches: हर्षयेत् is the causative optative of √हृष् (be glad): 'should make glad, should gladden'.

questions.q: Which split of मुहुश्चैनाम् is right?
optionExplain: अ + इ would give चेनाम्, with ए, not ऐ.
आ + इ would also give ए (चेनाम्), not ऐ.
चै and नाम् do not give 'and her'; the words are च and एनाम्.
Right: Visarga before च → श्; अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.explain: मुहुः (again) + च (and) + एनाम् (her): विसर्ग + च → श्च; अ + ए → ऐ.
questions.rule: Visarga + च → श्च; अ + ए → ऐ.

questions.q: A carer has done the oil anointing of unit 71. What does unit 72 add?
options: Keep her silent and quite alone
Make her fast until the evening
Let her sleep through the day
optionExplain: Right: मुहुर्मुहुश्चैनां हर्षयेत्.
Unit 72 asks to gladden her, not to keep her alone.
No fasting is named in unit 72.
Sleep is not named in unit 72.
questions.explain: Unit 72 adds: gladden her again and again.

questions.q: By the rule of चैनाम् (च + एनाम्), how is च + एव joined?
optionExplain: ए would come from अ + इ, not from अ + ए.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ, as च + एनाम् → चैनाम्.
य् comes from इ before a vowel; च ends in अ.
आ would come from अ + अ; एव begins with ए.
questions.explain: च + एव = चैव, like च + एनाम् = चैनाम्.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ए joins as ऐ: च + एनाम् → चैनाम्.

questions.q: By unit 73, to what should one look?
options: The signs of a dead fetus
optionExplain: Those signs come in unit 82, not here.
No stars are named in unit 73.
Right: पूर्वोक्तं चेक्षेत: look to what was said before.
Urine colour is not named in unit 73.
questions.explain: One should look to what was said before.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 73 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Before, said, and, one should look to.

questions.q: Match each part of unit 73 to its meaning.
questions.explain: And one should look to what was said before.
questions.teaches: उक्त is the past passive participle of √वच् (speak): 'said'; पूर्वोक्त = said before.

questions.q: Which split of चेक्षेत is right?
optionExplain: अ + ए would give ऐ: चैक्षेत.
क्षेत is not a verb; the verb is ईक्षेत.
च् is not the particle; the particle is च, ending in अ.
Right: अ + ई → ए: च + ईक्षेत → चेक्षेत.
questions.explain: च (and) + ईक्षेत (should look to): अ + ई → ए.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 73 are right by the card?
options: The line names the regimen it means
ईक्षेत is an optative: should look to
ईक्षेत is a future: will look
What पूर्वोक्तम् refers to is not stated
optionExplain: The data: what पूर्वोक्तम् refers to is not stated.
Right: 3 sg. opt. mid. √ईक्ष्.
The gram label is optative, not future.
Right: the earlier regimen is likely, but not stated.
questions.explain: ईक्षेत is an optative, and the line does not say what was said before.

questions.q: By the rule of चेक्षेत, how is गण + ईशः (lord of the troop) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ई → ए, as च + ईक्षेत → चेक्षेत.
ऐ comes from अ + ए or अ + ऐ, not from अ + ई.
The अ does not simply vanish before ई.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + ई.
questions.explain: गण + ईशः = गणेशः, like च + ईक्षेत = चेक्षेत.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ई joins as ए: च + ईक्षेत → चेक्षेत.

questions.q: By unit 74, with what is she treated?
options: Cold, dry food and a long fast
Sharp purgatives and strong emetics at once
Bloodletting and a light, dry diet
optionExplain: The line says unctuous (स्निग्ध), not dry, and names no fast.
Right: वातहरस्निग्धान्नपानैरुपाचरेत्.
No purgative or emetic is named in unit 74.
Neither is named; the food is unctuous.
questions.explain: She is treated with Vāta-removing, unctuous foods and drinks.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 74 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of her, however, who may have udāvarta and vibandha, her, with Vāta-removing unctuous foods and drinks, one should treat.
questions.rule: यस्याः पुनः → उदावर्त्तविबंधः स्यात् → तां → वातहरस्निग्धान्नपानैः → उपाचरेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 74 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The two complaints, and the unctuous foods and drinks that treat them.
questions.teaches: उप-आ-√चर् = to attend, to treat: उपाचरेत् = one should treat.

questions.q: Which split of स्निग्धान्न is right?
optionExplain: ए + अ would give स्निग्धेऽन्न, with ए kept and ऽ.
अः + अ would give स्निग्धोऽन्न, with ओऽ.
Right: अ + अ → आ: स्निग्ध (unctuous) + अन्न (food).
न here is not a word for food; the word is अन्न.
questions.explain: स्निग्ध (unctuous) + अन्न (food): अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 74 are right by the card?
options: The foods and drinks are unctuous
The line names a particular drug
उदावर्तविबन्धः may be read as two disorders or one
The text settles that it is one disorder
optionExplain: Right: स्निग्ध.
No drug or food is named; only their qualities.
Right: the data leaves both readings open.
It is not settled; the data reads two, with one possible.
questions.explain: The foods are unctuous and remove Vāta; whether udāvarta-vibandha is one disorder or two is open.

questions.q: Built like वातहर (removing Vāta), what does पित्तहर mean?
optionExplain: That would be पित्तज; -हर removes.
-हर takes away; it does not increase.
-हर does not mean seated in.
Right: -हर = removing, as in वातहर.
questions.explain: पित्तहर = removing Pitta, like वातहर = removing Vāta.
questions.teaches: -हर at the end of a compound = removing: वातहर = what removes Vāta.

questions.q: By unit 75, in which month is the anuvāsana given?
optionExplain: Right: अष्टमे तु मासे: in the eighth month.
The line says अष्टमे, the eighth.
The line says अष्टमे, the eighth.
The line says अष्टमे, the eighth.
questions.explain: The anuvāsana is given in the eighth month.
questions.rule: अष्टमे मासे = in the eighth month.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 75 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the eighth, however, month, cooked with madhuraka, with oil, one should give an anuvāsana.
questions.rule: अष्टमे तु → मासे → मधुरकसिद्धेन → तैलेन → अनुवासयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 75 to its meaning.
questions.explain: In the eighth month, an anuvāsana with oil cooked with madhuraka.
questions.teaches: X-सिद्ध = cooked with X: मधुरकसिद्धेन तैलेन = with oil cooked with madhuraka.

questions.q: Which split of तैलेनानुवासयेत् is right?
optionExplain: ए + अ would give तैलेनेऽनुवासयेत्, with ए and ऽ.
Right: अ + अ → आ: तैलेन (with oil) + अनुवासयेत्.
अः + अ would give तैलेनोऽनुवासयेत्, with ओऽ.
नुवासयेत् is not a verb; the verb is अनुवासयेत्.
questions.explain: तैलेन + अनुवासयेत्: अ + अ → आ.

questions.q: Which statement about madhuraka is right by the card?
options: Licorice alone, which the line names as madhuraka
A set of four sweet drugs, listed in this very line
Probably a group of sweet drugs; none listed
Honey boiled into the oil, as the line itself states
optionExplain: No single drug is named; madhuraka is probably a group.
No members are listed in unit 75.
Right: The data: probable, not certain, and the members are not listed here.
Honey is not named; the oil is cooked with madhuraka.
questions.explain: Madhuraka is probably a group of sweet drugs; its members are not listed.
questions.rule: मधुरक: probable group, members not listed.

questions.q: Built like अष्टमे मासे (in the eighth month), what does सप्तमे दिवसे mean?
optionExplain: A span of time would need another case; सप्तमे is the seventh, one day.
सप्तम is an ordinal, the seventh, not a count of times.
दिवस is a day, not a month, and the locative gives 'on', not 'after'.
Right: The locative of a time word gives 'on/in' that time.
questions.explain: सप्तमे दिवसे = on the seventh day, like अष्टमे मासे = in the eighth month.
questions.rule: Ordinal + time word in the locative = in/on that time.
questions.teaches: The locative of a time word gives 'in/on' that time: अष्टमे मासे = in the eighth month.

questions.q: By unit 76, what kind of enema is given if that does not succeed?
options: A milk enema with rock salt
optionExplain: Right: निरूहयेत्: one should give a nirūha.
That milk enema (kṣīrabasti) is unit 52; unit 76 ends with निरूहयेत्.
No nasal dose is named; the verb is निरूहयेत्.
Unit 76 gives a nirūha, not an anuvāsana.
questions.explain: If that does not succeed, a nirūha (decoction enema) is given.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 76 in the line's order.
questions.explain: If that fails; of the roots of vīraṇa ...; and of bhūtikā ... mṛdvīkā; with milk and half water, having extracted the rasa; with that, combined with a paste of kernels and sesame; slightly salty and warm, give a nirūha.
questions.rule: तदसिद्धौ → ...मूलानां → ...मृद्वीकानां च → पयसाऽर्द्धोदकेनोद्धृत्य रसं → तेन ...कल्कयुक्तेन → ईषल्लवणोष्णेन निरूहयेत्.

questions.q: Match each drug name of unit 76 to the data's identification.
questions.explain: Six names of unit 76 with the data's identifications and labels.
questions.rule: कुश, काश, काश्मर्य, परूषक, बिभीतक (standard); पियाल (probable).
questions.teaches: निरूह = a decoction enema; here the extracted rasa, with a paste (कल्क) mixed in, is its liquid.

questions.q: By unit 76, what is mixed into the extract before the enema?
options: Honey, rock salt and a little ghee in equal parts
A paste of piyāla and bibhītaka kernels and sesame
Oil cooked with madhuraka, the oil of the last unit
A powder of the first group's roots, dried and sifted
optionExplain: Honey and ghee are not named; the salt is only slight (ईषत्).
Right: पियालबिभीतकमज्जतिलकल्कयुक्तेन.
That oil is the anuvāsana of unit 75; here a paste is added.
The roots give the extract itself; the paste is of kernels and sesame.
questions.explain: The extract is combined with a paste of piyāla and bibhītaka kernels and sesame.

questions.q: Which describe the nirūha of unit 76?
options: Extracted with milk and half water
Given if the earlier step did not succeed
optionExplain: The line says slightly salty and warm: ईषल्लवणोष्णेन.
Right: ईषत्-लवण-उष्णेन.
Right: पयसाऽर्धोदकेन.
No ghee is named; the extract is made with milk and water.
Right: तदसिद्धौ, if that does not succeed.
questions.explain: Extracted with milk and half water, slightly salty and warm, given if that does not succeed.

questions.q: By the rule of ईषल्लवण (ईषत् + लवण), how is उत् + लासः (joy) joined?
optionExplain: द् does not stay before ल; it becomes ल्.
त् does not stay before ल; it becomes ल्.
Right: त् before ल becomes ल्, as ईषत् + लवण → ईषल्लवण.
च्छ comes (optionally) from त् + श, not from त् + ल.
questions.explain: उत् + लासः = उल्लासः, like ईषत् + लवण = ईषल्लवण.
questions.teaches: A final त् before ल becomes ल्: ईषत् + लवण → ईषल्लवण.

questions.q: By unit 77, at what time is this anuvāsana given?
optionExplain: The line says सायम्, in the evening.
The line says सायम्, in the evening.
The line says सायम्, in the evening.
Right: सायं तेनैव तैलेनानुवासयेत्.
questions.explain: The anuvāsana is given in the evening.

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 77 in the order of its two lines.
questions.explain: Her whose constipation has gone, bathed and fed, in the evening, with that very oil, give an anuvāsana. Udāvarta indeed, neglected, would suddenly destroy the pregnant woman with her fetus.
questions.rule: विगतविबंधां च → स्त्राताशितां → सायं → तेनैव तैलेनानुवासयेत् → उदावर्त्तोहि समुपेक्षितः → सहसा सगर्भां गर्भिणीमतिपातयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 77 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The conditions for the evening anuvāsana, and the warning about neglect.
questions.teaches: स- at the start of a bahuvrīhi = with: सगर्भा = (a woman) with her fetus.

questions.q: By unit 77, what would neglected udāvarta do?
options: Would suddenly destroy her along with her fetus
Would clear up on its own once the child is born
Would cause only a mild pain that passes in a day
Would slowly delay the labour by about a month
optionExplain: Right: उदावर्तो हि समुपेक्षितः सहसा सगर्भां गर्भिणीमतिपातयेत्.
The line warns of sudden harm, not a cure.
The line speaks of destruction, not mild pain.
The line says सहसा, suddenly, and names no delay.
questions.explain: Neglected udāvarta would suddenly destroy the pregnant woman together with her fetus.

questions.q: Before the evening anuvāsana, which must be true of her by unit 77?
options: She has fasted the whole day
She had a nirūha that morning
optionExplain: Right: विगतविबन्धाम्.
अशिताम् = having eaten, the opposite.
No morning nirūha is named in unit 77.
Right: अशिताम्, having eaten.
questions.explain: Her constipation has gone and she has eaten (and bathed, on a near-certain reading).

questions.q: By the rule of उदावर्त्तो हि, how is रामः + हसति (Rāma laughs) joined?
optionExplain: Dropping the visarga after आ is for आः, not अः.
Right: अः before a voiced sound (here ह) becomes ओ, as उदावर्तः + हि → उदावर्तो हि.
र् replaces a visarga after vowels other than अ/आ.
Visarga becomes श् before च, छ or (optionally) श, not before ह.
questions.explain: रामः + हसति = रामो हसति, like उदावर्तः + हि = उदावर्तो हि.
questions.teaches: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ: उदावर्तः + हि → उदावर्तो हि.

questions.q: By unit 78, what simile is used for the fetus released from its bond?
options: A leaf blown from a branch
A lamp running out of oil
optionExplain: No leaf is named; the simile is a fruit from its stalk.
A stone image is used of the belly in unit 81, not here.
Right: फलमिव वृन्तात्: like a fruit from its stalk.
No lamp is named in unit 78.
questions.explain: The fetus is released like a fruit from its stalk.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Put these causes and words of unit 78 in the line's order.
questions.explain: From excess doṣas, or by vyavāya and the like, or by other diseases, or by earlier action of mother and offspring, the fetus is released from its bond, like a fruit from its stalk.
questions.rule: अतिमात्रदोषोपचयात् → यथोक्तैर्वा व्यवायादिभिः → अन्यैर्वा व्याधिभिः → पूर्वोपचितेन वा ...कर्मणा → बंधनान्मोच्यते गर्भः → फलमिव वृंतात्.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 78 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Where the freed fetus hangs, the simile's stalk, and what it disturbs.
questions.teaches: कोष्ठ = the 'storehouse', the belly: कोष्ठसंक्षोभ = disturbance of the belly.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: By unit 78, what does the freed fetus bring about?
options: A quick and easy birth on that day
A fever with a strong thirst at night
A bleeding from the nose and mouth
A disturbance of the koṣṭha, the belly
optionExplain: No birth is described; the fetus disturbs the koṣṭha.
Fever and thirst are not named in unit 78.
No such bleeding is named in unit 78.
Right: कोष्ठसंक्षोभमापादयति.
questions.explain: The freed fetus brings about a disturbance of the koṣṭha.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Which does unit 78 name as causes of the release?
options: Earlier accumulated action of mother and offspring
optionExplain: Right: अतिमात्रदोषोपचयात्.
No bath or season is named in unit 78.
Right: अन्यैर्वा व्याधिभिः.
Right: पूर्वोपचितेन वा जनन्यपत्ययोः कर्मणा.
Fasting is not named in unit 78.
questions.explain: Excess doṣas, other diseases and earlier action of mother and offspring are named (with vyavāya and the like).
questions.rule: दोषोपचय, व्यवायादि, अन्य व्याधि, पूर्वोपचित कर्म.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Built like व्यवायादिभिः (by vyavāya and the like), what does स्नानादिभिः mean?
optionExplain: Right: X-आदि = X and the like, as व्यवाय + आदिभिः.
आदि adds 'and the like'; it does not mean alone.
आदि does not negate; it widens.
आदि here is 'and the like', not 'first'.
questions.explain: स्नानादिभिः = by bathing and the like, like व्यवायादिभिः = by vyavāya and the like.
questions.teaches: X-आदि = X and the like: व्यवायादिभिः = by vyavāya and the like (अ + आ → आ).
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: By unit 79, which wind makes the young fetus fall?
optionExplain: The line names अपान, not prāṇa.
Right: वायुरपानः ... गर्भं च्यावयति.
The line names अपान, not udāna.
The line names अपान, not vyāna.
questions.explain: The Apāna wind makes the young fetus fall.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 79 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, from the disturbance of the koṣṭha, the Apāna wind, repeatedly, having brought about pains and retentions, makes the fetus fall, young, in the form of blood.
questions.rule: ततः → कोष्ठसंक्षोभाद्वायुरपानो → मुहुः → कुक्षिबस्ति...संगानापाद्य → गर्भं च्यावयति → तरुणं शोणितभावेन.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Match each word of unit 79 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The signs Apāna brings about, and how the young fetus falls.
questions.rule: आनाह, विट्, मूत्र, सङ्ग, तरुण, शोणित.
questions.teaches: च्यावयति is the causative of √च्यु (fall away): 'causes to fall'.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: Which split of संक्षोभाद्वायुः is right?
optionExplain: आः before a voiced sound drops the visarga: संक्षोभा वायुः.
म् before a consonant is written ं: संक्षोभं वायुः.
Right: त् before a voiced sound becomes द्.
द्वायुः is not a word; the word is वायुः.
questions.explain: संक्षोभात् (from the disturbance) + वायुः (wind): त् + voiced sound → द्.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: By unit 79, in what form does the young fetus fall?
optionExplain: The fetus is called तरुण, young; the line says in the form of blood.
A stone image is used of the belly in unit 81, not of the fetus here.
The line says शोणित, blood, not water.
Right: तरुणं शोणितभावेन: the young fetus, in the form of blood.
questions.explain: The young fetus falls in the form of blood.
questions.rule: शोणितभावेन = in the form (state) of blood.
questions.section: गर्भ-च्युति, मृत गर्भ के लक्षण व मूढगर्भ

questions.q: By the rule of वायुरपानः, how is गुरुः + आगच्छति (the teacher comes) joined?
optionExplain: Right: उः before a vowel becomes उर्, as वायुः + अपानः → वायुरपानः.
After उ the visarga does not drop; it becomes र्.
व् comes from a plain उ before a vowel; here a visarga follows उ.
ओऽ comes from अः + अ, and आगच्छति begins with आ.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 80 in the line's order.

questions.q: By unit 81, the belly appears as if it had what inside?

questions.q: Match each word of unit 81 to its meaning.

questions.q: Which split of इवोदरम् is right?

questions.explain: इव (as if) + उदरम् (belly): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: Built like विवृद्धे गर्भे (when the fetus has grown), what does उदिते सूर्ये mean?

questions.teaches: A locative absolute (noun and participle both locative) gives 'when X has ...': विवृद्धे गर्भे.

questions.q: Which split of कृच्छ्राच्छ्वसिति is right?

Right: कृच्छ्राच्छ्वसिति.

questions.q: By the rule of विगुण + अनिल, how is हिम + अचलः (snow mountain) joined?

questions.q: Which split of समासतस्तु is right?

optionExplain: Three is the number of courses (gati) in unit 85.

questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of सङ्गो भवति is right?
optionExplain: Right: अः before a voiced consonant (here भ) becomes ओ.
ए before भ stays ए: सङ्गे भवति.
म् before भ would give anusvāra: सङ्गं भवति.
आ before भ stays आ: सङ्गा भवति.
questions.explain: सङ्गः (obstruction) + भवति (is): अः + voiced consonant → ओ.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the agreement in त्रिविधः सङ्गः, which form of त्रिविध goes with neuter कर्म (procedure)?
optionExplain: -अः is masculine; कर्म is neuter.
Right: Neuter कर्म takes a neuter adjective: त्रिविधम्, written ं before क.
-आ is feminine; कर्म is neuter.
-औ is a dual; कर्म here is singular.
questions.explain: त्रिविधं कर्म, as त्रिविधः सङ्गः and त्रिविधा गतिः.
questions.rule: The adjective takes its noun's gender: -अः m., -आ f., -अम् n.
questions.teaches: त्रिविध takes the gender of its noun: त्रिविधः सङ्गः (m.), त्रिविधा गतिः (f.), त्रिविधं कर्म (n.).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 93, which places are named?
options: Eyes, ears or the two nostrils
optionExplain: None of these is named in unit 93.
None of these is named in unit 93.
Right: शिरस्यंसे जघने वा: in the head, the shoulder or the hip region.
None of these is named in unit 93.
questions.explain: The head, the shoulder or the jaghana (hip region).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put the words of unit 93 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In the head, in the shoulder, in the hip region, or.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each word of unit 93 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Head, shoulder, hip region; वा = or.
questions.teaches: Here -इ and -ए mark the locative singular: शिरसि = in the head, अंसे, जघने = in the shoulder, hip region.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of शिरस्यंसे is right?
optionExplain: यंसे is not a word; the word is अंसे (in the shoulder).
ए + अ would give शिरसेऽंसे, with ए kept.
आ + अ would give आ: शिरसांसे.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: शिरसि + अंसे → शिरस्यंसे.
questions.explain: शिरसि (in the head) + अंसे (in the shoulder): इ + अ → य.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: What case are शिरसि, अंसे and जघने in, by the data?
optionExplain: Right: The data labels all three locative singular: in the head, shoulder, hip region.
The instrumental would be शिरसा, अंसेन, जघनेन.
The genitive would be शिरसः, अंसस्य, जघनस्य.
The ablative would be शिरसः, अंसात्, जघनात्.
questions.explain: All three are locatives: in the head, in the shoulder, in the hip region.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the rule of शिरसि + अंसे → शिरस्यंसे, how is दधि + अत्र (curd here) joined?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + अ.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्, as शिरसि + अंसे → शिरस्यंसे.
ई comes from इ + इ, not from इ + अ.
The इ does not vanish; it becomes य्.
questions.explain: दधि + अत्र = दध्यत्र, like शिरसि + अंसे = शिरस्यंसे.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A short इ before a different vowel becomes य्: शिरसि + अंसे → शिरस्यंसे.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 94, who holds the views given here?
options: The author, as his own rule
optionExplain: एके means some, not all; the views differ.
The text does not say which view it holds.
Right: इत्येके: thus some (say).
एके refers to some authorities, not to the mother.
questions.explain: Each view is marked इत्येके: thus some (say).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put these printed phrases of unit 94 in order.
questions.explain: For a mūḍhagarbha, however, the same as causing the afterbirth to fall is the procedure, some say; the procedure beginning with mantras is prescribed in the Atharvaveda, some say.
questions.rule: मूढगर्भस्य तु → जरायुपातनसामान्यं → कर्मेत्येके → मंत्रादि...विहितम् → इत्येके.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each word of unit 94 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Some liken it to causing the afterbirth to fall; some point to the Atharvaveda.
questions.teaches: इति एके = 'thus some (say)': it marks an opinion, not the text's own ruling.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of कर्मेत्येके is right?
optionExplain: ए + इ would give कर्म इति, with a gap.
इत्य is not a word; the particle is इति.
अ + ए would give ऐ: कर्मैत्येके.
Right: अ + इ → ए; इ + ए → ये.
questions.explain: कर्म (procedure) + इति (thus) + एके (some): अ + इ → ए; इ + ए → ये.
questions.rule: अ + इ → ए; इ + ए → ये.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which statements about unit 94 are right by the card?
options: The text says which opinion is right
One view likens it to causing the afterbirth to fall
One view links the mantra procedure to the Atharvaveda
The unit lists every step after the mantras
optionExplain: It does not; both are views of 'some' (एके).
Right: जरायुपातनसामान्यं कर्म.
Right: मन्त्रादिकर्म अथर्ववेदविहितम्.
आदि (beginning with) is all it says; no steps are listed.
questions.explain: Two views of 'some': like the falling of the afterbirth; mantras as in the Atharvaveda. Neither is ruled on.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the rule of इति + एके → इत्येके, how is प्रति + एकम् (each one) joined?
optionExplain: Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्, as इति + एके → इत्येके.
ई comes from इ + इ, not from इ + ए.
ऐ comes from अ + ए; here इ meets ए.
अय् comes from ए before a vowel, not from इ.
questions.explain: प्रति + एकम् = प्रत्येकम्, like इति + एके = इत्येके.
questions.teaches: A short इ before ए becomes य्: इति + एके → इत्येके.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 95, what is in truth the most difficult?
options: Laying the woman on a soft bed
optionExplain: Anointing comes in unit 100 and is never called the most difficult.
Right: तत्त्वतः कष्टतममस्ति शस्त्रकर्म: in truth śastrakarma is the most difficult.
Comforting the woman comes in unit 106; it is not called most difficult.
No bed is named in unit 95; the most difficult thing is śastrakarma.
questions.explain: In truth, work with the cutting instrument (śastrakarma) is the most difficult.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put these words of unit 95 in the order of the two printed lines.
questions.explain: By one whose work has been seen, by a śalya-remover, the extraction of the śalya, some say; in truth the most difficult is śastrakarma.
questions.rule: दृष्टकर्मणा → शल्यहर्त्रा → शल्याहरणमित्येके → तत्त्वतः → कष्टतममस्ति → शस्त्रकर्म.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each word of unit 95 to its meaning.
pairs: one whose work has been seen
questions.explain: An experienced remover extracts the śalya, some say; in truth śastrakarma is the most difficult.
questions.teaches: The suffix -तम makes a superlative: कष्ट (difficult) → कष्टतम (most difficult).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of शल्याहरणमित्येके is right?
optionExplain: ए + आ would give शल्ययाहरणम् or शल्य आहरणम्, not शल्याहरणम्.
इ + ऐ would give इत्यैके, with ऐ, not इत्येके.
Right: अ + आ → आ; म् joins the vowel; इ + ए → ये.
इत्य is not a word; the particle is इति (thus).
questions.explain: शल्य (śalya) + आहरणम् (extraction) + इति (thus) + एके (some): अ + आ → आ, इ + ए → ये.
questions.rule: अ + आ → आ; इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which statements about unit 95 are right by the card?
options: The remover in the opinion is a beginner
The line itself names the śalya as the fetus
Śastrakarma is called the most difficult
Some hold that an experienced remover extracts the śalya
optionExplain: दृष्टकर्मन् = one whose work has been seen: experienced.
The data reads the fetus from context (unit 89); this line does not say it.
Right: कष्टतममस्ति शस्त्रकर्म.
Right: दृष्टकर्मणा शल्यहर्त्रा शल्याहरणमित्येके.
questions.explain: Some say an experienced remover extracts the śalya; in truth śastrakarma is the most difficult.
questions.rule: एके: दृष्टकर्मा शल्यहर्ता; तत्त्वतः: शस्त्रकर्म कष्टतमम्.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the suffix of कष्टतम, what does a new example, प्रियतम, mean?
optionExplain: A comparative is made with -तर (प्रियतर), not -तम.
An abstract noun is made with -त्व or -ता (प्रियत्व), not -तम.
That would be a genitive (प्रियस्य), not a -तम form.
Right: -तम makes a superlative, as कष्ट → कष्टतम (most difficult).
questions.explain: प्रिय + तम = प्रियतम, most dear, like कष्ट + तम = कष्टतम, most difficult.
questions.teaches: The suffix -तम makes a superlative: कष्ट → कष्टतम (most difficult).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 96, with what are the listed operations to be done?
options: With a cloth round the hand
optionExplain: Right: एकेन पाणिना कार्याणि: to be done with one hand.
The unit says one hand: एकेन पाणिना.
No cloth is named in unit 96.
No helper's hands are named; the unit says one hand.
questions.explain: The operations are to be done with one hand.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put the organs of unit 96 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Among the yoni, liver, spleen, intestines, womb and the like.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each operation of unit 96 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Six of the eight operations to be done with one hand.
questions.rule: उत्कर्षण, अपकर्षण, व्यावर्तन, छेदन, पीडन, ऋजूकरण.
questions.teaches: उत्- means up and अप- down or away: उत्कर्षण = pulling up, अपकर्षण = pulling down.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of पीडनर्जूकरणानि is right?
optionExplain: ए + ऋ would not give अर्; ए before a vowel becomes अय् or अ.
Right: अ + ऋ → अर्: पीडन + ऋजू... → पीडनर्जू...
म् before a vowel joins it: पीडनमृजू..., with no र्.
Neither पीडनर्ज nor ऊकरणानि is a word here.
questions.explain: पीडन (pressing) + ऋजूकरणानि (straightenings): अ + ऋ → अर्.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which of these are among the operations listed in unit 96?
optionExplain: Burning is not in the list of unit 96.
Right: पीडन.
Stitching is not in the list of unit 96.
Right: ऋजूकरण.
Right: व्यावर्तन.
questions.explain: Pressing, straightening and turning round are in the list; burning and stitching are not.
questions.rule: उत्कर्षण, अपकर्षण, व्यावर्तन, उत्कर्तन, छेदन, भेदन, पीडन, ऋजूकरण.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the rule of पीडन + ऋजूकरणानि, how is देव + ऋषिः (a divine seer) joined?
optionExplain: अ + ऋ gives a short अर्, not a long आर्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + ऋ.
Right: अ + ऋ → अर्, as पीडन + ऋजू... → पीडनर्जू...
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + ऋ.
questions.explain: देव + ऋषिः = देवर्षिः, like पीडन + ऋजूकरणानि = पीडनर्जूकरणानि.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ऋ joins as अर्: पीडन + ऋजूकरणानि → पीडनर्जूकरणानि.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 97, whom should one consult before undertaking it?
optionExplain: No mother of the woman is named in unit 97.
The unit says to consult the īśvara and to act with experts.
No astrologer is named in unit 97.
Right: ईश्वरमापृच्छ्य: having consulted the īśvara (lord, master).
questions.explain: One should first consult the īśvara, the lord or master.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 97 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Therefore, having consulted the lord, and having resorted to supreme effort, accompanied by those who know it, one should undertake it.
questions.rule: तस्मात् → ईश्वरमापृच्छ्य → परं च यत्नमास्थाय → तद्विद्यसहितः → तमुपक्रमेत्.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each word of unit 97 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Therefore: consult, resort to great effort, and undertake it with experts.
questions.teaches: With a prefix, the absolutive ends in -य: आ-√प्रच्छ् → आपृच्छ्य (having consulted).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Which split of तस्मादीश्वरम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: A final त् before a vowel becomes द्: तस्मात् + ईश्वरम् → तस्मादीश्वरम्.
त् + ऐ would give तस्मादैश्वरम्, with ऐ, not ई.
Neither तस्मा nor दीश्वरम् is the word here.
A short इ would give तस्मादिश्वरम्; the word is ईश्वर, with long ई.
questions.explain: तस्मात् (therefore) + ईश्वरम् (the lord): त् + vowel → द्.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: A physician faces such a case. By unit 97, how should it be undertaken?
options: Alone and quickly, without telling anyone at all
After consulting the lord, with effort and experts
Only after waiting three days to watch the woman
By the woman herself, with the physician's words
optionExplain: The unit says to consult and to work with those who know it.
Right: ईश्वरमापृच्छ्य, परं यत्नमास्थाय, तद्विद्यसहितः.
No waiting and no number of days is named in unit 97.
The undertaker is the physician with experts, not the woman.
questions.explain: Consult the lord, resort to supreme effort, and undertake it with those who know it.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the form आपृच्छ्य (आ + √प्रच्छ्), what does a new example, आदाय (आ + √दा), mean?
optionExplain: That would be a present verb (आदत्ते), not a -य form.
That would be an infinitive in -तुम् (आदातुम्).
Right: With a prefix the absolutive ends in -य: आ + √दा → आदाय, having taken.
That would be a present participle (आददान), not a -य form.
questions.explain: आदाय = having taken, like आपृच्छ्य = having consulted: prefix + root + -य.
questions.teaches: With a prefix, the absolutive takes -य, not -त्वा: आ-√प्रच्छ् → आपृच्छ्य, आ-√स्था → आस्थाय.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 98, what follows if no action is taken?
optionExplain: The unit says the opposite: death is certain.
No illness is named; the unit says death.
No such outcome is named in unit 98.
Right: अक्रियायां ध्रुवं मरणम्: in inaction, death is certain.
questions.explain: In inaction, death is certain.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Put the words of unit 98 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In inaction, certain, death.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: Match each word of unit 98 to its meaning.
questions.explain: In inaction, death is certain.
questions.teaches: अ- before a word negates it: क्रिया (action) → अक्रिया (inaction).
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: What form is अक्रियायाम्, and what does it mean here?
optionExplain: Right: A feminine आ-stem makes its locative singular in -आयाम्.
The accusative singular would be अक्रियाम्.
The genitive plural would be अक्रियाणाम्.
The instrumental singular would be अक्रियया.
questions.explain: अक्रियायाम् = in inaction, i.e. if nothing is done: locative singular of अक्रिया.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the card, who is it that would certainly die?
options: No one is named in the line
optionExplain: जननी does not occur in unit 98.
Right: The data: the subject (the mother or the woman) is not stated.
गर्भ does not occur in unit 98.
वैद्य does not occur in unit 98.
questions.explain: The line names no one; it says only that in inaction death is certain.
questions.rule: अक्रियायां ध्रुवं मरणम्: कर्ता नहीं दिया.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By the अ- of अक्रिया, what does a new example, अज्ञान, mean?
optionExplain: Greatness would need a word such as महा-, not अ-.
That would need a word such as आत्म-, not अ-.
Right: अ- negates: ज्ञान (knowledge) → अज्ञान (not knowing).
Again would need a word such as पुनः, not अ-.
questions.explain: अ + ज्ञान = अज्ञान, not knowing, like अ + क्रिया = अक्रिया, inaction.
questions.teaches: अ- before a consonant negates the word: क्रिया → अक्रिया.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 99, which two diseases are named?
optionExplain: Cough and breathlessness are Kapha signs of unit 47.
Neither fever nor diarrhoea is named in unit 99.
Raktapitta is unit 21; mūrcchā is a sign in unit 46.
Right: तथोदरअश्मरीप्रभृतीनाम् अपि: udara, aśmarī and so on.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 99 in the line's order.

questions.q: Which split of तथोदर is right?

आ + ओ would give औ: तथौदर.
ए + उ would not give ओ; ए before a vowel becomes अय् or अ.
Neither तथो nor दर is the word here; the words are तथा and उदर.
questions.explain: तथा (likewise) + उदर (belly disease): आ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 99 are right by the card?

Right: the data labels this standard.

questions.q: By the rule of तथा + उदर, how is महा + उत्सवः (a great festival) joined?
optionExplain: औ comes from आ + ओ or आ + औ, not from आ + उ.
Right: आ + उ → ओ, as तथा + उदर → तथोदर.
The आ does not simply vanish before उ.
The उ is not lost; आ + उ merge into ओ.
questions.explain: महा + उत्सवः = महोत्सवः, like तथा + उदर = तथोदर.
questions.teaches: A long आ followed by उ joins as ओ: तथा + उदर → तथोदर.
questions.section: गर्भशल्य: संग के प्रकार व शस्त्रकर्म

questions.q: By unit 100, how does the woman lie?

On her left side, knees drawn up
Face up, with the thighs bent
Sitting up, leaning on the wall

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 100 in the line's order.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 100 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Face up, thighs bent, hip raised; anoint, then extract.
questions.rule: उत्ताना, व्याभुग्न, सक्थि, कटि, अभ्यज्य, आहरेत्.
questions.teaches: व्याभुग्नसक्थ्याः is a bahuvrīhi: of her whose thighs are bent.

questions.q: By unit 100, what is anointed before the extraction?

The cloth pad under the hips
optionExplain: The objects of अभ्यज्य are the hand and the yoni.
The objects of अभ्यज्य are the hand and the yoni.
The pad only raises the hips; it is not anointed.
Right: हस्तं योनिं च ... अभ्यज्य: the hand and the yoni are anointed.
questions.explain: The hand and the yoni are anointed, then the fetus is extracted.

questions.q: By the card, how sure is śālmalī-picchā as the gum of the silk-cotton tree?
optionExplain: Right: Śālmalī = Bombax ceiba (standard); picchā = its gum (probable).
The labels are the other way round: tree standard, gum probable.

Unclear is the label of धन्वनागमृत्तिका, not of śālmalī-picchā.
questions.explain: Śālmalī as Bombax ceiba is standard; picchā as its gum is probable.

questions.q: By the rule of उत्तानायाः + व्याभुग्न... (उत्तानाया व्याभुग्न...), how is बालायाः + वचनम् joined?
optionExplain: ओ comes only from अः before a voiced sound, not from आः.
Right: आः before a voiced sound loses its visarga, as उत्तानायाः + व्याभुग्न...
र् comes from a visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ.
Before the voiced व the visarga after आ is dropped; श् comes before च or छ (optionally before श), not before व.
questions.explain: बालायाः + वचनम् = बालाया वचनम् (the girl's word), like उत्तानायाः + व्याभुग्न... = उत्तानाया व्याभुग्न...
questions.teaches: A visarga after आ is dropped before a voiced sound: उत्तानायाः + व्याभुग्न... → उत्तानाया व्याभुग्न...

questions.q: By unit 101, by what has this one come?
optionExplain: No head is named in unit 101.
No arm is named in unit 101.
Right: सक्थिभ्याम् आगतस्य: of one who has come by the two thighs.
No face is named in unit 101.
questions.explain: This one has come by the two thighs.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 101 in the line's order.
questions.explain: There, by the two thighs, of one come, ... (the end is uncertain).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 101 to its meaning.
questions.explain: There: of one come by the two thighs.
questions.teaches: आगत is the past participle of आ-√गम्: come, arrived.

questions.q: Which split of सक्थिभ्यामागतस्य is right?
optionExplain: मागतस्य is not a word; the word is आगतस्य, come.
म् + अ would give सक्थिभ्यामगतस्य, with a short अ.
Before ग the print would show सक्थिभ्यां गतस्य, with no आ.
Right: A final म् before a vowel joins it: सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य → सक्थिभ्यामागतस्य.
questions.explain: सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य (of the one come): म् joins the following vowel.
questions.rule: म् + vowel → म् joins the vowel.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 101 are right by the card?
options: It says the fetus must be cut in two
The sense of the line's end is uncertain
optionExplain: No noun or verb for what is cut is given; nothing is supplied.
Right: the data calls the sense uncertain.
Right: the unit is elliptical.
No mother is named in unit 101.
Right: सक्थिभ्याम्, the two thighs.
questions.explain: The line has no verb, its end is uncertain, and it names the two thighs.

questions.q: By the rule of सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य, how is फलम् + आनय (bring the fruit) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A final म् before a vowel joins it, as सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य → सक्थिभ्यामागतस्य.
ं is written for म् only before a consonant; before आ the म् joins the vowel.
The म् is not lost; it joins the vowel.
The long आ of आनय stays long.
questions.explain: फलम् + आनय = फलमानय, like सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य = सक्थिभ्यामागतस्य.
questions.teaches: A word-final म् before a vowel joins it: सक्थिभ्याम् + आगतस्य → सक्थिभ्यामागतस्य.

questions.q: By unit 102, what is done when only one thigh has presented?
options: The two shoulders are pressed up
The other thigh is stretched out
The woman is turned onto her side
The thigh presented is pulled out
optionExplain: Pressing both shoulders up is for both arms presenting.
Right: एकस्मिन् सक्थ्नि प्रपन्नस्येतरं सक्थि प्रसार्य.
No turning of the woman is named in unit 102.
The unit stretches out the other (इतरम्) thigh.
questions.explain: For one thigh presented, the other thigh is stretched out.

questions.q: Put the five presentations of unit 102 in the line's order.
questions.explain: One thigh presented; come at the buttock region; come transversely; head turned to the side; both arms presented.
questions.rule: एक सक्थि → स्फिग्देश → तिर्यक् → पार्श्ववृत्तशिरस् → बाहुद्वय.

questions.q: Match each presentation of unit 102 to its handling.
pairs: press the buttock region down, lift upward
press the shoulder, bring the head
press both shoulders up, bring the head's base
questions.explain: Each case opens with 'for one who...' and has its own handling; then one draws out.
questions.rule: प्रसार्य; प्रनिपीड्य उत्क्षिप्य; परिवर्त्य; प्रतिपीड्य आनीय; उत्पीड्य आनीय → निर्हरेत्.
questions.teaches: Each case opens with a genitive, 'for one who...'; the single verb निर्हरेत् (should draw out) closes them all.

questions.q: By unit 102, which handling is named first for the one that has come transversely?
optionExplain: That is the handling for one thigh presented.
That is the handling for both arms presented.
Right: तिर्यगागतस्य परिवर्त्य: for one come transversely, having turned (it) round.
Pressing the shoulder is for the head turned aside.
questions.explain: Turning round is named first; the other way (or ...) rests on a flagged reading.

questions.q: A fetus has come at the buttock region (स्फिग्देश). By unit 102, what is done to that region?
options: It is cut open with a round knife
It is anointed with ghee and gum
It is turned round to the left side
It is pressed down and lifted upward

Anointing is in unit 100, of the hand and the yoni.
Turning round is the handling of the transverse case.
Right: स्फिग्देशं प्रनिपीड्य ऊर्ध्वम् उत्क्षिप्य.
questions.explain: The buttock region is pressed down and lifted upward.

questions.q: By the rule of प्रपन्नस्य + इतरम्, how is रामस्य + इच्छा (Rāma's wish) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + इ → ए, as प्रपन्नस्य + इतरम् → प्रपन्नस्येतरम्.
ऐ comes from अ + ए or अ + ऐ, not from अ + इ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + इ.
The अ does not vanish; अ + इ merge into ए.
questions.explain: रामस्य + इच्छा = रामस्येच्छा, like प्रपन्नस्य + इतरम् = प्रपन्नस्येतरम्.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by इ joins as ए: प्रपन्नस्य + इतरम् → प्रपन्नस्येतरम्.

questions.q: Which split of शिरोभिर्योनिम् is right?
optionExplain: With no visarga, no र् would appear: शिरोभीयोनिम्.
म् before य would give ं (शिरोभिं योनिम्), not र्.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 103 are right by the card?
options: It comes with hands, feet and head
It comes with one foot to the anus
The line says it must be cut at once
Its verb is प्रतिपद्यते, comes to
optionExplain: Right: पाणिपादशिरोभिः.
That is said in unit 104, not here.
No cutting is named in unit 103.
Right: योनिं प्रतिपद्यते.

questions.q: By the rule of यः + तु → यस्तु, how is रामः + तत्र (Rāma there) joined?
optionExplain: अः becomes ओ only before a voiced sound; त is unvoiced.
र् comes from a visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ.
Before त the visarga becomes स्; श् comes before च or छ (optionally before श).
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्, as यः + तु → यस्तु.
questions.explain: रामः + तत्र = रामस्तत्र, like यः + तु = यस्तु.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त or थ becomes स्: यः + तु → यस्तु.

questions.q: By unit 104, where does the second foot go?
optionExplain: Right: द्वितीयेन पायुम्: with the second, to the anus (pāyu).
No navel is named in unit 104.
No thigh is named in unit 104.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 104 in the line's order.

questions.teaches: एकेन ... द्वितीयेन = with the one ... with the second: both instrumental, both with पादेन.

questions.q: Which split of एवैकेन is right?
optionExplain: अ + इ would give ए: एवेकेन.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ: एव + एकेन → एवैकेन.
अ + उ would give ओ: एवोकेन.
एवै is not a word; the particle is एव.
questions.explain: एव (just) + एकेन (with one): अ + ए → ऐ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 104 are right by the card?
options: The line prescribes cutting the foot
One foot goes to the yoni
The second goes to the anus
Hands and head come first here
optionExplain: No cutting is named in unit 104.
Right: एकेन पादेन योनिम्.
Right: द्वितीयेन पायुम्.
Hands, feet and head are unit 103.

questions.q: By the rule of अभुग्नः + एव (अभुग्न एव), how is रामः + इति joined?
optionExplain: अः becomes ओ before a voiced consonant or अ, not before इ.
र् comes from a visarga after a vowel other than अ or आ.

questions.rule: अः + vowel other than अ → अ (visarga dropped, gap stays).
questions.teaches: अः before a vowel other than अ drops the visarga and leaves a gap: अभुग्नः + एव → अभुग्न एव.

questions.q: By unit 105, what should one apply to those two?
optionExplain: No cold water is named in unit 105.
The unit says they cannot be extracted by the hand.
No oil or fomentation is named in unit 105.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 105 to its meaning.

questions.q: Which split of अशक्याविति is right?
optionExplain: Right: औ before a vowel becomes आव्: अशक्यौ + इति → अशक्याविति.
अः before इ would give अशक्य इति, with a gap.
ए before इ would give अशक्ययिति or अशक्य इति, not आवि.
विति is not a word; the particle is इति.
questions.explain: अशक्यौ (the two, impossible) + इति (thus): औ + vowel → आव्.

questions.q: Why does unit 105 call for the instrument?
options: The fetus has grown far too large
They cannot be drawn out by hand
The lord has ordered it to be done
The yoni is too narrow to pass it
optionExplain: Size is not named in unit 105.
Right: हस्तेनाहर्तुमशक्यौ इति: thinking they cannot be extracted by hand.
No order of the lord is named in unit 105.
No narrowness is named in unit 105.
questions.explain: The two are stuck and cannot be extracted by hand; thus the instrument.

questions.q: By the rule of अशक्यौ + इति, how is बालौ + अत्र (the two boys here) joined?
optionExplain: ओऽ comes from अः + अ (बालः + अत्र), a singular.
अय् comes from ए before a vowel, not from औ.
Right: औ before a vowel becomes आव्, as अशक्यौ + इति → अशक्याविति.
औ does not swallow the अ; it becomes आव्.
questions.explain: बालौ + अत्र = बालावत्र, like अशक्यौ + इति = अशक्याविति.
questions.teaches: औ before a vowel becomes आव्: अशक्यौ + इति → अशक्याविति.

questions.q: By unit 106, what is done for the woman first?
options: She is tied to the bed
optionExplain: No turning face down is named in unit 106.
No tying is named in unit 106.
The unit begins by comforting her, not leaving her.
Right: स्त्रियमाश्वास्य: having comforted the woman.

questions.q: Put the steps of unit 106 in the line's order.
