A visarga after अ gives ओ before भ, not आ.
The neuter form is बहुलम्; बहुला is feminine.
questions.explain: तमोबहुला (f.) agrees with भूः (f.).
questions.rule: A bahuvrīhi takes the gender of its noun.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Which split of तमोबहुला in unit 10 is right?
optionExplain: तमा is not the word; the guṇa is तमस्.
Right: अस् before the voiced ब becomes ओ: तमोबहुला.
उबहुला is not a word; the word is बहुला.
तमोब and हुला are not words.
questions.explain: तमस् (inertia) + बहुला (abundant): अस् + voiced → ओ.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By the agreement in तमोबहुला भूः, which form fits नदी (river, f.) to mean abundant in water?
optionExplain: बहुलम् is neuter; नदी is feminine.
बहुलो (बहुलः) is masculine; नदी is feminine.
Right: Feminine, to agree with नदी, as बहुला with भूः.
बहुलेन is instrumental (m./n.); नदी is feminine nominative.
questions.explain: जलबहुला नदी = a river abundant in water: feminine singular, like तमोबहुला भूः.
questions.rule: The bahuvrīhi agrees with its noun in gender, number and case.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi in -बहुल takes the feminine -बहुला with a feminine noun: तमोबहुला भूः.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By unit 11, which is one of the marks (liṅga) of the elements?
optionExplain: No taste is named among the marks.
Heat is named; coldness is not.
Dryness is not named among the marks.
Right: चलत्वम् is the second mark in the list.
questions.explain: Mobility is one of the five marks.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Put the marks of unit 11 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Unobstructedness, mobility, heat, fluidity, hardness.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Match each mark of unit 11 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The five marks, in the line's order.
questions.teaches: लिङ्ग = mark, sign; the five marks run from unobstructedness to hardness.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Which split of क्रमाल्लिंगानि in unit 11 is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् before ल becomes ल्: क्रमात् + लिङ्गानि → क्रमाल्लिङ्गानि.
क्रमाल् is not a word; the word is क्रमात् (in order).
ल्लिङ्गानि is not a word; the word is लिङ्गानि.
A visarga would give क्रमो लिङ्गानि, not ल्ल.
questions.explain: क्रमात् (in order) + लिङ्गानि (marks): त् + ल → ल्ल.
questions.rule: A final त् before ल becomes ल्.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: In unit 11, what does the इति after काठिन्यम् do?
options: It adds a sixth mark to it
It closes the list of marks
optionExplain: No sixth mark follows; iti closes the list.
Right: The note: the closing iti marks the end of the list.
iti here closes a list; it gives no reason.
iti changes no meaning; it closes the list.
questions.explain: इति marks the end of the five marks.
questions.rule: इति = thus: it closes a list.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By the pattern of चल (moving) → चलत्व (mobility), what does गुरुत्व mean in a new example?
optionExplain: -त्व names the quality, not a person.
-त्व makes a noun, not a verb.
Right: -त्व makes an abstract noun: गुरु (heavy) → heaviness.
-त्व names the quality; it does not mean 'very'.
questions.explain: गुरुत्व = heaviness, like चलत्व = mobility.
questions.rule: Adjective + -त्व = the quality as a noun.
questions.teaches: The suffix -त्व makes an abstract noun of quality: चल (moving) → चलत्व (mobility).
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By unit 12, in what is the abiding (avasthāna) placed?
options: In the six parts, from the head on
In the minor parts, from the eye on
In the five marks, from heat on
In the sense organs, from the ear on
optionExplain: The six parts are in unit 2, not here.
The minor parts are in unit 3, not here.
The marks are in unit 11, not here.
Right: श्रोत्रादिषु इन्द्रियेषु अवस्थानम्.
questions.explain: Abiding in the sense organs beginning with the ear.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Put the five objects of unit 12 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Sound, touch, form, taste, smell.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Match each word of unit 12 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Association with the five objects, from sound to smell.
questions.rule: शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस, गन्ध, अन्वय.
questions.teaches: अन्वय = association, connection; अवस्थान = abiding, residence.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Which split of श्रोत्रादिष्विंद्रियेषु in unit 12 is right?
optionExplain: Right: उ before इ becomes व्: -षु + इ → -ष्वि.
विन्द्रियेषु is not a word; the word is इन्द्रियेषु.
ष्विन्द्रियेषु is not a word; the word is इन्द्रियेषु.
श्रोत्रादिषः is not the word; it is the locative श्रोत्रादिषु.
questions.explain: श्रोत्रादिषु (in ... beginning with the ear) + इन्द्रियेषु (in the sense organs): उ + इ → वि.
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + that vowel.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 12?
options: It pairs each object with its own organ
The objects run sound, touch, form, taste, smell
The sense organs are said to begin with the ear
It names the eye as the first sense organ
optionExplain: The note: which object belongs to which organ is not stated.
Right: that is the line's order.
Right: श्रोत्रादिषु, beginning with the ear.
The first named is the ear (श्रोत्र).
questions.explain: Organs beginning with the ear; five objects from sound to smell; no pairing stated.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By the rule of श्रोत्रादिषु + इन्द्रियेषु, how is मधु + इव (like honey) written?
optionExplain: उ + इ does not give a long ऊ.
Right: उ before इ becomes व्, as -षु + इ → -ष्वि.
The उ is not dropped; it becomes व्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from उ + इ.
questions.explain: मधु + इव = मध्विव, like श्रोत्रादिषु + इन्द्रियेषु = श्रोत्रादिष्विन्द्रियेषु.
questions.teaches: Before a different vowel, उ becomes व्: श्रोत्रादिषु + इन्द्रियेषु → श्रोत्रादिष्विन्द्रियेषु.
questions.section: आरंभ: शरीर के अंग व पंचमहाभूत

questions.q: By unit 13, which pair is born of space (ākāśa)?
optionExplain: These belong to earth (unit 17), not space.
These belong to water (unit 16), not space.
Right: श्रोत्रं शब्दः: both are ākāśaja.
Sight and form belong to fire (unit 15), not space.
questions.explain: The ear and sound are born of space.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the things born of space in unit 13 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Ear, sound, channels, separateness.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 13 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Born of space: ear, sound, channels, separateness.
questions.teaches: स्रोतस् = a channel of the body (a doctrinal term); विविक्तता = separateness, openness.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of तत्राकाशजानि in unit 13 is right?
optionExplain: तत्रा and काशजानि are not the words; they are तत्र, आकाशजानि.
तत्र has no visarga; it is an indeclinable.
राकाशजानि is not a word; the word is आकाशजानि.
Right: अ + आ → आ: तत्र + आकाश → तत्राकाश.
questions.explain: तत्र (among these) + आकाशजानि (born of space): अ + आ → आ.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: A student adds touch to the things born of space. By unit 13, is that right?
options: No: touch is not in the list
Yes: touch is the first item
Yes: it is the last item
optionExplain: Right: Unit 13 names ear, sound, channels, separateness only.
The first item is the ear (श्रोत्र).
Sound is named in unit 13; touch is not named at all.
The last item is separateness (विविक्तता).
questions.explain: Touch is not born of space in unit 13; the list is ear, sound, channels, separateness.
questions.rule: आकाशजानि श्रोत्रं शब्दः स्रोतांसि विविक्तता च.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the pattern of आकाशज (born of space), what does जलज mean in a new example?
optionExplain: -ज means born of, not giving.
Right: -ज = born of: जल + ज, as आकाश + ज.
-ज means born of, not without.
-ज means born of, not drinking.
questions.explain: जलज = born of water, like आकाशज = born of space.
questions.teaches: The final member -ज means 'born of': आकाशज = born of space.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 14, which quality of the body belongs to wind (vāyu)?
optionExplain: Heaviness belongs to earth (unit 17), not to wind.
Unctuousness belongs to water (unit 16), not to wind.
Right: लाघवं च: lightness closes the wind list.
Steadiness belongs to earth (unit 17), not to wind.
questions.explain: Wind gives the body lightness (लाघव).
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the items of unit 14 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of wind: the touch faculty, touch, the movements beginning with the breaths, and lightness.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 14 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Of wind: the touch faculty and touch, the movements of the body, and lightness.
questions.teaches: स्पर्शन is the faculty (the skin sense); स्पर्श is what it senses, touch.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास in unit 14 is right?
optionExplain: प्रश्वा and सोच्छ्वास are not the words; the words are प्रश्वास and उच्छ्वास.
ओच्छ्वास is not a word, and अ + ओ would give औ, not ओ.
A compound member has no visarga, and अः + उ would not join to ओ.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास → प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास.
questions.explain: प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास = प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास: the two breaths, joined by अ + उ → ओ.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which of these does unit 14 assign to wind?
optionExplain: Right: स्पर्शः is in the wind list.
Sound is born of space (unit 13).
Right: प्रश्वासोच्छ्वासादिपरिस्पंदनानि.
Form belongs to fire (unit 15).
questions.explain: Wind: the touch faculty, touch, the movements beginning with the breaths, lightness.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास, how are सूर्य + उदयः (sunrise) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अ + उ → ओ, as प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास → प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास.
औ comes from अ + ओ or औ, not from अ + उ.
आ comes from अ + अ, not from अ + उ.
अ before उ is not dropped; the two join as ओ.
questions.explain: सूर्य + उदयः = सूर्योदयः, like प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास = प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by उ joins as ओ: प्रश्वास + उच्छ्वास → प्रश्वासोच्छ्वास.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 15, which sense faculty belongs to fire (agni)?
optionExplain: The ear is born of space (unit 13).
Right: दर्शनं: the organ of sight opens the fire list.
The nose belongs to earth (unit 17).
The tongue belongs to water (unit 16).
questions.explain: Fire gives sight (दर्शन) and its object, form (रूप).
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the items of unit 15 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Sight, form, Pitta-heat-digestion, burning heat and intelligence, colour-radiance-brilliance, valour.
questions.rule: दर्शनं → रूपं → पित्तमूष्मापक्तिः → संतापो मेधा → वर्णो भास्तेजः → शौर्य्यं च.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 15 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Fire gives heat, digestion, burning heat, intelligence, radiance and valour, among others.
questions.rule: ऊष्मा, पक्ति, संताप, मेधा, भा, शौर्य.
questions.teaches: पक्ति (from √पच्, to cook) = digestion, cooking: a fire item.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of भास्तेजः in unit 15 is right?
optionExplain: स्तेजः is not a word; the word is तेजः, brilliance.
भास्ते and जः are not the words of the list.
Right: A visarga before त becomes स्: भाः + तेजः → भास्तेजः.
स्तेजः is not a word; the स् comes from the visarga.
questions.explain: भाः (radiance) + तेजः (brilliance) = भास्तेजः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: A student lists the fire items of unit 15. Which one does not belong?
optionExplain: Intelligence is in the fire list: मेधा.
Burning heat is in the fire list: संतापो.
Colour is in the fire list: वर्णो.
Right: Lightness belongs to wind (unit 14), not to fire.
questions.explain: Lightness is wind's (unit 14); intelligence, burning heat and colour are fire's.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of भाः + तेजः, how are देवाः + तत्र (the gods there) joined?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before त becomes स्, as भाः + तेजः → भास्तेजः.
आः loses its visarga before a voiced sound; त is unvoiced.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, before a voiced sound.
श् comes before च, छ or श, not before त.
questions.explain: देवाः + तत्र = देवास्तत्र, like भाः + तेजः = भास्तेजः.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त becomes स्: भाः + तेजः → भास्तेजः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 16, which quality does water (ambhas) give the body?
optionExplain: Steadiness belongs to earth (unit 17).
Right: स्नेहश्च: unctuousness closes the water list.
Heaviness belongs to earth (unit 17).
Brilliance belongs to fire (unit 15).
questions.explain: Water gives looseness (शैथिल्य) and unctuousness (स्नेह).
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the items of unit 16 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of water: the tongue, taste, the mass of fluids, looseness, unctuousness.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each fluid or quality of unit 16 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The mass of fluids and the qualities of water.
questions.rule: स्वेद, क्लेद, वसा, असृज्, शुक्र, शैथिल्य.
questions.teaches: असृज् (असृक् before an unvoiced consonant) = blood: असृक्शुक्र = blood and semen.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: In unit 16, what is the second रस, inside ...वसारसासृक्...?
options: Juice pressed out of a fresh plant
optionExplain: The first रसः is taste; the second sits among the body's fluids.
Nothing in the unit speaks of mercury; it is a body fluid.
Right: The data: the second rasa is the rasa dhātu, the nutritive fluid.
No plant is named; the compound lists the body's fluids.
questions.explain: रसः (taste) stands alone; the रस inside the fluid compound is the nutritive fluid.
questions.rule: रसः = taste; ...वसारसासृक्... = vasā, rasa (nutritive fluid), blood.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which of these does unit 16 name in its mass of fluids?
optionExplain: Pitta belongs to fire (unit 15).
Right: स्वेद opens the fluid compound.
Marrow is listed as mother-born (unit 18), not here.
Right: ...मूत्रादिद्रवसमूहः.
questions.explain: Sweat, moisture, vasā, rasa, blood, semen, urine and so on: the mass of fluids.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of स्नेहः + च, how are रामः + च (and Rāma) joined?
optionExplain: अः becomes ओ only before a voiced consonant or अ; च is unvoiced.
स् comes before त or थ, not before च.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, before a voiced sound.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्, as स्नेहः + च → स्नेहश्च.
questions.explain: रामः + च = रामश्च, like स्नेहः + च = स्नेहश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च becomes श्: स्नेहः + च → स्नेहश्च.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 17, which quality of the body belongs to earth?
optionExplain: Right: गौरवं च: heaviness closes the earth list.
Lightness belongs to wind (unit 14).
Looseness belongs to water (unit 16).
Radiance belongs to fire (unit 15).
questions.explain: Earth gives steadiness (धैर्य) and heaviness (गौरव).
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the items of unit 17 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of earth: the nose, smell, the mass of solid forms, steadiness, heaviness.
questions.rule: पार्थिवानि → घ्राणं → गंधः → ...मूर्त्तिसमूहो → धैर्य्यं → गौरवं च.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Unit 17: earth gives the nose (घ्राण) and its object, ____ (smell). Type it in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: पार्थिवानि घ्राणं गंधः: the nose and smell (गन्धः, printed गंधः).
questions.teaches: गन्ध = smell, the object of the nose (घ्राण), as शब्द is of the ear and स्पर्श of the skin sense.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of अस्थ्यादि in unit 17 is right?
optionExplain: अस्थ्य is not the word; the word is अस्थि, bone.
Right: इ + आ → या: अस्थि + आदि → अस्थ्यादि.
अस्थ and यादि are not words; the य् comes from इ.
अस्थे is not the word, and ए + आ would not give या.
questions.explain: अस्थि (bone) + आदि (and so on) = अस्थ्यादि.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which of these does unit 17 count in earth's mass of solid forms?
optionExplain: Sweat is a fluid of water (unit 16).
Heat belongs to fire (unit 15).
Right: केशनखास्थ्यादि...: hair, nails, bones and so on.
The breaths are movements of wind (unit 14).
questions.explain: Hair, nails and bones head earth's solid forms.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of अस्थि + आदि, how are इति + आदि (and so on) joined?
optionExplain: Short य comes from इ + short अ; here the vowel is long आ.
The इ is not dropped; it becomes य्.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + आ.
Right: इ + आ → या, as अस्थि + आदि → अस्थ्यादि.
questions.explain: इति + आदि = इत्यादि, like अस्थि + आदि = अस्थ्यादि.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: अस्थि + आदि → अस्थ्यादि.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 18, what quality do the mother-born parts share?
optionExplain: Right: मृदूनि: they are soft.
Firm (स्थिर) is said of the father-born parts (unit 19).
No heat is named; the word is मृदूनि, soft.
No cold is named; the word is मृदूनि, soft.
questions.explain: मातृजानि मृदूनि: the mother-born parts are soft.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put these organs of unit 18 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Heart, stomach, uterus, liver, spleen, (kloma,) intestines.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each mother-born part of unit 18 to its modern name.
questions.explain: These organs of the mother-born list have standard identifications.
questions.rule: आमाशय, यकृत्, प्लीहा, गर्भाशय, गुद, मज्जा.
questions.teaches: आमाशय (stomach) and गर्भाशय (uterus) both end in आशय, a receptacle.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of मेदोमज्ज in unit 18 is right?
optionExplain: ओमज्जा is not a word; the word is मज्जा, marrow.
Right: A final अस् becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: मेदस् + मज्जा → मेदोमज्ज.
मेदा and उमज्जा are not the words of the list.
मेदु and अमज्जा are not words; the words are मेदस्, मज्जा.
questions.explain: मेदस् (fat) + मज्जा (marrow) = मेदोमज्ज...
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which of these is not among the mother-born parts of unit 18?
optionExplain: Liver is in the mother-born list: यकृत्.
Spleen is in the mother-born list: प्लीह.
Right: Bones are father-born (unit 19), not mother-born.
Navel is in the mother-born list: नाभि.
questions.explain: Liver, spleen and navel are mother-born; bones are father-born.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of त्वच् + रक्त → त्वग्रक्त, how are वाच् + दानम् (giving of one's word) joined?
optionExplain: Before the voiced द the unvoiced क् is not kept; it becomes ग्.
A final च् does not stay; it turns to the क्/ग् row.
A final च् goes to ग्, not to ज्.
Right: A final च् becomes ग् before a voiced sound, as त्वच् + रक्त → त्वग्रक्त.
questions.explain: वाच् + दानम् = वाग्दानम्, like त्वच् + रक्त = त्वग्रक्त.
questions.teaches: A final च् becomes ग् before a voiced sound: त्वच् + रक्त → त्वग्रक्त.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 19, which of these is born of the father?
optionExplain: Right: केशनखास्थि...: bones are in the father-born list.
The liver is mother-born (unit 18).
Blood is mother-born (unit 18).
The heart is mother-born (unit 18).
questions.explain: Hair, nails, bones, semen and the vessels are father-born.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the father-born parts of unit 19 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Hair, nails, bones, semen, sirā, dhamanī.
questions.rule: केश → नख → अस्थि → शुक्र → सिरा → धमनी.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 19 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The father-born parts are firm: hair, semen, the vessels and the rest.
questions.rule: पितृज, स्थिर, सिरा, धमनी, शुक्र, केश.
questions.teaches: सिरा and धमनी are both tubular vessels; vein and artery are only probable equivalents.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of धमन्यादीनि in unit 19 is right?
optionExplain: धमन्य is not the word; the word is धमनी.
Right: ई + आ → या: धमनी + आदीनि → धमन्यादीनि.
यादीनि is not a word; the य् comes from the ई.
धम and न्यादीनि are not the words of the list.
questions.explain: धमनी (vessel) + आदीनि (and so on) = धमन्यादीनि.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which rendering of पितृजानि स्थिराणि is right?
options: The firm are born of space
optionExplain: Soft (मृदु) is said of the mother-born (unit 18).
पितृ means father, not mother (मातृ).
Right: पितृजानि = born of the father; स्थिराणि = firm.
पितृज is born of the father, not of space.
questions.explain: पितृजानि स्थिराणि = the father-born (parts) are firm.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the pattern of पितृज (born of the father), what does जलज literally mean?
optionExplain: The last member ज names what is born; the first says from where.
ज means born, not giving.
The first member is जल, water, not पितृ.
Right: जल (water) + ज (born): born of water, as पितृ + ज = born of the father.
questions.explain: जलज = born of water, like पितृज = born of the father.
questions.teaches: A compound ending in -ज means 'born of' its first member: पितृज = born of the father.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 20, which of these is born of the self (ātman)?
optionExplain: Right: मनः is in the self-born list.
The liver is mother-born (unit 18).
The bones are father-born (unit 19).
Heaviness belongs to earth (unit 17).
questions.explain: Mind, consciousness and the senses are self-born.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the first self-born items of unit 20 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Birth in the wombs, mind, consciousness, the senses, prāṇa and apāna, sustaining.
questions.rule: योनिषूत्पत्तिः → मनः → चेतना → इन्द्रियाणि → प्राणापानौ → धारणम्.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each self-born item of unit 20 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Desire, anger, greed, fear, aversion and effort are self-born.
questions.rule: काम, क्रोध, लोभ, भय, द्वेष, प्रयत्न.
questions.teaches: इच्छा (wish) and द्वेष (aversion) stand side by side: liking and disliking.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of योनिषूत्पत्तिः in unit 20 is right?
optionExplain: त्पत्तिः is not a word; the word is उत्पत्तिः, birth.
Right: उ + उ → ऊ: योनिषु + उत्पत्तिः → योनिषूत्पत्तिः.
षूत्पत्तिः is not a word; षु is the locative ending.
ऊत्पत्तिः is not a word; the word has short उ.
questions.explain: योनिषु (in the wombs) + उत्पत्तिः (birth) = योनिषूत्पत्तिः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which of these does unit 20 count as born of the self?
optionExplain: Skin is mother-born (unit 18).
Right: स्मृति is in the self-born list.
Semen is father-born (unit 19).
Right: प्रयत्न is in the self-born list.
The spleen is mother-born (unit 18).
Right: अहंकार is in the self-born list.
questions.explain: Memory, effort and ego are self-born; skin and spleen are mother-born, semen father-born.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of चेतना + इन्द्रियाणि → चेतनेन्द्रियाणि, how are महा + इन्द्रः (great Indra) joined?
optionExplain: ऐ comes from अ/आ + ए or ऐ, not from आ + इ.
ई comes from इ + इ, not from आ + इ.
Right: आ + इ → ए, as चेतना + इन्द्रियाणि → चेतनेन्द्रियाणि.
The इ is not lost; आ + इ join as ए.
questions.explain: महा + इन्द्रः = महेन्द्रः, like चेतना + इन्द्रियाणि = चेतनेन्द्रियाणि.
questions.teaches: आ followed by इ joins as ए: चेतना + इन्द्रियाणि → चेतनेन्द्रियाणि (the data's split).
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 21, what does sātmya, the source named here, mean?
options: What is born of the mother
What is born of the father
optionExplain: That is मातृज (unit 18), not sātmya.
Pure sattva is the source of unit 23.
That is पितृज (unit 19), not sātmya.
Right: The data: sātmya = what is habitually suited or compatible.
questions.explain: सात्म्य = what suits a person by habit; unit 21 lists what is born of it.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put these sure items of unit 21 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Absence of laziness, absence of greed, clear senses, abundant joy, intelligence, strength.
questions.rule: अनालस्यम् → अलोलुपत्वम् → इन्द्रियप्रसाद... → प्रहर्षभूयस्त्वम् → मेधा → बलम्.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 21 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Sātmya brings freedom from laziness and greed, clear senses, much joy and strength.
questions.teaches: अन्- (before a vowel) and अ- (before a consonant) negate: अनालस्य, अलोलुपत्व.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of अनालस्य in unit 21 is right?
optionExplain: Right: अन्- is the negative before a vowel: absence of laziness (आलस्य).
अना and लस्य are not the parts; आलस्य is laziness.
अनल + अस्य would join as अनलास्य, a different word.
नालस्य is not a word; before a vowel the negative is अन्-.
questions.explain: अन् (not) + आलस्य (laziness) = अनालस्य, absence of laziness.
questions.rule: Negative अ- before a consonant, अन्- before a vowel.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 21, which of these is born of sātmya?
optionExplain: Grief belongs to tamas (unit 25).
Right: बलं च closes the sātmya list.
Hypocrisy belongs to rajas (unit 24).
Dejection belongs to tamas (unit 25).
questions.explain: What suits a person by habit brings strength, intelligence and clear senses.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of बीज + ओजः → बीजौजः, how are जल + ओघः (flood of water) joined?
optionExplain: ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + ओ.
ऐ comes from अ + ए, not from अ + ओ.
Right: अ + ओ → औ, as बीज + ओजः → बीजौजः.
आ comes from अ + अ, not from अ + ओ.
questions.explain: जल + ओघः = जलौघः, like बीज + ओजः = बीजौजः.
questions.teaches: A short अ followed by ओ joins as औ: बीज + ओजः → बीजौजः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 22, what does rasa give the body?
optionExplain: Hair, nails and bones are father-born (unit 19).
The mind and the senses are self-born (unit 20).
These are rajas traits (unit 24).
Right: वृद्धिः and पुष्टिः are in the rasa list.
questions.explain: Rasa gives the whole body its origin, maintenance, growth, satisfaction, nourishment and vigour.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Put the sure items of unit 22 in the line's order (the unclear औल्यं is left out).
questions.explain: Coming into being, maintenance, growth, satisfaction, nourishment, vigour.
questions.rule: संभवो → वृत्तिर् → वृद्धिस् → तृप्तिर् → (औल्यं) → पुष्टिर् → उत्साहश्च.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Match each word of unit 22 to its meaning.
questions.explain: What rasa gives the whole body.
questions.rule: संभव, वृत्ति, वृद्धि, तृप्ति, पुष्टि, उत्साह.
questions.teaches: रसज = born of rasa, here the nutritive fluid (the first dhātu), not taste.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: Which split of वृद्धिस्तृप्तिः in unit 22 is right?
optionExplain: Right: A visarga before त becomes स्: वृद्धिः + तृप्तिः → वृद्धिस्तृप्तिः.
स्तृप्तिः is not a word; the स् comes from the visarga.
स्तृप्तिः is not a word; the word is तृप्तिः.
वृद्धिस्तृ and प्तिः are not words.
questions.explain: वृद्धिः (growth) + तृप्तिः (satisfaction) = वृद्धिस्तृप्तिः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: A child grows and keeps nourished. Which source does unit 22 credit with this?
optionExplain: Space gives the ear, sound, the channels and separateness (unit 13).
Right: रसजानि ... वृद्धिः ... पुष्टिः.
The self-born list (unit 20) has no growth or nourishment.
Tamas gives ignorance, sleep and the like (unit 25).
questions.explain: Growth (वृद्धि) and nourishment (पुष्टि) are born of rasa.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By the rule of पुष्टिः + उत्साहः → पुष्टिरुत्साहः, how are हरिः + अस्ति (Hari is) joined?
optionExplain: य् comes from a vowel इ, not from इः.
The इ of हरि does not change to ओ.
Right: After इ, a visarga before a vowel becomes र्.
After इ the visarga becomes र्; it is not dropped.
questions.explain: हरिः + अस्ति = हरिरस्ति, like पुष्टिः + उत्साहः = पुष्टिरुत्साहः.
questions.teaches: A visarga after इ becomes र् before a vowel: पुष्टिः + उत्साहः → पुष्टिरुत्साहः.
questions.section: भूतज, मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज व रसज भाव

questions.q: By unit 23, which of these is born of pure sattva?
optionExplain: Envy belongs to rajas and tamas (units 24, 25).
Hypocrisy belongs to rajas (unit 24).
Heedlessness belongs to tamas (unit 25).
Right: दाक्षिण्यं is in the sattva list.
questions.explain: Pure sattva gives purity, belief, gratitude, courtesy and the like.

questions.q: Put the first sattva items of unit 23 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Purity, belief, gratitude, courtesy, resolve, valour.
questions.rule: शौचम् → आस्तिकत्वम् → कृतज्ञता → दाक्षिण्यम् → व्यवसायः → शौर्यम्.

questions.q: Match each sattva trait of unit 23 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Traits born of pure sattva.
questions.rule: शौच, कृतज्ञता, दाक्षिण्य, व्यवसाय, गाम्भीर्य, अनभिष्वङ्ग.
questions.teaches: कृतज्ञ = one who knows (ज्ञ) what was done (कृत) for him: grateful; -ता makes the abstract noun.

questions.q: Which split of तमोगुण in unit 23 is right?
optionExplain: Right: A final अस् becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: तमस् + गुण → तमोगुण.
ओगुण is not a word; the word is गुण.
उगुण is not a word, and the ओ is not अ + उ here.
तमा and उगुण are not the words; they are तमस्, गुण.
questions.explain: तमस् (tamas) + गुण = तमोगुण; विपर्यय = its contrary.

questions.q: Which of these does unit 23 count as born of pure sattva?
optionExplain: Right: स्मृतिः is in the sattva list.
Grief belongs to tamas (unit 25).
Greed belongs to rajas (unit 24).
Right: भक्ति is in the sattva list.
questions.explain: Memory and devotion are sattva's; grief is tamas's, greed rajas's.

questions.q: By the rule of तमस् + गुण → तमोगुण, how are मनस् + बलम् (strength of mind) joined?
optionExplain: Before a voiced sound the अस् does not stay as visarga; it becomes ओ.
Right: A final अस् becomes ओ before the voiced ब, as तमस् + गुण → तमोगुण.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ.
आ does not come from अस्; before a voiced consonant it is ओ.
questions.explain: मनस् + बलम् = मनोबलम्, like तमस् + गुण = तमोगुण.
questions.teaches: A final अस् becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: तमस् + गुण → तमोगुण.

questions.q: By unit 24, which of these belongs to rajas?
optionExplain: Gratitude is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Courtesy is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Right: दंभो is in the rajas list.
Purity is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
questions.explain: Rajas gives envy, egoism, greed, hypocrisy, pride and desire.

questions.q: Put these rajas items of unit 24 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Envy, unmeasured talk, egoism, greed, hypocrisy, pride.
questions.rule: मात्सर्यम् → अमितभाषित्वम् → अहंकारः → लोलुपत्वम् → दम्भः → मानः.

questions.q: Match each rajas word of unit 24 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Rajas traits: envy, much talk, hypocrisy, pride, greed, desire.
questions.rule: मात्सर्य, अमितभाषित्व, दम्भ, मान, लोलुपत्व, काम.
questions.teaches: अमितभाषित्व: अमित (unmeasured) + भाषिन् (one who speaks) + -त्व (-ness).

questions.q: Why is अहंकारः printed अहंकारो before लोलुपत्वं in unit 24?
options: अः becomes ओ before any consonant
ओ marks a vocative form here
The stem itself ends in ओ
अः becomes ओ before the voiced ल
optionExplain: Before unvoiced sounds the visarga stays or changes otherwise.
The data reads अहंकारः, nominative: egoism.
The stem is अहंकार; the ओ comes from sandhi.
Right: ल is voiced; अः before a voiced consonant gives ओ.
questions.explain: अहंकारः + लोलुपत्वम् = अहंकारो लोलुपत्वं.

questions.q: A person talks without measure and is full of pride. By unit 24, these are products of what?
optionExplain: Right: अमितभाषित्व and मान are in the rajas list.
Sattva gives purity, gratitude, depth and the like (unit 23).
Sātmya gives lifespan, strength and the like (unit 21).
Rasa gives growth, nourishment and the like (unit 22).
questions.explain: Unmeasured talk and pride are rājasa.

questions.q: By the rule of दम्भः + मानः → दम्भो मानः, how are शिष्यः + वदति (the pupil speaks) joined?
optionExplain: Before a voiced consonant अः gives ओ; it is not simply dropped.
Right: अः becomes ओ before the voiced व, as दम्भः + मानः → दम्भो मानः.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ.
श् comes before च, छ or श, not before व.
questions.explain: शिष्यः + वदति = शिष्यो वदति, like दम्भः + मानः = दम्भो मानः.
questions.teaches: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ: दम्भः + मानः → दम्भो मानः.

questions.q: By unit 25, which of these belongs to tamas?
optionExplain: Gratitude is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Devotion is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Right: शोको is in the tamas list.
Pride belongs to rajas (unit 24).
questions.explain: Tamas gives ignorance, dejection, sleep, laziness, grief and the like.

questions.q: Put the first tamas items of unit 25 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Ignorance, dejection, heedlessness, sleep, laziness, hunger and thirst.
questions.rule: अज्ञानम् → विषादः → प्रमादः → निद्रा → आलस्यम् → क्षुत्तृष्णा.

questions.q: Match each tamas word of unit 25 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Tamas traits: ignorance, dejection, heedlessness, grief, hunger and thirst, scheming.
questions.rule: अज्ञान, विषाद, प्रमाद, शोक, क्षुत्तृष्णा, पराभिसंधान.
questions.teaches: पराभिसंधान: पर (others) + अभिसंधान (scheming), scheming against others.

questions.q: Which split of क्षुत्तृष्णा in unit 25 is right?
optionExplain: त्तृष्णा is not a word; the word is तृष्णा, thirst.
क्षुत्त and ऋष्णा are not the words of the pair.
क्षुता is not the word; hunger is क्षुध्.
Right: A final ध् becomes त् before the unvoiced त: क्षुध् + तृष्णा → क्षुत्तृष्णा.
questions.explain: क्षुध् (hunger) + तृष्णा (thirst) = क्षुत्तृष्णा.

questions.q: Which of these does unit 25 assign to tamas?
optionExplain: Right: निद्रा is in the tamas list.
Purity is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Right: मात्सर्य्यं is in the tamas list (it is in unit 24 too).
Courtesy is born of pure sattva (unit 23).
Right: आलस्यं is in the tamas list.
questions.explain: Sleep, envy and laziness are tāmasa; purity and courtesy are sattva's.

questions.q: By the rule of तामसानि + अज्ञानम् → तामसान्यज्ञानम्, how are यदि + अपि (even if) joined?
optionExplain: Right: इ before अ becomes य्, as तामसानि + अज्ञानम् → तामसान्यज्ञानम्.
ई comes from इ + इ, not from इ + अ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + अ.
The इ is not dropped; it becomes य्.
questions.explain: यदि + अपि = यद्यपि, like तामसानि + अज्ञानम् = तामसान्यज्ञानम्.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: तामसानि + अज्ञानम् → तामसान्यज्ञानम्.

questions.q: By unit 26, what is sattva said to be?
optionExplain: Unit 26 does not name the body; unit 28 calls the body bhūtātmaka.
Right: तत्र सत्त्वं मनः: among these, sattva is the mind.
The skins come later, from unit 30; unit 26 does not name them.
Prāṇa is not named in unit 26.
questions.explain: Sattva is the mind: सत्त्वं मनः.
questions.rule: तत्र सत्त्वं मनः = among these, sattva is the mind.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 26 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Among these, sattva, (is) the mind.

questions.q: तत्र सत्वं ____: type the word for 'mind' in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तत्र सत्त्वं मनः: the last word, मनः, is the mind (nominative of मनस्).
questions.teaches: मनस् (n.) = mind; its nominative singular is मनः. Unit 26 names sattva as the mind.

questions.q: In unit 26, how is the verb 'is' given?
options: By मनः, which is a verb form
It is not written but understood
optionExplain: तत्र is an indeclinable: 'among these'.
मनः is a noun, the mind, neuter nominative singular.
Right: The data notes: copula understood.
सत्त्वम् is a noun, neuter nominative singular.
questions.explain: No verb is written; 'is' is understood between सत्त्वम् and मनः.
questions.rule: Sanskrit often leaves 'is' unwritten: सत्त्वं मनः = sattva (is) the mind.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 26 are right by the card?
options: Sattva is named as the mind
Rajas is named as the mind
It says the mind is made of the elements
The verb 'is' is understood, not written
optionExplain: Right: तत्र सत्वं मनः (= सत्त्वम्).
Unit 26 names sattva, not rajas.
Unit 26 says nothing about what the mind is made of.
Right: the data notes the copula is understood.
questions.explain: Sattva is the mind; the verb is understood.

questions.q: By the rule of सत्वं मनः, how is फलम् + ददाति (gives fruit) written in a new example?
optionExplain: ओ comes from a visarga after अ, not from a final म्.
A final म् is not simply dropped before a consonant.
र् comes from a visarga after vowels other than अ/आ, not from म्.
Right: Inside a sentence a final म् before a consonant is written ं, as सत्त्वम् + मनः → सत्त्वं मनः.
questions.explain: फलम् + ददाति = फलं ददाति, like सत्त्वम् + मनः = सत्त्वं मनः.
questions.teaches: Inside a sentence a word-final म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra: सत्त्वम् + मनः → सत्त्वं मनः.

questions.q: By unit 27, what is the disturbance (upaplava) of sattva, the mind?
optionExplain: Right: रजस्तमश्च: rajas and tamas.
These are doṣas of the body; unit 27 names rajas and tamas.
These are elements; unit 27 does not name them.
Sattva is the mind itself; its disturbance is rajas and tamas.
questions.explain: Its disturbance is rajas and tamas.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 27 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Its disturbance (is) rajas and tamas: thus.
questions.rule: तस्य → उपप्लवः → रजः → तमः → च इति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 27 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Of it, the disturbance, rajas and tamas, and, thus.
questions.teaches: उपप्लव = disturbance or affliction; unit 27 gives rajas and tamas as that of sattva, the mind.

questions.q: Which split of तस्योपप्लवो is right?
optionExplain: ओपप्लव is not a word; the word is उपप्लव.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: तस्य + उपप्लवः → तस्योपप्लवः.
तस्यो and पप्लव are not words here.
तस्याः + उ would stay apart as तस्या उपप्लवः.
questions.explain: तस्य (of it) + उपप्लवः (disturbance): अ + उ → ओ.

questions.q: Why is उपप्लवः written उपप्लवो before रजः in unit 27?
options: अः before any consonant becomes ओ
ओ is the ending of a dual noun
अः before voiced र becomes ओ
अः before a vowel becomes ओ here
optionExplain: Before an unvoiced sound such as त or प it does not become ओ.
उपप्लवः is singular; ओ comes from the visarga rule.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant such as र becomes ओ: उपप्लवः + रजः → उपप्लवो रजः.
रजः begins with र, a consonant, not a vowel.
questions.explain: अः + voiced consonant → ओ: उपप्लवो रजः.

questions.q: By the rule of तमश्च, how is रामः + च (and Rāma) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: ओ comes before a voiced sound; च is unvoiced.
स् comes before त or थ, not before च.
र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, and only before a voiced sound.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्, as तमः + च → तमश्च.
questions.explain: रामः + च = रामश्च, like तमः + च = तमश्च.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्: तमः + च → तमश्च.

questions.q: By unit 28, what do they call the body (deha)?
optionExplain: Right: भूतात्मकं देहम्: the body consisting of the elements (bhūta).
Unit 28 says the body consists of the elements, not the mind.
Sattva is named the mind in unit 26; unit 28 speaks of the elements.
The opposite: the body consists of the elements.
questions.explain: They call the body bhūtātmaka.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 28 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Thus, consisting of the elements, the body, they call.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 28 to its meaning.
pairs: consisting of, having as its nature
questions.explain: Thus they call the body consisting of the elements.
questions.teaches: भूतात्मक (bahuvrīhi) = having the elements as its nature, consisting of the elements.

questions.q: Which split of भूतात्मकं is right?
optionExplain: इ + आ would give या: भूत्यात्मकम्.
Right: अ + आ → आ: भूत + आत्मकम् → भूतात्मकम्.
A visarga after अ drops before आ and the words stay apart: भूत आत्मकम्.
म् before a vowel joins it: भूतमात्मकम्.
questions.explain: भूत (element) + आत्मकम् (consisting of): अ + आ → आ.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 28 are right by the card?
options: The author speaks in the first person
'They' who say it are not named
देहम् is the object of आहुः
The body is called free of the elements
optionExplain: आहुः is third person plural: they say.
Right: the data notes that 'they' is unspecified.
Right: देहम् is accusative: they call the body ...
It is called भूतात्मक, consisting of the elements.
questions.explain: Unnamed 'they' call the body (accusative) bhūtātmaka.

questions.q: By the rule of देहमाहुः, how is गृहम् + आगच्छति (comes home) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: The anusvāra stands for म् only before a consonant, not before a vowel.
ओ comes from a visarga after अ, not from म्.
Right: Before a vowel a final म् stays म् and joins it, as देहम् + आहुः → देहमाहुः.
The म् is not dropped before a vowel.
questions.explain: गृहम् + आगच्छति = गृहमागच्छति, like देहम् + आहुः = देहमाहुः.
questions.rule: Final म् + vowel → म् joined to the vowel.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a vowel stays म् and joins the vowel: देहम् + आहुः → देहमाहुः.

questions.q: By unit 29, what of the body is announced again?
optionExplain: Upaplava is said of sattva, the mind, in unit 27.
No healing is named in unit 29.
No death is named in unit 29.
Right: तस्य पुनः प्रविभागः: again, its division.
questions.explain: Again, its division.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 29 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of it, again, the division.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 29 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Again, the division of it, the body.
questions.teaches: प्रविभाग = division or classification; तस्य here points back to the body (देह) of unit 28.

questions.q: By the card, what does तस्य (of it) in unit 29 refer to?
optionExplain: Right: The data notes: तस्य refers to the body of line 29 (card 28).
That is the तस्य of unit 27; here it is the body.
Blood is named only later; तस्य points back, to the body.
The skins come later; तस्य points back, to the body.
questions.explain: तस्य = of the body (देह), named in unit 28.
questions.rule: तस्य पुनः प्रविभागः = again, the division of the body.

questions.q: Unit 29 has no verb. How is it read by the card?
options: As a sentence whose verb is पुनः
As a question about the division
As the close of the list of skins
optionExplain: पुनः is an indeclinable, 'again', not a verb.
Right: The data calls it an elliptical fragment without a verb.
Nothing in unit 29 marks a question.
The skins are named later; unit 29 names none.
questions.explain: A verbless fragment: तस्य पुनः प्रविभागः.

questions.q: By the rule of पुनः प्रविभागः, how is बालः + पठति (the boy reads) written in a new example?
optionExplain: ओ comes only before a voiced sound; प is unvoiced.
र् does not come from a visarga after अ.
Right: Before प the visarga stays, as पुनः + प्रविभागः → पुनः प्रविभागः.
स् comes before त or थ, not before प.
questions.explain: बालः + पठति = बालः पठति, like पुनः प्रविभागः.
questions.teaches: Before क, ख, प, फ the visarga stays as it is: पुनः + प्रविभागः → पुनः प्रविभागः.

questions.q: By unit 30, which item opens the list of the body's division?
optionExplain: Bones are named in the list, but much later.
Marma comes near the end of the list.
Hair comes near the end of the list.
Right: त्वचः is the first word of the list.
questions.explain: The list opens with त्वचः, the skins.

questions.q: Put the first five items of unit 30 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Skins, kalās, doṣas, dhātus, malas: the list's opening.

questions.q: Match each body term of unit 30 to the card's identification.
questions.explain: Only peśī as muscle is standard; the others are probable.
questions.teaches: The data keeps labels: peśī = muscle (standard); sirā, dhamanī, kaṇḍarā, snāyu (probable).

questions.q: Which identification in unit 30 is labelled standard on the card?
optionExplain: Right: The data labels peśī = muscle standard.
Sirā as vein is labelled probable.
Kaṇḍarā as tendon is labelled probable.
Snāyu as ligament is labelled probable.
questions.explain: Peśī = muscle is the one standard identification.
questions.rule: Keep the data's labels: standard or probable.

questions.q: Which of these does the list of unit 30 name?
optionExplain: Nails are not in the list; it names hair of the head, beard and body hair.
Teeth are not in the list.
Right: मर्माणि is in the list.
Right: पेश्यः is in the list.
questions.explain: Marma and peśī are named; nails and teeth are not.
questions.rule: Only the items the list names belong to it.

questions.q: By the rule of अस्थीन्यस्थिसंधयः, how is फलानि + अत्र (fruits here) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from इ + अ.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्, as अस्थीनि + अस्थि → अस्थीन्यस्थि.
The अ of अत्र is not lost; इ becomes य्.
इ + अ keeps a short अ: न्य, not न्या.
questions.explain: फलानि + अत्र = फलान्यत्र, like अस्थीनि + अस्थिसंधयः = अस्थीन्यस्थिसंधयः.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: अस्थीनि + अस्थिसंधयः → अस्थीन्यस्थिसंधयः.

questions.q: By unit 31, how many skins (tvac) come into being?
optionExplain: The line says षट्, six.
The line says षट्, six.
Right: षट् त्वचो भवन्ति: six skins come into being.
The line says षट्, six.
questions.explain: षट् = six.

questions.q: Put the phrases of unit 31 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Among these, from blood, being cooked, like milk's, films, six skins come into being.
questions.rule: तत्रासृजः → पच्यमानस्य → क्षीरस्येव → संतानिकाः → षट् त्वचो भवंति.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 31 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Blood being cooked; like the films of milk.
questions.teaches: सन्तानिका = the creamy film or layer that forms on milk; unit 31 likens the skins to it.

questions.q: Which split of क्षीरस्येव is right?
optionExplain: अ + ए would give ऐ: क्षीरस्यैव.
क्षीरस्ये is not a form of क्षीर.
स्येव is not a word.
Right: अ + इ → ए: क्षीरस्य + इव → क्षीरस्येव (like ... of milk).
questions.explain: क्षीरस्य (of milk) + इव (like): अ + इ → ए.

questions.q: In 'six skins come into being from blood being cooked, like the films of water', which word is wrong?
optionExplain: Right: क्षीरस्येव = like ... of milk, not water.
षट् is six; 'six' is right.
असृज् is blood; 'blood' is right.
सन्तानिका is film; 'films' is right.
questions.explain: The comparison is with the films of milk.
questions.rule: क्षीरस्येव संतानिकाः = like the films of milk.

questions.q: By the rule of तत्रासृजः, how is अत्र + अस्ति (is here) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as तत्र + असृजः → तत्रासृजः.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
Two short अ join into a long आ, not a short अ.
questions.explain: अत्र + अस्ति = अत्रास्ति, like तत्र + असृजः = तत्रासृजः.
questions.teaches: Two short अ join into long आ: तत्र + असृजः → तत्रासृजः.

questions.q: By unit 32, the clarity (prasāda) of what follows from the clarity of the skin?
optionExplain: The mind is not named in unit 32.
Milk is a comparison in unit 31; unit 32 names blood.
Right: त्वक्प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य प्रसादः: of the blood.
Bones are not named in unit 32.
questions.explain: From the skin's clarity, the blood's clarity.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 32 in the line's order.
questions.explain: From the skin's clarity, of the blood, the clarity.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 32 to its meaning.
questions.explain: From the clarity of the skin, the clarity of the blood.
questions.teaches: प्रसाद = clarity, purity (perhaps 'essence'); -आत् marks the ablative, 'from'.

questions.q: Which split of त्वक्प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य is right?
optionExplain: अः before र would give ओ: प्रसादो रक्तस्य.
म् before र would be written ं: प्रसादं रक्तस्य.
द्रक्तस्य is not a word.
Right: त् becomes द् before the voiced र: प्रसादात् + रक्तस्य → प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य.
questions.explain: त्वक्प्रसादात् (from the skin's clarity) + रक्तस्य (of the blood).

questions.q: Why is the skin-word त्वक् and not त्वच् in त्वक्प्रसाद?
options: Final च् becomes क् before the consonant प
च् becomes क् before every vowel
The print has misspelled त्वच् here
optionExplain: Right: At the end of a compound member च् becomes क् before प.
त्वक् is the skin; 'from' is the ablative ending of प्रसादात्.
Before a vowel च् stays: त्वचः, त्वचो.
No flag: त्वक् is the regular form before प.
questions.explain: त्वच् + प्रसाद → त्वक्प्रसाद: च् → क् before a consonant.
questions.rule: Final च् before a consonant → क्.

questions.q: By the rule of प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य, how is तस्मात् + गच्छति (therefore goes) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: Before a voiced sound त् does not stay त्.
Right: त् before the voiced ग becomes द्, as प्रसादात् + रक्तस्य → प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य.
त् does not become र्.
त् may become न् (optionally) only before a nasal; ग is not a nasal.
questions.explain: तस्मात् + गच्छति = तस्माद्गच्छति, like प्रसादात् + रक्तस्य = प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य.
questions.teaches: A final त् becomes द् before a voiced consonant such as र or ग: प्रसादात् + रक्तस्य → प्रसादाद्रक्तस्य.

questions.q: By unit 33, what is the first skin called?
options: The one that seats all kuṣṭha
optionExplain: Asṛgdharā is the second skin (unit 34).
Prāṇadharā is the sixth skin (unit 38).
Right: तासामुदकधरा चाद्या: the first is udakadharā.
That is the fourth skin (unit 36).
questions.explain: The first skin is udakadharā.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 33 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of these, udakadharā, and, the first.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 33 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Of these, the first is the water-bearing one.
questions.teaches: उदकधरा = water-bearing (उदक water + धरा bearing), the name of the first skin.

questions.q: Which split of चाद्या is right?
optionExplain: म् before a vowel joins it: चमाद्या.
A visarga after अ drops before आ and the words stay apart: च आद्या.
चाद् and या are not the words here.
Right: अ + आ → आ: च + आद्या → चाद्या.
questions.explain: च (and) + आद्या (first): अ + आ → आ.

questions.q: By the card, what does तासाम् (of these) in unit 33 refer to?
optionExplain: Right: The data notes: the six (or seven) skins are meant.
उदक is part of the first skin's name, and it is neuter; तासाम् is feminine.
The elements are not meant here; the list is of skins.
The doṣas are not meant here; the list is of skins.
questions.explain: तासाम् = of these skins.

questions.q: By the rule of चाद्या, how is न + आगच्छति (does not come) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + आ.
Right: अ + आ → आ, as च + आद्या → चाद्या.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + आ.
अ + आ gives a long आ, not a short अ.
questions.explain: न + आगच्छति = नागच्छति, like च + आद्या = चाद्या.
questions.teaches: अ followed by आ joins into one long आ: च + आद्या → चाद्या.

questions.q: By unit 34, what is the second skin called?
options: The seat of sidhma and kilāsa
optionExplain: Udakadharā is the first skin (unit 33).
Prāṇadharā is the sixth skin (unit 38).
Right: द्वितीयाऽसृग्धरा: the second is asṛgdharā.
That is the third skin (unit 35).
questions.explain: The second skin is asṛgdharā.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 34 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The second is the blood-bearing one.

questions.q: असृग्धरा = ____ + धरा: type the word for 'blood' in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: असृज् (blood) + धरा (bearing) = असृग्धरा: ज् becomes ग् before the voiced ध.
questions.teaches: असृज् = blood (as असृजः in unit 31); in a compound before ध it is written असृग्.

questions.q: Why does the print show ऽ in द्वितीयाऽसृग्धरा?
options: It marks a lost अ after ए or ओ here
It marks a long pause in the reading
It shows that असृग्धरा is negated
A print habit: आ + अ already gives आ
optionExplain: The vowel before it is आ, not ए or ओ.
The ऽ is not a pause mark.
Nothing is negated; no न or अ- of negation.
Right: The data notes the ऽ after -आ as a print habit; no flag.
questions.explain: द्वितीया + असृग्धरा → द्वितीयासृग्धरा; the ऽ is only the printer's habit.
questions.rule: आ + अ → आ; the printed ऽ adds nothing.

questions.q: How do द्वितीया + असृग्धरा join by the vowel rule?
optionExplain: Right: आ and अ join into one long आ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from आ + अ.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from आ + अ.
आ + अ gives a long आ, not a short अ.
questions.explain: द्वितीया + असृग्धरा = द्वितीयासृग्धरा.

questions.q: By the rule of असृग्धरा, how is वाच् + देवी (goddess of speech) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: A final च् does not stay before a consonant.
Right: Final च् becomes क्, and before the voiced द it is voiced ग्, as असृज् + धरा → असृग्धरा.
Before the voiced द the क् must be voiced: ग्.
A final च् does not become ज्.
questions.explain: वाच् + देवी = वाग्देवी, like असृज् + धरा = असृग्धरा.
questions.teaches: A final च् or ज् of a compound member becomes ग् before a voiced consonant: असृज् + धरा → असृग्धरा.

questions.q: By unit 35, the third skin is the seat of which diseases?
optionExplain: Those belong to the fifth skin (unit 37).
That is the fourth skin (unit 36).
Right: सिध्मकिलासाधिष्ठाना: the seat of sidhma and kilāsa.
Sores (arus) at the joints are tied to the sixth skin (unit 39).
questions.explain: The third skin seats sidhma and kilāsa.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 35 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Third; sidhma, kilāsa; seat.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 35 to the card's meaning.
questions.explain: The third is the seat of sidhma and kilāsa.
questions.teaches: सिध्म = a patchy skin disease, probably pityriasis versicolor (disputed); किलास = probably vitiligo.

questions.q: How does the card label the identification of kilāsa as vitiligo?
optionExplain: Standard is not the tag for kilāsa.
Disputed is the tag for sidhma, not kilāsa.
Kilāsa is given a probable identification.
Right: The data tags kilāsa probable.
questions.explain: Kilāsa = vitiligo, probable; sidhma, disputed.
questions.rule: Keep the data's labels: kilāsa probable, sidhma disputed.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 35 are right by the card?
options: The third skin is a seat of kilāsa
Unit 35 gives a treatment for sidhma
The identity of sidhma is disputed
optionExplain: Kilāsa as vitiligo is only probable.
Right: सिध्मकिलासाधिष्ठाना.
No treatment is named in unit 35.
Right: the data tags sidhma disputed.
questions.explain: The third skin seats sidhma (disputed identity) and kilāsa (probably vitiligo).

questions.q: By the rule of किलासाधिष्ठाना, how is ज्वर + अधिष्ठाना (seat of fever) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: Right: अ + अ → आ, as किलास + अधिष्ठाना → किलासाधिष्ठाना.
ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
Two short अ give a long आ, not a short अ.
questions.explain: ज्वर + अधिष्ठाना = ज्वराधिष्ठाना, like किलास + अधिष्ठाना = किलासाधिष्ठाना.
questions.teaches: Two short अ join into long आ: किलास + अधिष्ठाना → किलासाधिष्ठाना.

questions.q: By unit 36, the fourth skin is the seat of what?
optionExplain: सर्व means all, not one.
Right: सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना: the seat of all kuṣṭha.
Those belong to the third skin (unit 35).
Those belong to the fifth skin (unit 37).
questions.explain: The fourth skin seats all kuṣṭhas.

questions.q: Put the parts of unit 36 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Fourth; all; kuṣṭha; seat.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 36 to its meaning.
pairs: chronic skin diseases, leprosy among them
questions.explain: The fourth is the seat of all kuṣṭha.
questions.teaches: कुष्ठ = the group of chronic skin diseases, leprosy among them (standard identification).

questions.q: In the translation: the fourth is the seat of some kuṣṭhas, which word is wrong?
optionExplain: चतुर्थी is the fourth; 'fourth' is right.
अधिष्ठान is the seat; 'seat' is right.
Right: सर्वकुष्ठ = all kuṣṭha.
कुष्ठ is named; 'kuṣṭhas' is right.
questions.explain: The fourth is the seat of all kuṣṭhas.

questions.q: चतुर्थी ____कुष्ठाधिष्ठाना: type the word for 'all' in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: चतुर्थी सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना: the seat of all kuṣṭha.
questions.teaches: सर्व = all; it opens the compound सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना.

questions.q: In a new example, which nominative bahuvrīhi agrees with one feminine skin (त्वक्) as seat of all diseases (रोग)?
optionExplain: Masculine singular; the skin is feminine.
Feminine dual; only one skin is meant.
Feminine plural; only one skin is meant.
Right: Feminine singular in -आ, as सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना agrees with the feminine skin.
questions.explain: One feminine skin: सर्वरोगाधिष्ठाना, like चतुर्थी सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना.
questions.rule: A bahuvrīhi takes the gender and number of what it describes.
questions.teaches: A bahuvrīhi agrees with its noun: सर्वकुष्ठाधिष्ठाना is feminine singular for one skin (त्वच्, f.).

questions.q: By unit 37, which disease of sure identity has the fifth skin as its seat?
optionExplain: Right: विद्रध्यधिष्ठाना: the seat of vidradhi (abscess, standard).
Kilāsa belongs to the third skin (unit 35).
Kuṣṭha belongs to the fourth skin (unit 36).
Sidhma belongs to the third skin (unit 35).
questions.explain: The fifth skin seats vidradhi (and alajī).

questions.q: Match each word of unit 37 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The fifth, again, is the seat of vidradhi (and alajī).

questions.q: Which split of विद्रध्यधिष्ठाना is right?
optionExplain: धिष्ठाना is not a word; the word is अधिष्ठाना.
Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: विद्रधि + अधिष्ठाना → विद्रध्यधिष्ठाना.
ए + अ would give एऽ: विद्रधेऽधिष्ठाना.
इः before a vowel would give इर्: विद्रधिरधिष्ठाना.
questions.explain: विद्रधि (abscess) + अधिष्ठाना (seat): इ + अ → य.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: विद्रधि + अधिष्ठाना → विद्रध्यधिष्ठाना.

questions.q: Why does पुनः appear as पुनर् in पुनरल्जी?
options: Its र् shows before a vowel
optionExplain: No flag marks पुनर्; it is the regular form before a vowel.
पुनर् means again; the fifth is पञ्चमी.
Right: पुनर् keeps its र् before a vowel; here before अ.
Before an unvoiced consonant it is ः, as पुनः प्रविभागः.
questions.explain: पुनर् + vowel → पुनर; before प it is पुनः (unit 29).

questions.q: Which statements about unit 37 are right by the card?
options: The fifth skin is a seat of vidradhi
The fifth skin is called prāṇadharā
Vidradhi is identified as an abscess
Unit 37 gives a treatment for abscess
optionExplain: Right: विद्रध्यधिष्ठाना.
Prāṇadharā is the sixth skin (unit 38).
Right: vidradhi = abscess, standard.
No treatment is named in unit 37.
questions.explain: The fifth skin seats vidradhi, an abscess.

questions.q: By the rule of पुनरल्जी, how is पुनः + आगच्छति (comes again) joined in a new example?
optionExplain: ओ comes from अः before a voiced sound, not from पुनर्.
The र् of पुनर् is not dropped before a vowel.
श् comes before च, छ or श, not before a vowel.
Right: पुनर् keeps its र् before a vowel, as in पुनरल्जी.
questions.explain: पुनः + आगच्छति = पुनरागच्छति, like पुनर् + अल्जी = पुनरल्जी.
questions.teaches: पुनः (from पुनर्) shows its र् before a vowel: पुनरल्जी, पुनरागच्छति.

questions.q: By unit 38, what is the sixth skin called?
options: The seat of all the kuṣṭhas
optionExplain: Right: षष्ठी तु प्राणधरा: the sixth is prāṇadharā.
Udakadharā is the first skin (unit 33).
Asṛgdharā is the second skin (unit 34).
That is the fourth skin (unit 36).
questions.explain: The sixth skin is prāṇadharā.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 38 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The sixth, however, life-bearing.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 38 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sixth, however, is the life-bearing one.
questions.teaches: प्राणधरा = life-bearing (प्राण life-breath + धरा bearing), the name of the sixth skin.

questions.q: What does तु mean in षष्ठी तु प्राणधरा?
optionExplain: 'You' is त्वम्; तु is an indeclinable.
Right: The data glosses तु as 'but, however'.
'Not' is न; तु is 'but, however'.
No verb is written; तु is not a verb.
questions.explain: तु = but, however.

questions.q: ____ तु प्राणधरा: type the word for 'sixth' (feminine) in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: षष्ठी तु प्राणधरा: the sixth, however, is prāṇadharā.
questions.teaches: षष्ठी = sixth, feminine (of षष्ठ), agreeing with the feminine skin.

questions.q: By the rule of षष्ठी, which form means the eighth night (रात्रिः, feminine) in a new example?
optionExplain: अष्टमः is masculine; रात्रि is feminine.
The feminine of अष्टम is अष्टमी, not अष्टमा.
Right: Ordinals from the fourth on make the feminine in -ई, as षष्ठ → षष्ठी.
अष्टमम् is neuter; रात्रि is feminine.
questions.explain: अष्टम → अष्टमी (f.), like षष्ठ → षष्ठी.
questions.rule: Ordinals from चतुर्थ on: feminine in -ई.
questions.teaches: Ordinals from the fourth on form the feminine in -ई (चतुर्थी, पञ्चमी, षष्ठी); प्रथमा, द्वितीया, तृतीया take -आ.

questions.q: By unit 39, what happens to a person when this skin is cut?
options: One loses all feeling in the skin of the limbs
Blood and fat flow out of the cut in a stream
The skin heals at once and leaves no mark
One faints and enters darkness, as it were
optionExplain: Loss of feeling is not named in unit 39.
No flow of blood or fat is named in unit 39.
Healing is not named; the unit says one faints.
Right: ताम्यति, अन्धमिव च तमः प्रविशति: one faints and enters darkness.
questions.explain: When it is cut, one faints and, as it were, enters blinding darkness.
questions.rule: यस्यां छिन्नायां ताम्यति, अन्धमिव च तमः प्रविशति.

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 39 in the line's order.
questions.explain: When it is cut, one faints and enters darkness; resting on it, sores arise at the joints, black-red, thick-rooted, most difficult to treat.
questions.rule: यस्यां छिन्नायां → ताम्यति ... प्रविशति → यां चाधिष्ठायारूंषि जायंते → पर्वसु → कृष्णरक्तानि स्थूलमूलानि → दुश्चिकित्स्यतमानि.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 39 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Cut, one faints; the sores at the joints are thick-rooted and most difficult to treat.
questions.teaches: अरुस् (plural अरूंषि) = sores, wounds; they arise resting on (अधिष्ठाय) the sixth skin.

questions.q: Which split of ताम्यत्यंधम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ before a different vowel becomes य्: ताम्यति + अन्धम् → ताम्यत्यन्धम्.
यन्धम् is not a word; the word is अन्धम् (blind).
ताम्यत्य is not a form; the verb is ताम्यति (faints).
ए + अ would give ताम्यतेऽन्धम्, with ए kept and ऽ.
questions.explain: ताम्यति (faints) + अन्धम् (blind): इ + अ → य.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.

questions.q: Which features of the sores (arus) does unit 39 name?
options: They heal by themselves in a few days
They are most difficult to treat
They arise only on the face
optionExplain: Right: पर्वसु, at the joints.
Right: स्थूलमूलानि.
The unit says the opposite: most difficult to treat.
Right: दुश्चिकित्स्यतमानि.
The unit names the joints, not the face.
questions.explain: At the joints, thick-rooted, most difficult to treat (and black-red).

questions.q: By the pattern of दुश्चिकित्स्यतम (most difficult to treat), what does प्रियतम mean?
optionExplain: 'Dearer' would be -तर (प्रियतर), not -तम.
Right: -तम marks the highest degree, as in दुश्चिकित्स्य-तम.
Nothing in -तम makes a negative.
-तम is a degree suffix, not a causative.
questions.explain: प्रियतम = dearest, like दुश्चिकित्स्यतम = most difficult to treat.
questions.teaches: The suffix -तम makes 'most': दुश्चिकित्स्य (hard to treat) + तम = most difficult to treat.

questions.q: By unit 40, how many skins do the others speak of?
optionExplain: Six is the view of units 31-39; the others say seven.
Five is not the number in unit 40.
Right: सप्त त्वचः: seven skins.
Eight is not the number in unit 40.
questions.explain: Others, however, speak of seven skins.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 40 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Others, however, seven skins speak of.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 40 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Others, however, say there are seven skins.
questions.teaches: अन्ये तु ... वदन्ति = 'others, however, say': it brings in another opinion (मतान्तर).
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Why is त्वचः printed त्वचो before वदंति in unit 40?
options: ओ is a plural ending of त्वच्
अः becomes ओ before any consonant
After अ the visarga drops before व
अः becomes ओ before a voiced consonant
optionExplain: The form is त्वचः; the ओ comes from sandhi.
Before unvoiced sounds it stays or becomes श्/ष्/स्.
After अ it becomes ओ here; the plain drop is after आ.
Right: व is a voiced consonant, so त्वचः + वदंति → त्वचो वदंति.
questions.explain: त्वचः + वदंति = त्वचो वदंति: अः before a voiced consonant → ओ.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: In unit 40 the others say there are ____ skins. Type the number word in Devanagari or in English letters (e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: सप्त = seven: अन्ये तु सप्त त्वचो वदंति.
questions.teaches: सप्त = seven, the others' count of the skins.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By the rule of त्वचो वदंति, how is बालः + गच्छति (the boy goes) joined?
optionExplain: Right: अः before the voiced ग becomes ओ, as त्वचः + वदंति.
The visarga drops this way after आ; बालः has a short अ.
र् comes from a visarga after vowels other than अ and आ.
Before a voiced sound the visarga after अ does not stay.
questions.explain: बालः + गच्छति = बालो गच्छति, like त्वचः + वदंति = त्वचो वदंति.
questions.teaches: A visarga after short अ becomes ओ before a voiced consonant: त्वचः + वदंति → त्वचो वदंति.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 41, what is the first skin of the seven called?
optionExplain: Lohinī is the second (unit 42).
Right: तत्र प्रथमा भासिनी नाम: the first is named Bhāsinī.
Rohiṇī is the sixth (unit 44).
Śvetā is the third (unit 42).
questions.explain: The first of the seven is Bhāsinī.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 41 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The first is named Bhāsinī, which makes manifest the colours and the five chāyās beginning with kha; it is of an eighteenth part of a vrīhi.
questions.rule: तत्रप्रथमा भासिनी नाम → या वर्णानामवभासिनी → खादीनां च पंचानांछायानां → सा व्रीहेरष्टादशभागप्रमाणा.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 41 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Bhāsinī makes manifest the colours and the five chāyās from kha; it is an eighteenth of a vrīhi.
questions.teaches: -प्रमाणा = 'of the measure of': each of the seven skins is measured in parts of a vrīhi grain.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Which split of व्रीहेरष्टादश is right?
optionExplain: रष्टादश is not a word; the र् comes from the visarga.
इः would give व्रीहिरष्टादश; the data reads व्रीहेः.
Right: After ए, the visarga becomes र् before a vowel.
अः + अ would give व्रीहयोऽष्टादश.
questions.explain: व्रीहेः (of a vrīhi) + अष्टादश (eighteen): एः + vowel → एर्.
questions.rule: A visarga after a vowel other than अ/आ → र् before a vowel.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 41, what does Bhāsinī make manifest?
options: The joints and the bones of the limbs
The heat that digests all the food
The sores that rise at the joints
The colours and five chāyās from kha
optionExplain: Joints and bones are not named in unit 41.
Digestion is not named in unit 41.
The sores belong to the sixth skin of the six (unit 39).
Right: वर्णानामवभासिनी खादीनां च पंचानां छायानाम्.
questions.explain: Bhāsinī makes manifest the colours and the five chāyās beginning with space.
questions.rule: या वर्णानामवभासिनी खादीनां च पंचानां छायानाम्.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By the rule of व्रीहेरष्टादश, how is अग्नेः + अपि (even of fire) joined?
optionExplain: Right: After ए, the visarga becomes र् before a vowel, as व्रीहेः + अष्टादश.
ए + अ → एऽ only with no visarga; here the visarga gives र्.
ओ comes from a visarga after short अ, not after ए.
अय् comes from a bare ए before a vowel, not from एः.
questions.explain: अग्नेः + अपि = अग्नेरपि, like व्रीहेः + अष्टादश = व्रीहेरष्टादश.
questions.teaches: A visarga after ए becomes र् before a vowel: व्रीहेः + अष्टादश → व्रीहेरष्टादश.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 42, what is the measure of Lohinī?
optionExplain: A twelfth part is Śvetā's measure.
Right: षोडशभागप्रमाणा: of a sixteenth part.
An eighteenth part is Bhāsinī's (unit 41).
Two grains is the seventh skin's (unit 45).
questions.explain: Lohinī, the second, is of a sixteenth part.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 42 in the lines' order.
questions.explain: Second, named Lohinī, of a sixteenth part; third, named Śvetā, of a twelfth part.
questions.rule: द्वितीया → लोहिनी नाम → षोडशभागप्रमाणा → तृतीया → श्वेता नाम → द्वादशभागप्रमाणा.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 42 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Second (Lohinī) a sixteenth part; third (Śvetā) a twelfth part.
questions.teaches: षोडश = sixteen, द्वादश = twelve: the fraction of a vrīhi that measures each skin.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Which pairing is right by unit 42?
options: Śvetā: the second, a sixteenth part
Lohinī: the third, a twelfth part
Śvetā: the third, a twelfth part
Lohinī: the second, a twelfth part
optionExplain: The second, of a sixteenth part, is Lohinī.
Lohinī is the second, of a sixteenth part.
Right: तृतीया श्वेता नाम द्वादशभागप्रमाणा.
Lohinī's measure is a sixteenth part.
questions.explain: Lohinī = second, a sixteenth; Śvetā = third, a twelfth.
questions.rule: द्वितीया लोहिनी षोडश-; तृतीया श्वेता द्वादश-.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Which statements fit unit 42?
options: The word vrīhi is printed in both lines
Lohinī's measure is an eighteenth part
Śvetā's measure is a twelfth part
optionExplain: Not printed: 'of a vrīhi' is carried from unit 41.
Right: द्वितीया लोहिनी नाम.
An eighteenth is Bhāsinī's; Lohinī's is a sixteenth.
Right: द्वादशभागप्रमाणा.
questions.explain: Lohinī is second (a sixteenth), Śvetā third (a twelfth); vrīhi is understood from unit 41.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: द्वितीया agrees with the feminine त्वच्. With शाखा (branch, f.), how is the second branch said?
optionExplain: द्वितीयः is masculine; शाखा is feminine.
द्वितीयम् is neuter; शाखा is feminine.
द्वितीय takes -आ in the feminine; -ई is for चतुर्थी, पञ्चमी.
Right: The feminine of द्वितीय ends in -आ, as द्वितीया (त्वक्).
questions.explain: द्वितीया शाखा = the second branch, as द्वितीया (त्वक्) = the second skin.
questions.rule: An ordinal agrees in gender: द्वितीय → द्वितीया (f.).
questions.teaches: Ordinals agree with their noun: with the feminine त्वच्, द्वितीय → द्वितीया, तृतीय → तृतीया.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 43, what is the fifth skin named?
optionExplain: Right: पंचमी वेदिनी नाम: the fifth is named Vedinī.
Tāmrā is the fourth.
Rohiṇī is the sixth (unit 44).
Śvetā is the third (unit 42).
questions.explain: The fifth skin is Vedinī.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put these words of unit 43 in the lines' order.
questions.explain: Fourth, named Tāmrā, of an eighth part; fifth, named Vedinī, of a fifth part.
questions.rule: चतुर्थी → ताम्रा नाम → अष्टभागप्रमाणा → पंचमी → वेदिनी नाम → पंचभागप्रमाणा.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 43 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Fourth (Tāmrā) an eighth; fifth (Vedinī) a fifth.
questions.teaches: चतुर्थी, पञ्चमी are feminine ordinals in -ई (fourth, fifth), agreeing with त्वच्.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: The print runs ताम्रानामाष्टभाग together. Which split of नामाष्टभाग is right?
optionExplain: नाम has no visarga; अः + अ would give नामोऽष्ट.
Right: अ + अ → आ: नाम + अष्ट → नामाष्ट.
ए + अ would give नामेऽष्ट, with ए kept.
ष्टभाग is not a word; the numeral is अष्ट.
questions.explain: नाम (named) + अष्टभाग (an eighth part): अ + अ → आ.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 43, which skin has the measure of an eighth part?
optionExplain: Vedinī is of a fifth part.
Lohinī is of a sixteenth part (unit 42).
Right: चतुर्थी ताम्रा नाम अष्टभागप्रमाणा.
Rohiṇī is of one vrīhi (unit 44).
questions.explain: Tāmrā, the fourth, is of an eighth part.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By the rule of नाम + अष्ट → नामाष्ट, how is च + अपि (and also) joined?
optionExplain: ए comes from अ + इ, not from अ + अ.
ओ comes from अ + उ, not from अ + अ.
ऽ marks an अ dropped after ए or ओ, not after अ.
Right: अ + अ → आ, as नाम + अष्ट → नामाष्ट.
questions.explain: च + अपि = चापि, like नाम + अष्टभाग = नामाष्टभाग.
questions.teaches: A short अ meeting a short अ gives long आ: नाम + अष्टभाग → नामाष्टभाग.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 44, what is the measure of Rohiṇī?
options: A fifth part of a grain
An eighth part of a grain
optionExplain: Right: व्रीहिप्रमाणा: of the measure of a vrīhi.
Two grains is the seventh skin's (unit 45).
A fifth part is Vedinī's (unit 43).
An eighth part is Tāmrā's (unit 43).
questions.explain: Rohiṇī is of the measure of one vrīhi.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 44 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The sixth, Rohiṇī by name, of the measure of a vrīhi.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 44 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The sixth, named Rohiṇī, has the measure of a rice grain.
questions.teaches: व्रीहिप्रमाणा = having the measure of a vrīhi: a whole grain, after five fractions.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Which skin of the seven has exactly the measure of one vrīhi?
optionExplain: Māṃsadharā is of two vrīhis (unit 45).
Right: षष्ठी रोहिणी नाम व्रीहिप्रमाणा.
Bhāsinī is of an eighteenth part (unit 41).
Vedinī is of a fifth part (unit 43).
questions.explain: Rohiṇī, the sixth, is of one vrīhi.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Unit 44 is printed षष्ठीरोहिणी. How is it read?
options: षष्ठीर् ओहिणी, with an र् of sandhi
षष्ठी रोहिणी, two words run together
optionExplain: ओहिणी is not a word; the name is रोहिणी.
ईरोहिणी is not a word; the ordinal is षष्ठी.
Right: The data: words run together in the print; no sandhi change.
The data reads षष्ठी, nominative: the sixth.
questions.explain: षष्ठीरोहिणी = षष्ठी रोहिणी: a missing space, nothing more.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By the pattern of व्रीहिप्रमाणा, what does अङ्गुलप्रमाणा (अङ्गुल, a finger-breadth) say of a layer?
options: It has the shape of a finger
It covers all of the fingers
It is thinner than a finger
optionExplain: प्रमाण is measure, not shape.
प्रमाण says how large, not what it covers.
Nothing in -प्रमाणा compares smaller or larger.
Right: -प्रमाणा = having the measure of, as व्रीहिप्रमाणा.
questions.explain: अङ्गुलप्रमाणा = of the measure of a finger-breadth, like व्रीहिप्रमाणा = of the measure of a vrīhi.
questions.rule: X-प्रमाणा = having the measure of X.
questions.teaches: -प्रमाणा after a measure word gives the size: व्रीहिप्रमाणा = of the measure of a rice grain.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: By unit 45, what is the measure of the seventh skin?
optionExplain: Right: व्रीहिद्वयप्रमाणा: of the measure of a pair of vrīhis.
One grain is Rohiṇī's, the sixth (unit 44).
A fifth part is Vedinī's (unit 43).
A twelfth part is Śvetā's (unit 42).
questions.explain: The seventh, Māṃsadharā, is of two vrīhis.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Put the words of unit 45 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The seventh, Māṃsadharā by name, of the measure of two vrīhis.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Match each word of unit 45 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The seventh, flesh-bearing, has the measure of a pair of vrīhis.
questions.teaches: -धरा = 'bearing, holding': मांसधरा = flesh-bearing.
questions.section: मतान्तर: सात त्वचाएँ व उनका प्रमाण

questions.q: Which is right about the name मांसधरा in this chapter?
options: It names only this skin, no other layer
It names this skin and also the first kalā
It names the sixth skin of the six-skin list
It names the second kalā, the blood-bearing
optionExplain: Unit 48 gives the same name to the first kalā.
Right: Data note: the first kalā of unit 48 has the same name.
The sixth of the six is Prāṇadharā (unit 38).
The second kalā is Raktadharā (unit 49).
questions.explain: Māṃsadharā is the seventh skin here and the first kalā in unit 48.
